text: And eft hē ongan hī æt þǣre sǣ lǣran.
text_bare: And eft he ongan hi æt þære sæ læran.

text: And him wæs mycel menegu tō gegaderod, swā þæt hē on scip ēode, and on þǣre sǣ wæs; and eall sēo menegu ymbe þā sǣ wæs on lande.
text_bare: And him wæs mycel menegu to gegaderod, swa þæt he on scip eode, and on þære sæ wæs; and eall seo menegu ymbe þa sæ wæs on lande.

text: And hē hī fela on bigspellum lǣrde, and him tō cwæð on his lāre, Gehȳrað: Ūt ēode sē sǣdere his sǣd tō sawenne.
text_bare: And he hi fela on bigspellum lærde, and him to cwæð on his lare, Gehyrað: Ut eode se sædere his sæd to sawenne.

text: And þā hē sēow, sum fēoll wið þone weg, and fugelas cōmon and hit frǣton.
text_bare: And þa he seow, sum feoll wið þone weg, and fugelas comon and hit fræton.

text: Sum fēoll ofer stānscyligean, þār, hit næfde mycele eorðan, and sōna ūp ēode; and for þām hit næfde eorðan þiccnesse, þā hit ūp ēode, sēo sunne hit forswǣlde, and hit forscranc, for þām hit wyrtruman næfde.
text_bare: Sum feoll ofer stanscyligean, þar, hit næfde mycele eorðan, and sona up eode; and for þam hit næfde eorðan þiccnesse, þa hit up eode, seo sunne hit forswælde, and hit forscranc, for þam hit wyrtruman næfde.

text: And sum fēoll on þornas ; þā stigon ðā þornas and forðrysmodon þæt, and hit wæstm ne bær.
text_bare: And sum feoll on þornas ; þa stigon ða þornas and forðrysmodon þæt, and hit wæstm ne bær.

text: And sum fēoll on gōd land, and hit sealde ūppstīg endne and wexendne wæstm; and ān brōhte þrītig-fealdne, sum syxtigfealne, sum hundfealdne.
text_bare: And sum feoll on god land, and hit sealde uppstig endne and wexendne wæstm; and an brohte þritig-fealdne, sum syxtigfealne, sum hundfealdne.

text: And hē cwæð, Gehyre, sē ðe ēaren hæbbe tō gehȳranne.
text_bare: And he cwæð, Gehyre, se ðe earen hæbbe to gehyranne.

text: And þā hē āna wæs, hine āxodon þæt bigspell þā twelfe þe mid him wǣron.
text_bare: And þa he ana wæs, hine axodon þæt bigspell þa twelfe þe mid him wæron.

text: And hē sǣde him, Ēow is geseald tō witanne Godes rīces gerȳnu; þām þe ūte synt ealle þing on bigspellum gewurþað: þæt hī gesēonde gesēon, and nā ne gesēon; and gehȳrende gehȳren, and ne ongyten; þē lǣs hī hwænne sȳn gecyrrede, and him sīn hyra synna, forgyfene.
text_bare: And he sæde him, Eow is geseald to witanne Godes rices gerynu; þam þe ute synt ealle þing on bigspellum gewurþað: þæt hi geseonde geseon, and na ne geseon; and gehyrende gehyren, and ne ongyten; þe læs hi hwænne syn gecyrrede, and him sin hyra synna, forgyfene.

text: Ðā sǣde hē him Gē nyton þis bigspell?
text_bare: Ða sæde he him Ge nyton þis bigspell?

text: and hū mage gē ealle bigspell witan ?
text_bare: and hu mage ge ealle bigspell witan ?

text: Sē þe sǣwð, word hē sǣwð, Sōðlīce þā synt wið þone weg þār þæt word is gesāwen; and þonne hī hit gehȳrað, sōna cymð Sātanas, and āfyrð þæt word þe on heora heortan āsāwen ys.
text_bare: Se þe sæwð, word he sæwð, Soðlice þa synt wið þone weg þar þæt word is gesawen; and þonne hi hit gehyrað, sona cymð Satanas, and afyrð þæt word þe on heora heortan asawen ys.

text: And þā synt gelīce þe synt ofer þā stānscyligean gesāwen sōna pænne hī þæt word gehȳrað, and þæt mid blisse onfoð; and hī nabbað wyrtruman on him, ac bēoð unstaðolfæste; and syþþan ūp cymð dēofles costnung and his ēhtnys for pām worde, and hrædlīce hī bēoð geuntrēowsode.
text_bare: And þa synt gelice þe synt ofer þa stanscyligean gesawen sona pænne hi þæt word gehyrað, and þæt mid blisse onfoð; and hi nabbað wyrtruman on him, ac beoð unstaðolfæste; and syþþan up cymð deofles costnung and his ehtnys for pam worde, and hrædlice hi beoð geuntreowsode.

text: Hī synd on þornum gesāwen, þæt synd þā ðe þæt word gehȳrað; and of yrmðe and swīcdōme woroldwelena and ōðra gewilnunga þæt word ofþrysmiað, and synt būton wæstme gewordene.
text_bare: Hi synd on þornum gesawen, þæt synd þa ðe þæt word gehyrað; and of yrmðe and swicdome woroldwelena and oðra gewilnunga þæt word ofþrysmiað, and synt buton wæstme gewordene.

text: And þā ðe gesāwene synt ofer þæt gōde land, þā synd þe þæt word gehȳrað and onfōð, and wæstm bringað, sum þrītigfealdne, sum syxtigfealdne, and sum hundfealdne.
text_bare: And þa ðe gesawene synt ofer þæt gode land, þa synd þe þæt word gehyrað and onfoð, and wæstm bringað, sum þritigfealdne, sum syxtigfealdne, and sum hundfealdne.

text: Hē sǣde him, Cwyst þū cymð þæt lēohtfæt þæt hit bēo under bydene āsett, oððe under bedde?
text_bare: He sæde him, Cwyst þu cymð þæt leohtfæt þæt hit beo under bydene asett, oððe under bedde?

text: wite geare þæt hit sȳð ofer eandelstæf āsett.
text_bare: wite geare þæt hit syð ofer eandelstæf asett.

text: Sōðlīce nīs nān ðing behȳdd þe ne sȳ geswutelod ; nē nis dīgle geworden, ac þæt hit openlīce cume.
text_bare: Soðlice nis nan ðing behydd þe ne sy geswutelod ; ne nis digle geworden, ac þæt hit openlice cume.

text: Gehȳre, gif hwð ēaran hæbbe tō gehȳranne.
text_bare: Gehyre, gif hwð earan hæbbe to gehyranne.

text: And hē cwæð tō him, Warniað hwæt gē gehȳran; and on þām gemete þe gē metað, ēow bið gemeten, and ēow bið geīet.
text_bare: And he cwæð to him, Warniað hwæt ge gehyran; and on þam gemete þe ge metað, eow bið gemeten, and eow bið geiet.

text: Þām bið geseald þe hæfð; and þām ðe næfð, ēac þæt hē hæfð him bið ætbrōden.
text_bare: Þam bið geseald þe hæfð; and þam ðe næfð, eac þæt he hæfð him bið ætbroden.

text: And hē cwæð, Godes rīce ys swylce man wurpe gōd sǣd on his land; and slāpe and ārīse dæges and nihtes, and þæt sǣd grōwe and wexe, þonne hē nāt.
text_bare: And he cwæð, Godes rice ys swylce man wurpe god sæd on his land; and slape and arise dæges and nihtes, and þæt sæd growe and wexe, þonne he nat.

text: Sōðlīce sylfwilles sēo eorðe wæstm bereð; ǣrest gærs, syððan ēar, syþþan fullne hwǣte on þām ēare.
text_bare: Soðlice sylfwilles seo eorðe wæstm bereð; ærest gærs, syððan ear, syþþan fullne hwæte on þam eare.

text: And þonne sē wæstm hine forð bringð, sōna hē sent his sicol, for þām þæt rip æt is.
text_bare: And þonne se wæstm hine forð bringð, sona he sent his sicol, for þam þæt rip æt is.

text: And eft hē cwæð, For hwām geanlīcie wē heofena rīce?
text_bare: And eft he cwæð, For hwam geanlicie we heofena rice?

text: oððe hwylcum bigspelle wiðmete wē hit ?
text_bare: oððe hwylcum bigspelle wiðmete we hit ?

text: Swā swā senepes sǣd, þonne hit bið on eorðan gesāwen, hit is ealra sǣda lǣst þe on eorðan synt; and þonne hit āsāwen bið, hit āstīhð, and bið ealra wyrta mǣst, and hæfð swā mycele bōgas þæt heofenes fugelas eardian magon under his sceade.
text_bare: Swa swa senepes sæd, þonne hit bið on eorðan gesawen, hit is ealra sæda læst þe on eorðan synt; and þonne hit asawen bið, hit astihð, and bið ealra wyrta mæst, and hæfð swa mycele bogas þæt heofenes fugelas eardian magon under his sceade.

text: And manegum swylcum bigspellum hē spræc tō him þæt hī mihton gehȳran.
text_bare: And manegum swylcum bigspellum he spræc to him þæt hi mihton gehyran.

text: Ne spæc hē nā būtan bigspelle; eall hē his leorningcnihtum asundron rehte.
text_bare: Ne spæc he na butan bigspelle; eall he his leorningcnihtum asundron rehte.

text: And hē sǣde him þonne ǣfen wæs, Uton faran agēn.
text_bare: And he sæde him þonne æfen wæs, Uton faran agen.

text: And þā menigu forlǣtende, hī onfēngon hine swā hē on scipe wæs.
text_bare: And þa menigu forlætende, hi onfengon hine swa he on scipe wæs.

text: And ōþre scipu wǣron mid him.
text_bare: And oþre scipu wæron mid him.

text: And þā wæs mycel ȳst windes geworden, and ȳpa hē āwearp on þæt scyp, þæt hit gefylled wæs.
text_bare: And þa wæs mycel yst windes geworden, and ypa he awearp on þæt scyp, þæt hit gefylled wæs.

text: And hē wæs on scipe ofer bolster slāpende; and hī āwehton hine, and cwǣdon, Ne belimpð tō pē þæt wē forwurþað?
text_bare: And he wæs on scipe ofer bolster slapende; and hi awehton hine, and cwædon, Ne belimpð to pe þæt we forwurþað?

text: And hē ārās, and þām winde bebēad, and cwæð tō ðǣre sǣ, Suwa and gestille.
text_bare: And he aras, and þam winde bebead, and cwæð to ðære sæ, Suwa and gestille.

text: And sē wind geswāc þā, and wearð mycel smyltnes.
text_bare: And se wind geswac þa, and wearð mycel smyltnes.

text: And hē sǣde him, Hwī synt gē forhte?
text_bare: And he sæde him, Hwi synt ge forhte?

text: gȳt nabbe gē gelēafan?
text_bare: gyt nabbe ge geleafan?

text: And hī micclum ege him ondrēdon, and cwǣdon ǣlc tō ōðrum, Hwæt wēnst þū hwæt is ðēs, þæt him windas and sǣ hȳrsumiað?
text_bare: And hi micclum ege him ondredon, and cwædon ælc to oðrum, Hwæt wenst þu hwæt is ðes, þæt him windas and sæ hyrsumiað?

text: Hit gelamp gīo ðætte ān hearpere wæs on ðǣre ðīode ðe Ðrācia hātte, sīo wæs on Crēca rīce; sē hearpere wæs swīðe ungefrǣglīce good, ðæs nama wæs Orfeus; hē hæfde ān swīðe ǣnlīc wīf, sīo wæs hāten Eurudice.
text_bare: Hit gelamp gio ðætte an hearpere wæs on ðære ðiode ðe Ðracia hatte, sio wæs on Creca rice; se hearpere wæs swiðe ungefræglice good, ðæs nama wæs Orfeus; he hæfde an swiðe ænlic wif, sio wæs haten Eurudice.

text: Ðā ongon mon secgan be ðām hearpere, þæt hē meahte hearpian þæt sē wudu wagode, ond þā stānas hī styredon for þy swēge, ond wildu dīor ðǣr woldon tō irnan ond stondan swilce hī tamu wǣren, swā stille, ðēah him men oððe hundas wið ēoden, ðæt hī hī nā ne onscunedon.
text_bare: Ða ongon mon secgan be ðam hearpere, þæt he meahte hearpian þæt se wudu wagode, ond þa stanas hi styredon for þy swege, ond wildu dior ðær woldon to irnan ond stondan swilce hi tamu wæren, swa stille, ðeah him men oððe hundas wið eoden, ðæt hi hi na ne onscunedon.

text: Ðā sǣdon hī þæt ðæs hearperes wīf sceolde ācwellan, ond hire sāule mon sceolde lǣdan tō helle.
text_bare: Ða sædon hi þæt ðæs hearperes wif sceolde acwellan, ond hire saule mon sceolde lædan to helle.

text: Ðā sceolde sē hearpere weorðan swā sārig, þæt hē ne meahte ongemong ōðrum monnum bīon, ac tēah tō wuda, ond sæt on ðǣm muntum, ǣgðer ge dæges ge nihtes, wēop ond hearpode, ðæt ðā wudas bifedon, on ðā ēa stōdon, ond nān heort ne onscunede nǣnne lēon, nē nān hara nǣnne hund, nēnān nēat nyste nǣnne andan nē nǣnne ege tō ōðrum, for ðǣre mergðe ðæs sōnes.
text_bare: Ða sceolde se hearpere weorðan swa sarig, þæt he ne meahte ongemong oðrum monnum bion, ac teah to wuda, ond sæt on ðæm muntum, ægðer ge dæges ge nihtes, weop ond hearpode, ðæt ða wudas bifedon, on ða ea stodon, ond nan heort ne onscunede nænne leon, ne nan hara nænne hund, nenan neat nyste nænne andan ne nænne ege to oðrum, for ðære mergðe ðæs sones.

text: Ðā ðǣm hearpere ðā ðūhte ðæt hine nānes ðinges ne lyste on ðisse worulde, ðā ðōhte hē ðæt hē wolde gesēcan helle godu, ond onginnan him ōleccan mid his hearpan, ond biddan þæt hī him āgēafen eft his wīf.
text_bare: Ða ðæm hearpere ða ðuhte ðæt hine nanes ðinges ne lyste on ðisse worulde, ða ðohte he ðæt he wolde gesecan helle godu, ond onginnan him oleccan mid his hearpan, ond biddan þæt hi him ageafen eft his wif.

text: Dā hē ðā ðider cōm, ðā sceolde cuman ðǣre helle hund ongēan hine, þæs nama wæs Ceruerus, sē sceolde habban þrīo hēafdu, ond onfægnian mid his steorte, ond plegian wið hine for his hearpunga.
text_bare: Da he ða ðider com, ða sceolde cuman ðære helle hund ongean hine, þæs nama wæs Ceruerus, se sceolde habban þrio heafdu, ond onfægnian mid his steorte, ond plegian wið hine for his hearpunga.

text: Ðā wæs ðǣr ēac swīðe egeslīc geatweard, ðæs nama sceolde bīon Caron, sē hæfde ēac þrīo hēafdu, ond wæs swīðe oreald.
text_bare: Ða wæs ðær eac swiðe egeslic geatweard, ðæs nama sceolde bion Caron, se hæfde eac þrio heafdu, ond wæs swiðe oreald.

text: Ðā ongon sē hearpere hine biddan þæt hē hine gemundbyrde ðā hwīle þe hē ðǣr wǣre, ond hine gesundne eft ðonan brōhte.
text_bare: Ða ongon se hearpere hine biddan þæt he hine gemundbyrde ða hwile þe he ðær wære, ond hine gesundne eft ðonan brohte.

text: Ðā gehēt hē him ðæt, for ðǣm hē wæs oflyst ðæs seldcūðan sōnes.
text_bare: Ða gehet he him ðæt, for ðæm he wæs oflyst ðæs seldcuðan sones.

text: Ðā ēode hē furðor oð hē gemētte ðā graman gydena ðe folcisce men hātað Parcas, ðā hī secgað ðæt on nānum men nyten nāne ārē, ac ǣleum men wrecen be his gewyrhtum; þā hī secgað ðæt wealden ǣlces mannes wyrde.
text_bare: Ða eode he furðor oð he gemette ða graman gydena ðe folcisce men hatað Parcas, ða hi secgað ðæt on nanum men nyten nane are, ac æleum men wrecen be his gewyrhtum; þa hi secgað ðæt wealden ælces mannes wyrde.

text: Ðā ongon hē biddan heora miltse; ðā ongunnon hī wēpan mid him.
text_bare: Ða ongon he biddan heora miltse; ða ongunnon hi wepan mid him.

text: Ðā ēode hē furðor, ond him urnon ealle hellwaran ongēan, ond lǣddon hine tō hiora cyninge, ond ongunnon ealle sprecan mid him, ond biddan þæs ðe hē bæd.
text_bare: Ða eode he furðor, ond him urnon ealle hellwaran ongean, ond læddon hine to hiora cyninge, ond ongunnon ealle sprecan mid him, ond biddan þæs ðe he bæd.

text: Ond þæt unstille hwēol ðe Ixīon wæs tō gebunden, Leuita cyning, for his scylde, ðæt oðstōd for his hearpunga; ond Tantulus sē eyning, ðe on ðisse worulde ūngemetlīce gīfre wæs, ond him ðǣr ðæt ilce yfel filgde ðǣre gīfernesse, hē gestilde.
text_bare: Ond þæt unstille hweol ðe Ixion wæs to gebunden, Leuita cyning, for his scylde, ðæt oðstod for his hearpunga; ond Tantulus se eyning, ðe on ðisse worulde ungemetlice gifre wæs, ond him ðær ðæt ilce yfel filgde ðære gifernesse, he gestilde.

text: Ona sē vultor sceolde forlǣtan ðæt hē ne slāt ðā lifre Tyties ðæs cyninges, ðe hine ǣr mid ðȳ wītnode; ond eall hellwara wītu gestildon, þā hwīle þe bē beforan þām cyninge hearpode.
text_bare: Ona se vultor sceolde forlætan ðæt he ne slat ða lifre Tyties ðæs cyninges, ðe hine ær mid ðy witnode; ond eall hellwara witu gestildon, þa hwile þe be beforan þam cyninge hearpode.

text: Ðā hē ðā longe ond longe hearpode, ðā cleopode sē hellwara cyning, ond cwæð 'Wuton āgifan ðæm esne his wīf, for ðǣm hē hī hæfð geearnad mid his hearpunga.' Bebēad him ðā ðæt hē geare wisse, ðæt hē hine nǣfre under bæc ne bisāwe, siððan he ðonanweard wǣre, ond sǣde, gif hē hine under bæc besāwe, ðæt hē sceolde forlǣtan ðæt wīf.
text_bare: Ða he ða longe ond longe hearpode, ða cleopode se hellwara cyning, ond cwæð 'Wuton agifan ðæm esne his wif, for ðæm he hi hæfð geearnad mid his hearpunga.' Bebead him ða ðæt he geare wisse, ðæt he hine næfre under bæc ne bisawe, siððan he ðonanweard wære, ond sæde, gif he hine under bæc besawe, ðæt he sceolde forlætan ðæt wif.

text: Ac ðā lufe mon mæg swīðe unēaðe oððe nā forbēodan: wēi lā wēi!
text_bare: Ac ða lufe mon mæg swiðe uneaðe oððe na forbeodan: wei la wei!

text: hwæt Orpheus ðā lǣdde his wīf mid him, oð ðe hē cōm on þæt gemǣre lēohtes ond ðīostro ðā ēode þæt wīf æfter him.
text_bare: hwæt Orpheus ða lædde his wif mid him, oð ðe he com on þæt gemære leohtes ond ðiostro ða eode þæt wif æfter him.

text: Ðā hē forð on ðæt lēoht cōm, ðā beseah hē hine under bæc wið ðæs wīfes: ðā losade hīo him sōna.
text_bare: Ða he forð on ðæt leoht com, ða beseah he hine under bæc wið ðæs wifes: ða losade hio him sona.

text: Ðās lēasan spell lǣrað gehwylcne mon ðāra ðe wilnaðā helle ðīostro tō flīonne, ond tō ðæs sōðan Godes līohte tō cumanne, ðæt hē hine ne besīo tō his ealdum yflum, swā ðæt hē hī eft swā fullīce fullfremme swā hē hī ǣr dyde; for ðǣm swā hwā swā mid fulle willan his mōd went tō ðæm yflum ðe hē ǣr forlēt, ond hī ðonne fullfremeð, ond hī him ðonne fullīce līciað, and hē hī nǣfre forlǣtan ne þenceð, ðonne forlȳst hē eall his ǣrran good, būton bē hit eft gebēte.
text_bare: Ðas leasan spell lærað gehwylcne mon ðara ðe wilnaða helle ðiostro to flionne, ond to ðæs soðan Godes liohte to cumanne, ðæt he hine ne besio to his ealdum yflum, swa ðæt he hi eft swa fullice fullfremme swa he hi ær dyde; for ðæm swa hwa swa mid fulle willan his mod went to ðæm yflum ðe he ær forlet, ond hi ðonne fullfremeð, ond hi him ðonne fullice liciað, and he hi næfre forlætan ne þenceð, ðonne forlyst he eall his ærran good, buton be hit eft gebete.

text: In ðeosse abbudissan mynstre wæs sum brōðor syndriglīce mid godcundre gife gemǣred ond gewordðad, for þon hē of godcundan stafum þurh bōceras geleornode, þæt hē æfter medmiclum fæce in scopgereorde mid þā mǣstan swētnisse ond inbryrdnisse geglengde, ond in Engliscgereorde wel geworht forþ brōhte.
text_bare: In ðeosse abbudissan mynstre wæs sum broðor syndriglice mid godcundre gife gemæred ond gewordðad, for þon he of godcundan stafum þurh boceras geleornode, þæt he æfter medmiclum fæce in scopgereorde mid þa mæstan swetnisse ond inbryrdnisse geglengde, ond in Engliscgereorde wel geworht forþ brohte.

text: Ond for his lēoþsongum monigra monna mōd oft tō worulde forhogdnisse ond tō geþēodnisse þæs heofonlīcan līfes onbærnde wǣron.
text_bare: Ond for his leoþsongum monigra monna mod oft to worulde forhogdnisse ond to geþeodnisse þæs heofonlican lifes onbærnde wæron.

text: Ond ēac swelce monige ōðre æfter him in Ongelþēode ongunnan ǣfteste lēoð wyrcan, ac nǣnig hwæðre him þæt gelīce dōn ne meahte; for þon hē nālæs from monnum nē þurh mon gelǣred wæs þæt hē þone lēoðcræft leornade, ac hē wæs godcundlīce gefultumod, ond þurh Godes gife þone songcræft onfēng; ond hē for ðon nǣfre nōht lēasunge, nē īdles lēoþes wyrcan ne meahte, ac efne þa ān ðā ðe tō ǣfestnisse belumþon, ond hīs þā ǣfestan tungangedeofanade singan.
text_bare: Ond eac swelce monige oðre æfter him in Ongelþeode ongunnan æfteste leoð wyrcan, ac nænig hwæðre him þæt gelice don ne meahte; for þon he nalæs from monnum ne þurh mon gelæred wæs þæt he þone leoðcræft leornade, ac he wæs godcundlice gefultumod, ond þurh Godes gife þone songcræft onfeng; ond he for ðon næfre noht leasunge, ne idles leoþes wyrcan ne meahte, ac efne þa an ða ðe to æfestnisse belumþon, ond his þa æfestan tungangedeofanade singan.

text: Wæs hē sē mon in weoruldhāde geseted oð þā tīde þe hē wæs gelȳfdre ylde, ond nǣfre nǣnig lēoð geleornade.
text_bare: Wæs he se mon in weoruldhade geseted oð þa tide þe he wæs gelyfdre ylde, ond næfre nænig leoð geleornade.

text: Ond hē for þon oft in gebēorscipe, þonne þǣr wæs blisse intinga gedēmed, þæt hēo ealle sceolden þurh endebyrdnesse be hearpan singan, þonne hē geseah þā hearpan him nēalēcan, þonne ārās hē for scome from þǣm symble, ond hām ēode tō his hūse.
text_bare: Ond he for þon oft in gebeorscipe, þonne þær wæs blisse intinga gedemed, þæt heo ealle sceolden þurh endebyrdnesse be hearpan singan, þonne he geseah þa hearpan him nealecan, þonne aras he for scome from þæm symble, ond ham eode to his huse.

text: Ðā hē þæt þā sumre tīde dyde, þæt hē forlēt þæt hūs þæs gebēorscipes, ond ūt wæs gongende tō nēata scipene, þāra heord him wæs þǣre neahte beboden; þā hē ðā þǣr in gelimplīce tīde his leomu on reste gesette ond onslēpte, þā stōd him sum mon æt þurh swefn, on hine hālette on grētte, on hine be his noman nemnde: 'Cedmon, sing mē hwæthwugu.' Þā ondswarede hē, on cwæð: 'Ne con ic nōht singan; ond ic for þon of þeossum gebēorscipe ūt ēode ond hider gewāt, for þon ic nāht singan ne cūðe.' Eft hē cwæð sē ðe wið hine sprecende wæs: 'Hwæðre þū meaht mē singan.' Þā cwæð hē: 'Hwæt sceal ic singan?' Cwæð hē: 'Sing mē frumsceaft.' Þā hē ðā þās andsware onfēng, þā ongon hē sōna singan, in herenesse Godes Scyppendes, þā fres ond þā word þe hē nǣfre ne gehȳrde, þāra endebyrdnes þis is:
text_bare: Ða he þæt þa sumre tide dyde, þæt he forlet þæt hus þæs gebeorscipes, ond ut wæs gongende to neata scipene, þara heord him wæs þære neahte beboden; þa he ða þær in gelimplice tide his leomu on reste gesette ond onslepte, þa stod him sum mon æt þurh swefn, on hine halette on grette, on hine be his noman nemnde: 'Cedmon, sing me hwæthwugu.' Þa ondswarede he, on cwæð: 'Ne con ic noht singan; ond ic for þon of þeossum gebeorscipe ut eode ond hider gewat, for þon ic naht singan ne cuðe.' Eft he cwæð se ðe wið hine sprecende wæs: 'Hwæðre þu meaht me singan.' Þa cwæð he: 'Hwæt sceal ic singan?' Cwæð he: 'Sing me frumsceaft.' Þa he ða þas andsware onfeng, þa ongon he sona singan, in herenesse Godes Scyppendes, þa fres ond þa word þe he næfre ne gehyrde, þara endebyrdnes þis is:

text: Þā ārās hē from þǣm slǣpe, ond eal þā þe hē slǣpende song fæste in gemynde hæfde.
text_bare: Þa aras he from þæm slæpe, ond eal þa þe he slæpende song fæste in gemynde hæfde.

text: ond þǣm wordum sōna monig word in þæt ilce gemet Gode wyrðes songes tōgeþēodde.
text_bare: ond þæm wordum sona monig word in þæt ilce gemet Gode wyrðes songes togeþeodde.

text: Þā cōm hē on morgenne tō þǣm tūngerēfan, sē þe his ealdormon wæs: sægde him hwylc gife hē onfeng; on hē hine sōna tō þǣre abbudissan gelǣdde, ond hire þæt cȳðde ond sægde.
text_bare: Þa com he on morgenne to þæm tungerefan, se þe his ealdormon wæs: sægde him hwylc gife he onfeng; on he hine sona to þære abbudissan gelædde, ond hire þæt cyðde ond sægde.

text: Þā heht hēo gesomnian ealle þā gelǣredestan men ond þā leorneras, ond him ondweardum hēt secgan þæt swefn, on þæt lēoð singan þæt ealra heora dōme gecoren wǣre, hwæt oððe hwonan þæt cumen wǣre.
text_bare: Þa heht heo gesomnian ealle þa gelæredestan men ond þa leorneras, ond him ondweardum het secgan þæt swefn, on þæt leoð singan þæt ealra heora dome gecoren wære, hwæt oððe hwonan þæt cumen wære.

text: Þā wæs him eallum gesegen, swā swā hit wæs, þæt him wǣre from Drihtne sylfum heofonlīc gifu forgifen.
text_bare: Þa wæs him eallum gesegen, swa swa hit wæs, þæt him wære from Drihtne sylfum heofonlic gifu forgifen.

text: Þā rehton hēo him ond sægdon sum hālig spell ond godcundre lāre word: bebudon him þā, gif hē meahte, þæt hē in swīnsunge lēoðsonges þæt gehwyrfde.
text_bare: Þa rehton heo him ond sægdon sum halig spell ond godcundre lare word: bebudon him þa, gif he meahte, þæt he in swinsunge leoðsonges þæt gehwyrfde.

text: Þā hē ðā hæfde þā wīsan onfongne, þā ēode hē hām tō his hūse, ond cwōm eft on morgenne, ond þȳ betstan lēoðe geglenged him āsong ond āgeaf þæt him beboden wæs.
text_bare: Þa he ða hæfde þa wisan onfongne, þa eode he ham to his huse, ond cwom eft on morgenne, ond þy betstan leoðe geglenged him asong ond ageaf þæt him beboden wæs.

text: Ðā ongan sēo abbudisse clyppan ond lufigean þā Godes gife in þǣm men, ond hēo hine þā monade ond lǣrde þæt hē woruldhād ānforlēte ond munuchād onfēnge: ond hē þæt wel þafode.
text_bare: Ða ongan seo abbudisse clyppan ond lufigean þa Godes gife in þæm men, ond heo hine þa monade ond lærde þæt he woruldhad anforlete ond munuchad onfenge: ond he þæt wel þafode.

text: Ond hēo hine in þæt mynster onfēng mid his gōdum, ond hine geþēodde tō gesomnunge þāra Godes þēowa, on heht hine lǣran þæt getæl þæs hālgan stǣres on spelles.
text_bare: Ond heo hine in þæt mynster onfeng mid his godum, ond hine geþeodde to gesomnunge þara Godes þeowa, on heht hine læran þæt getæl þæs halgan stæres on spelles.

text: Ond hē eal þā þe hē in gehȳrnesse geleornian meahte, mid hine gemyndgade, ond swā swā clǣne nēten eodorcende in þæt swēteste lēoð gehwyrfde.
text_bare: Ond he eal þa þe he in gehyrnesse geleornian meahte, mid hine gemyndgade, ond swa swa clæne neten eodorcende in þæt sweteste leoð gehwyrfde.

text: Ond his song ond his lēoð wǣron swā wynsumu tō gehȳranne, þætte seolfan þā his lārēowas æt his mūðe wreoton ond leornodon.
text_bare: Ond his song ond his leoð wæron swa wynsumu to gehyranne, þætte seolfan þa his lareowas æt his muðe wreoton ond leornodon.

text: Song hē ǣrest be middangeardes gesceape, ond bī fruman moncynnes, ond eal þæt stǣr Genesis, þæt is sēo ǣreste Moyses booc; ond eft bī ūtgonge Israhēla folces of Ǣgypta londe, on bī ingonge þæs gehātlandes; ond bī ōðrum monegum spellum þæs hālgan gewrites canones bōca; ond bī Crīstes menniscnesse, ond bī his þrōwunge, on bī his ūpāstīgnesse in heofonas; on bī þæs Hālgan Gāstes cyme, ond þāra apostola lāre; ond eft bī þǣm dæge þæs tōweardan dōmes, ond bī fyrhtu þæs tintreglīcan wiites, ond bī swētnesse þæs heofonlecan rīces, hē monig lēoð geworhte; ond swelce ēac ōðer monig be þǣ godcundan fremsumnessum ond dōmum bē geworhte.
text_bare: Song he ærest be middangeardes gesceape, ond bi fruman moncynnes, ond eal þæt stær Genesis, þæt is seo æreste Moyses booc; ond eft bi utgonge Israhela folces of Ægypta londe, on bi ingonge þæs gehatlandes; ond bi oðrum monegum spellum þæs halgan gewrites canones boca; ond bi Cristes menniscnesse, ond bi his þrowunge, on bi his upastignesse in heofonas; on bi þæs Halgan Gastes cyme, ond þara apostola lare; ond eft bi þæm dæge þæs toweardan domes, ond bi fyrhtu þæs tintreglican wiites, ond bi swetnesse þæs heofonlecan rices, he monig leoð geworhte; ond swelce eac oðer monig be þæ godcundan fremsumnessum ond domum be geworhte.

text: In eallum þǣm hē geornelīce gēmde þæt hē men ātuge from synna lufan ond māndǣda, ond tō lufan ond tō geornfulnesse āwehte gōdra dǣda; for þon hē wæs sē mon swīþe ǣfest ond regollecum þēodscipum ēaðmōdlīce underþēoded; ond wið þǣm þā ðe in ōðre wīsan dōn woldon, hē wæs mid welme micelre ellenwōdnisse onbærned.
text_bare: In eallum þæm he geornelice gemde þæt he men atuge from synna lufan ond mandæda, ond to lufan ond to geornfulnesse awehte godra dæda; for þon he wæs se mon swiþe æfest ond regollecum þeodscipum eaðmodlice underþeoded; ond wið þæm þa ðe in oðre wisan don woldon, he wæs mid welme micelre ellenwodnisse onbærned.

text: Ond hē for ðon fægre ende his līf betȳnde on geendade.
text_bare: Ond he for ðon fægre ende his lif betynde on geendade.

text: For þon þā ðǣre tīde nēalǣcte his gewitenesse ond forðfōre, þā wæs hē fēowertȳnum dagum ǣr; þæt hē wæs līchomlīcre untrymnesse þrycced ond hefgad, hwæðre tō þon gemetlīce þæt hē ealle þā tīd meahte ge sprecan ge gongan.
text_bare: For þon þa ðære tide nealæcte his gewitenesse ond forðfore, þa wæs he feowertynum dagum ær; þæt he wæs lichomlicre untrymnesse þrycced ond hefgad, hwæðre to þon gemetlice þæt he ealle þa tid meahte ge sprecan ge gongan.

text: Wæs þǣr in nēaweste untrumra monna hūs, in þǣm heora þēaw wæs þæt hēo þā untruman on þā ðe æt forðfōre wǣron in lǣdan sceoldon, ond him þǣr ætsomne þegnian.
text_bare: Wæs þær in neaweste untrumra monna hus, in þæm heora þeaw wæs þæt heo þa untruman on þa ðe æt forðfore wæron in lædan sceoldon, ond him þær ætsomne þegnian.

text: Þā bæd hē his þegn on ǣfenne þǣre neahte þe hē of worulde gongende wæs þæt hē in þǣm hūse him stōwe gegearwode, þæt hē gerestan meahte.
text_bare: Þa bæd he his þegn on æfenne þære neahte þe he of worulde gongende wæs þæt he in þæm huse him stowe gegearwode, þæt he gerestan meahte.

text: Þā wundrode sē þegn for hwon hē ðæs bǣde, for þon him þūhte þæt his forðfōr swā nēah ne wǣre: dyde hwæðre swā swā hē cwæð ond bibēad.
text_bare: Þa wundrode se þegn for hwon he ðæs bæde, for þon him þuhte þæt his forðfor swa neah ne wære: dyde hwæðre swa swa he cwæð ond bibead.

text: Ond mid þȳ hē ðā þǣr on reste ēode, ond hē gefēonde mōde sumu þing mid him sprecende ætgædere ond glēowiende wæs þe þǣr ǣr inne wǣron þā wæs ofer middeneaht þæt hē frægn, hwæðer hēo ǣnig hūsl inne hæfdon.
text_bare: Ond mid þy he ða þær on reste eode, ond he gefeonde mode sumu þing mid him sprecende ætgædere ond gleowiende wæs þe þær ær inne wæron þa wæs ofer middeneaht þæt he frægn, hwæðer heo ænig husl inne hæfdon.

text: Þā ondswarodon hēo ond cwǣdon: 'Hwylc þearf is ðē hūsles?
text_bare: Þa ondswarodon heo ond cwædon: 'Hwylc þearf is ðe husles?

text: Ne þīnre forþfōre swā nēah is, nu þū þus rōtlīce ond þus glædlīce tō ūs sprecende eart.' Cwæð hē eft: 'Berað mē hūsl tō.' Þā hē hit þā on honda hæfdem þā frægn hē, hwæþer hēo ealle smolt mōd ond būton eallum incan blīðe tō him hæfdon.
text_bare: Ne þinre forþfore swa neah is, nu þu þus rotlice ond þus glædlice to us sprecende eart.' Cwæð he eft: 'Berað me husl to.' Þa he hit þa on honda hæfdem þa frægn he, hwæþer heo ealle smolt mod ond buton eallum incan bliðe to him hæfdon.

text: Þā ondswaredon hȳ ealle, ond cwǣdon þæt hēo nǣnigne incan tō him wiston, ac hēo ealle swīðe hlīðemōde wǣron; ond hēo wrīxendlīce hine bǣdon þæt hē him eallum nlīðe wǣre.
text_bare: Þa ondswaredon hy ealle, ond cwædon þæt heo nænigne incan to him wiston, ac heo ealle swiðe hliðemode wæron; ond heo wrixendlice hine bædon þæt he him eallum nliðe wære.

text: Þā ondswarade hē ond cwæð: 'Mīne brōðor, mīne þā lēofan, ic eom swīðe blīðemōd tō ēow ond tō eallum Godes monnum.' Ond hē swā wæs hine getrymmende mid þȳ heofonlecan wegneste, ond him ōðres līfes ingong gegearwode.
text_bare: Þa ondswarade he ond cwæð: 'Mine broðor, mine þa leofan, ic eom swiðe bliðemod to eow ond to eallum Godes monnum.' Ond he swa wæs hine getrymmende mid þy heofonlecan wegneste, ond him oðres lifes ingong gegearwode.

text: Þā gȳt hē frægn, hū nēah þǣre tīde wǣre þætte þā brōðor ārīsan sceoldon, ond Godes lof rǣran ond heora ūhtsong singan.
text_bare: Þa gyt he frægn, hu neah þære tide wære þætte þa broðor arisan sceoldon, ond Godes lof ræran ond heora uhtsong singan.

text: Þā ondswaredon hēo: 'Nis hit feor tō þon.' Cwæð hē: 'Teala, wuton wē wel þǣre tīde bīdan;' ond þā him gebæd, ond hine gesegnode mid Crīstes rōdetācne, ond his hēafod onhylde tō þām bolstre, ond medmicel fæc onslēpte, ond swā mid stilnesse his līf geendade.
text_bare: Þa ondswaredon heo: 'Nis hit feor to þon.' Cwæð he: 'Teala, wuton we wel þære tide bidan;' ond þa him gebæd, ond hine gesegnode mid Cristes rodetacne, ond his heafod onhylde to þam bolstre, ond medmicel fæc onslepte, ond swa mid stilnesse his lif geendade.

text: Ond swā wæs geworden þætte swā swā hē hlūttre mōde ond bilwiltre ond smyltre wilsumnesse Drihtne þēode, þæt hē ēac swylce swā smylte dēaðe middangeard wæs forlǣtende, ond tō his gesihðe becwōm.
text_bare: Ond swa wæs geworden þætte swa swa he hluttre mode ond bilwiltre ond smyltre wilsumnesse Drihtne þeode, þæt he eac swylce swa smylte deaðe middangeard wæs forlætende, ond to his gesihðe becwom.

text: Ond sēo tunge þe swā monig hālwende word in þæs Scyppendes lof gesette, hē ðā swelce ēac þā ȳtmæstan word in his herenisse, hine seolfne segniende ond his gāst in his honda bebēodende, betȳnde.
text_bare: Ond seo tunge þe swa monig halwende word in þæs Scyppendes lof gesette, he ða swelce eac þa ytmæstan word in his herenisse, hine seolfne segniende ond his gast in his honda bebeodende, betynde.

text: Ēac swelce þæt is gesegen þæt hē wǣre gewis his seolfes forðfōre of þǣm þe wē nū secgan hȳrdon.
text_bare: Eac swelce þæt is gesegen þæt he wære gewis his seolfes forðfore of þæm þe we nu secgan hyrdon.

text: Hēr Cynewulf benam Sigebryht his rīces ond Westseaxna wīotan for unryhtum dǣdum, būton Hāmtūnscīre; ond hē hæfde þā oþ hē ofslōg þone aldormon þe him lengest wunode.
text_bare: Her Cynewulf benam Sigebryht his rices ond Westseaxna wiotan for unryhtum dædum, buton Hamtunscire; ond he hæfde þa oþ he ofslog þone aldormon þe him lengest wunode.

text: Ond hiene þā Cynewulf on Andred ādrǣfde; ond hē þæt hiene ān swān ofstang æt Pryfetes flōdan, -- ond hē wræc þone aldormon Cumbran.
text_bare: Ond hiene þa Cynewulf on Andred adræfde; ond he þæt hiene an swan ofstang æt Pryfetes flodan, -- ond he wræc þone aldormon Cumbran.

text: Ond sē Cynewulf oft miclum gefeohtum feaht uuiþ Bretwālum; ond ymb wintra þæs þe hē rīce hæfde, hē wolde ādrǣfan ānne æþeling sē wǣs Cyneheard hāten, -- ond sē Cyneheard wæs þæs Sigebryhtes brōþur.
text_bare: Ond se Cynewulf oft miclum gefeohtum feaht uuiþ Bretwalum; ond ymb wintra þæs þe he rice hæfde, he wolde adræfan anne æþeling se wæs Cyneheard haten, -- ond se Cyneheard wæs þæs Sigebryhtes broþur.

text: Ond þā geāscode hē þone cyning lȳtle werode on wīfcȳþþe on Merantūne, ond hine þǣr berād, ond þone būr ūtan beēode ǣr hine þā men onfunden þe mid þām kyninge wǣrun.
text_bare: Ond þa geascode he þone cyning lytle werode on wifcyþþe on Merantune, ond hine þær berad, ond þone bur utan beeode ær hine þa men onfunden þe mid þam kyninge wærun.

text: Ond þā ongeat sē cyning þæt, ond hē on þā duru ēode, ond þā unhēanlice hine werede, oþ hē on þone æþeling lōcude, ond þā ūt rǣsde on hine, ond hine miclum gewundode; ond hīe alle on þone cyning wǣrun feohtende, oþ þæt hīe hine ofslægenne hæfdon.
text_bare: Ond þa ongeat se cyning þæt, ond he on þa duru eode, ond þa unheanlice hine werede, oþ he on þone æþeling locude, ond þa ut ræsde on hine, ond hine miclum gewundode; ond hie alle on þone cyning wærun feohtende, oþ þæt hie hine ofslægenne hæfdon.

text: Ond þā on þæs wīfes gebǣrum onfundon þæs cyninges þegnas þā unstilnesse, ond þā þider urnon swā hwelc swā þonne gearo wearþ ond radost.
text_bare: Ond þa on þæs wifes gebærum onfundon þæs cyninges þegnas þa unstilnesse, ond þa þider urnon swa hwelc swa þonne gearo wearþ ond radost.

text: Ond hiera sē æþeling gehwelcum feoh ond feorh gebead, ond hiera nǣnig hit geþicgean nolde; ac hīe simle feohtende wǣran oþ hīe alle lǣgon būtan anum Bryttiscum gisle, ond sē swīþe gewundad wæs.
text_bare: Ond hiera se æþeling gehwelcum feoh ond feorh gebead, ond hiera nænig hit geþicgean nolde; ac hie simle feohtende wæran oþ hie alle lægon butan anum Bryttiscum gisle, ond se swiþe gewundad wæs.

text: Þā on morgenne gehīerdun þæt þæs cyninges þegnas, þe him beæftan wǣrun, þæt sē cyning ofslægen wæs.
text_bare: Þa on morgenne gehierdun þæt þæs cyninges þegnas, þe him beæftan wærun, þæt se cyning ofslægen wæs.

text: Þā rīdon hīe þider, ond his aldormon Ōsrīc, ond Wīferþ his þegn, ond þā men þe hē beæftan him lǣfde ǣr, ond þone æþeling on þǣre byrig mētton þǣr sē cyning ofslægen læg ond þā gatu him tō belocen hæfdon ond þā þær tō ēodon.
text_bare: Þa ridon hie þider, ond his aldormon Osric, ond Wiferþ his þegn, ond þa men þe he beæftan him læfde ær, ond þone æþeling on þære byrig metton þær se cyning ofslægen læg ond þa gatu him to belocen hæfdon ond þa þær to eodon.

text: Ond þā gebēad hē him hiera āgenne dōm fēos ond londes, gif hīe him þæs rīces ūþon; ond him cȳþdon þæt hiera mǣgas him mid wǣron, þā þe him from noldon.
text_bare: Ond þa gebead he him hiera agenne dom feos ond londes, gif hie him þæs rices uþon; ond him cyþdon þæt hiera mægas him mid wæron, þa þe him from noldon.

text: Ond þā cuǣdon hīe þæt him nǣnig mǣg lēofra nǣre þonne hiera hlāford, ond hīe nǣfre his banan folgian noldon.
text_bare: Ond þa cuædon hie þæt him nænig mæg leofra nære þonne hiera hlaford, ond hie næfre his banan folgian noldon.

text: Ond þā budon hīe hiera mǣgum þæt hīe gesunde from ēodon; ond hīe cuǣdon þæt tæt ilce hiera geferum geboden wǣre, þe ǣr mid þām cyninge wǣrun.
text_bare: Ond þa budon hie hiera mægum þæt hie gesunde from eodon; ond hie cuædon þæt tæt ilce hiera geferum geboden wære, þe ær mid þam cyninge wærun.

text: Þā cuǣdon hīe þæt hīe hīe þæs ne onmunden 'þon mā þe ēowre gefēran þe mid þām cyninge ofslægene wǣrun.' Ond hīe þā ymb þā gatu feohtende wǣron oþ þæt hīe þǣr inne fulgon, ond þone æþeling ofslōgon, ond þā men þe him mid wǣrun alle būtan ānum, sē wæs þæs aldormonnes godsunu, ond hē his feorh generede, ond þēah hē wæs oft gewundad.
text_bare: Þa cuædon hie þæt hie hie þæs ne onmunden 'þon ma þe eowre geferan þe mid þam cyninge ofslægene wærun.' Ond hie þa ymb þa gatu feohtende wæron oþ þæt hie þær inne fulgon, ond þone æþeling ofslogon, ond þa men þe him mid wærun alle butan anum, se wæs þæs aldormonnes godsunu, ond he his feorh generede, ond þeah he wæs oft gewundad.

text: Hēr cuom sē here tō Rēadingum on Westseaxe, ond þæs ymb niht rīdon eorlas up.
text_bare: Her cuom se here to Readingum on Westseaxe, ond þæs ymb niht ridon eorlas up.

text: Þā gemētte hīe Æþelwulf aldorman on Englafelda, ond him þǣr wiþ gefeaht ond sige nam.
text_bare: Þa gemette hie Æþelwulf aldorman on Englafelda, ond him þær wiþ gefeaht ond sige nam.

text: Þæs ymb niht Æþerēd cyning ond Ælfrēd his brōþur þǣr micle fierd tō Rēadingum gelæddon, ond wiþ þone here gefuhton; ond þǣr wæs micel wæl geslægen on gehwæþre hond, ond Æþelwulf aldormon wearþ ofslægen, ond þā Deniscan āhton wælstowe gewald.
text_bare: Þæs ymb niht Æþered cyning ond Ælfred his broþur þær micle fierd to Readingum gelæddon, ond wiþ þone here gefuhton; ond þær wæs micel wæl geslægen on gehwæþre hond, ond Æþelwulf aldormon wearþ ofslægen, ond þa Deniscan ahton wælstowe gewald.

text: Ond þæs ymb niht gefeaht Æþerēd cyning ond Ælfrēd his brōþur wiþ alne þone here on Æscesdūne.
text_bare: Ond þæs ymb niht gefeaht Æþered cyning ond Ælfred his broþur wiþ alne þone here on Æscesdune.

text: Ond hīe wǣrun on twǣm gefylcum: on ōþrum wæs Bāchsecg ond Halfdene þā hǣþnan cyningas, ond on ōþrum wǣron þā eorlas.
text_bare: Ond hie wærun on twæm gefylcum: on oþrum wæs Bachsecg ond Halfdene þa hæþnan cyningas, ond on oþrum wæron þa eorlas.

text: Ond þā gefeaht sē cyning Æþerēd wiþ þāra cyninga getruman, ond þǣr wearþ sē cyning Bāgsecg ofslægen; ond Ælfrēd his broþur wiþ þāra eorla getruman, ond þǣr wearþ Sidroc eorl ofslægen sē alda, ond Sidroc eorl sē gioncga, ond Ōsbearn eorl, ond Frǣna eorl, ond Hareld eorl; ond þā hergas bēgen geflīemde, ond fela þūsenda ofslægenra, ond onfeohtende wǣron oþ niht.
text_bare: Ond þa gefeaht se cyning Æþered wiþ þara cyninga getruman, ond þær wearþ se cyning Bagsecg ofslægen; ond Ælfred his broþur wiþ þara eorla getruman, ond þær wearþ Sidroc eorl ofslægen se alda, ond Sidroc eorl se gioncga, ond Osbearn eorl, ond Fræna eorl, ond Hareld eorl; ond þa hergas begen gefliemde, ond fela þusenda ofslægenra, ond onfeohtende wæron oþ niht.

text: Ond þæs ymb niht gefeaht Æþerēd cyning ond Ælfrēd his brōður wiþ þone here æt Basengum, ond þǣr þā Deniscan sige nāmon.
text_bare: Ond þæs ymb niht gefeaht Æþered cyning ond Ælfred his broður wiþ þone here æt Basengum, ond þær þa Deniscan sige namon.

text: Ond þæs ymb mōnaþ gefeaht Æþerēd cyning ond Ælfrēd his brōþur wiþ þone here æt Meretūne, ond hīe wǣrun on tuǣm gefylcium, ond hīe būtū geflīemdon, ond longe on dæg sige āhton; ond þǣr wearþ micel wælsliht on gehwæþere hond, ond þā Deniscan āhton wælstōwe gewald; ond þǣr wearþ Hēahmund bisceop ofslægen, ond fela gōdra monna.
text_bare: Ond þæs ymb monaþ gefeaht Æþered cyning ond Ælfred his broþur wiþ þone here æt Meretune, ond hie wærun on tuæm gefylcium, ond hie butu gefliemdon, ond longe on dæg sige ahton; ond þær wearþ micel wælsliht on gehwæþere hond, ond þa Deniscan ahton wælstowe gewald; ond þær wearþ Heahmund bisceop ofslægen, ond fela godra monna.

text: Ond æfter þissum gefeohte cuōm micel sumorlida.
text_bare: Ond æfter þissum gefeohte cuom micel sumorlida.

text: Ond þæs ofer Ēastron gefōr Æþerēd cyning; ond he ricsode gēar, ond his līc līþ æt Winburnan.
text_bare: Ond þæs ofer Eastron gefor Æþered cyning; ond he ricsode gear, ond his lic liþ æt Winburnan.

text: Þā feng Ælfrēd Æþelwulfing his brōþur to Wesseaxna rīce.
text_bare: Þa feng Ælfred Æþelwulfing his broþur to Wesseaxna rice.

text: Ond þæs ymb ānne mōnaþ gefeaht Ælfrēd cyning wiþ alne þone here lȳtle werede æt Wiltūne, ond hine longe on dæg geflīemde, ond þā Deniscan āhton wælstōwe gewald.
text_bare: Ond þæs ymb anne monaþ gefeaht Ælfred cyning wiþ alne þone here lytle werede æt Wiltune, ond hine longe on dæg gefliemde, ond þa Deniscan ahton wælstowe gewald.

text: Ond þæs gēares wurdon folcgefeoht gefohten wiþ þone here on þȳ cynerīce be sūþan Temese, ond būtan þām þe him Ælfrēd þæs cyninges brōþur, ond ānlīpig aldormon ond cyninges þegnas oft rāde onrīdon þe mon nā ne rīmde; ond þæs gēares wǣrun ofslægene eorlas ond ān cyning.
text_bare: Ond þæs geares wurdon folcgefeoht gefohten wiþ þone here on þy cynerice be suþan Temese, ond butan þam þe him Ælfred þæs cyninges broþur, ond anlipig aldormon ond cyninges þegnas oft rade onridon þe mon na ne rimde; ond þæs geares wærun ofslægene eorlas ond an cyning.

text: Ond þȳ gēare nāmon Westseaxe friþ wiþ þone here.
text_bare: Ond þy geare namon Westseaxe friþ wiþ þone here.

text: Hēr on þysum gēare fōr sē micla here, þe wē gehyrn ymbe sprǣcon, eft of þǣm ēastrīce westweard tō Bunnan, on þǣr wurdon gescipode swā þæt hīe āsettan him on ānne sīþ ofer mid horsum mid ealle; ond þā cōmon ūp on Limene mūþan mid ccl hunde scipa.
text_bare: Her on þysum geare for se micla here, þe we gehyrn ymbe spræcon, eft of þæm eastrice westweard to Bunnan, on þær wurdon gescipode swa þæt hie asettan him on anne siþ ofer mid horsum mid ealle; ond þa comon up on Limene muþan mid ccl hunde scipa.

text: Sē mūþa is on ēasteweardre Cent, æt þæs miclan wuda ēastende þe wē Andred hātað.
text_bare: Se muþa is on easteweardre Cent, æt þæs miclan wuda eastende þe we Andred hatað.

text: Sē wudu is ēastlang ond westlang hundtwelftiges mīla lang, oþþe lengra, ond þrītiges mīla brād.
text_bare: Se wudu is eastlang ond westlang hundtwelftiges mila lang, oþþe lengra, ond þritiges mila brad.

text: Sēo ēa, þe wē ǣr ymbe sprǣcon, līð ūt of þǣm wealda.
text_bare: Seo ea, þe we ær ymbe spræcon, lið ut of þæm wealda.

text: On þā ēa hī tugon ūp hiora scipu oþ þone weald, mīla fram þǣm mūþan ūteweardum, ond þǣr ābrǣcon ān geweorc: inne on þǣm fæstenne sǣton fēawa cirlisce men on, ond wæs sāmworht.
text_bare: On þa ea hi tugon up hiora scipu oþ þone weald, mila fram þæm muþan uteweardum, ond þær abræcon an geweorc: inne on þæm fæstenne sæton feawa cirlisce men on, ond wæs samworht.

text: Ðā sōna æfter þǣm cōm Hæsten mid scipa ūp on Temese mūðan, ond worhte him geweorc æt Middeltūne, ond sē ōþer here æt Apuldre.
text_bare: Ða sona æfter þæm com Hæsten mid scipa up on Temese muðan, ond worhte him geweorc æt Middeltune, ond se oþer here æt Apuldre.

text: On þȳs gēare, þæt wæs ymb twelf mōnað ðæs þe hīe on þǣm ēastrīce geweorc geworht hæfdon, Norþhymbre ond Ēastengle hæfdon Ælfrēde cyninge āþas geseald, ond Ēastengle foregīsla : ond þēh ofer þā trēowa, swā oft swā þā ōþre hergas mid ealle herige ūt fōron, þonne fōron hīe, oþþe mid oþþe on heora healfe.
text_bare: On þys geare, þæt wæs ymb twelf monað ðæs þe hie on þæm eastrice geweorc geworht hæfdon, Norþhymbre ond Eastengle hæfdon Ælfrede cyninge aþas geseald, ond Eastengle foregisla : ond þeh ofer þa treowa, swa oft swa þa oþre hergas mid ealle herige ut foron, þonne foron hie, oþþe mid oþþe on heora healfe.

text: Ond þā gegaderade Ælfrēd cyninge his fierd, ond fōr þæt hē gewīcode betwuh þǣm twām hergum, þǣr þǣr hē nīehst rȳmet hæfde for wudufæstenne ond for wæterfæstenne, swā þæt hē mehte ǣgþerne gerǣcan, gif hīe ǣnigne feld sēcan wolden.
text_bare: Ond þa gegaderade Ælfred cyninge his fierd, ond for þæt he gewicode betwuh þæm twam hergum, þær þær he niehst rymet hæfde for wudufæstenne ond for wæterfæstenne, swa þæt he mehte ægþerne geræcan, gif hie ænigne feld secan wolden.

text: Ðā fōron hīe siþþan æfter þǣm wealda hlōþum ond flocrādum, bī swā hwaþerre efes swā hit þonne fierdlēas wǣs.
text_bare: Ða foron hie siþþan æfter þæm wealda hloþum ond flocradum, bi swa hwaþerre efes swa hit þonne fierdleas wæs.

text: Ond him mon ēac mid ōþrum floccum sōhte mǣstra daga ǣlce, oþþe on dæg oþþe on niht, ge of þǣre fierde ge ēac of þǣm burgum.
text_bare: Ond him mon eac mid oþrum floccum sohte mæstra daga ælce, oþþe on dæg oþþe on niht, ge of þære fierde ge eac of þæm burgum.

text: Hæfde sē cyning his fierd on tū tōnumen, swā þæt hīe wǣron simle hælde æt hām, healfe ūte, būtan þǣm monnum þe þā burga healdan scolden.
text_bare: Hæfde se cyning his fierd on tu tonumen, swa þæt hie wæron simle hælde æt ham, healfe ute, butan þæm monnum þe þa burga healdan scolden.

text: Ne cōm sē here oftor eall ūte of þǣm setum þonne tūwwa.
text_bare: Ne com se here oftor eall ute of þæm setum þonne tuwwa.

text: ōþre sīþe þā hīe ǣrest tō londe cōmon, ǣr sīo fierd gesamnod wǣre; ōþre sīþe þā hīe of þǣm setum faran woldon.
text_bare: oþre siþe þa hie ærest to londe comon, ær sio fierd gesamnod wære; oþre siþe þa hie of þæm setum faran woldon.

text: Þā hīe gefēngon micle herehȳð, ond þā woldon ferian norþweardes ofer Temese in on Ēastseaxe ongēan þā scipu.
text_bare: Þa hie gefengon micle herehyð, ond þa woldon ferian norþweardes ofer Temese in on Eastseaxe ongean þa scipu.

text: Þā forrād sīo fierd hīe foran, ond him wið gefeaht æt Fearnhamme, ond þone here geflīemde, ond þā herehȳþa āhreddon; ond hīe flugon ofer Temese būton ǣlcum forda; þā ūp be Colne on ānne iggað.
text_bare: Þa forrad sio fierd hie foran, ond him wið gefeaht æt Fearnhamme, ond þone here gefliemde, ond þa herehyþa ahreddon; ond hie flugon ofer Temese buton ælcum forda; þa up be Colne on anne iggað.

text: Ðā besæt sīo fierd hīe þǣr ūtan þā hwīle þe hīe þǣr lengest mete hæfdon; ac hī hæfdon þā heora stemn gesetenne ond hiora mete genotudne; ond wæs sē cyng þā þiderweardes on fære, mid þǣre scīre þe mid him fierdedon.
text_bare: Ða besæt sio fierd hie þær utan þa hwile þe hie þær lengest mete hæfdon; ac hi hæfdon þa heora stemn gesetenne ond hiora mete genotudne; ond wæs se cyng þa þiderweardes on fære, mid þære scire þe mid him fierdedon.

text: Ðā hē þā wæs þiderweardes, ond sīo ōþeru fierd wæs hāmweardes; ond ðā Deniscan sǣton þǣr behindan, for þǣm hiora cyninge wæs gewundod on þǣm gefeohte, þæt hī hine ne mehton ferian.
text_bare: Ða he þa wæs þiderweardes, ond sio oþeru fierd wæs hamweardes; ond ða Deniscan sæton þær behindan, for þæm hiora cyninge wæs gewundod on þæm gefeohte, þæt hi hine ne mehton ferian.

text: Þā gegaderedon þā þe in Norþhymbrum būgeað ond on Ēastengum sum hund scipa, ond fōron sūð ymbūtan, ond sum fēowertig scipa norþ ymbūtan, ond ymbsǣton ān geweorc on Defnascīre be þǣre Norþsǣ; ond þā þe sūþ ymbūtan fōron, ymbsǣton Exancester.
text_bare: Þa gegaderedon þa þe in Norþhymbrum bugeað ond on Eastengum sum hund scipa, ond foron suð ymbutan, ond sum feowertig scipa norþ ymbutan, ond ymbsæton an geweorc on Defnascire be þære Norþsæ; ond þa þe suþ ymbutan foron, ymbsæton Exancester.

text: Þā sē cyng þæt hīerde, þā wede hē hine west wið Exanceastres mid ealre þǣre fierde, būton swīþe gewaldenum dǣle ēasteweardes þæs folces, Þā fōron forð oþ þe hīe cōmon tō Lundenbyrg, ond þā mid þǣm burgwarum ond þǣm fultume þe him westan cōm, fōron ēast tō Bēamflēote.
text_bare: Þa se cyng þæt hierde, þa wede he hine west wið Exanceastres mid ealre þære fierde, buton swiþe gewaldenum dæle easteweardes þæs folces, Þa foron forð oþ þe hie comon to Lundenbyrg, ond þa mid þæm burgwarum ond þæm fultume þe him westan com, foron east to Beamfleote.

text: Wæs Hæsten þā þǣr cumen mid his herge þe ǣr æt Middeltūne sæt; ond ēac sē micla here wæs þā þǣr tō cumen þe ǣr on Limene mūþan sæt æt Apuldre.
text_bare: Wæs Hæsten þa þær cumen mid his herge þe ær æt Middeltune sæt; ond eac se micla here wæs þa þær to cumen þe ær on Limene muþan sæt æt Apuldre.

text: Hæfde Hæsten ǣr geworht þæt geweorc æt Bēamflēote, ond wās þā ūt āfaren on hergaþ, ond wæs sē micla here æt hām.
text_bare: Hæfde Hæsten ær geworht þæt geweorc æt Beamfleote, ond was þa ut afaren on hergaþ, ond wæs se micla here æt ham.

text: Þā fōron hīe tō, ond geflīemdon þone here, ond þæt geweorc ābrǣcon, ond genāmon eal þæt þǣr binnan wæs, ge on fēo ge on wīfum, ge ēac on bearnum, ond brōhton eall in tō Lundenbyrig; ond þā scipu eall oðþe tōbrǣcon, oþþe forbærndon, oþþe to Lundenbyrig brōhton oþþe to Hrōfesceastre; ond Hæstenes wīf ond his suna twēgen mon brōhte tō þǣm cyninge, ond hē hī him eft āgeaf, for þǣm þe hiora wæs ōþer his godsunu, ōþer Æðerēdes ealdormonnes; Hæfdon hī hiora onfangen ǣr Hæsten to Bēamflēote cōme, ond hē him hæfde geseald gīslas ond āðas, ond sē cyng him ēac wel feoh sealde, ond ēac swā þā he þone cniht āgef ond þæt wīf.
text_bare: Þa foron hie to, ond gefliemdon þone here, ond þæt geweorc abræcon, ond genamon eal þæt þær binnan wæs, ge on feo ge on wifum, ge eac on bearnum, ond brohton eall in to Lundenbyrig; ond þa scipu eall oðþe tobræcon, oþþe forbærndon, oþþe to Lundenbyrig brohton oþþe to Hrofesceastre; ond Hæstenes wif ond his suna twegen mon brohte to þæm cyninge, ond he hi him eft ageaf, for þæm þe hiora wæs oþer his godsunu, oþer Æðeredes ealdormonnes; Hæfdon hi hiora onfangen ær Hæsten to Beamfleote come, ond he him hæfde geseald gislas ond aðas, ond se cyng him eac wel feoh sealde, ond eac swa þa he þone cniht agef ond þæt wif.

text: Ac sōna swā hīe to Bēamflēote cōmon, ond þæt geweorc geworct wæs, swā hergode hē on his rīce, þone ilcan ende þe Æþerēd his cumpæder healdan sceolde; ond eft ōþre sīþe hē wæs on hergað gelend on þæt ilce rīce þā þā mon his geweorc ābræc.
text_bare: Ac sona swa hie to Beamfleote comon, ond þæt geweorc geworct wæs, swa hergode he on his rice, þone ilcan ende þe Æþered his cumpæder healdan sceolde; ond eft oþre siþe he wæs on hergað gelend on þæt ilce rice þa þa mon his geweorc abræc.

text: Þā sē cyning hine þā west wende mid þǣre fierde wið Exancestres, swā ic ǣr sǣde, ond sē here þā burg beseten hæfde, þā hē þǣr tō gefaren wæs, þā ēodon hīe tō hiora scipum.
text_bare: Þa se cyning hine þa west wende mid þære fierde wið Exancestres, swa ic ær sæde, ond se here þa burg beseten hæfde, þa he þær to gefaren wæs, þa eodon hie to hiora scipum.

text: Þā hē þā wið þone here þǣr west ābisgod wæs, ond þā hergas wǣron þā gegaderode bēgen tō Sceobyrig on Ēastseaxum, ond þǣr geweorc worhtun, fōron bēgen ætgædere ūp be Temese; ond him cōm micel ēaca tō ǣgþer ge of Ēastenglum ge of Norþhymbrum.
text_bare: Þa he þa wið þone here þær west abisgod wæs, ond þa hergas wæron þa gegaderode begen to Sceobyrig on Eastseaxum, ond þær geweorc worhtun, foron begen ætgædere up be Temese; ond him com micel eaca to ægþer ge of Eastenglum ge of Norþhymbrum.

text: Fōron þā ūp be Temese oþ þæt hīe gedydon æt Sǣferne; þā ūp be Sǣferne.
text_bare: Foron þa up be Temese oþ þæt hie gedydon æt Sæferne; þa up be Sæferne.

text: Þā gegaderode Æþerēd ealdormon, ond Æþelm ealdorman, ond Æþelnōþ ealdorman, ond þā cinges þegnas þe þā æt hām æt þǣm geweorcum wǣron, of ǣlcre byrig be ēastan Pedredan, ge be westan Sealwuda ge be ēastan, ge ēac be norþan Temese, ond be westan Sǣfern, ge ēac sum dǣl þæs Norðwēalcynnes.
text_bare: Þa gegaderode Æþered ealdormon, ond Æþelm ealdorman, ond Æþelnoþ ealdorman, ond þa cinges þegnas þe þa æt ham æt þæm geweorcum wæron, of ælcre byrig be eastan Pedredan, ge be westan Sealwuda ge be eastan, ge eac be norþan Temese, ond be westan Sæfern, ge eac sum dæl þæs Norðwealcynnes.

text: Þā hīe þā ealle gegaderode wǣron, þā offōron hīe þone here hindan æt Buttingtūne, on Sǣferne staþe, ond hine þǣr ūtan besǣton on ǣlce healfe, on ānum fæstenne.
text_bare: Þa hie þa ealle gegaderode wæron, þa offoron hie þone here hindan æt Buttingtune, on Sæferne staþe, ond hine þær utan besæton on ælce healfe, on anum fæstenne.

text: Þā hīe ðā fela wucena sǣton on twā healfe þǣre ē, ond sē cyng wæs west on Defnum wiþ þone sciphere, þā wǣron hīe mid metelīeste gewǣgde, ond hæfdon miclne dǣl þāra horsa freten, ond þā ōþre wǣron hungre ācwolen.
text_bare: Þa hie ða fela wucena sæton on twa healfe þære e, ond se cyng wæs west on Defnum wiþ þone sciphere, þa wæron hie mid metelieste gewægde, ond hæfdon miclne dæl þara horsa freten, ond þa oþre wæron hungre acwolen.

text: Þā ēodon hīe ūt tō ðǣm monnum þe on ēasthealfe þǣre ē wīcodon, ond him wiþ gefuhton; ond þā Crīstnan hæfdon sige.
text_bare: Þa eodon hie ut to ðæm monnum þe on easthealfe þære e wicodon, ond him wiþ gefuhton; ond þa Cristnan hæfdon sige.

text: Ond þǣr wearð Ordhēh cyninges þegn ofslægen, ond ēac monige ōþre cyninges þegnas; ond þāra Deniscra þǣr wearð swīþe wycel wæl geselgen, ond sē dǣl þe þǣr aweg cōm wurdon on flēame generede.
text_bare: Ond þær wearð Ordheh cyninges þegn ofslægen, ond eac monige oþre cyninges þegnas; ond þara Deniscra þær wearð swiþe wycel wæl geselgen, ond se dæl þe þær aweg com wurdon on fleame generede.

text: Þā hīe on Ēastseaxe cōmon tō hiora geweorce ond tō hiora scipum, þā gegaderade sīo lāf eft of Ēastenglum, ond of Norðhymbrum micelne here onforan winter, ond befæston hira wīf ond hira scipu ond hira feoh on Ēastenglum, ond fōron ānstreces dæges ond nihtes, þæt hīe gedydon on ānre wēstre ceastre on Wīrhēalum, sēo is Lēgaceaster gehāten.
text_bare: Þa hie on Eastseaxe comon to hiora geweorce ond to hiora scipum, þa gegaderade sio laf eft of Eastenglum, ond of Norðhymbrum micelne here onforan winter, ond befæston hira wif ond hira scipu ond hira feoh on Eastenglum, ond foron anstreces dæges ond nihtes, þæt hie gedydon on anre westre ceastre on Wirhealum, seo is Legaceaster gehaten.

text: Þā ne mehte sēo fird hīe nā hindan offaran, ǣr hīe wǣron inne on þǣm geweorce; besǣton þēah þæt geweorc ūtan sume twēgen dagas, ond genāmon cēapes eall þæt þǣr būton wæs, ond þā men ofslōgon þe hīe foran forrīdan mehton būtan geweorce, ond þæt corn eall forbærndon, ond mid hira horsum ond fretton on ǣlcre efenēhðe.
text_bare: Þa ne mehte seo fird hie na hindan offaran, ær hie wæron inne on þæm geweorce; besæton þeah þæt geweorc utan sume twegen dagas, ond genamon ceapes eall þæt þær buton wæs, ond þa men ofslogon þe hie foran forridan mehton butan geweorce, ond þæt corn eall forbærndon, ond mid hira horsum ond fretton on ælcre efenehðe.

text: Ond þæt wæs ymb twelf mōnað þæs þe hīe ǣr hider ofer sǣ comon.
text_bare: Ond þæt wæs ymb twelf monað þæs þe hie ær hider ofer sæ comon.

text: Ond þā sōna æfter þǣm on ðȳs gēre fōr sē here of Wīrhēale in on Norðwēalas, for þǣm hīe ðǣr sittan ne mehton: þæt wæs for ðȳ þe hīe wǣron benumene ǣgðer ge þæs cēapes ge þæs cornes, ðe hīe gehergod hæfdon.
text_bare: Ond þa sona æfter þæm on ðys gere for se here of Wirheale in on Norðwealas, for þæm hie ðær sittan ne mehton: þæt wæs for ðy þe hie wæron benumene ægðer ge þæs ceapes ge þæs cornes, ðe hie gehergod hæfdon.

text: Þā hīe ðā eft ūt of Norðwēalum wendon mid þǣre herehȳðe þe hīe ðǣr genumen hæfdon, þā fōron hīe ofer Norðhymbra lond ond Ēastengla, swā swā sēo fird hīe gerǣcan ne mehte, oþ þæt hīe cōmon on Ēastseaxna lond ēasteweard, on ān īgland þæt is ūte on þǣre sǣ, þæt is Meresīg hāten.
text_bare: Þa hie ða eft ut of Norðwealum wendon mid þære herehyðe þe hie ðær genumen hæfdon, þa foron hie ofer Norðhymbra lond ond Eastengla, swa swa seo fird hie geræcan ne mehte, oþ þæt hie comon on Eastseaxna lond easteweard, on an igland þæt is ute on þære sæ, þæt is Meresig haten.

text: Ond þā sē here eft hāmweard wende þe Exanceaster beseten hæfde, þā hergodon hīe ūp on Sūðseaxum nēah Cisseceastre, ond þā burgware hīe geflīemdon, ond hira monig hund ofslōgon, ond hira scipu sumu genāmon.
text_bare: Ond þa se here eft hamweard wende þe Exanceaster beseten hæfde, þa hergodon hie up on Suðseaxum neah Cisseceastre, ond þa burgware hie gefliemdon, ond hira monig hund ofslogon, ond hira scipu sumu genamon.

text: Ðā þȳ ylcan gēre onforan winter þā Deniscan þe on Meresīge sǣton tugon hira scipu ūp on Temese, ond þā ūp on Lȳgan.
text_bare: Ða þy ylcan gere onforan winter þa Deniscan þe on Meresige sæton tugon hira scipu up on Temese, ond þa up on Lygan.

text: Þæt wæs ymb twā gēr þæs þe hīe hider ofer sǣ cōmon.
text_bare: Þæt wæs ymb twa ger þæs þe hie hider ofer sæ comon.

text: On þȳ ylcan gēre worhte sē foresprecena here geweorc be Lȳgan, mīla bufan Lundenbyrig.
text_bare: On þy ylcan gere worhte se foresprecena here geweorc be Lygan, mila bufan Lundenbyrig.

text: Þā þæs on sumera fōron micel dǣl þāra burgwara, ond ēac swā ōþres folces, þæt hīe gedydon æt þāra Deniscana geweorce, ond þǣr wurdon geflīemde, ond sume fēower cyninges þegnas ofslægene.
text_bare: Þa þæs on sumera foron micel dæl þara burgwara, ond eac swa oþres folces, þæt hie gedydon æt þara Deniscana geweorce, ond þær wurdon gefliemde, ond sume feower cyninges þegnas ofslægene.

text: Þā þæs on hærfeste þā wīcode sē cyng on nēaweste þāre byrig, þā hwīle þe hīe hira corn gerypon, þæt þā Deniscan him ne mehton þæs ripes forwiernan.
text_bare: Þa þæs on hærfeste þa wicode se cyng on neaweste þare byrig, þa hwile þe hie hira corn gerypon, þæt þa Deniscan him ne mehton þæs ripes forwiernan.

text: Þā sume dæge rād sē cyng ūp bi þǣre ēæ, ond gehāwade hwǣr mon mehte þā ēa forwyrcan, þæt hīe ne mehton þā scipu ūt brengan.
text_bare: Þa sume dæge rad se cyng up bi þære eæ, ond gehawade hwær mon mehte þa ea forwyrcan, þæt hie ne mehton þa scipu ut brengan.

text: Ond hīe ðā swā dydon: worhton ðā tū geweorc on twā healfe þǣre ēas.
text_bare: Ond hie ða swa dydon: worhton ða tu geweorc on twa healfe þære eas.

text: Þā hīe ðā þæt geweorc furþum ongunnen hæfdon, ond þǣr tō gewīcod hæfdon, þā onget sē here þæt hīe ne mehton þā scipu ūt brengan.
text_bare: Þa hie ða þæt geweorc furþum ongunnen hæfdon, ond þær to gewicod hæfdon, þa onget se here þæt hie ne mehton þa scipu ut brengan.

text: Þā forlēton hīe hīe, ond ēodon ofer land þæt hīe gedydon æt Cwātbrycge be Sǣfern, ond þǣr gewerc worhton.
text_bare: Þa forleton hie hie, ond eodon ofer land þæt hie gedydon æt Cwatbrycge be Sæfern, ond þær gewerc worhton.

text: Þā rād sēo fird west æfter þǣm herige, ond þā men of Lundenbyrig gefetedon þā scipu, ond þā ealle þe hīe ālǣdan ne mehton tōbrǣcon, ond þā þe þǣr stælwyrðe wǣron binnan Lundenbyrig gebrohton.
text_bare: Þa rad seo fird west æfter þæm herige, ond þa men of Lundenbyrig gefetedon þa scipu, ond þa ealle þe hie alædan ne mehton tobræcon, ond þa þe þær stælwyrðe wæron binnan Lundenbyrig gebrohton.

text: Ond þā Deniscan hæfdon hira wīf befæst innan Ēastengle ǣr hīe ūt of þǣm geweorce fōron.
text_bare: Ond þa Deniscan hæfdon hira wif befæst innan Eastengle ær hie ut of þæm geweorce foron.

text: Þā sǣton hīe þone winter æt Cwātbrycge.
text_bare: Þa sæton hie þone winter æt Cwatbrycge.

text: Þæt wæs ymb þrēo gēr þæs þe hīe on Limene mūðan cōmon hider ofer sǣ.
text_bare: Þæt wæs ymb þreo ger þæs þe hie on Limene muðan comon hider ofer sæ.

text: Ðā þæs on sumera on ðysum gere tōfōr sē here, sum on Ēastengle, sum on Norðhymbre.
text_bare: Ða þæs on sumera on ðysum gere tofor se here, sum on Eastengle, sum on Norðhymbre.

text: Ond þā þe feohlēase wǣron him þǣr scipu begēton, ond sūð ofer sǣ fōron tō Sigene.
text_bare: Ond þa þe feohlease wæron him þær scipu begeton, ond suð ofer sæ foron to Sigene.

text: Næfde sē here, Godes þonces, Angelcyn ealles for swīðe gebrocod; ac hīe wǣron micle swīþor gebrocede on þǣm þrīm gēarum mid cēapes cwilde ond monna, ealles swīþost mid þǣm þæt manige þāra sēlestena cynges þēna þe þǣr on londe wǣron forðfērdon on þǣm þrȳm gēarum.
text_bare: Næfde se here, Godes þonces, Angelcyn ealles for swiðe gebrocod; ac hie wæron micle swiþor gebrocede on þæm þrim gearum mid ceapes cwilde ond monna, ealles swiþost mid þæm þæt manige þara selestena cynges þena þe þær on londe wæron forðferdon on þæm þrym gearum.

text: Þāra wæs sum Swīðulf biscop on Hrōfesceastre, ond Cēolmund ealdormon on Cent, ond Beorhtulf ealdormon on Ēastseaxum, ond Wulfrēd ealdormon on Hāmtūnscīre, ond Ealhheard biscop æt Dorceceastre, ond Ēadulf cynges þegn on Sūðseaxum, ond Beornulf wīcgefera on Winteceastre, ond Ecgulf cynges horsþegn, ond manige ēac him, þēh ic ðā geðungnestan nemde.
text_bare: Þara wæs sum Swiðulf biscop on Hrofesceastre, ond Ceolmund ealdormon on Cent, ond Beorhtulf ealdormon on Eastseaxum, ond Wulfred ealdormon on Hamtunscire, ond Ealhheard biscop æt Dorceceastre, ond Eadulf cynges þegn on Suðseaxum, ond Beornulf wicgefera on Winteceastre, ond Ecgulf cynges horsþegn, ond manige eac him, þeh ic ða geðungnestan nemde.

text: Þȳ ilcan gēare drehton þā hergas on Ēastenglum ond on Norðhymbrum Westseaxna lond swīðe be þǣm sūðstæðe mid stælhergum, ealra swīþust mid ðǣm æscum þe hīe fela gēara ǣr timbredon.
text_bare: Þy ilcan geare drehton þa hergas on Eastenglum ond on Norðhymbrum Westseaxna lond swiðe be þæm suðstæðe mid stælhergum, ealra swiþust mid ðæm æscum þe hie fela geara ær timbredon.

text: Þā hēt Ælfrēd cyng timbran lang scipu ongēn ðā æscas; þā wǣron ful nēah tū swā lange swā þā ōðru; sume hæfdon āra, sume mā; þā wǣron ǣgðer ge swiftran, ge unwealtran, ge ēac hīerran þonne þā ōðru; nǣron nāwðer nē on Frēsisc gescæpene nē on Denisc, būte swā him selfum ðūhte þæt hīe nytwyrðoste bēon meahten.
text_bare: Þa het Ælfred cyng timbran lang scipu ongen ða æscas; þa wæron ful neah tu swa lange swa þa oðru; sume hæfdon ara, sume ma; þa wæron ægðer ge swiftran, ge unwealtran, ge eac hierran þonne þa oðru; næron nawðer ne on Fresisc gescæpene ne on Denisc, bute swa him selfum ðuhte þæt hie nytwyrðoste beon meahten.

text: Þā æt sumum cirre þæs ilcan gēares cōmon þǣr sex scipu tō Wiht, ond þær micel yfel gedydon, ǣgðer ge on Defenum ge wel hwǣr be ðǣm sǣriman.
text_bare: Þa æt sumum cirre þæs ilcan geares comon þær sex scipu to Wiht, ond þær micel yfel gedydon, ægðer ge on Defenum ge wel hwær be ðæm særiman.

text: Þā hēt sē cyng faran mid nigonum tō þāra nīwena scipa; ond forfōron him þone mūðan foran on ūtermere.
text_bare: Þa het se cyng faran mid nigonum to þara niwena scipa; ond forforon him þone muðan foran on utermere.

text: Þā fōron hie mid þrīm scipum ūt ongēn hīe, ond þrēo stōdon æt ufeweardum þǣm mūðan on drȳgum, wǣron þā men uppe on londe of āgāne.
text_bare: Þa foron hie mid þrim scipum ut ongen hie, ond þreo stodon æt ufeweardum þæm muðan on drygum, wæron þa men uppe on londe of agane.

text: Þā gefēngon hīe þāra þrēora scipa tū æt ðǣm mūðan ūteweardum, ond þā men ofslōgon, ond þæt ān oðwand; on þǣm wǣron ēac þā men ofslægene būton fīfum; þā cōmon for ðȳ on weg ðe ðāra ōþerra scipu āsǣton.
text_bare: Þa gefengon hie þara þreora scipa tu æt ðæm muðan uteweardum, ond þa men ofslogon, ond þæt an oðwand; on þæm wæron eac þa men ofslægene buton fifum; þa comon for ðy on weg ðe ðara oþerra scipu asæton.

text: Þā wurdon ēac swīðe unēðelīce āseten.
text_bare: Þa wurdon eac swiðe uneðelice aseten.

text: Þrēo āsǣton on ðā healfe þæs dēopes ðe ðā Deniscan scipu āseten wǣron, ond þā ōðru eall on ōþre healfe, þæt hira ne mehte nān tō ōðrum.
text_bare: Þreo asæton on ða healfe þæs deopes ðe ða Deniscan scipu aseten wæron, ond þa oðru eall on oþre healfe, þæt hira ne mehte nan to oðrum.

text: Ac ðā þæt wæter wæs āhebbad fela furlanga from þǣm scipum, þā ēodan ðā Deniscan from þǣm þrīm scipum tō þǣm ōðrum þrīm þe on hira healfe beebbade wǣron, ond hīe þā þǣr gefuhton.
text_bare: Ac ða þæt wæter wæs ahebbad fela furlanga from þæm scipum, þa eodan ða Deniscan from þæm þrim scipum to þæm oðrum þrim þe on hira healfe beebbade wæron, ond hie þa þær gefuhton.

text: Þǣr wearð ofslægen Lucumon cynges gerēfa, ond Wulfheard Frīesa.
text_bare: Þær wearð ofslægen Lucumon cynges gerefa, ond Wulfheard Friesa.

text: ond Æbbe Frīesa, ond Æðelhere Frīesa, ond Æðelferð cynges genēat, ond ealra monna, Frēsiscra ond Engliscra , ond þāra Deniscena .
text_bare: ond Æbbe Friesa, ond Æðelhere Friesa, ond Æðelferð cynges geneat, ond ealra monna, Fresiscra ond Engliscra , ond þara Deniscena .

text: Þā cōm þǣm Deniscum scipum þēh ǣr flōd tō, ǣr þā Crīstnan mehten hira ūt āscūfan, ond hīe for ðȳ ūt oðrēowon.
text_bare: Þa com þæm Deniscum scipum þeh ær flod to, ær þa Cristnan mehten hira ut ascufan, ond hie for ðy ut oðreowon.

text: Þā wǣron hīe tō þǣm gesārgode þæt hīe ne mehton Sūðseaxna lond ūtan berōwan, ac hira þǣr tū sǣ on lond wearp; ond þā men mon lǣdde tō Winteceastre tō þǣm cynge, ond hē hīe ðǣr āhōn hēt; ond þā men cōmon on Ēastengle þe on þǣm ānum scipe wǣron.
text_bare: Þa wæron hie to þæm gesargode þæt hie ne mehton Suðseaxna lond utan berowan, ac hira þær tu sæ on lond wearp; ond þa men mon lædde to Winteceastre to þæm cynge, ond he hie ðær ahon het; ond þa men comon on Eastengle þe on þæm anum scipe wæron.

text: swīðe forwundode.
text_bare: swiðe forwundode.

text: Þȳ ilcan sumera forwearð nō lǣs þonne scipa mid monnum mid ealle be þām sūðriman.
text_bare: Þy ilcan sumera forwearð no læs þonne scipa mid monnum mid ealle be þam suðriman.

text: Þȳ ilcan gēre forðfērde Wulfrīc cynges horsðegn, sē wæs ēac Wealhgefēra.
text_bare: Þy ilcan gere forðferde Wulfric cynges horsðegn, se wæs eac Wealhgefera.

text: Hēr gefōr Ælfrēd Aþulfing, syx nihtum ǣr ealra hāligra mæssan.
text_bare: Her gefor Ælfred Aþulfing, syx nihtum ær ealra haligra mæssan.

text: Sē wæs cyning ofer eall Ongelcyn būtan ðǣm dǣle þe under Dena onwalde wæs, ond hē hēold þæt rīce ōþrum healfum lǣs þe wintra.
text_bare: Se wæs cyning ofer eall Ongelcyn butan ðæm dæle þe under Dena onwalde wæs, ond he heold þæt rice oþrum healfum læs þe wintra.

text: Ond þā feng Ēadweard his sunu tō rīce.
text_bare: Ond þa feng Eadweard his sunu to rice.

text: Ælfrēd kyning hāteð grētan Wærferð biscep his wordum luflīce ond frēondlīce; ond ðē cȳðan hāte ðæt mē cōm swīðe oft gemynd, hwelce wiotan īu wǣron giond Angelcynn, ǣgðer ge godcundra hāda ge woruldcundra; ond hū gesǣliglīca tīda ðā wǣron giond Angelcynn; ond hū ðā kyningas ðe ðone onwald hæfdon ðæs folces on ðām dagum Gode ond his ǣrendwrecum hērsumedon; ond hū hīe ǣgðer ge hiora sibbe ge ge hiora siodo ge hiora onweald innanbordes gehīoldon, ond ēac ūt hiora ēðel gerȳmdon; ond hū him ðā spēow ǣgðer ge mid wīge ge mid wīsdōme; ond ēac ðā godcundan hādas hū giorne hīe wǣron ǣgðer ge ymb lāre ge ymb liornunga, ge ymb ealle ðā ðīowotdōmas ðe hīe Gode dōn scoldon; ond hū man ūtanbordes wīsdōm ond lāre hieder on lond sōhte, ond hū wē hīe nū sceoldan ūte begietan, gif wē hīe habban sceoldan.
text_bare: Ælfred kyning hateð gretan Wærferð biscep his wordum luflice ond freondlice; ond ðe cyðan hate ðæt me com swiðe oft gemynd, hwelce wiotan iu wæron giond Angelcynn, ægðer ge godcundra hada ge woruldcundra; ond hu gesæliglica tida ða wæron giond Angelcynn; ond hu ða kyningas ðe ðone onwald hæfdon ðæs folces on ðam dagum Gode ond his ærendwrecum hersumedon; ond hu hie ægðer ge hiora sibbe ge ge hiora siodo ge hiora onweald innanbordes gehioldon, ond eac ut hiora eðel gerymdon; ond hu him ða speow ægðer ge mid wige ge mid wisdome; ond eac ða godcundan hadas hu giorne hie wæron ægðer ge ymb lare ge ymb liornunga, ge ymb ealle ða ðiowotdomas ðe hie Gode don scoldon; ond hu man utanbordes wisdom ond lare hieder on lond sohte, ond hu we hie nu sceoldan ute begietan, gif we hie habban sceoldan.

text: Swǣ clǣne hīo wæs oðfeallenu on Angelcynne ðæt swīðe fēawa wǣron behionan Humbre ðe hiora ðēninga cūðen understondan on Englisc oððe furðum ān ǣrendgewrit of Lǣdene on Englisc āreccan; ond ic wēne ðætte nōht monige begiondan Humbre nǣren.
text_bare: Swæ clæne hio wæs oðfeallenu on Angelcynne ðæt swiðe feawa wæron behionan Humbre ðe hiora ðeninga cuðen understondan on Englisc oððe furðum an ærendgewrit of Lædene on Englisc areccan; ond ic wene ðætte noht monige begiondan Humbre næren.

text: Swǣ fēawa hiora wǣron ðæt ic furðum ānne ānlēne ne mæg geðencean be sūðan Temese, ðā ðā ic tō rīce fēng.
text_bare: Swæ feawa hiora wæron ðæt ic furðum anne anlene ne mæg geðencean be suðan Temese, ða ða ic to rice feng.

text: Gode ælmihtegum sīe ðonc ðætte wē nū ǣnigne onstāl habbað lārēowa.
text_bare: Gode ælmihtegum sie ðonc ðætte we nu ænigne onstal habbað lareowa.

text: Ond for ðon ic ðē bebīode ðæt ðū dō swǣ ic gelīefe ðæt ðū wille, ðæt ðū ðē ðissa woruldðinga tō ðǣm geǣmetige; swǣ ðū oftost mæge, ðæt ðū ðone wīsdōm ðe ðē God sealde ðǣr ðǣr ðū hiene befæstan mæge, befæste.
text_bare: Ond for ðon ic ðe bebiode ðæt ðu do swæ ic geliefe ðæt ðu wille, ðæt ðu ðe ðissa woruldðinga to ðæm geæmetige; swæ ðu oftost mæge, ðæt ðu ðone wisdom ðe ðe God sealde ðær ðær ðu hiene befæstan mæge, befæste.

text: Geðenc hwelc wītu ūs ðā becōmon for ðisse worulde, ðā ðā wē hit nōhwæðer nē selfe ne lufodon, nē ēac ōðrum monnum ne lēfdon: ðone naman ānne wē lufodon ðætte wē Crīstne wǣren, ond swīðe fēawe ðā ðēawas.
text_bare: Geðenc hwelc witu us ða becomon for ðisse worulde, ða ða we hit nohwæðer ne selfe ne lufodon, ne eac oðrum monnum ne lefdon: ðone naman anne we lufodon ðætte we Cristne wæren, ond swiðe feawe ða ðeawas.

text: Ðā ic ðā ðis eall gemunde, ðā gemunde ic ēac hū ic geseah, ǣr ðǣm ðe hit eall forhergod wǣre ond forbærned, hū ðā ciricean giond eall Angelcynn stōdon māðma ond bōca gefylda, ond ēac micel menigeo Godes ðīowa, ond ðā swīðe lȳtle fiorme ðāra bōca wiston, for ðǣm ðe hīe hiora nānwuht ongietan, ne meahton, for ðǣm ðe hīe nǣron on hiora agen geðīode āwritene.
text_bare: Ða ic ða ðis eall gemunde, ða gemunde ic eac hu ic geseah, ær ðæm ðe hit eall forhergod wære ond forbærned, hu ða ciricean giond eall Angelcynn stodon maðma ond boca gefylda, ond eac micel menigeo Godes ðiowa, ond ða swiðe lytle fiorme ðara boca wiston, for ðæm ðe hie hiora nanwuht ongietan, ne meahton, for ðæm ðe hie næron on hiora agen geðiode awritene.

text: Swelce hīe cwǣðen: 'Ūre ieldran, ðā ðe ðās stōwa ǣr hīoldon, hīe lufodon wīsdōm, ond ðurh ðone hīe begēaton welan, ond ūs lǣfdon.
text_bare: Swelce hie cwæðen: 'Ure ieldran, ða ðe ðas stowa ær hioldon, hie lufodon wisdom, ond ðurh ðone hie begeaton welan, ond us læfdon.

text: Hēr mon mæg gīet gesīon hiora swæð, ac wē him ne cunnon æfter spyrigean, ond for ðǣm wē habbað nū ǣgðer forlǣten ge ðone welcan ge ðone wīsdōm, for ðǣm ðe wē noldon tō ðǣm spore mid ūre mōde onlūtan.'
text_bare: Her mon mæg giet gesion hiora swæð, ac we him ne cunnon æfter spyrigean, ond for ðæm we habbað nu ægðer forlæten ge ðone welcan ge ðone wisdom, for ðæm ðe we noldon to ðæm spore mid ure mode onlutan.'

text: Ðā ic ðā ðis eall gemunde, ðā wundrade ic swīðe swīðe ðāra gōdena wiotona ðe gīu wǣron giond Angelcynn, ond ðā bēc ealla be fullan geliornod hæfdon, ðæt hīe hiora ðā nǣnne dǣl noldon on hiora āgen geðīode wendan.
text_bare: Ða ic ða ðis eall gemunde, ða wundrade ic swiðe swiðe ðara godena wiotona ðe giu wæron giond Angelcynn, ond ða bec ealla be fullan geliornod hæfdon, ðæt hie hiora ða nænne dæl noldon on hiora agen geðiode wendan.

text: Ac ic ðā sōna eft mē selfum andwyrde, ond cwæð: 'Hīe ne wēndon þætte ǣfre menn sceoldon swǣ rēccelēase weorðan, ond sīo lār swǣ oðfeallan; for ðǣre wilnunga hīe hit forlēton, ond woldon ðæt hēr ðȳ māra wīsdōm on londe wǣre ðȳ wē mā geðēoda cūðon.'
text_bare: Ac ic ða sona eft me selfum andwyrde, ond cwæð: 'Hie ne wendon þætte æfre menn sceoldon swæ reccelease weorðan, ond sio lar swæ oðfeallan; for ðære wilnunga hie hit forleton, ond woldon ðæt her ðy mara wisdom on londe wære ðy we ma geðeoda cuðon.'

text: Ðā gemunde ic hū sīo ǣ wæs ǣrest on Ebrēisc geðīode funden, ond eft, ðā hīe Crēacas geliornoden, ðā wendon hīe hīe on hiora āgen geðīode ealle, ond ēac ealle ōðre bēc.
text_bare: Ða gemunde ic hu sio æ wæs ærest on Ebreisc geðiode funden, ond eft, ða hie Creacas geliornoden, ða wendon hie hie on hiora agen geðiode ealle, ond eac ealle oðre bec.

text: Ond eft Lǣdenware swǣ same, siððan hīe hīe geliornodon, hīe hīe wendon ealla ðurh wīse wealhstōdas on hiora āgen geðīode.
text_bare: Ond eft Lædenware swæ same, siððan hie hie geliornodon, hie hie wendon ealla ðurh wise wealhstodas on hiora agen geðiode.

text: Ond ēac ealla ōðra Crīstena ðīoda sumne dǣl hiora on hiora āgen geðīode wendon.
text_bare: Ond eac ealla oðra Cristena ðioda sumne dæl hiora on hiora agen geðiode wendon.

text: For ðȳ mē ðyncð betre, gif īow swǣ ðyncð, ðæt wē ēac suma bēc, ðā ðe nīedbeðearfosta sīen eallum monnum tō wiotonne, ðæt wē ðā on ðæt geðīode wenden ðe wē ealle gecnāwan mægen, ond gedōn swǣ wē swīðe ēaðe magon mid Godes fultume, gif wē ðā stilnesse habbað, ðætte eall sīo gioguð ðe nū is on Angelcynne frīora monna, ðāra ðe ðā spēda hæbben ðæt hīe ðǣm befeolan mægen, sīen tō leornunga oðfæste, ðā hwile ðe hīe tō nānre ōðerre note ne mægen, oðone first ðe hīe wel cunnen Englisc gewrit ārǣdan: lǣre mon siððan furður on Lǣdengeðīodes ǣr ðissum āfeallen wæs giond Angelcynn, ond ðēah monige cūðon Englisc gewrit ārǣdan, ðā ongan ic ongemang ōðrum mislīcum on manigfealdum bisgum ðisses kynerīces ðā bōc endan on Englisc ðe is genemned on Lǣden 'Pastoralis,' ond on Englisc 'Hierdebōc,' hwīlum word be worde, hwīlum angit of angiete, swǣ swǣ ic hīe geliornode æt Plegmunde mīnum ærcebiscepe, ond æt Assere mīnum biscepe, ond æt Grimbolde mīnum mæsseprīoste, ond æt Iōhanne mīnum mæsseprīoste.
text_bare: For ðy me ðyncð betre, gif iow swæ ðyncð, ðæt we eac suma bec, ða ðe niedbeðearfosta sien eallum monnum to wiotonne, ðæt we ða on ðæt geðiode wenden ðe we ealle gecnawan mægen, ond gedon swæ we swiðe eaðe magon mid Godes fultume, gif we ða stilnesse habbað, ðætte eall sio gioguð ðe nu is on Angelcynne friora monna, ðara ðe ða speda hæbben ðæt hie ðæm befeolan mægen, sien to leornunga oðfæste, ða hwile ðe hie to nanre oðerre note ne mægen, oðone first ðe hie wel cunnen Englisc gewrit arædan: lære mon siððan furður on Lædengeðiodes ær ðissum afeallen wæs giond Angelcynn, ond ðeah monige cuðon Englisc gewrit arædan, ða ongan ic ongemang oðrum mislicum on manigfealdum bisgum ðisses kynerices ða boc endan on Englisc ðe is genemned on Læden 'Pastoralis,' ond on Englisc 'Hierdeboc,' hwilum word be worde, hwilum angit of angiete, swæ swæ ic hie geliornode æt Plegmunde minum ærcebiscepe, ond æt Assere minum biscepe, ond æt Grimbolde minum mæsseprioste, ond æt Iohanne minum mæsseprioste.

text: Siððan ic hīe heliornod hæfde, swǣ swǣ ic hīe forstōd, ond swǣ ic hīe andgitfullīcost āreccean meahte, ic hīe on Englisc āwende; ond tō ǣlcum biscepstōle on mīnum rīce wille āne onsendan; ond on ǣlcre bið ān æstel, sē bið on fīftengum mancessa, Ond ic bebīode on Godes naman ðæt nān mon ðone æstel from ðǣre bēc ne dō, ne ðā bōc from ðǣm mynstre; uncūð hū longe ðǣr swǣ gelǣrede biscepas sīen, swǣ swǣ nū, Gode ðonc, wel hwǣr siendon.
text_bare: Siððan ic hie heliornod hæfde, swæ swæ ic hie forstod, ond swæ ic hie andgitfullicost areccean meahte, ic hie on Englisc awende; ond to ælcum biscepstole on minum rice wille ane onsendan; ond on ælcre bið an æstel, se bið on fiftengum mancessa, Ond ic bebiode on Godes naman ðæt nan mon ðone æstel from ðære bec ne do, ne ða boc from ðæm mynstre; uncuð hu longe ðær swæ gelærede biscepas sien, swæ swæ nu, Gode ðonc, wel hwær siendon.

text: For ðȳ ic wolde ðætte hīe ealneg æt ðǣre stōwe wǣren, būton sē biscep hīe mid him habban wille, oððe hīo hwǣr tō lǣne sīe, oððe hwā ōðre bī wrīte.
text_bare: For ðy ic wolde ðætte hie ealneg æt ðære stowe wæren, buton se biscep hie mid him habban wille, oððe hio hwær to læne sie, oððe hwa oðre bi write.

text: Þū lēofusta brōður, suīðe frēondlīce ond suīðe fresumlīce ðū mē tǣldesð ond mid ēadmōde ingeðonce ðū mē cīddesð, for ðon ic mīn māð ond wolde flēon ðā byrðenne ðǣre hirdelecan gīemenne.
text_bare: Þu leofusta broður, suiðe freondlice ond suiðe fresumlice ðu me tældesð ond mid eadmode ingeðonce ðu me ciddesð, for ðon ic min mað ond wolde fleon ða byrðenne ðære hirdelecan giemenne.

text: Ðāra byrðenna hefignesse, eall ðæt ic his geman, ic āwrīte on ðisse andwardan bēc, ðȳ lǣs hī hwǣm leohte ðyncen tō underfōnne; ond ic ēac lǣre ðæt hira nān ðāra ne wilnie ðe hine unwærlīce begā; ond sē ðe hī unwærlīce ond unryhtlīce gewilnige, ondrǣde hē ðæt hē hī ǣfre underfēnge.
text_bare: Ðara byrðenna hefignesse, eall ðæt ic his geman, ic awrite on ðisse andwardan bec, ðy læs hi hwæm leohte ðyncen to underfonne; ond ic eac lære ðæt hira nan ðara ne wilnie ðe hine unwærlice bega; ond se ðe hi unwærlice ond unryhtlice gewilnige, ondræde he ðæt he hi æfre underfenge.

text: Nū ic wilnige ðætte ðēos sprǣc stigge on ðæt ingeðonc ðæs leorneres, swǣ swǣ on sume hlǣdre, stæpmǣlum nēar ond nēar, oð ðæt hīo fæstlīce gestonde on ðǣm solore ðæs mōdes ðe hī leornige.
text_bare: Nu ic wilnige ðætte ðeos spræc stigge on ðæt ingeðonc ðæs leorneres, swæ swæ on sume hlædre, stæpmælum near ond near, oð ðæt hio fæstlice gestonde on ðæm solore ðæs modes ðe hi leornige.

text: Ond for ðȳ ic hī tōdǣle on fēower: ān is ðāra dǣla, hū hē on ðone folgoð becume; ōðer, hū hē ðǣr on libbe; ðridda is, hū hē ðǣr on lǣre; fēorða is, hū hē his āgene unðēawas ongietan wille on hira geðæf bīon, ðȳ lǣs hē ðȳ underfenge his ēaðmōdnesse forlǣte; oððe eft his līf sīe ungelīc his ðēnunga, oððe hē tō ðrīste ond tō stīð sīe for ðȳ underfenge his lārēowdōmes; ac gemitgige hit sē ege his āgenra unðēowa, ond befæste hē mid his līfes bisenum ðā lāre ðǣm ðe his wordum ne gelīefen; ond ðonne hē gōd weorc wyrce, gemyne hē ðæs yfeles ðe hē worhte, þætte sīo unrōtnes ðe hē for ðǣm yflan weorcum hæbbe, gemetgige ðone gefēan ðe hē for ðǣm gōdan weorcum hæfde, ðȳ lǣs hē befoan ðǣs dieglan Dēman ēagum sīe āhafen on his mōde ond on ofermēttum āðunden, ond ðonne ðurh ðæt selflīce his gōdan weorc forlēose.
text_bare: Ond for ðy ic hi todæle on feower: an is ðara dæla, hu he on ðone folgoð becume; oðer, hu he ðær on libbe; ðridda is, hu he ðær on lære; feorða is, hu he his agene unðeawas ongietan wille on hira geðæf bion, ðy læs he ðy underfenge his eaðmodnesse forlæte; oððe eft his lif sie ungelic his ðenunga, oððe he to ðriste ond to stið sie for ðy underfenge his lareowdomes; ac gemitgige hit se ege his agenra unðeowa, ond befæste he mid his lifes bisenum ða lare ðæm ðe his wordum ne geliefen; ond ðonne he god weorc wyrce, gemyne he ðæs yfeles ðe he worhte, þætte sio unrotnes ðe he for ðæm yflan weorcum hæbbe, gemetgige ðone gefean ðe he for ðæm godan weorcum hæfde, ðy læs he befoan ðæs dieglan Deman eagum sie ahafen on his mode ond on ofermettum aðunden, ond ðonne ðurh ðæt selflice his godan weorc forleose.

text: Ac monige sindon mē suīðe onlīce on ungelǣrednesse, ðēah ðe hī nǣfre leorningcnihtas nǣren, wilniað ðēah lārēowas tō beōonne, ond ðynceð him suīðe leoht sīo byrðen ðæs lārēowdōmes, for ðon ðe hī ne cunnon ðæt mægen his micelnesse.
text_bare: Ac monige sindon me suiðe onlice on ungelærednesse, ðeah ðe hi næfre leorningcnihtas næren, wilniað ðeah lareowas to beoonne, ond ðynceð him suiðe leoht sio byrðen ðæs lareowdomes, for ðon ðe hi ne cunnon ðæt mægen his micelnesse.

text: From ðǣre dura selfre ðisse bēc, ðæt is from onginne ðisse sprǣce, sint ādrifene ond getǣlde ðā unwaran ðe him āgniað ðone cræft ðæs lārēowdōmes ðe hī nā ne geleornodon.
text_bare: From ðære dura selfre ðisse bec, ðæt is from onginne ðisse spræce, sint adrifene ond getælde ða unwaran ðe him agniað ðone cræft ðæs lareowdomes ðe hi na ne geleornodon.

text: I.
text_bare: I.

text: Ðætte unlǣrde ne dyrren underfōn lārēowdōm.
text_bare: Ðætte unlærde ne dyrren underfon lareowdom.

text: For ðon ðe nān cræft nis tō lǣranne ðǣm ðe hine ǣr geornlīce ne leornode, for hwon bēoð ǣfre suǣ þrīste ðā ungelǣredan ðæt hī underfōn ðā heorde ðæs lārīowdōmes, ðonne sē cræft ðæs lārēowdōmes bið cræft ealra cræfta?
text_bare: For ðon ðe nan cræft nis to læranne ðæm ðe hine ær geornlice ne leornode, for hwon beoð æfre suæ þriste ða ungelæredan ðæt hi underfon ða heorde ðæs lariowdomes, ðonne se cræft ðæs lareowdomes bið cræft ealra cræfta?

text: Huā nāt ðæt ðā wunda ðæs mōdes bīoð dīgelran ðonne ðā wunda ðæs līchaman?
text_bare: Hua nat ðæt ða wunda ðæs modes bioð digelran ðonne ða wunda ðæs lichaman?

text: Ond ðēah ðā woroldlecan lǣcas scomað ðæt hī onginnen ðā wundan lācnian ðe hī gesīon ne magon, ond huru gif hī nōuðer gecnāwan ne cunnan nē ðā medtrymnesse nē ēac ðā wyrta ðe ðǣr wið sculon.
text_bare: Ond ðeah ða woroldlecan læcas scomað ðæt hi onginnen ða wundan lacnian ðe hi gesion ne magon, ond huru gif hi nouðer gecnawan ne cunnan ne ða medtrymnesse ne eac ða wyrta ðe ðær wið sculon.

text: Ond hwīlon ne scomað ðā ðe ðæs mōdes lǣceas bēon scoldon, ðēah ðe hī nāne wuht ongitan ne cunnon ðāra gǣstlecena beboda, ðæt hīe him ontēoð ðæt hīe sīen heortan lǣcas.
text_bare: Ond hwilon ne scomað ða ðe ðæs modes læceas beon scoldon, ðeah ðe hi nane wuht ongitan ne cunnon ðara gæstlecena beboda, ðæt hie him onteoð ðæt hie sien heortan læcas.

text: Ac for ðon ðe nū eall sē weorðscipe ðisse worolde is gecierred -- Gode ðonc -- tō weorðscipe ðǣm ǣwfæstum, ðæt ðā sindon nū weorðoste ðe ǣwfæstoste sindon, for ðone līcet suīðe monig ðæt hē ǣwfæsð lārēow sīe, ðe hē wilnað micle woroldāre habban.
text_bare: Ac for ðon ðe nu eall se weorðscipe ðisse worolde is gecierred -- Gode ðonc -- to weorðscipe ðæm æwfæstum, ðæt ða sindon nu weorðoste ðe æwfæstoste sindon, for ðone licet suiðe monig ðæt he æwfæsð lareow sie, ðe he wilnað micle woroldare habban.
