text: Be ðām Crīsð selfa cleopode ond ðus cwæð: 'Hī sēcað ðæt hī mon ǣrest grēte ond worðige on cēapstōwum ond on gebēorscipum, ond ðæt hīe fyrmest hlynigen æt ǣfengieflum, ond ðæt ieldesðe setl on gemētengum hī sēcað.' For ðon hīe suā on ofermēttum on mid ūpāhafenesse becumað tō ðǣre āre ðǣre hirdelecan gīemenne hī ne magon medomlīce ðēnian ðā ðēnunga, ond ðǣre ēaðmōdnesse lārēowas bīon; ac sīon tunge bið gescinded on ðām lārīowdōme ðonne hīo ōðer lǣreð, ōðer hīo liornode.
text_bare: Be ðam Crisð selfa cleopode ond ðus cwæð: 'Hi secað ðæt hi mon ærest grete ond worðige on ceapstowum ond on gebeorscipum, ond ðæt hie fyrmest hlynigen æt æfengieflum, ond ðæt ieldesðe setl on gemetengum hi secað.' For ðon hie sua on ofermettum on mid upahafenesse becumað to ðære are ðære hirdelecan giemenne hi ne magon medomlice ðenian ða ðenunga, ond ðære eaðmodnesse lareowas bion; ac sion tunge bið gescinded on ðam lariowdome ðonne hio oðer læreð, oðer hio liornode.

text: Suelcum monnum Dryhten cīdde ðurh ðone wītgan, ond him suelfc oðwāt, ðā hē cwæð: 'Hīe rīcsedon, næs ðēah mīnes ðonces; ealdormen hī wǣron, ond ic hīe ne cūðe.' Ðā ðe suā rīciað, hī rīcsiað of hira āgnum dōme, næs of ðæs hīehstan Dēman, ðonne hī ne bēð mid nānre sylle underscotene ðæs godcundlīcan mægenes, nē for nānum cræfte gecorene, ac mid hira āgenre gewilnunge hīe bīoð onbærnede, ðæt hīe gerēafiað suā hēane lārīowdōm suīðor ðonne hī hine geearnien.
text_bare: Suelcum monnum Dryhten cidde ðurh ðone witgan, ond him suelfc oðwat, ða he cwæð: 'Hie ricsedon, næs ðeah mines ðonces; ealdormen hi wæron, ond ic hie ne cuðe.' Ða ðe sua riciað, hi ricsiað of hira agnum dome, næs of ðæs hiehstan Deman, ðonne hi ne beð mid nanre sylle underscotene ðæs godcundlican mægenes, ne for nanum cræfte gecorene, ac mid hira agenre gewilnunge hie bioð onbærnede, ðæt hie gereafiað sua heane lariowdom suiðor ðonne hi hine geearnien.

text: Hīe ðonne sē ēca ond sē dīegla Dēma ūpāhefeð suelce hē hī nyte, ond geðafiende hē hit forbireð for ðām ðōme his geðylde.
text_bare: Hie ðonne se eca ond se diegla Dema upahefeð suelce he hi nyte, ond geðafiende he hit forbireð for ðam ðome his geðylde.

text: Ac ðēah hī on ðām hāde fela wundra wyrcen, eft ðonne hī tō cumað, hē cuið: 'Gewītað from mē, gē unryhtwyrtan!
text_bare: Ac ðeah hi on ðam hade fela wundra wyrcen, eft ðonne hi to cumað, he cuið: 'Gewitað from me, ge unryhtwyrtan!

text: nāt ic hwæt gē sint.' Eft hē hīe ðrēade ðurh ðone wītgan for hira ungelǣrednesse, ðā hē cuæð: 'Ðā hierdas næfdon ondgit: hīe hæfon mīne ǣ, ond hī mē ne gecnīowon.' Sē ðe Godes bebodu ne gecnǣwð, ni bið hē oncnāwen from Gode.
text_bare: nat ic hwæt ge sint.' Eft he hie ðreade ðurh ðone witgan for hira ungelærednesse, ða he cuæð: 'Ða hierdas næfdon ondgit: hie hæfon mine æ, ond hi me ne gecniowon.' Se ðe Godes bebodu ne gecnæwð, ni bið he oncnawen from Gode.

text: Ðæt ilce cuæð sanctus Paulus: 'Sē ðe God ne ongit, ne ongit God hine.' Unwīse lārēowsas cumað for ðæs folces synnum; for ðon oft for ðæs lārēowes unwīsdōme misfarað ðā hīeremenn, ond oft for ðæs lārēowes wīsdōme unwīsum hīeremonnum bið geborgen.
text_bare: Ðæt ilce cuæð sanctus Paulus: 'Se ðe God ne ongit, ne ongit God hine.' Unwise lareowsas cumað for ðæs folces synnum; for ðon oft for ðæs lareowes unwisdome misfarað ða hieremenn, ond oft for ðæs lareowes wisdome unwisum hieremonnum bið geborgen.

text: Gif ðonne ǣgðer bið unwīs, ðonne is tō geðencanne hwæt Crīsð self cuæð on his godseplle; hē cwæð: 'Gif sē blinda ðone blindan lǣt, hī feallað bēgen on ǣnne pytt.' Be ðǣm ilcan sē sealmscop cuæð: 'Sīen hira ēagan āðīstrode ðæt hī ne gesēon, ond hiora hrycg simle gebīeged.' Ne cwæð hē ðæt for ðȳ ðe hē ǣnegum men ðæs sȳscte oððe wilnode, ac hē wītgode suā suā hit geweorðan sceolde.
text_bare: Gif ðonne ægðer bið unwis, ðonne is to geðencanne hwæt Crisð self cuæð on his godseplle; he cwæð: 'Gif se blinda ðone blindan læt, hi feallað begen on ænne pytt.' Be ðæm ilcan se sealmscop cuæð: 'Sien hira eagan aðistrode ðæt hi ne geseon, ond hiora hrycg simle gebieged.' Ne cwæð he ðæt for ðy ðe he ænegum men ðæs syscte oððe wilnode, ac he witgode sua sua hit geweorðan sceolde.

text: Sōðlīce ðā ēagan ðæt bēoð ðā lārēowas, ond sē hrycg ðæt sint ðā hīeremenn; for ðan ðā ēagan bīoð on ðām līchoman foreweardum ond ufeweardum, ond sē hrycg færð æfter ǣlcre wuhte; suā gāð ðā lārēowas beforan ðǣm folce, ond ðæt folc æfter.
text_bare: Soðlice ða eagan ðæt beoð ða lareowas, ond se hrycg ðæt sint ða hieremenn; for ðan ða eagan bioð on ðam lichoman foreweardum ond ufeweardum, ond se hrycg færð æfter ælcre wuhte; sua gað ða lareowas beforan ðæm folce, ond ðæt folc æfter.

text: Ðonne ðām lārēowum āðīstriað ðæs mōdes ēagan, ðe beforan gān scoldon mid gōdum bīsenum, donne gebīgð ðæt folc hira hrycg tō hefegum byrðenum manegum.
text_bare: Ðonne ðam lareowum aðistriað ðæs modes eagan, ðe beforan gan scoldon mid godum bisenum, donne gebigð ðæt folc hira hrycg to hefegum byrðenum manegum.

text: Nē eft ðā gelǣredan, ðe swā nyllað libban swā hīe on bōcum leornodon ðæt hī scoldon, ne underfōn ðā āre ðæs lārēowdōmes.
text_bare: Ne eft ða gelæredan, ðe swa nyllað libban swa hie on bocum leornodon ðæt hi scoldon, ne underfon ða are ðæs lareowdomes.

text: Monige ēac wīse lārēowas winnað mid hira ðēawum wið ðā gǣsðlecan bebodu ðe hī mid wordum lǣrað, ðonne hīe on ōðre wīsan libbað, on ōðre hī lǣrað.
text_bare: Monige eac wise lareowas winnað mid hira ðeawum wið ða gæsðlecan bebodu ðe hi mid wordum lærað, ðonne hie on oðre wisan libbað, on oðre hi lærað.

text: Oft ðonne sē hirde gǣð on frēcne wegas, sīo hiord, ðe unwærre bið, gehrīst.
text_bare: Oft ðonne se hirde gæð on frecne wegas, sio hiord, ðe unwærre bið, gehrist.

text: Be suelcum hirdum cwæð sē wītga: 'Gē fortrǣdon Godes scēapa gærs, ond gē gedrēfdon hiora wæter mid īowrum fōtum, ðēah gē hit ǣr undrēfed druncen.' Suā ðā lārēowas, hī drinað suīðe hlūter wæter, donne hī ðone godcundan wīsdōm leorniað, on ēac ðonne hīe hiene lǣrað; ac hI-e hit gedrēfað mid hira āgnum unðēawum, ðonne ðæt folc bīsenað on hira unðēawum nāls on hira lāre.
text_bare: Be suelcum hirdum cwæð se witga: 'Ge fortrædon Godes sceapa gærs, ond ge gedrefdon hiora wæter mid iowrum fotum, ðeah ge hit ær undrefed druncen.' Sua ða lareowas, hi drinað suiðe hluter wæter, donne hi ðone godcundan wisdom leorniað, on eac ðonne hie hiene lærað; ac hI-e hit gedrefað mid hira agnum unðeawum, ðonne ðæt folc bisenað on hira unðeawum nals on hira lare.

text: Ðēah ðæt folc ðyrste ðǣre lāre, hīe hīe ne magon drincan, ac hīo bið gedrēfed mid ðām ðe ðā lārēowas ōðer dōð ōðer hīe lǣrað.
text_bare: Ðeah ðæt folc ðyrste ðære lare, hie hie ne magon drincan, ac hio bið gedrefed mid ðam ðe ða lareowas oðer doð oðer hie lærað.

text: Be ðǣm Dryhten cwæð eft ðurh ðone wītgan: 'Yfle prēostas bīoð folces hryre.' Ne dereð nān mon suīðor ðǣr hālgan gesomnunge ðonne ðā ðe ðone noman underfōð ond ðā endebyrdnesse ðæs hālgan hādes, ond ðonne on wōh dōð; for ðon hīe nān monn ne dearr ðrēagean ðēah hīe āgylten, ac mid ðam bēoð synna suīðe gebrǣdda ðe hīe bēoð suā geweorðade.
text_bare: Be ðæm Dryhten cwæð eft ðurh ðone witgan: 'Yfle preostas bioð folces hryre.' Ne dereð nan mon suiðor ðær halgan gesomnunge ðonne ða ðe ðone noman underfoð ond ða endebyrdnesse ðæs halgan hades, ond ðonne on woh doð; for ðon hie nan monn ne dearr ðreagean ðeah hie agylten, ac mid ðam beoð synna suiðe gebrædda ðe hie beoð sua geweorðade.

text: Ac hīe woldon selfe dlēon ðā byrðenne suā micelre scylde, ðā ðe his unwierðe wǣron, gif hē mid hora heortan ēarum woldon gehīeran ond geornlīce geðencan ðone Crīstes cuide, ðā hē cuæð: 'Sē ðe ǣnigne ðissa ierminga besuīcð, him wǣre betere ðæt him wǣre sumu esulcweorn tō ðǣm suīran getīged, ond suā āworpen tō sǣs grunde.' Ðurh ðā cweorne is getācnod sē ymbhwyrft ðisse worolde ond ēac monna līfes ond hira gesuinces, ond ðurh ðone sǣgrund hira ende ond sē sīðemesða demm.
text_bare: Ac hie woldon selfe dleon ða byrðenne sua micelre scylde, ða ðe his unwierðe wæron, gif he mid hora heortan earum woldon gehieran ond geornlice geðencan ðone Cristes cuide, ða he cuæð: 'Se ðe ænigne ðissa ierminga besuicð, him wære betere ðæt him wære sumu esulcweorn to ðæm suiran getiged, ond sua aworpen to sæs grunde.' Ðurh ða cweorne is getacnod se ymbhwyrft ðisse worolde ond eac monna lifes ond hira gesuinces, ond ðurh ðone sægrund hira ende ond se siðemesða demm.

text: Ðonne bið sīo cweorn becierred, ðonne sē monn bið geendod, ðonne bið sēo micle cweorn becierred, ðonne ðēos weorld bið geendod.
text_bare: Ðonne bið sio cweorn becierred, ðonne se monn bið geendod, ðonne bið seo micle cweorn becierred, ðonne ðeos weorld bið geendod.

text: Sē ðonne þe tō hālgum hāde becymð, ond ðonne mid yflym bīsnum oððe worda oððe weorca ōðre on wōn gebringð, betre him wǣre ðæt hē on lǣssan hāde ond on eorðlīcum weorcum his līf geendode; for ðǣm gif hē on ðǣm wel dēð, hē hæfð ðæs gōd lēan, gif hē yfle dēð lǣsse wīte hē ðrōwað on helle gif hē āna ðider cymð, ðonne hē dō gif ōðerne mid him ðider bringð.
text_bare: Se ðonne þe to halgum hade becymð, ond ðonne mid yflym bisnum oððe worda oððe weorca oðre on won gebringð, betre him wære ðæt he on læssan hade ond on eorðlicum weorcum his lif geendode; for ðæm gif he on ðæm wel deð, he hæfð ðæs god lean, gif he yfle deð læsse wite he ðrowað on helle gif he ana ðider cymð, ðonne he do gif oðerne mid him ðider bringð.

text: Hū swīðe sē reccere sceal bēon on his smēaunga ābisgod ymb ðā hālgan ǣ.
text_bare: Hu swiðe se reccere sceal beon on his smeaunga abisgod ymb ða halgan æ.

text: Ac eall ðis āredað sē reccere suīðe ryhte, ðonne hē for Godes lufum ond for Godes ege dēð ðæt ðæt hē dēð, ond ǣlce dæge geornfullīce smēað ðā bebodu hālegra gewrita, ðætte on him sīe ūppārǣred sē cræft ðǣre gīemenne ymbe ðā forescēawunga ðæs hefonlīcan līfes, ðone singālīce ðisse eorðlīcan drohtunge gewuna wilw tōweorpan būton hine sīo myndgung ðāra hāligra gewrita onbryrde.
text_bare: Ac eall ðis aredað se reccere suiðe ryhte, ðonne he for Godes lufum ond for Godes ege deð ðæt ðæt he deð, ond ælce dæge geornfullice smeað ða bebodu halegra gewrita, ðætte on him sie upparæred se cræft ðære giemenne ymbe ða foresceawunga ðæs hefonlican lifes, ðone singalice ðisse eorðlican drohtunge gewuna wilw toweorpan buton hine sio myndgung ðara haligra gewrita onbryrde.

text: For ðǣm sē eorðlīca gefērscipe hine tīehð on ðā lufe his ealdan ungewunan, hē sceal simle hīgian ðæt hē weorðe onbryrd ond geednīwad tō ðǣm hefonlīcan ēðle.
text_bare: For ðæm se eorðlica geferscipe hine tiehð on ða lufe his ealdan ungewunan, he sceal simle higian ðæt he weorðe onbryrd ond geedniwad to ðæm hefonlican eðle.

text: Ac his mōd bið swuīðe īeðegende ond suīðe ābisgad mid worðlīcra monna wodum, for ðām hit is openlīce cūð ðætte sīo ūterre ābisgung ðissa woroldðinga ðæs monnes mōd gedrēfð, ond hine scofett hidres ðidres oð ðæt hē āfielð of his āgnum willan; ac him bið ðearf ðæt hē hine genime simle be ðǣre leornunge hāligra gewrita, ond be ðām ārīse.
text_bare: Ac his mod bið swuiðe ieðegende ond suiðe abisgad mid worðlicra monna wodum, for ðam hit is openlice cuð ðætte sio uterre abisgung ðissa woroldðinga ðæs monnes mod gedrefð, ond hine scofett hidres ðidres oð ðæt he afielð of his agnum willan; ac him bið ðearf ðæt he hine genime simle be ðære leornunge haligra gewrita, ond be ðam arise.

text: For ðiosum ðingum manade Paulus Tīmotheum his cniht, ond cwæð: 'Ðonne ic cume, ðonne bēo ðū ābisgad ymbe rǣdinge.' Ond eft Dāuīd be ðām ilcan spræc ðā hē cuæð: 'Lōca, Dryhten, hū suīðe ic lufige ðīne ǣ; ealne dæg ðæt bið mīn smēanung.' Eft bī ðȳs ilcan Dryhten bebēad Moyse hū hē scolde beran ðā earce, ðā hē cwæð: 'Wyrc fēower hringas ælgyldene, ond āhōh hīe suīðe fæste on ðā fēower hyrnan ðǣre earce; ond hāt wyrcean twēgen stengas of ðǣm trēowe ðe is hāten sethim ðæt ne wyrð nǣfre forrotad, ond befōh ūtan mid golde; ond sting ūt ðurh ðā hringas bī ðǣre earce sīdan, ðæt hīe man mæge beran on ðām, ond lǣt hī stician ðǣr on, ne tīo hīe mon nǣfre of.' Hwæt mæg ðonne elles sēo earc tācnian būton ðā hālgan ciricean, on ðǣre sculon hangian ðā fēower hringas on ðām fēower hyrnum, ðæt sint ðā fēower hyrnan ðises middangeardes, binnan ðǣm is tōbrǣdd Godes folc, ðæt is ūtan begyrdd mid ðām fēower godspellaum?
text_bare: For ðiosum ðingum manade Paulus Timotheum his cniht, ond cwæð: 'Ðonne ic cume, ðonne beo ðu abisgad ymbe rædinge.' Ond eft Dauid be ðam ilcan spræc ða he cuæð: 'Loca, Dryhten, hu suiðe ic lufige ðine æ; ealne dæg ðæt bið min smeanung.' Eft bi ðys ilcan Dryhten bebead Moyse hu he scolde beran ða earce, ða he cwæð: 'Wyrc feower hringas ælgyldene, ond ahoh hie suiðe fæste on ða feower hyrnan ðære earce; ond hat wyrcean twegen stengas of ðæm treowe ðe is haten sethim ðæt ne wyrð næfre forrotad, ond befoh utan mid golde; ond sting ut ðurh ða hringas bi ðære earce sidan, ðæt hie man mæge beran on ðam, ond læt hi stician ðær on, ne tio hie mon næfre of.' Hwæt mæg ðonne elles seo earc tacnian buton ða halgan ciricean, on ðære sculon hangian ða feower hringas on ðam feower hyrnum, ðæt sint ða feower hyrnan ðises middangeardes, binnan ðæm is tobrædd Godes folc, ðæt is utan begyrdd mid ðam feower godspellaum?

text: Ðā sāglas ðonne, ðe mon ðā earce big beran sceal, sticiað eallne weg inn on ðām hringum ðā earce mid tō beranne, ðā bēoð geworht of ðǣm trēowe sethim, ðæt nǣfre ne rotað.
text_bare: Ða saglas ðonne, ðe mon ða earce big beran sceal, sticiað eallne weg inn on ðam hringum ða earce mid to beranne, ða beoð geworht of ðæm treowe sethim, ðæt næfre ne rotað.

text: Suā sindon tō sēceanne stronge ond unāðrotene lārēowas ond ðurhwuniende on ðǣre lāre hāligra bōca, ðā simle sculon bīon bodiende ymbe ðā ānmōdnesse ðǣre hālgan gesomnunga, suā suā ðā anbestungnan sāglas ðā earce berað.
text_bare: Sua sindon to seceanne stronge ond unaðrotene lareowas ond ðurhwuniende on ðære lare haligra boca, ða simle sculon bion bodiende ymbe ða anmodnesse ðære halgan gesomnunga, sua sua ða anbestungnan saglas ða earce berað.

text: Ðæt is donne ðæt mon ðā earce bere on ðǣm sāglum, ðætte ðā gōdan lārēowas ðā hālgan gesomnunge lǣrende, ðā nīwan ond ðā ungelēaffullan mōd mid hira lāre gelǣde tō ryhtum gelēafan.
text_bare: Ðæt is donne ðæt mon ða earce bere on ðæm saglum, ðætte ða godan lareowas ða halgan gesomnunge lærende, ða niwan ond ða ungeleaffullan mod mid hira lare gelæde to ryhtum geleafan.

text: Ðā sāglas is beboden ðæt scoldon bēon mid golde befongne.
text_bare: Ða saglas is beboden ðæt scoldon beon mid golde befongne.

text: Ðæt is, ðonne ðā lārēowas mid wordum ōðre menn lǣrað, ðæt hī ēac selfe on hira āgnum weorcum biorhte scīnen.
text_bare: Ðæt is, ðonne ða lareowas mid wordum oðre menn lærað, ðæt hi eac selfe on hira agnum weorcum biorhte scinen.

text: Be ðām sāglum is suīðe gescēadlīce gecueden ðæt hīe sculon simle stician on ðām hringum, ond nǣfre ne mōton him bēon gesette tō ðǣre ðēnunga ðæs lārēowdōmes, ðæt hī nǣfre ne gewīten from ðǣre geornfulnesse ðǣre rǣdinge ond leornunge hāligra gewrita.
text_bare: Be ðam saglum is suiðe gesceadlice gecueden ðæt hie sculon simle stician on ðam hringum, ond næfre ne moton him beon gesette to ðære ðenunga ðæs lareowdomes, ðæt hi næfre ne gewiten from ðære geornfulnesse ðære rædinge ond leornunge haligra gewrita.

text: For ðǣm is ēac gecueden ðætte simle ðā ofergyldan sāglas sceoldon stician on ðǣm gyldnum hringum, ðȳ lǣs hine ǣnig wuht gǣlde ungearowes, ðonne mon ðā earce beran scolde.
text_bare: For ðæm is eac gecueden ðætte simle ða ofergyldan saglas sceoldon stician on ðæm gyldnum hringum, ðy læs hine ænig wuht gælde ungearowes, ðonne mon ða earce beran scolde.

text: Ðæt is ðonne ðonne ðāra lārēowa hīeremenn hwæthwugu gǣsðlīces tō him sēcað on hī frīnað, ðonne is suīðe micel scand gif hē ðonne færð sēcende hwæt hē sellan scyle, ðonne hē īowan scolde ðæt him mon tō āscað.
text_bare: Ðæt is ðonne ðonne ðara lareowa hieremenn hwæthwugu gæsðlices to him secað on hi frinað, ðonne is suiðe micel scand gif he ðonne færð secende hwæt he sellan scyle, ðonne he iowan scolde ðæt him mon to ascað.

text: Ac ðonne sticiað ðā sāglas suīde singāllīce on ðǣm hringum, ðonne ðā lārēowas simle on hira heortum smēagað ðā hālgan gewritu.
text_bare: Ac ðonne sticiað ða saglas suide singallice on ðæm hringum, ðonne ða lareowas simle on hira heortum smeagað ða halgan gewritu.

text: Ond ðonne hī hebbað suīðe ārodlīce ðā earce ūp, ðonne hī suīðe hrædlīce bīoð gearwe tō lǣranne ðætte ðonne ðearf bið.
text_bare: Ond ðonne hi hebbað suiðe arodlice ða earce up, ðonne hi suiðe hrædlice bioð gearwe to læranne ðætte ðonne ðearf bið.

text: Bī ðǣm suīðe wel sē forma hierde ðǣre hālgan ciricean, ðæt is sanctus Pētrus, manode ōðre hierdas, ðā hē cuæð: 'Bīoð simle gearwe tō lǣranne ond tō forgiefanne ǣlcum ðāra ðe īow ryhtlīce bidde ymbe ðone tōhopan ðe gē habbað on ēow.' Suelce hē openlīce cuǣde: 'Ne bregde gē nō ðā stengas og ðǣm hringum, ðȳ lǣs sīo earc sī ungearo tō beranne.'
text_bare: Bi ðæm suiðe wel se forma hierde ðære halgan ciricean, ðæt is sanctus Petrus, manode oðre hierdas, ða he cuæð: 'Bioð simle gearwe to læranne ond to forgiefanne ælcum ðara ðe iow ryhtlice bidde ymbe ðone tohopan ðe ge habbað on eow.' Suelce he openlice cuæde: 'Ne bregde ge no ða stengas og ðæm hringum, ðy læs sio earc si ungearo to beranne.'

text: Ōhthere sǣde his hlāforde, Ælfrēde cyninge, ðæt hē ealra Norðmonna norþmest būde.
text_bare: Ohthere sæde his hlaforde, Ælfrede cyninge, ðæt he ealra Norðmonna norþmest bude.

text: Hē cwæð þæt hē būde on þǣm lande norþweardum wiþ þā Westsǣ.
text_bare: He cwæð þæt he bude on þæm lande norþweardum wiþ þa Westsæ.

text: Hē sǣde þēah þæt þæt land sīe swīþe lang norþ þonan; ac hit is eal wēste, būton on fēawum stōwum styccemǣlum wīciað Finnas, on huntoðe on wintra, ond on sumera on fiscaþe be þǣre sǣ.
text_bare: He sæde þeah þæt þæt land sie swiþe lang norþ þonan; ac hit is eal weste, buton on feawum stowum styccemælum wiciað Finnas, on huntoðe on wintra, ond on sumera on fiscaþe be þære sæ.

text: Hē sǣde þæt hē æt sumum cirre wolde fandian hū longe þæt land norþryhte lǣge, oþþe hwæðer ǣnig mon be norðan þǣm wēstenne būde.
text_bare: He sæde þæt he æt sumum cirre wolde fandian hu longe þæt land norþryhte læge, oþþe hwæðer ænig mon be norðan þæm westenne bude.

text: Þā fōr hē norþryhte be þǣm lande: lēt him ealne weg þæt wēste land on ðæt stēorbord, ond þā wīdsǣ on ðæt bæcbord þrīe dagas.
text_bare: Þa for he norþryhte be þæm lande: let him ealne weg þæt weste land on ðæt steorbord, ond þa widsæ on ðæt bæcbord þrie dagas.

text: Þā wæs hē swā feor norþ swā þā hwælhuntan firrest faraþ.
text_bare: Þa wæs he swa feor norþ swa þa hwælhuntan firrest faraþ.

text: Þā fōr hē þā giet norþryhte swā feor swā hē meahte on þǣm ōþrum þrīm dagum gesiglan.
text_bare: Þa for he þa giet norþryhte swa feor swa he meahte on þæm oþrum þrim dagum gesiglan.

text: Þā bēag þæt land, þǣr ēastryhte, oþþe sēo sǣ in on ðæt lond, hē nysse hwæðer, būton hē wisse ðæt hē ðǣr bād westanwindes ond hwōn norþan, ond siglde ðā ēast be lande swā swā hē meahte on fēower dagum gesiglan.
text_bare: Þa beag þæt land, þær eastryhte, oþþe seo sæ in on ðæt lond, he nysse hwæðer, buton he wisse ðæt he ðær bad westanwindes ond hwon norþan, ond siglde ða east be lande swa swa he meahte on feower dagum gesiglan.

text: Þā sceolde hē ðǣr bīdan ryhtnorþanwindes, for ðǣm þæt land bēag þǣr sūþryhte, oþþe sēo sǣ in on ðæt land, hē nysse hwæþer.
text_bare: Þa sceolde he ðær bidan ryhtnorþanwindes, for ðæm þæt land beag þær suþryhte, oþþe seo sæ in on ðæt land, he nysse hwæþer.

text: Þā siglde hē þonan sūðryhte be lande swā swā hē meahte on fīf dagum gesiglan.
text_bare: Þa siglde he þonan suðryhte be lande swa swa he meahte on fif dagum gesiglan.

text: Ðā læg þǣr ān micel ēa ūp on þæt land.
text_bare: Ða læg þær an micel ea up on þæt land.

text: Ðā cirdon hīe ūp in on ðā ēa for þǣm hīe ne dorston forþ bī þǣre ēa siglan for unfriþe; for þǣm ðæt land wæs eall gebūn on ōþre healfe þǣre ēas.
text_bare: Ða cirdon hie up in on ða ea for þæm hie ne dorston forþ bi þære ea siglan for unfriþe; for þæm ðæt land wæs eall gebun on oþre healfe þære eas.

text: Ne mētte hē ǣr nān gebūn land, siþþan hē from his āgnum hām fōr; ac him wæs ealne weg wēste land on þæt stēorbord, būtan fiscerum ond fugelerum ond huntum, ond þæt wǣron eall Finnas; ond him wæs āwīdsǣ on þæt bæcbord.
text_bare: Ne mette he ær nan gebun land, siþþan he from his agnum ham for; ac him wæs ealne weg weste land on þæt steorbord, butan fiscerum ond fugelerum ond huntum, ond þæt wæron eall Finnas; ond him wæs awidsæ on þæt bæcbord.

text: Þā Beormas heafdon sīþe wel gebūd hiraland: ac hīe ne dorston þǣr on cuman.
text_bare: Þa Beormas heafdon siþe wel gebud hiraland: ac hie ne dorston þær on cuman.

text: Ac þāra Terfinna land wæs eal wēste, būton ðǣr huntan gewīcodon, oþþe fisceras, oþþe fugeleras.
text_bare: Ac þara Terfinna land wæs eal weste, buton ðær huntan gewicodon, oþþe fisceras, oþþe fugeleras.

text: Fela spella him sǣdon þā Beormas ǣgþer ge of hiera āgnum lande ge of þǣm landum þe ymb hīe ūtan wǣron; ac hē nyste hwæt þæs sōþes wæs, for þǣm hē hit self ne geseah.
text_bare: Fela spella him sædon þa Beormas ægþer ge of hiera agnum lande ge of þæm landum þe ymb hie utan wæron; ac he nyste hwæt þæs soþes wæs, for þæm he hit self ne geseah.

text: Þā Finnas, him þūhte, ond þā Beormas sprǣcon nēah ān geþēode.
text_bare: Þa Finnas, him þuhte, ond þa Beormas spræcon neah an geþeode.

text: Swīþost hē fōr ðīder, tō ēacan þæs landes scēawunge, for þǣm horshwælum, for ðǣm hīe habbað swīþe æþele bān on hiora tōþum — þā tēð hīe brōhton sume þǣm cyninge — ond hiora hȳd bið swīðe gōd tō sciprāpum.
text_bare: Swiþost he for ðider, to eacan þæs landes sceawunge, for þæm horshwælum, for ðæm hie habbað swiþe æþele ban on hiora toþum — þa teð hie brohton sume þæm cyninge — ond hiora hyd bið swiðe god to sciprapum.

text: Sē hwæl bið micle lǣssa þonne ōðre hwalas: ne bið hē lengra ðonne syfan elna lang; ac on his āgnum lande is sē betsta hwælhuntað; þā bēoð eahta and fēowertiges elna lange, and þā mǣstan fīftiges elna lange; þāra hē sǣde þæt hē syxa sum ofslōge syxtig on twām dagum.
text_bare: Se hwæl bið micle læssa þonne oðre hwalas: ne bið he lengra ðonne syfan elna lang; ac on his agnum lande is se betsta hwælhuntað; þa beoð eahta and feowertiges elna lange, and þa mæstan fiftiges elna lange; þara he sæde þæt he syxa sum ofsloge syxtig on twam dagum.

text: Hē wæs swȳðe spēdig man on þǣm ǣhtum þe heora spēda on bēoð, þæt is, on wildrum.
text_bare: He wæs swyðe spedig man on þæm æhtum þe heora speda on beoð, þæt is, on wildrum.

text: Hē hæfde þā gȳt, ðā hē þone cyningc sōhte, tamra dēora unbebohtra syx hund.
text_bare: He hæfde þa gyt, ða he þone cyningc sohte, tamra deora unbebohtra syx hund.

text: Þā dēor hī hātað 'hrānas'; þāra wǣron syx stælhrānas; ðā bēoð swȳðe dyre mid Finnum, for ðǣm hȳ fōð þā wildan hrānas mid.
text_bare: Þa deor hi hatað 'hranas'; þara wæron syx stælhranas; ða beoð swyðe dyre mid Finnum, for ðæm hy foð þa wildan hranas mid.

text: Hē wæs mid þǣm fyrstum mannum on þǣm lande: næfde hē þēah mā ðonne twēntig hrȳðera, and twentig scēapa, and twentig swȳna; and þæt lȳtle þæt hē erede, hē erede mid horsan.
text_bare: He wæs mid þæm fyrstum mannum on þæm lande: næfde he þeah ma ðonne twentig hryðera, and twentig sceapa, and twentig swyna; and þæt lytle þæt he erede, he erede mid horsan.

text: Ac hyra ār is mǣst on þǣm gafole þe ðā Finnas him gyldað.
text_bare: Ac hyra ar is mæst on þæm gafole þe ða Finnas him gyldað.

text: Þæt gafol bið on dēora fellum, and on fugela feðerum, and hwales bāne, and on þǣm sciprāpum, þe bēoð of hwæles hȳde geworht, and of sēoles.
text_bare: Þæt gafol bið on deora fellum, and on fugela feðerum, and hwales bane, and on þæm sciprapum, þe beoð of hwæles hyde geworht, and of seoles.

text: Ǣghwilc gylt be hys gebyrdum.
text_bare: Æghwilc gylt be hys gebyrdum.

text: Sē byrdesta sceall gyldan fīftȳne mearðes fell, and fīf hrānes, and ān beran fel, and tȳn ambra feðra, and berenne kyrtel oððe yterenne, and twegen sciprāpas; ǣgþer sȳ syxtig elna lang, ōþer sȳ of hwæles hȳde geworht, ōþer of sīoles.
text_bare: Se byrdesta sceall gyldan fiftyne mearðes fell, and fif hranes, and an beran fel, and tyn ambra feðra, and berenne kyrtel oððe yterenne, and twegen sciprapas; ægþer sy syxtig elna lang, oþer sy of hwæles hyde geworht, oþer of sioles.

text: Hē sǣde ðæt Norðmanna land wǣre swȳþe lang and swȳðe smæl.
text_bare: He sæde ðæt Norðmanna land wære swyþe lang and swyðe smæl.

text: Eal þæt his man āþer oððe ettan oððe erian mæg, þæt līð wið ðā sǣ; and þæt is þēah on sumum stōwum swȳðe clūdig; and licgað wilde mōras wið ēastan and wið ūpp on emnlange þǣm bȳnum lande.
text_bare: Eal þæt his man aþer oððe ettan oððe erian mæg, þæt lið wið ða sæ; and þæt is þeah on sumum stowum swyðe cludig; and licgað wilde moras wið eastan and wið upp on emnlange þæm bynum lande.

text: On þǣm mōrum eardiað Finnas.
text_bare: On þæm morum eardiað Finnas.

text: And þæt bȳne land is ēasteweard brādost, and symle swā norðor swā smælre.
text_bare: And þæt byne land is easteweard bradost, and symle swa norðor swa smælre.

text: Ēastewerd hit mæg bīon syxtig mīla brād, oþþe hwēne brǣdre; and middeweard þrītig oððe brādre; and norðeweard hē cwæð, þǣr hit smalost wǣre, þæt hit mihte bēon þrēora mīla brād tō þǣm mōre; and sē mōr syðþan, on sumum stōwum swā brād swā man mæg on twām wucum oferfēran; and on sumum stōwum swā brād swā man mæg on syx dagum oferfēran.
text_bare: Eastewerd hit mæg bion syxtig mila brad, oþþe hwene brædre; and middeweard þritig oððe bradre; and norðeweard he cwæð, þær hit smalost wære, þæt hit mihte beon þreora mila brad to þæm more; and se mor syðþan, on sumum stowum swa brad swa man mæg on twam wucum oferferan; and on sumum stowum swa brad swa man mæg on syx dagum oferferan.

text: Þonne is tōemnes þǣm lande sūðeweardum, on ōðre healfe þæs mōres, Swēoland, oþ þæt land norðeweard; and tōemnes þǣm lande norðeweardum, Cwēna land.
text_bare: Þonne is toemnes þæm lande suðeweardum, on oðre healfe þæs mores, Sweoland, oþ þæt land norðeweard; and toemnes þæm lande norðeweardum, Cwena land.

text: Þā Cwēnas hergiað hwīlum on ðā Norðmen ofer ðone mōr, hwīlum þā Norðmen on hȳ.
text_bare: Þa Cwenas hergiað hwilum on ða Norðmen ofer ðone mor, hwilum þa Norðmen on hy.

text: And þǣr sint swīðe micle meras fersce geond þā mōras; and berað þā Cwēnas hyra scypu ofer land on ðā meras, and þanon hergiað on ðā Norðmen; hȳ habbað swȳðe lȳtle scypa and swȳðe leohte.
text_bare: And þær sint swiðe micle meras fersce geond þa moras; and berað þa Cwenas hyra scypu ofer land on ða meras, and þanon hergiað on ða Norðmen; hy habbað swyðe lytle scypa and swyðe leohte.

text: Ōhthere sǣde þæt sīo scīr hātte Hālgoland þe hē on būde.
text_bare: Ohthere sæde þæt sio scir hatte Halgoland þe he on bude.

text: Hē cwæð þæt nān man ne būde be norðan him.
text_bare: He cwæð þæt nan man ne bude be norðan him.

text: Þonne is ān port on sūðeweardum þǣm lande, þone man hǣt Sciringeshēal.
text_bare: Þonne is an port on suðeweardum þæm lande, þone man hæt Sciringesheal.

text: Þyder hē cwæð þæt man ne mihte geseglian on ānum mōnðe, gyf man on niht wīcode, and ǣlce dæge hæfde ambyrne wind; and ealle ðā hwīle hē sceal seglian be lande.
text_bare: Þyder he cwæð þæt man ne mihte geseglian on anum monðe, gyf man on niht wicode, and ælce dæge hæfde ambyrne wind; and ealle ða hwile he sceal seglian be lande.

text: And on þæt stēorbord him bið ǣrest Īraland, and þonne ðā īgland þe synd betux Īralande and þissum lande.
text_bare: And on þæt steorbord him bið ærest Iraland, and þonne ða igland þe synd betux Iralande and þissum lande.

text: Þone is þis land, oð hē cymð tō Scirincgeshēale, and ealne weg on þæt bæcbord Norðweg.
text_bare: Þone is þis land, oð he cymð to Scirincgesheale, and ealne weg on þæt bæcbord Norðweg.

text: Wið sūðan þone Sciringeshēal fylð swȳðe mycel sǣ ūp in on ðæt land; sēo is brādre þonne ǣnig man ofer sēon mæge.
text_bare: Wið suðan þone Sciringesheal fylð swyðe mycel sæ up in on ðæt land; seo is bradre þonne ænig man ofer seon mæge.

text: And is Gotland on ōðre healfe ongēan, and siððan Sillende.
text_bare: And is Gotland on oðre healfe ongean, and siððan Sillende.

text: Sēo sǣ līð mænig hund mīla ūp in on þæt land.
text_bare: Seo sæ lið mænig hund mila up in on þæt land.

text: And of Sciringeshēale hē cwæð þæt hē seglode on fīf dagan tō þǣm porte þe mon hǣt æt Hǣþum; sē stent betuh Winedum, and Seaxum, and Angle, and hȳrð in on Dene.
text_bare: And of Sciringesheale he cwæð þæt he seglode on fif dagan to þæm porte þe mon hæt æt Hæþum; se stent betuh Winedum, and Seaxum, and Angle, and hyrð in on Dene.

text: Ðā hē þiderweard seglode fram Sciringeshēale, þā wæs him on þæt bæcbord Denamearc and on þæt stēorbord wīdsǣ þrȳ dagas; and þā, twegen dagas ǣr hē tō Hǣþum cōme, him wæs on þæt stēorbord Gotland, and Sillende, and īglanda fela.
text_bare: Ða he þiderweard seglode fram Sciringesheale, þa wæs him on þæt bæcbord Denamearc and on þæt steorbord widsæ þry dagas; and þa, twegen dagas ær he to Hæþum come, him wæs on þæt steorbord Gotland, and Sillende, and iglanda fela.

text: On þǣm landum eardodon Engle, ǣr hī hider on land cōman.
text_bare: On þæm landum eardodon Engle, ær hi hider on land coman.

text: And hym wæs ðā twēgen dagas on ðæt bæcbord þā īgland þe in on Denemearce hȳrað.
text_bare: And hym wæs ða twegen dagas on ðæt bæcbord þa igland þe in on Denemearce hyrað.

text: Wulfstan sǣde þæt hē gefōre of Hǣðum, þæt hē wǣre on Trūsō on syfan dagum and nihtum, þæt þæt scip wæs ealne weg yrnende under segle.
text_bare: Wulfstan sæde þæt he gefore of Hæðum, þæt he wære on Truso on syfan dagum and nihtum, þæt þæt scip wæs ealne weg yrnende under segle.

text: Weonoðland him wæs on stēorbord, and on bæcbord him wæs Langaland, and Lǣland, and Falster, and Scōnēg; and þās land eall hȳrað tō Denemearcan.
text_bare: Weonoðland him wæs on steorbord, and on bæcbord him wæs Langaland, and Læland, and Falster, and Sconeg; and þas land eall hyrað to Denemearcan.

text: And þonne Burgenda land wæs ūs on bæcbord, and þā habbað him sylfe cyning.
text_bare: And þonne Burgenda land wæs us on bæcbord, and þa habbað him sylfe cyning.

text: Þonne æfter Burgenda lande wǣron ūs þās land, þā synd hātene ǣrest Blēcinga-ēg, and Mēore, and Ēowland, and Gotland on bæcbord; and þās land hȳrað tō Swēom.
text_bare: Þonne æfter Burgenda lande wæron us þas land, þa synd hatene ærest Blecinga-eg, and Meore, and Eowland, and Gotland on bæcbord; and þas land hyrað to Sweom.

text: And Weonodland wæs ūs ealne weg on stēorbord oð Wīslemūðan.
text_bare: And Weonodland wæs us ealne weg on steorbord oð Wislemuðan.

text: Sēo Wīsle is swȳðe mycel ēa, and hīo tōlīð Wītland and Weonodland; and þæt Wītland belimpeþ tō Estum; and sēo Wīsle līð ūt of Weonodlande, and līð in Estmere; and sē Estmere is hūru fīftēne mīla brād.
text_bare: Seo Wisle is swyðe mycel ea, and hio tolið Witland and Weonodland; and þæt Witland belimpeþ to Estum; and seo Wisle lið ut of Weonodlande, and lið in Estmere; and se Estmere is huru fiftene mila brad.

text: Þonne cymeð Ilfling ēastan in Estmere of ðǣm mere, ðe Trūsō standeð in stæðe; and cumað ūt samod in Estmere, Ilfing ēastan of Estlande, and Wīsle wūðan of Winodlande.
text_bare: Þonne cymeð Ilfling eastan in Estmere of ðæm mere, ðe Truso standeð in stæðe; and cumað ut samod in Estmere, Ilfing eastan of Estlande, and Wisle wuðan of Winodlande.

text: And þonne benimð Wīsle Ilfing hire naman, and ligeð of þǣm mere west and norð on sǣ; for ðȳ hit man hǣt Wīslemūða.
text_bare: And þonne benimð Wisle Ilfing hire naman, and ligeð of þæm mere west and norð on sæ; for ðy hit man hæt Wislemuða.

text: Þæt Estland is swȳðe mycel, and þǣr bið swȳðe manig burh, and on ǣlcere byrig bið cyning.
text_bare: Þæt Estland is swyðe mycel, and þær bið swyðe manig burh, and on ælcere byrig bið cyning.

text: And þǣr bið swȳðe mycel hunig, and fiscnað, and sē cyning and þā rīcostan men drincað mȳran meolc, and þā unspēdigan and þā þēowan drincad medo.
text_bare: And þær bið swyðe mycel hunig, and fiscnað, and se cyning and þa ricostan men drincað myran meolc, and þa unspedigan and þa þeowan drincad medo.

text: Þǣr bið swȳðe mycel gewinn betwēonan him.
text_bare: Þær bið swyðe mycel gewinn betweonan him.

text: And ne bid ðǣr nǣnig ealo gebrowen mid Estum, ac þǣr bið medo genōh.
text_bare: And ne bid ðær nænig ealo gebrowen mid Estum, ac þær bið medo genoh.

text: And þǣr is mid Estum ðēaw, þonne þǣr bið man dēad, þæt hē līð inne unforbærned mid his māgum and frēondum mōnað, ge hwīlum twēgen; and þā kyningas, and þā ōðre hēahðungene men, swā micle lencg swā hī māran spēda habbað, hwīlum healf gēar þæt hī bēoð unforbærned, and licgað bufan eorðan on hyra hūsum.
text_bare: And þær is mid Estum ðeaw, þonne þær bið man dead, þæt he lið inne unforbærned mid his magum and freondum monað, ge hwilum twegen; and þa kyningas, and þa oðre heahðungene men, swa micle lencg swa hi maran speda habbað, hwilum healf gear þæt hi beoð unforbærned, and licgað bufan eorðan on hyra husum.

text: And ealle þā hwīle þe þæt līc bið inne, þǣr sceal bēon gedrync and plega, oð ðone dæg þe hī hine forbærnað.
text_bare: And ealle þa hwile þe þæt lic bið inne, þær sceal beon gedrync and plega, oð ðone dæg þe hi hine forbærnað.

text: Þonne þȳ ylcan dæge þe hī hine tō þǣm āde beran wyllað, þonne tōdǣlað hī his feoh, þæt þǣr tō lǣfe bið æfter þǣm gedrynce and þǣm plegan on fīf oððe syx, hwȳlum on mā, swā swā þæs fēos andēfn bið.
text_bare: Þonne þy ylcan dæge þe hi hine to þæm ade beran wyllað, þonne todælað hi his feoh, þæt þær to læfe bið æfter þæm gedrynce and þæm plegan on fif oððe syx, hwylum on ma, swa swa þæs feos andefn bið.

text: Alecgað hit ðonne forhweæga on ānre mīle þone mǣstan dǣl fram þǣm tūne, þonne ōðerne, ðonne þone þriddan, oþ þe hyt eall ālēd bið on þǣre ānre mīle; and sceall bēon sē lǣsta dǣl nȳhst þǣm tūne ðe sē dēada man on līð.
text_bare: Alecgað hit ðonne forhweæga on anre mile þone mæstan dæl fram þæm tune, þonne oðerne, ðonne þone þriddan, oþ þe hyt eall aled bið on þære anre mile; and sceall beon se læsta dæl nyhst þæm tune ðe se deada man on lið.

text: Ðonne sceolon bēon gesamnode ealle ðā menn ðe swyftiste hors habbað on þǣm lande, forhwæga on fīf mīlum oððe on syx mīlum fram þǣm fēo.
text_bare: Ðonne sceolon beon gesamnode ealle ða menn ðe swyftiste hors habbað on þæm lande, forhwæga on fif milum oððe on syx milum fram þæm feo.

text: Þonne ærnað hȳ ealle tōweard þǣm fēo: ðonne cymeð sē man sē þæt swiftoste hors hafað tō þǣm ǣrestan dǣle and tō þǣm mǣstan, and swā ǣlc æfter ōðrum, oþ hit bið eall genumen; and sē nimð þone lǣstan dǣl sē nȳhst þǣm tūne þæt feoh geærneð.
text_bare: Þonne ærnað hy ealle toweard þæm feo: ðonne cymeð se man se þæt swiftoste hors hafað to þæm ærestan dæle and to þæm mæstan, and swa ælc æfter oðrum, oþ hit bið eall genumen; and se nimð þone læstan dæl se nyhst þæm tune þæt feoh geærneð.

text: And þonne rīdeð ǣlc hys weges mid ðǣm fēo, and hyt mōtan habban eall; and for ðȳ þǣr bēoð þā swiftan hors ungefōge dȳre.
text_bare: And þonne rideð ælc hys weges mid ðæm feo, and hyt motan habban eall; and for ðy þær beoð þa swiftan hors ungefoge dyre.

text: And þonne his gestrēon bēoð þus ealle āspended, þonne byrð man hit ūt, and forbærneð mid his wǣpnum and hrægle; and swīðost ealle hys spēda hȳ forspendað mid þǣm langan leger þæs dēadan mannes inne, and þæs þe hȳ be þǣm wegum ālecgað, þe ðā fremdan tō ærnað, and nimað.
text_bare: And þonne his gestreon beoð þus ealle aspended, þonne byrð man hit ut, and forbærneð mid his wæpnum and hrægle; and swiðost ealle hys speda hy forspendað mid þæm langan leger þæs deadan mannes inne, and þæs þe hy be þæm wegum alecgað, þe ða fremdan to ærnað, and nimað.

text: And þæt is mid Estum þǣw þæt þǣr sceal ǣlces geðēodes man bēon forbærned; and gyf þār man ān bān findeð unforbærned, hī hit sceolan miclum gebētan.
text_bare: And þæt is mid Estum þæw þæt þær sceal ælces geðeodes man beon forbærned; and gyf þar man an ban findeð unforbærned, hi hit sceolan miclum gebetan.

text: And þǣr is mid Estum ān mǣgð þæt hī magon cyle gewyrcan; and þȳ þǣr licgað þā dēadan men swā lange, and ne fūliað, þæt hȳ wyrcað þone cyle him on.
text_bare: And þær is mid Estum an mægð þæt hi magon cyle gewyrcan; and þy þær licgað þa deadan men swa lange, and ne fuliað, þæt hy wyrcað þone cyle him on.

text: And þēah man āsette twēgen fǣtels full ealað oððe wæteres, hȳ gedōð þæt ǣgþer bið oferfroren, sam hit sȳ sumor sam winter.
text_bare: And þeah man asette twegen fætels full ealað oððe wæteres, hy gedoð þæt ægþer bið oferfroren, sam hit sy sumor sam winter.

text: Ic þē wolde gīet reccan sume swīðe rihte race, ac ic wāt þæt þis flc his nele gelȳfan: þæt is, þæt ðā bīoð gesǣligran þe mon wītnað, þonne þā bīon þe hī wītniað.
text_bare: Ic þe wolde giet reccan sume swiðe rihte race, ac ic wat þæt þis flc his nele gelyfan: þæt is, þæt ða bioð gesæligran þe mon witnað, þonne þa bion þe hi witniað.

text: Ðā wundrode ic ðǣs, on cwæð, 'Ic wolde þæt þū mē gereahte hū hit swā bīon meahte.' Ða cwæð hē, 'Hwæðer þū ongite þæt ǣlc yfelwillende mon ond yfelwyrcende sīe wītes wyrðe?' Ðā cwæð ic, 'Genōg sweotole ic þæt ongite.' Ðā cwæð hē, 'Hū ne is sē ðonne yfelwillende ond yfelwyrcende ðe þone unscyldigan wītnað?' Ða cwæð hē, 'Hwæðer þū wēne þæt ðā sīen earme ond ungesǣlige þe wītes wyrðe bīoð?' Ðā cwæð ic, 'Ne wēne ic his nō, ac wāt geare.' Ðā cwæð hē, 'Gif þū nū dēman mōste, hwæðerne woldes þū dēman wītan wyrðran, þe ðone þe ðone unscyldan wītnode, ðe ðone þe þæt wīte þolade?' Ðā cwæð ic, 'Nis þæt gelīc; ic wolde helpan þæs ðe ðǣr unscyldig wǣre, ond hēnan þone þine hine yflode.' Ðā cwæð hē, 'Þonne þē ðincð sē earmra, sē þe þæt yfel dēð, þonne sē þe hit þafað?' Ðā cwæð ic, 'Þæs ic gelēfe, þætte ǣlc unriht wītnung sīe þæs yfel þe hit dēð, næs þæs ðe hit ðafað, for ðǣm his yfel hine gedēð earmne.
text_bare: Ða wundrode ic ðæs, on cwæð, 'Ic wolde þæt þu me gereahte hu hit swa bion meahte.' Ða cwæð he, 'Hwæðer þu ongite þæt ælc yfelwillende mon ond yfelwyrcende sie wites wyrðe?' Ða cwæð ic, 'Genog sweotole ic þæt ongite.' Ða cwæð he, 'Hu ne is se ðonne yfelwillende ond yfelwyrcende ðe þone unscyldigan witnað?' Ða cwæð he, 'Hwæðer þu wene þæt ða sien earme ond ungesælige þe wites wyrðe bioð?' Ða cwæð ic, 'Ne wene ic his no, ac wat geare.' Ða cwæð he, 'Gif þu nu deman moste, hwæðerne woldes þu deman witan wyrðran, þe ðone þe ðone unscyldan witnode, ðe ðone þe þæt wite þolade?' Ða cwæð ic, 'Nis þæt gelic; ic wolde helpan þæs ðe ðær unscyldig wære, ond henan þone þine hine yflode.' Ða cwæð he, 'Þonne þe ðincð se earmra, se þe þæt yfel deð, þonne se þe hit þafað?' Ða cwæð ic, 'Þæs ic gelefe, þætte ælc unriht witnung sie þæs yfel þe hit deð, næs þæs ðe hit ðafað, for ðæm his yfel hine gedeð earmne.

text: Ond ic ongite ðǣt þis is swīðe riht racu þæt þū nū recst, ond swīðe anlīc þǣm þe þū ǣr reahtes; ac ic wāt þēah þæt þīs folce swā ne þincð.'
text_bare: Ond ic ongite ðæt þis is swiðe riht racu þæt þu nu recst, ond swiðe anlic þæm þe þu ær reahtes; ac ic wat þeah þæt þis folce swa ne þincð.'

text: Ðā cwæð hē, 'Wel þū hīt ongītst.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he, 'Wel þu hit ongitst.

text: Ac ðā þingeras þingiað nū hwīlum þǣm þe lǣssan þearfe āhton; pingiað þǣm þe þǣr man yflað, ond ne þingiað þǣm þe þæt yfel dōð.
text_bare: Ac ða þingeras þingiað nu hwilum þæm þe læssan þearfe ahton; pingiað þæm þe þær man yflað, ond ne þingiað þæm þe þæt yfel doð.

text: Þǣm wǣre māre ðearf þe þā ōðre unscyldige yflað, þæt him mon þingode tō ðǣm rīcum, ond bǣde þæt him mon dyde swā micel wīte swā hī þǣm ōðrum unscyldgum dydon.
text_bare: Þæm wære mare ðearf þe þa oðre unscyldige yflað, þæt him mon þingode to ðæm ricum, ond bæde þæt him mon dyde swa micel wite swa hi þæm oðrum unscyldgum dydon.

text: Swā swā sē sīoca āh þearfe þæt hine mon lǣde tō þǣm lǣce þæt hē his tilige, swā āh sē þe ðæt yfel dēð; þæt hīne mon lǣde tō þǣm rīcum, þæt mon þǣr mæge snīðan ond bærnan his unþēawas.
text_bare: Swa swa se sioca ah þearfe þæt hine mon læde to þæm læce þæt he his tilige, swa ah se þe ðæt yfel deð; þæt hine mon læde to þæm ricum, þæt mon þær mæge sniðan ond bærnan his unþeawas.

text: Ne cweðe ic nā þæt þæt yfel sīe þæt mon helpe þæs unscyldgan, ond him foreþingie, ac ic cweðe þæt hit is betere þæt mon wrēge þone scyldgan; ond ic secge þæt sīo foresprǣc ne dyge nāuðer nē þǣm scyldgan nē ðǣm þe him foreþingað, gif hī þæs wilniað þæt him heora yefel unwrecen sīe be ðæs gyltes andēfne.
text_bare: Ne cweðe ic na þæt þæt yfel sie þæt mon helpe þæs unscyldgan, ond him foreþingie, ac ic cweðe þæt hit is betere þæt mon wrege þone scyldgan; ond ic secge þæt sio forespræc ne dyge nauðer ne þæm scyldgan ne ðæm þe him foreþingað, gif hi þæs wilniað þæt him heora yefel unwrecen sie be ðæs gyltes andefne.

text: Ac ic wāt gif ðā scyldgan ǣnigne spearcan wīsdōmes hæfden, ond be ǣnigum dǣle ongēaten þæt hī meahten heora scylda þurh þæt wīte gebētan þe him hēr on weorulde on becōme, þonne noldon hī nā cweðan þæt hit wǣre wīte, ac woldon cweðan þæt hit wǣre heora clǣnsung ond heora betrung; ond noldon nǣnne þīngere gesēcan, ac lustlīce hī woldon lǣtan þā rīcan hī tūcian æfter hiora āgnum willan.
text_bare: Ac ic wat gif ða scyldgan ænigne spearcan wisdomes hæfden, ond be ænigum dæle ongeaten þæt hi meahten heora scylda þurh þæt wite gebetan þe him her on weorulde on become, þonne noldon hi na cweðan þæt hit wære wite, ac woldon cweðan þæt hit wære heora clænsung ond heora betrung; ond noldon nænne þingere gesecan, ac lustlice hi woldon lætan þa rican hi tucian æfter hiora agnum willan.

text: For ðǣm ne scyle nān wīs man nǣnne mannan hatian.
text_bare: For ðæm ne scyle nan wis man nænne mannan hatian.

text: Ne hatað nān mon þone gōdan, būtan sē eallra dysgosta, nē þæt nis nān riht þæt mon þone yflan hatige, ac hit is rihtre þæt him mon miltsege: þæt is þonne hiora mildsung, þæt mon wrece hiora unðēawas be hiora gewyrhtum.
text_bare: Ne hatað nan mon þone godan, butan se eallra dysgosta, ne þæt nis nan riht þæt mon þone yflan hatige, ac hit is rihtre þæt him mon miltsege: þæt is þonne hiora mildsung, þæt mon wrece hiora unðeawas be hiora gewyrhtum.

text: Ne scyle nān mon sīocne monnon ond gesārgodne swencan; ac hine mon sceal lǣdan tō þǣm lǣce, þæt hē his tilige.
text_bare: Ne scyle nan mon siocne monnon ond gesargodne swencan; ac hine mon sceal lædan to þæm læce, þæt he his tilige.

text: Þā ongan hē sprecan swīðe fiorran ymbūtan, swelce hē nā þā sprǣce ne mǣnde, ond tiohhode hit ðēah þiderweardes, ond cwæð, 'Ealla gesceafta gesewenlīca ond ungesewenlīca, stillu ond unstillu, ondfōð æt þǣm stillan, ond æt þām gestæððegan, ond æt þǣm ānfealdan Gode endebyrdnesse ond andwlitan ond gemeþunge; ond for hwǣm hit swā gesceapen wæs, for ðǣm hē wāt hwȳ hē gescēop eall þæt hē gescēop: nis him nān whit unnyt þæs ðe hē gescēop.
text_bare: Þa ongan he sprecan swiðe fiorran ymbutan, swelce he na þa spræce ne mænde, ond tiohhode hit ðeah þiderweardes, ond cwæð, 'Ealla gesceafta gesewenlica ond ungesewenlica, stillu ond unstillu, ondfoð æt þæm stillan, ond æt þam gestæððegan, ond æt þæm anfealdan Gode endebyrdnesse ond andwlitan ond gemeþunge; ond for hwæm hit swa gesceapen wæs, for ðæm he wat hwy he gesceop eall þæt he gesceop: nis him nan whit unnyt þæs ðe he gesceop.

text: Sē God wunað symle on þǣre hēan ceastre his ānfaldnesse and bilewitnesse, þonan hē dǣlð manega ond misleca gemetgunga eallum his gesceaftum, ond þonan hē welt eallra.
text_bare: Se God wunað symle on þære hean ceastre his anfaldnesse and bilewitnesse, þonan he dælð manega ond misleca gemetgunga eallum his gesceaftum, ond þonan he welt eallra.

text: Ac ðæt ðæt wē hātað Godes foreþonc ond his forescēawung, þæt bið þā hwīle þe his ðǣr mid him bið on his mōde ǣr ðǣm þe hit gefremed weorðe, þā hwīle ðe hit geþōht bið; ac siððan hit fullfremed bið, þonne hātað wē hit wyrd: be þȳ mæg ǣlc mon witan þæt hit sint ǣgþer ge twēgen naman ge twā þing, foreþonc ond wyrd.
text_bare: Ac ðæt ðæt we hatað Godes foreþonc ond his foresceawung, þæt bið þa hwile þe his ðær mid him bið on his mode ær ðæm þe hit gefremed weorðe, þa hwile ðe hit geþoht bið; ac siððan hit fullfremed bið, þonne hatað we hit wyrd: be þy mæg ælc mon witan þæt hit sint ægþer ge twegen naman ge twa þing, foreþonc ond wyrd.

text: Sē foreþonc is sēo godcunde gescēadwīsnes, sīo is fæst on þǣm hēan Sceppende þe eall forewāt, hū hit geweorðan sceal ǣr ǣr hit geweorðe.
text_bare: Se foreþonc is seo godcunde gesceadwisnes, sio is fæst on þæm hean Sceppende þe eall forewat, hu hit geweorðan sceal ær ær hit geweorðe.

text: Ac þæt þæt hē wyrd hātað, þæt bið Godes weorc þæt hē ǣlce dæg wyrcð, ǣgþer ge þæs þe wē gesīoð ge þæs þe ūs ungesewenlīc bið.
text_bare: Ac þæt þæt he wyrd hatað, þæt bið Godes weorc þæt he ælce dæg wyrcð, ægþer ge þæs þe we gesioð ge þæs þe us ungesewenlic bið.

text: Ac sē godcunda foreþonc heaðerað ealle gesceafta þæt hī ne mōton tōslūpan of heora endebyrdnesse.
text_bare: Ac se godcunda foreþonc heaðerað ealle gesceafta þæt hi ne moton toslupan of heora endebyrdnesse.

text: Sīo wyrd ðonne dǣlþ eallum gesceaftum andwlitan, ond stōwa, ond tīda, ond gemetgunga.
text_bare: Sio wyrd ðonne dælþ eallum gesceaftum andwlitan, ond stowa, ond tida, ond gemetgunga.

text: Ac sīo wyrd cymð of ðǣm gewitte ond of ðǣm foreþonce þæs ælmehtigan Godes, sē wyrcð æfter his unāsecgendlīcum foreþonce swā hwæt swā hē wile.
text_bare: Ac sio wyrd cymð of ðæm gewitte ond of ðæm foreþonce þæs ælmehtigan Godes, se wyrcð æfter his unasecgendlicum foreþonce swa hwæt swa he wile.

text: Swā swā ǣlc cræfega ðencð ond mearcað his weorc on his mōde ǣr ǣr hē hit wyrce, ond wyrcð siððan eall, þīos wandriende wyrd þe wē wyrd hātað, færð æfter his foreþonce ond æfter his geþeahte, swā swā hē tiohhað þæt hit sīe.
text_bare: Swa swa ælc cræfega ðencð ond mearcað his weorc on his mode ær ær he hit wyrce, ond wyrcð siððan eall, þios wandriende wyrd þe we wyrd hatað, færð æfter his foreþonce ond æfter his geþeahte, swa swa he tiohhað þæt hit sie.

text: Þēah hit ūs manigfaldlīc ðince, sum good, sum yfel, hit is ðēah him ānfeald good, for ðǣm hē hit eall tō gōdum ende brengð, ond for gōde dēð ealle þæt þæt hē dēð.
text_bare: Þeah hit us manigfaldlic ðince, sum good, sum yfel, hit is ðeah him anfeald good, for ðæm he hit eall to godum ende brengð, ond for gode deð ealle þæt þæt he deð.

text: Siððan wē hit hātað wyrd, syððan hit geworht bið; ǣr hit wæs Godes foreþonc ond his foretīohhung: ðā wyrd hē þonne wyrcð, oððe þurh þā goodan englas, oððe þurh monna sāwla, oððe þurh ōðerra gesceafta līf, oððe þurh heofones tungl, oððe ðurh þāra scuccena mislīce lotwrencas; hwīlum þurh ān ðāra, hwīlum þurh eall ðā.
text_bare: Siððan we hit hatað wyrd, syððan hit geworht bið; ær hit wæs Godes foreþonc ond his foretiohhung: ða wyrd he þonne wyrcð, oððe þurh þa goodan englas, oððe þurh monna sawla, oððe þurh oðerra gesceafta lif, oððe þurh heofones tungl, oððe ðurh þara scuccena mislice lotwrencas; hwilum þurh an ðara, hwilum þurh eall ða.

text: Ac þæt is openlīce cūð, þæt sīo godcunde foretiohhung is ānfeald ond unāwendendlīc, ond welt ǣlces þinges endebyrdlīce, ond eall þing gehīwað.
text_bare: Ac þæt is openlice cuð, þæt sio godcunde foretiohhung is anfeald ond unawendendlic, ond welt ælces þinges endebyrdlice, ond eall þing gehiwað.

text: Sumu þing þonne on þisse weorulde sint underðīed þǣre wyrde; sume hire nān wuht underðīed ne sint.
text_bare: Sumu þing þonne on þisse weorulde sint underðied þære wyrde; sume hire nan wuht underðied ne sint.

text: Ac sīo wyrd ond eall ðā þing þe hire underðīed sint, sint underðīed ðǣm godcundan foreþonce.
text_bare: Ac sio wyrd ond eall ða þing þe hire underðied sint, sint underðied ðæm godcundan foreþonce.

text: Be ðǣm ic ðē mæg sum bīspell secgan, þæt þū meaht þȳ sweotolor ongitan hwilce men bīoð underðīed þǣre wyrde, hwylce ne bīoð.
text_bare: Be ðæm ic ðe mæg sum bispell secgan, þæt þu meaht þy sweotolor ongitan hwilce men bioð underðied þære wyrde, hwylce ne bioð.

text: Eall ðīos unstille gesceaft ond þīos hwearfiende hwearfað on ðǣm stillan Gode, ond on ðǣm gestæððegan, ond on ðǣm ānfealdan; ond hē welt eallra gesceafta swā swā hē æt fruman getiohhod hæfde ond gēt hæfð.
text_bare: Eall ðios unstille gesceaft ond þios hwearfiende hwearfað on ðæm stillan Gode, ond on ðæm gestæððegan, ond on ðæm anfealdan; ond he welt eallra gesceafta swa swa he æt fruman getiohhod hæfde ond get hæfð.

text: Swā swā on wǣnes eaxe hwearfiað þā hwēol, ond sīo eax stint stille, ond byrð þēah ealne þone wǣn, ond welt ealles þæs færeltes – þæt hwēol hwerfð ymbūtan ond sīo nafu, nēhst ðǣre eaxe, sīo færð micle fæstlīcor ond orsorglīcor þonne ðā felgan dōð – swelce sīo eax sīe þæt hēhste gōd þe wē nemnað Gode, ond þā sēlestan men farað nēhste Gode, swā swā sīo nafu færð nēahst þǣre eaxe; ond þā midmestan swā swā ðā spacan.
text_bare: Swa swa on wænes eaxe hwearfiað þa hweol, ond sio eax stint stille, ond byrð þeah ealne þone wæn, ond welt ealles þæs færeltes – þæt hweol hwerfð ymbutan ond sio nafu, nehst ðære eaxe, sio færð micle fæstlicor ond orsorglicor þonne ða felgan doð – swelce sio eax sie þæt hehste god þe we nemnað Gode, ond þa selestan men farað nehste Gode, swa swa sio nafu færð neahst þære eaxe; ond þa midmestan swa swa ða spacan.

text: For ðǣm þe ǣlces spācan bið ōðer ende fæst on ðǣre nafe, ōðer on þǣre felge, swā bið þǣm midlestan monnum; ōðre hwīle hē smeað on his mōde ymb þis eorðlīce, ōðre hwīle ymb ðæt godcundlīce, swilce hē lōcie mid ōðre ēagan tō heofonum, mid ōðre tō eorþan.
text_bare: For ðæm þe ælces spacan bið oðer ende fæst on ðære nafe, oðer on þære felge, swa bið þæm midlestan monnum; oðre hwile he smeað on his mode ymb þis eorðlice, oðre hwile ymb ðæt godcundlice, swilce he locie mid oðre eagan to heofonum, mid oðre to eorþan.

text: Swā swā þā spācan sticiað, ōðer ende on þǣre felge, ōþer on þǣre nafe, middeweard sē spaca bið ǣgðrum emn nēah, ðēah ōðer ende bīo fæst on þǣre nafe, ōðer on þǣre felge; swā bīoð þā midmestan men onmiddan þām spācan, ond þā betran nēar þǣre nafe, ond þā mǣtran nēar ðǣm felgum: bīoð þēah fæste on ðǣre nafe, ond sīo nafu on ðǣre eaxe.
text_bare: Swa swa þa spacan sticiað, oðer ende on þære felge, oþer on þære nafe, middeweard se spaca bið ægðrum emn neah, ðeah oðer ende bio fæst on þære nafe, oðer on þære felge; swa bioð þa midmestan men onmiddan þam spacan, ond þa betran near þære nafe, ond þa mætran near ðæm felgum: bioð þeah fæste on ðære nafe, ond sio nafu on ðære eaxe.

text: Hwæt þā felga þēah hongiað on þǣm spācum, þēah hī eallunga wealowigen on þǣre eorðan; swā dōð þā mǣtestan men on þǣm midmestum, ond þā midmestan on þǣm betstum, ond þā betstan on Gode.
text_bare: Hwæt þa felga þeah hongiað on þæm spacum, þeah hi eallunga wealowigen on þære eorðan; swa doð þa mætestan men on þæm midmestum, ond þa midmestan on þæm betstum, ond þa betstan on Gode.

text: Þēah þā mǣtestan ealle hiora lufe wenden tō ðisse weorulde, hī ne magon þǣr onwunigan, nē tō nāuhte ne weorðað, gif hī be nānum dǣle ne bēoð gefæstnode tō Gode, þōn mā þe þæs hwēoles felga magon bīon on ðǣm færelte, gif hī ne bīoð fæste on þǣm spācum, ond þā spācan on þǣre eaxe.
text_bare: Þeah þa mætestan ealle hiora lufe wenden to ðisse weorulde, hi ne magon þær onwunigan, ne to nauhte ne weorðað, gif hi be nanum dæle ne beoð gefæstnode to Gode, þon ma þe þæs hweoles felga magon bion on ðæm færelte, gif hi ne bioð fæste on þæm spacum, ond þa spacan on þære eaxe.

text: Þā felgea bīoð fyrrest ðǣre eaxe; for ðǣm hī farað ungerēdelīcost.
text_bare: Þa felgea bioð fyrrest ðære eaxe; for ðæm hi farað ungeredelicost.

text: Sīo nafu færð nēaxst þǣre eaxe, for ðȳ hīo færð gesundlīcost.
text_bare: Sio nafu færð neaxst þære eaxe, for ðy hio færð gesundlicost.

text: Swā dōð ðā sēlestan men.
text_bare: Swa doð ða selestan men.

text: Swā hī hiora lufe nēar Gode lǣtað, ond swīðor þās eorðlīcon þing forsēoþ, swā hī bēoð orsorgran, ond lǣs rēccað hū sīo wyrd wandrige, oððe hwæt hīo brenge.
text_bare: Swa hi hiora lufe near Gode lætað, ond swiðor þas eorðlicon þing forseoþ, swa hi beoð orsorgran, ond læs reccað hu sio wyrd wandrige, oððe hwæt hio brenge.

text: Swā swā sīo nafu bið symle swā gesund, hnæppen þā felga on þæt ðe hī hnæppen; ond þēah bið sīo nafu hwæthwugu tōdǣled from þǣre eaxe.
text_bare: Swa swa sio nafu bið symle swa gesund, hnæppen þa felga on þæt ðe hi hnæppen; ond þeah bið sio nafu hwæthwugu todæled from þære eaxe.

text: Be þȳ þū meaht ongitan þæt sē wǣn bið micle leng gesund, þē lǣs bið tōdǣled from þǣre eaxe.
text_bare: Be þy þu meaht ongitan þæt se wæn bið micle leng gesund, þe læs bið todæled from þære eaxe.

text: Swā bīoð þā men eallra orsorgoste, ǣgðer ge þisses andweardan līfes earfoða, ge þæs tōweardan, þā þe fæste bīoð on Gode; ac swā hī swīður bīoð āsyndrede fram Gode, swā hī swīður bīoð gedrēfde ond geswencte, ǣgþer ge on mōde ge on līchoman.
text_bare: Swa bioð þa men eallra orsorgoste, ægðer ge þisses andweardan lifes earfoða, ge þæs toweardan, þa þe fæste bioð on Gode; ac swa hi swiður bioð asyndrede fram Gode, swa hi swiður bioð gedrefde ond geswencte, ægþer ge on mode ge on lichoman.

text: Swilc is þæt þæt wē wyrd hātað, be þǣm godcundan foreþonce: swylce sīo smēaung ond sīo gescēadwīsnes, is tō metanne wið þone gearowitan, ond swylce þās lǣnan þing bīoð tō metanne wið ðā ēcan, ond swilce þæt hweol bið tō metanne wið ðā eaxe.
text_bare: Swilc is þæt þæt we wyrd hatað, be þæm godcundan foreþonce: swylce sio smeaung ond sio gesceadwisnes, is to metanne wið þone gearowitan, ond swylce þas lænan þing bioð to metanne wið ða ecan, ond swilce þæt hweol bið to metanne wið ða eaxe.

text: For ðǣm sīo eax welt ealles þæs wænes; swā deð sē godcunda foreðonc.
text_bare: For ðæm sio eax welt ealles þæs wænes; swa deð se godcunda foreðonc.

text: Hē āstereð þone rodor ond þā tunglu, ond þā eorðan gedēð stille; ond gemetgað þā fēower gesceafta, þæt is, wæter, ond eorðe, ond fȳr, ond lyft.
text_bare: He astereð þone rodor ond þa tunglu, ond þa eorðan gedeð stille; ond gemetgað þa feower gesceafta, þæt is, wæter, ond eorðe, ond fyr, ond lyft.

text: Þā hē geðwǣrað ond wlitegað, hwīlum eft unwlitegað, ond on ōðrum hīwe gebrengð, ond eft geednīwað; ond tȳdreð ælc tūdor, ond hit eft gehȳt ond gehelt þonne hit forealdod bið ond forsēarod, ond eft geēowð ond geednīwað þonne þonne hē wile.
text_bare: Þa he geðwærað ond wlitegað, hwilum eft unwlitegað, ond on oðrum hiwe gebrengð, ond eft geedniwað; ond tydreð ælc tudor, ond hit eft gehyt ond gehelt þonne hit forealdod bið ond forsearod, ond eft geeowð ond geedniwað þonne þonne he wile.

text: Sume ūðwiotan ðēah secgað, þæt sīo wyrd wealde ǣgþer ge gesǣlða ge ungesǣlða ǣlces monnes.
text_bare: Sume uðwiotan ðeah secgað, þæt sio wyrd wealde ægþer ge gesælða ge ungesælða ælces monnes.

text: Ic þonne secge, swā swā ealle crīstene men secgað, þæt sīo godcunde foretiohhung his wealde, næs sīo wyrd; ond ic wāt þæt hīo dēmð eall þing swīðe rihte, þēah ungescēadwīsum men swā ne þince.
text_bare: Ic þonne secge, swa swa ealle cristene men secgað, þæt sio godcunde foretiohhung his wealde, næs sio wyrd; ond ic wat þæt hio demð eall þing swiðe rihte, þeah ungesceadwisum men swa ne þince.

text: Hī wēnað þæt þāra ǣlc sīe god ðe hiora willan fulgǣð; nis hit nān wundor, for ðǣm hī bēoð āblende mid ðǣm þīostrum heora scylda.
text_bare: Hi wenað þæt þara ælc sie god ðe hiora willan fulgæð; nis hit nan wundor, for ðæm hi beoð ablende mid ðæm þiostrum heora scylda.

text: Ac sē godcunda foreþonc hit understent eall swīðe rihte, þēah ūs þince for ūrum dysige þæt hit on wōh fare, for ðǣm wē ne cunnon þæt rihte understandan.
text_bare: Ac se godcunda foreþonc hit understent eall swiðe rihte, þeah us þince for urum dysige þæt hit on woh fare, for ðæm we ne cunnon þæt rihte understandan.

text: Hē dēmð þēah eall swīðe rihte, þēah ūs hwīlum swā ne ðince.
text_bare: He demð þeah eall swiðe rihte, þeah us hwilum swa ne ðince.

text: Ealle men spiriað æfter þǣm hēhstan goode, ǣgðer ge goode ge yfle.
text_bare: Ealle men spiriað æfter þæm hehstan goode, ægðer ge goode ge yfle.

text: Ac for ðȳ ne magon þā yflan cuman tō ðǣm hēan hrōfe eallra gooda, for ðǣm hī ne spyriað on riht æfter.
text_bare: Ac for ðy ne magon þa yflan cuman to ðæm hean hrofe eallra gooda, for ðæm hi ne spyriað on riht æfter.

text: Ic wāt þēah þæt þū cweðe nū hwonne tō me: 'Hwylc unriht mæg bēon māre þonne þæt hē þafige þæt hit geweorðe, swā hit hwīlum gewyrð, þæt þǣm goodum becymð ānfeald yfel on þisse weorulde, ond þǣm yflum ānfeald gōd; ond ōðre hwīle ægðer gemenged, ǣgþer ge ðǣm goodum ge þǣm yflum?' Ac ic ðē ācsige hwæðer þū wēne þæt ǣnig mon sīe swā andgitfull þæt hē mæge ongitan ǣlcne mon on riht hwylc hē sīe, þæt hē nāwðer ne sīe nē betra nē wyrsa þonne hē his wene?
text_bare: Ic wat þeah þæt þu cweðe nu hwonne to me: 'Hwylc unriht mæg beon mare þonne þæt he þafige þæt hit geweorðe, swa hit hwilum gewyrð, þæt þæm goodum becymð anfeald yfel on þisse weorulde, ond þæm yflum anfeald god; ond oðre hwile ægðer gemenged, ægþer ge ðæm goodum ge þæm yflum?' Ac ic ðe acsige hwæðer þu wene þæt ænig mon sie swa andgitfull þæt he mæge ongitan ælcne mon on riht hwylc he sie, þæt he nawðer ne sie ne betra ne wyrsa þonne he his wene?

text: Ic wāt þēah þæt hī ne magon.
text_bare: Ic wat þeah þæt hi ne magon.

text: Ac wyrð swīðe oft on wōn sē sido þe sume men secgað þæt hē sīe mēde wyrðe, sume men secgað þæt hē sīe wītes wyrðe.
text_bare: Ac wyrð swiðe oft on won se sido þe sume men secgað þæt he sie mede wyrðe, sume men secgað þæt he sie wites wyrðe.

text: Þēah hwā mæge ongitan hwæt ōðer dō, hē ne mæg witan hwæt hē þencð; þēah hē mæge sume his willan ongitan, þonne ne mæg hē eallne.
text_bare: Þeah hwa mæge ongitan hwæt oðer do, he ne mæg witan hwæt he þencð; þeah he mæge sume his willan ongitan, þonne ne mæg he eallne.

text: Ic þē mæg ēac reccan sum bīspell be þǣm þæt þū hit meaht þe sweotolor ongitan, þēah hit ungescēadwise men ongitan ne mægen.
text_bare: Ic þe mæg eac reccan sum bispell be þæm þæt þu hit meaht þe sweotolor ongitan, þeah hit ungesceadwise men ongitan ne mægen.

text: Þæt is, For hwȳ sē gooda lǣce selle þǣm hālum men sēftne drenc ond swētne, ond ōðrum hālum biterne ond strangne?
text_bare: Þæt is, For hwy se gooda læce selle þæm halum men seftne drenc ond swetne, ond oðrum halum biterne ond strangne?

text: Ond hwīlum eft þǣm unhālum, sumum līðne, sumum strangne; sumum swētne, sumum biterne?
text_bare: Ond hwilum eft þæm unhalum, sumum liðne, sumum strangne; sumum swetne, sumum biterne?

text: Ic wāt þæt ǣlc þāra þe þone cræft ne can, wile þæs wundrian for hwī hī swā dōn; ac his ne wundriað þā lǣcas nāuht, for ðǣm hī witon þæt ðā ōðre nyton: for ðǣm hī cunnon ǣlces hiora medtrymnesse ongitan ond oncnāwan, ond ēac ðā cræftas þe þǣr wið sculon.
text_bare: Ic wat þæt ælc þara þe þone cræft ne can, wile þæs wundrian for hwi hi swa don; ac his ne wundriað þa læcas nauht, for ðæm hi witon þæt ða oðre nyton: for ðæm hi cunnon ælces hiora medtrymnesse ongitan ond oncnawan, ond eac ða cræftas þe þær wið sculon.

text: Hwæt is sāwla hǣlo būte rihtwīsnes?
text_bare: Hwæt is sawla hælo bute rihtwisnes?

text: oððe hwæt is hiora untrumnes būte unþēawas?
text_bare: oððe hwæt is hiora untrumnes bute unþeawas?

text: Hwā is þonne betera lǣce þǣre sāwle þonne sē þe hī gescēop, þæt is God?
text_bare: Hwa is þonne betera læce þære sawle þonne se þe hi gesceop, þæt is God?

text: Hē ārað þā goodan, ond witnað ðā yflan.
text_bare: He arað þa goodan, ond witnað ða yflan.

text: Hē wāt hwæs ǣlc wyrðe bið; nis hit nān wundor, for ðǣm hē of þǣm hēan hrōfe hit eall gesihð, ond þonan miscað ond metgað ǣlcum be his gewyrhtum.
text_bare: He wat hwæs ælc wyrðe bið; nis hit nan wundor, for ðæm he of þæm hean hrofe hit eall gesihð, ond þonan miscað ond metgað ælcum be his gewyrhtum.

text: Þæt wē þonne hātað wyrd, þonne sē gescēadwīsa God, þe ǣlces monnes ðearfe wāt, hwæt wyrcð oððe geþafað þæs þe wē ne wenað.
text_bare: Þæt we þonne hatað wyrd, þonne se gesceadwisa God, þe ælces monnes ðearfe wat, hwæt wyrcð oððe geþafað þæs þe we ne wenað.

text: Ond git ic þē mæg sume bīsne fēaum wordum secgan be þǣm dǣle þe sīo mennisce gescēadwīsnes mæg ongitan þā godcundnesse.
text_bare: Ond git ic þe mæg sume bisne feaum wordum secgan be þæm dæle þe sio mennisce gesceadwisnes mæg ongitan þa godcundnesse.

text: Þæt is þonne, þæt wē ongitað hwīlum mon on ōðre wīsan, on ōðre hine God ongit.
text_bare: Þæt is þonne, þæt we ongitað hwilum mon on oðre wisan, on oðre hine God ongit.

text: Hwīlum wē tiohhiað þæt hē sīe sē betra, ond þonne wāt God þæt hit swā ne bið.
text_bare: Hwilum we tiohhiað þæt he sie se betra, ond þonne wat God þæt hit swa ne bið.

text: Þonne hwǣm hwæt cymð, oððe goodes oððe yfles, māre þonne ðē þincð þæt hē wyrðe sīe, ne bið sīo unrihtwīsnes nō on Gode, ac sīo unglēawnes bið on ðē selfum, þæt þū hit ne canst on riht gecnāwan.
text_bare: Þonne hwæm hwæt cymð, oððe goodes oððe yfles, mare þonne ðe þincð þæt he wyrðe sie, ne bið sio unrihtwisnes no on Gode, ac sio ungleawnes bið on ðe selfum, þæt þu hit ne canst on riht gecnawan.

text: Oft gebyreð þēah þætte men ongitað mon on ðā ilcan wīsan þe hine God ongit.
text_bare: Oft gebyreð þeah þætte men ongitað mon on ða ilcan wisan þe hine God ongit.

text: Oft hit gebyreð þætte manige men bīoð swā ungetrume ǣgþer ge on mōde ge on līchoman þæt hī ne magon nē nān good don, nē nān yfel nyllað unnēdige; ond bīoð ēac swā ungeþyldige þæt hī ne magon nān earfoðu geþyldelīce āberan.
text_bare: Oft hit gebyreð þætte manige men bioð swa ungetrume ægþer ge on mode ge on lichoman þæt hi ne magon ne nan good don, ne nan yfel nyllað unnedige; ond bioð eac swa ungeþyldige þæt hi ne magon nan earfoðu geþyldelice aberan.

text: For ðǣm hit gebyreð oft þæt God nylle for his mildheortnesse nān unaberendlīce broc him an settan, þȳ læs hī forlǣten hiora unsceaðfulnesse, ond weorðen wyrsan, gif hī āsterede bīoð ond geswencte.
text_bare: For ðæm hit gebyreð oft þæt God nylle for his mildheortnesse nan unaberendlice broc him an settan, þy læs hi forlæten hiora unsceaðfulnesse, ond weorðen wyrsan, gif hi asterede bioð ond geswencte.

text: Sume men bēoð ǣlces cræftes full cræftige, ond fullhālige weras ond rihtwise.
text_bare: Sume men beoð ælces cræftes full cræftige, ond fullhalige weras ond rihtwise.

text: Þonne þincð þæt Gode unriht þæt hē swylce swence; ge furðum þone dēað þe eallum monnum is gecynde tō þolianne, hē him gedēð seftran þone ōðrum monnum: swā swā gīo wīsmon cwæð, þæt sē godcunda anwald gefrioðode his dēorlingas under his fiðra sceate, ond hī scilde swā geornlīce swā man dēð þone æppel on his ēagan.
text_bare: Þonne þincð þæt Gode unriht þæt he swylce swence; ge furðum þone deað þe eallum monnum is gecynde to þolianne, he him gedeð seftran þone oðrum monnum: swa swa gio wismon cwæð, þæt se godcunda anwald gefrioðode his deorlingas under his fiðra sceate, ond hi scilde swa geornlice swa man deð þone æppel on his eagan.

text: Manige tiliað Gode tō cwēmanne tō þon georne, þæt hī wilniað hiora āgnum willum manigfeald earfoðu tō ðrōwianne; for ðǣm hī willniað māran āre ond māran hlīsan ond weorðscipe mid Gode tō habbanne þonne þā habbað þe softor libbað.
text_bare: Manige tiliað Gode to cwemanne to þon georne, þæt hi wilniað hiora agnum willum manigfeald earfoðu to ðrowianne; for ðæm hi willniað maran are ond maran hlisan ond weorðscipe mid Gode to habbanne þonne þa habbað þe softor libbað.

text: Oft ēac becymð sē anwald þisse worulde tō swiðe goodum monnum, for ðǣm þæt sē anwald þāra yflena weorðe tōworpen.
text_bare: Oft eac becymð se anwald þisse worulde to swiðe goodum monnum, for ðæm þæt se anwald þara yflena weorðe toworpen.

text: Sumum monnum God seleð ǣgðer ge good ge yfel gemenged, for ðǣm hī ǣgþres earniað.
text_bare: Sumum monnum God seleð ægðer ge good ge yfel gemenged, for ðæm hi ægþres earniað.

text: Sume hē berēafað hiora welan swiðe hraðe, þæs þe hī ǣrest gesǣlige weorðað, þȳ lǣs hī for longum gesǣlðum hī tō ūp āhebben, ond þonan on ofermēttum weorðen.
text_bare: Sume he bereafað hiora welan swiðe hraðe, þæs þe hi ærest gesælige weorðað, þy læs hi for longum gesælðum hi to up ahebben, ond þonan on ofermettum weorðen.

text: Sume hē lǣt þrēagan mid heardum broce, þæt hī leornigen þone cræft geþyldelice on ðǣm langan geswince.
text_bare: Sume he læt þreagan mid heardum broce, þæt hi leornigen þone cræft geþyldelice on ðæm langan geswince.

text: Sume him ondrǣdað earfoðu swīðor þonne hī þyrfen, þēah hī hī ēaðe ādrēogan mægen.
text_bare: Sume him ondrædað earfoðu swiðor þonne hi þyrfen, þeah hi hi eaðe adreogan mægen.

text: Sume hī gebycgað weorðlīcne hlīsan þisses andweardan līfes mid hiora agnum dēaðe; for ðǣm hī wēnað þæt hī næbben nān ōðer fioh þæs hlīsan wyrðe būton hiora āgnum fīore.
text_bare: Sume hi gebycgað weorðlicne hlisan þisses andweardan lifes mid hiora agnum deaðe; for ðæm hi wenað þæt hi næbben nan oðer fioh þæs hlisan wyrðe buton hiora agnum fiore.

text: Sume men wǣron gīo unoferswiðedlīce, swā þæt hī nān ne meahte mid nānum wīte oferswīðan; þā bȳsnodon hiora æftergengum, þæt hī nǣren mid wītum oferswiðde.
text_bare: Sume men wæron gio unoferswiðedlice, swa þæt hi nan ne meahte mid nanum wite oferswiðan; þa bysnodon hiora æftergengum, þæt hi næren mid witum oferswiðde.

text: On þǣm wæs sweotol þæt hī for heora gōdum weorcum, hæfden ðone cræft þæt hī mon ne meahte oferswīðan.
text_bare: On þæm wæs sweotol þæt hi for heora godum weorcum, hæfden ðone cræft þæt hi mon ne meahte oferswiðan.

text: Ac þā yflan, for hiora yflum weorcum, wǣron gewītnode ond oferswīðde, for ðǣm þæt ðā wītu gestīrden ōðrum þæt hī swā gedōn ne dorsten, ond ēac þā gebēten þe hī þonne brociað.
text_bare: Ac þa yflan, for hiora yflum weorcum, wæron gewitnode ond oferswiðde, for ðæm þæt ða witu gestirden oðrum þæt hi swa gedon ne dorsten, ond eac þa gebeten þe hi þonne brociað.

text: Þæt is swīðe sweotol tācn þǣm wīsan, þæt hē ne sceal lufian tō ungemetlīce ðās woruldgesǣlða, for ðǣm hīe oft cumað tō ðǣm wyrrestum monnum.
text_bare: Þæt is swiðe sweotol tacn þæm wisan, þæt he ne sceal lufian to ungemetlice ðas woruldgesælða, for ðæm hie oft cumað to ðæm wyrrestum monnum.

text: Ac hwæt wille wē cweðan be þǣm andweardan welan þe oft cymð tō ðǣm goodum?
text_bare: Ac hwæt wille we cweðan be þæm andweardan welan þe oft cymð to ðæm goodum?

text: Hwæt hē elles sīe būton tācn þæs tōweardan welan, ond þæs edlēanes angin þe him God tiohhod hæfð for his goodan willan?
text_bare: Hwæt he elles sie buton tacn þæs toweardan welan, ond þæs edleanes angin þe him God tiohhod hæfð for his goodan willan?

text: Ic wēne ēac þætte God selle mænegum yfelum men gesǣlða, for ðǣm þe hē wāt hiora gecynd ond hiora willan swā gerādne þæt hī for nānum ermðum bīoð nē þȳ betran, ac þȳ wyrsan.
text_bare: Ic wene eac þætte God selle mænegum yfelum men gesælða, for ðæm þe he wat hiora gecynd ond hiora willan swa geradne þæt hi for nanum ermðum bioð ne þy betran, ac þy wyrsan.

text: Ac sē gōda lǣce, þæt is God, lācnað hiora mōd mid ðǣm welan; wile þæt hī ongiten hwonon him sē wela cōme, ond ōlecce þǣm þe lǣs hē him þone welan āfyrre, oððe hine þǣm welan, ond wende his þēawas tō gōde, ond forlǣte ðā unþēawas ond þā yfel þe hē ǣr for his ermðum dyde.
text_bare: Ac se goda læce, þæt is God, lacnað hiora mod mid ðæm welan; wile þæt hi ongiten hwonon him se wela come, ond olecce þæm þe læs he him þone welan afyrre, oððe hine þæm welan, ond wende his þeawas to gode, ond forlæte ða unþeawas ond þa yfel þe he ær for his ermðum dyde.

text: Sume bīoð þēah þȳ wyrson gif hī welan habbað, forðǣm hī ofermodigað for ðǣm welan, ond his ungemetlīce brūcað.
text_bare: Sume bioð þeah þy wyrson gif hi welan habbað, forðæm hi ofermodigað for ðæm welan, ond his ungemetlice brucað.

text: Manegum men bīoð ēac forgifene forðǣm þās weoruldgesǣlða, þæt hē scyle þǣm goodum lēanian hiora good, ond þǣm yflum hiora yfel.
text_bare: Manegum men bioð eac forgifene forðæm þas weoruldgesælða, þæt he scyle þæm goodum leanian hiora good, ond þæm yflum hiora yfel.

text: For ðǣm symle bīoð þā goodan ond þā yflan ungeþwǣre betwuh him, ge ēac hwīlum þā yflan bīoð ungerāde betwuh him selfum; ge furðum ān yfel man bið hwīlum ungeþwǣre him selfum, for ðǣm þe hē wāt þæt hē untela dēð, ond wēnð him þāra lēana, ond nyle þēah þæs geswīcan, nē hit furðum him ne lǣt hrēowan: ond þonne for ðǣm singālan ege ne mǣg nō weorðan geþwǣre on him selfum.
text_bare: For ðæm symle bioð þa goodan ond þa yflan ungeþwære betwuh him, ge eac hwilum þa yflan bioð ungerade betwuh him selfum; ge furðum an yfel man bið hwilum ungeþwære him selfum, for ðæm þe he wat þæt he untela deð, ond wenð him þara leana, ond nyle þeah þæs geswican, ne hit furðum him ne læt hreowan: ond þonne for ðæm singalan ege ne mæg no weorðan geþwære on him selfum.

text: Oft hit ēac gebyreð þæt sē yfla forlǣt his yfel for sumes ōðres yfles mannes andan, for ðǣm hē wolde mid þē tǣlan þone ōðerne þæt hē onscunode his þēawas: swincð þonne ymb þæt swā hē swīðost mæg, þæt hē tiolað ungelīc tō bīonne þǣm ōðrum; for ðǣm hit is þæs godcundan anwealdes gewuna, þæt hē wircð of yfle good.
text_bare: Oft hit eac gebyreð þæt se yfla forlæt his yfel for sumes oðres yfles mannes andan, for ðæm he wolde mid þe tælan þone oðerne þæt he onscunode his þeawas: swincð þonne ymb þæt swa he swiðost mæg, þæt he tiolað ungelic to bionne þæm oðrum; for ðæm hit is þæs godcundan anwealdes gewuna, þæt he wircð of yfle good.

text: Ac hit nis nānum men ālēfed þæt hē mæge witan eall þæt God getiohhod hæfð, nē ēac āreccan þæt þæt hē geworht hæfð.
text_bare: Ac hit nis nanum men alefed þæt he mæge witan eall þæt God getiohhod hæfð, ne eac areccan þæt þæt he geworht hæfð.

text: Ac on þǣm hī habbað genōh tō ongitanne, þæt sē Scippend ond sē Waldend eallra gesceafta welt ond rehte gescēop eall þæt hē gescēop, ond nān yfel ne worhte nē get ne wyrcð, ac ǣlc yfel hē adrifð of eallum his rīce.
text_bare: Ac on þæm hi habbað genoh to ongitanne, þæt se Scippend ond se Waldend eallra gesceafta welt ond rehte gesceop eall þæt he gesceop, ond nan yfel ne worhte ne get ne wyrcð, ac ælc yfel he adrifð of eallum his rice.

text: Ac gif þū æfter þǣm hēan anwalde spyrian wilt þæs ælmehtigan Godes, þonne ne ongitst þū nān yfel on nanum þinge, þēah þe nū ðince þæt hēr micel on þȳs middangearde sīe; for ðǣm hit is riht þæt ðā goodan hæbben good edlēan hiora goodes, ond þā yflan hæbban wīte hiora yfles; ne bið þæt nān yfel þæt riht bið, ac bið good.
text_bare: Ac gif þu æfter þæm hean anwalde spyrian wilt þæs ælmehtigan Godes, þonne ne ongitst þu nan yfel on nanum þinge, þeah þe nu ðince þæt her micel on þys middangearde sie; for ðæm hit is riht þæt ða goodan hæbben good edlean hiora goodes, ond þa yflan hæbban wite hiora yfles; ne bið þæt nan yfel þæt riht bið, ac bið good.

text: Ðā cwæð hē, 'For ðȳ wē sceoldon ealle mægene spyrian æfter Gode, þæt wē wissen hwæt hē wǣre.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he, 'For ðy we sceoldon ealle mægene spyrian æfter Gode, þæt we wissen hwæt he wære.

text: Ðēah hit ūre mǣð ne sīe þæt wē witen hwylc hē sīe, wē sculon þēah be þæs andgites mǣþ, for ðǣm wē ne magon ǣlc þing ongitan swylc swylce hit bið.
text_bare: Ðeah hit ure mæð ne sie þæt we witen hwylc he sie, we sculon þeah be þæs andgites mæþ, for ðæm we ne magon ælc þing ongitan swylc swylce hit bið.

text: Ǣlc gesceaft ðēah, ǣgðer ge gescēadwīs ge ungescēadwīs, þæt sweotolað þæt God ēce is.
text_bare: Ælc gesceaft ðeah, ægðer ge gesceadwis ge ungesceadwis, þæt sweotolað þæt God ece is.

text: For ðǣm nǣfre swā manega gesceafta, on swā micla on swā fǣgra, hī ne underðīodden lǣssan gesceafte ond lǣssan anwalde þonne hī ealle sindon, nē furðum emne miclum.' Ðā cwæð ic, 'Hwæt is ēcnes?' Ðā cwæð hē, 'Þū mē āhsast micles earfoðes tō ongitanne.
text_bare: For ðæm næfre swa manega gesceafta, on swa micla on swa fægra, hi ne underðiodden læssan gesceafte ond læssan anwalde þonne hi ealle sindon, ne furðum emne miclum.' Ða cwæð ic, 'Hwæt is ecnes?' Ða cwæð he, 'Þu me ahsast micles earfoðes to ongitanne.

text: Gif þū hit witan wilt, ðū scealt habban ǣr þīnes mōdes ēagan clǣne ond hlūtor.
text_bare: Gif þu hit witan wilt, ðu scealt habban ær þines modes eagan clæne ond hlutor.

text: Ne mæg ic ðē nāuht helan þæs þe ic wāt.
text_bare: Ne mæg ic ðe nauht helan þæs þe ic wat.

text: Wāst þū þæt þrēo ðing sindon on þīs middangearde?
text_bare: Wast þu þæt þreo ðing sindon on þis middangearde?

text: Ān is hwīlendlīc, þæt hæfð ǣgðer ge fruman ge ende, ond nāt ðēah nān wuht ðæs ðe hwīlendlīc is, nāuðer nē his fruman nē his ende.
text_bare: An is hwilendlic, þæt hæfð ægðer ge fruman ge ende, ond nat ðeah nan wuht ðæs ðe hwilendlic is, nauðer ne his fruman ne his ende.

text: Ōðer ðing is ēce, þæt hæfð fruman on næfð nǣnne ende, ond wāt hwonne hit onginð, ond wāt þæt hit nǣfre ne geendað, þæt sint englas, on monna sāula.
text_bare: Oðer ðing is ece, þæt hæfð fruman on næfð nænne ende, ond wat hwonne hit onginð, ond wat þæt hit næfre ne geendað, þæt sint englas, on monna saula.

text: Þridde ðing is ēce, būton end on būton anginne, þæt is God.
text_bare: Þridde ðing is ece, buton end on buton anginne, þæt is God.

text: Betweoh þǣm þrīm is swīðe micel tōscēad.
text_bare: Betweoh þæm þrim is swiðe micel toscead.

text: Gif wit þæt eall sculon tōsmēagian, þonne cume wit late tō ende þisse bēc, oððe nǣfre.
text_bare: Gif wit þæt eall sculon tosmeagian, þonne cume wit late to ende þisse bec, oððe næfre.

text: Ac ān þing ðū scealt nēde þǣr ǣr witan, for hwȳ God is gehāten sīo hēhste ēcnes.' Ðā cwæð ic 'Hwȳ?' Ðā cwæð hē, 'For ðon þe wē witon swīðe lȳtel ðæs ðe ǣr ūs wæs, būton be gemynde ond be geāscunge; ond gēt lǣsse þæs ðe æfter ūs bið.
text_bare: Ac an þing ðu scealt nede þær ær witan, for hwy God is gehaten sio hehste ecnes.' Ða cwæð ic 'Hwy?' Ða cwæð he, 'For ðon þe we witon swiðe lytel ðæs ðe ær us wæs, buton be gemynde ond be geascunge; ond get læsse þæs ðe æfter us bið.

text: Þæt ān ūs is gewislīce andweard, þæt þe þonne bið; ac him is eall andweard, ge þæt þe ǣr wæs, ge þæt þe nū is, ge þæt þe æfter ūs bið; eall þæt is him andweard.
text_bare: Þæt an us is gewislice andweard, þæt þe þonne bið; ac him is eall andweard, ge þæt þe ær wæs, ge þæt þe nu is, ge þæt þe æfter us bið; eall þæt is him andweard.

text: Ne wexð his wela nā nē ēac nǣfre ne wanað.
text_bare: Ne wexð his wela na ne eac næfre ne wanað.

text: Ne ofman hē nǣfre nān wuht, for þǣm þe hē nǣfre nāuht ne forgeat.
text_bare: Ne ofman he næfre nan wuht, for þæm þe he næfre nauht ne forgeat.

text: Ne sēcð hē nān wuht nē ne smēað, for ðǣm þe hē hit wāt eall.
text_bare: Ne secð he nan wuht ne ne smeað, for ðæm þe he hit wat eall.

text: Ne sēcð hē nān wuht, for ðȳ hē nāan wuht ne forlēas.
text_bare: Ne secð he nan wuht, for ðy he naan wuht ne forleas.

text: Ne ēht hē nānre wuhte, for ðȳ hine nān wuht ne mǣg flīon.
text_bare: Ne eht he nanre wuhte, for ðy hine nan wuht ne mæg flion.

text: Ne ondrǣt hē him nān wuht, for ðǣm hē næfð nǣnne rīcran, nē furðum nǣnne gelīcan.
text_bare: Ne ondræt he him nan wuht, for ðæm he næfð nænne ricran, ne furðum nænne gelican.

text: Simle hē bið gefende, ond ne wanað his nǣfre nāuht.
text_bare: Simle he bið gefende, ond ne wanað his næfre nauht.

text: Symle hē bið ælmihtig, for ðǣm hē symle wile good, ond nǣfre nān yfel.
text_bare: Symle he bið ælmihtig, for ðæm he symle wile good, ond næfre nan yfel.

text: Nis him nānes þinges nēdþearf.
text_bare: Nis him nanes þinges nedþearf.

text: Symle hē bið lōciende, nē nǣfre ne wyrð.
text_bare: Symle he bið lociende, ne næfre ne wyrð.

text: Simle hē bið frīoh, nē bið hē tō nānum weorce genēded.
text_bare: Simle he bið frioh, ne bið he to nanum weorce geneded.

text: For his godcundlīcum anwalde hē is ǣghwǣr andweard.
text_bare: For his godcundlicum anwalde he is æghwær andweard.

text: His micelnesse ne mæg nān man āmetan; nis þæt ðēah ne līchomlīce tō wēnanne, ac gāstlīce, swā swā nū wīsdōm is ond rihtwīsnes, for ðǣm hē þæt is self.
text_bare: His micelnesse ne mæg nan man ametan; nis þæt ðeah ne lichomlice to wenanne, ac gastlice, swa swa nu wisdom is ond rihtwisnes, for ðæm he þæt is self.

text: Ac hwæt ofermōdie gē þonne, oððe hwȳ āhebbe gē ēow wið swā hēane anwald?
text_bare: Ac hwæt ofermodie ge þonne, oððe hwy ahebbe ge eow wið swa heane anwald?

text: For ðǣm gē nāuht wið hine dōn ne magon.
text_bare: For ðæm ge nauht wið hine don ne magon.

text: For ðǣm sē ēca ond sē ælmehtiga symle sit on þǣm hēan setle his anwaldes, þonan hē mæg eall gesīon, ond gilt ǣlcum swīðe rihte æfter his gewyrhtum.
text_bare: For ðæm se eca ond se ælmehtiga symle sit on þæm hean setle his anwaldes, þonan he mæg eall gesion, ond gilt ælcum swiðe rihte æfter his gewyrhtum.

text: For ðǣm hit nis nō unnet þæt wē hopien tō Gode; for ðǣm hē is swīðe rūmmōd ond swīðe mildheort.
text_bare: For ðæm hit nis no unnet þæt we hopien to Gode; for ðæm he is swiðe rummod ond swiðe mildheort.

text: Hebbað ēower mōd tō him mid ēowrum hondum, ond biddað þæs þe riht sīe ond ēower þearf sīe, for ðǣm hē ēow nele wyrnan.
text_bare: Hebbað eower mod to him mid eowrum hondum, ond biddað þæs þe riht sie ond eower þearf sie, for ðæm he eow nele wyrnan.

text: Hatiað yfel ond flēoð swā gē swīðost magen.
text_bare: Hatiað yfel ond fleoð swa ge swiðost magen.

text: Lufiað cræftas ond folgiað þǣm.
text_bare: Lufiað cræftas ond folgiað þæm.

text: Gē habbað micle nēdðearfe þæt gē symle wel dōn, for ðǣm gē symle beforan þǣm ēcan ond þǣm ælmihtigan Gode dōð eall þæt þæt gē dōð.
text_bare: Ge habbað micle nedðearfe þæt ge symle wel don, for ðæm ge symle beforan þæm ecan ond þæm ælmihtigan Gode doð eall þæt þæt ge doð.

text: Eall hē hit gesihð, ond eall hē hit forgilt.'
text_bare: Eall he hit gesihð, ond eall he hit forgilt.'

text: Mid þȳ hē þā Paulīnus sē biscop Godes word bodade ond lǣrde, ond se+ cyning elde þā gȳt tō gelȳfanne, ond þurh sume tīde, swā swā wē ǣr cwǣdon, gelimplīcum āna sæt, ond geornlīce mid him seolfum smēade ond þōhte hwæt him sēlest tō dōnne wǣre hwylc ǣfæstnes him tō healdanne wǣre, þā wæs sume dæg sē Godes wer ingongende tō him þǣr hē āna sæt, ond sette his þā swīðran hond him on þæt hēafod, ond hine āhsode hwæðer hē þæt tācen ongytan meahte.
text_bare: Mid þy he þa Paulinus se biscop Godes word bodade ond lærde, ond se+ cyning elde þa gyt to gelyfanne, ond þurh sume tide, swa swa we ær cwædon, gelimplicum ana sæt, ond geornlice mid him seolfum smeade ond þohte hwæt him selest to donne wære hwylc æfæstnes him to healdanne wære, þa wæs sume dæg se Godes wer ingongende to him þær he ana sæt, ond sette his þa swiðran hond him on þæt heafod, ond hine ahsode hwæðer he þæt tacen ongytan meahte.

text: Þā oncnēow hē hit sōna sweotole, ond wæs swīðe forht geworden, ond him tō fōtum fēoll; ond hine sē Godes monn ūp hōf ond him cūðlīce tō spræc, ond þus cwæð: Ono hwæt, þū nū hafast þurh Godes gide þīnra fēonda hond beswīcade, þā ðū ðē ondrēde, ond þū þurh his sylene ond gife þǣm rīce onfēnge þe ðū wilnadest.
text_bare: Þa oncneow he hit sona sweotole, ond wæs swiðe forht geworden, ond him to fotum feoll; ond hine se Godes monn up hof ond him cuðlice to spræc, ond þus cwæð: Ono hwæt, þu nu hafast þurh Godes gide þinra feonda hond beswicade, þa ðu ðe ondrede, ond þu þurh his sylene ond gife þæm rice onfenge þe ðu wilnadest.

text: Ac gemyne nū þæt þū þæt þridde galǣstest þæt þū gehēte, þæt þū onfō his geleāfan ond his bebodu healde, sē ðe þē from wīlwendlecum earfeðum generede ond ēac in āre wīlwendlīces rīces āhōf.
text_bare: Ac gemyne nu þæt þu þæt þridde galæstest þæt þu gehete, þæt þu onfo his geleafan ond his bebodu healde, se ðe þe from wilwendlecum earfeðum generede ond eac in are wilwendlices rices ahof.
