text: Ond gid ðū forð his willan hēarsum bēon wilt, þone hē þurh mē bodað ond lǣreð, hē þonne þē ēac from tinttregum genereð ēcra yfela, ond þec dǣlneomende gedēð mid him þæs ēcan rīces in heofonum.
text_bare: Ond gid ðu forð his willan hearsum beon wilt, þone he þurh me bodað ond læreð, he þonne þe eac from tinttregum genereð ecra yfela, ond þec dælneomende gedeð mid him þæs ecan rices in heofonum.

text: Þā sē syning þā þās word gehȳrde, þā ondswarode hē him, ond cwæð, þæt hē ǣghwæþer ge wolde ge sceolde þǣm gelēafan onfōn þe hē lǣrde; cwæð hwæþere, þæt hē wolde mid his frēondum ond mid his wytum gesprec ond geþeaht habban, þæt gif hī mid hine þæt geþafian woldan, þæt hī ealle ætsomne on līfes willan Crīste gehālgade wǣran.
text_bare: Þa se syning þa þas word gehyrde, þa ondswarode he him, ond cwæð, þæt he æghwæþer ge wolde ge sceolde þæm geleafan onfon þe he lærde; cwæð hwæþere, þæt he wolde mid his freondum ond mid his wytum gesprec ond geþeaht habban, þæt gif hi mid hine þæt geþafian woldan, þæt hi ealle ætsomne on lifes willan Criste gehalgade wæran.

text: Þā dyde sē cyning swā swā hē cwæð, ond sē bisceop þæt geþafade.
text_bare: Þa dyde se cyning swa swa he cwæð, ond se bisceop þæt geþafade.

text: Þā heafde hē gesprec ond geþeaht mid his witum, ond syndriglīce wæs from him eallum frignende hywlc him þūhte ond gesawen wǣre þēos nīwe lār ond þǣre godcundnesse bīgong þe þǣr lǣred wæs.
text_bare: Þa heafde he gesprec ond geþeaht mid his witum, ond syndriglice wæs from him eallum frignende hywlc him þuhte ond gesawen wære þeos niwe lar ond þære godcundnesse bigong þe þær læred wæs.

text: Him þā ondswarode his ealdorbisceop, Cēfi wæs hāten: 'Geseoh þū, cyning, hwelc þēos lār sīe þe ūs nū bodad is.
text_bare: Him þa ondswarode his ealdorbisceop, Cefi wæs haten: 'Geseoh þu, cyning, hwelc þeos lar sie þe us nu bodad is.

text: Ic þē sōðlīce andette, þæt ic cūðlīce geleornad hæbbe, þæt eallinga nāwiht mægenes nē nyttnesse hafað sīo ǣfeastnes þe wē oð ðis hæfdon ond beēodon.
text_bare: Ic þe soðlice andette, þæt ic cuðlice geleornad hæbbe, þæt eallinga nawiht mægenes ne nyttnesse hafað sio æfeastnes þe we oð ðis hæfdon ond beeodon.

text: For þon nǣnig þīnra þegna nēodlīcor nē gelustfullīcor hine sylfne underþēodde tō ūra goda bīgange þonne ic; ond nōht þone lǣs monige syndon þā þe māran wefe ond fremsumnesse æt þē onfēngon þonne ic, ond eallum þingum māran gesynto hæfdon, þonne woldan hīe mē mā fultumian, for þon ic him geornlīcor þēodde ond hȳrde.
text_bare: For þon nænig þinra þegna neodlicor ne gelustfullicor hine sylfne underþeodde to ura goda bigange þonne ic; ond noht þone læs monige syndon þa þe maran wefe ond fremsumnesse æt þe onfengon þonne ic, ond eallum þingum maran gesynto hæfdon, þonne woldan hie me ma fultumian, for þon ic him geornlicor þeodde ond hyrde.

text: For þon mē þynceð wīslīc, gid þū gesēo þā þing beteran ond strangran þe ūs nīwan bodad syndon, þæt wē þām onfōn.'
text_bare: For þon me þynceð wislic, gid þu geseo þa þing beteran ond strangran þe us niwan bodad syndon, þæt we þam onfon.'

text: Þæs wordum ōþer cyninges wita ond ealdormann geþafunge sealde, ond tō þǣre sprǣce fēng ond þus cwæð: 'Þyslīc mē is gesewen, þū cyning, þis andwearde līf manna on eorðan tō wiðmetenesse þǣre tīde, þe ūs uncuð is, swylc swā þū æt swǣsendum sitte mid þīnum ealdormannum ond þegnum on wintertīde, ond sīe fȳr onǣlæd ond þīn heall gewyrmed, ond hit rīne & snīwe ond styrme ūte; cume ān spearwa ond hrædlīce þæt hūs þurhflēo, cume þurh ōþre duru in þurh ōþre ūt gewīte.
text_bare: Þæs wordum oþer cyninges wita ond ealdormann geþafunge sealde, ond to þære spræce feng ond þus cwæð: 'Þyslic me is gesewen, þu cyning, þis andwearde lif manna on eorðan to wiðmetenesse þære tide, þe us uncuð is, swylc swa þu æt swæsendum sitte mid þinum ealdormannum ond þegnum on wintertide, ond sie fyr onælæd ond þin heall gewyrmed, ond hit rine & sniwe ond styrme ute; cume an spearwa ond hrædlice þæt hus þurhfleo, cume þurh oþre duru in þurh oþre ut gewite.

text: Hwæt hē on þā tīd, þe hē inne bið, ne bið hrinen mid þȳ storme þæs wintres; ac þæt bið ān ēagan bryhtm ond þæt lǣsste fæc, ac hē sōna of wintra on þone winter eft cymeð.
text_bare: Hwæt he on þa tid, þe he inne bið, ne bið hrinen mid þy storme þæs wintres; ac þæt bið an eagan bryhtm ond þæt læsste fæc, ac he sona of wintra on þone winter eft cymeð.

text: Swā þonne þis monna līf tō medmiclum fæce ætȳweð; hwæt þǣr foregange, oððe hwæt þǣr æfterfylige, wē ne cunnun.
text_bare: Swa þonne þis monna lif to medmiclum fæce ætyweð; hwæt þær foregange, oððe hwæt þær æfterfylige, we ne cunnun.

text: For ðon gif þēos lār ōwiht cūðlīcre ond gerisenlīcre brenge, þæs weorþe is þæt wē þǣre fylgen.' Þeossum wordum gelīcum ōðre aldormen & ðæs cyninges geþeahteras sprǣcan.
text_bare: For ðon gif þeos lar owiht cuðlicre ond gerisenlicre brenge, þæs weorþe is þæt we þære fylgen.' Þeossum wordum gelicum oðre aldormen & ðæs cyninges geþeahteras spræcan.

text: Þā gēn tōætyhte Cēfi and cwæð, þæt hē wolde Paulīnus þone bisceop geornlīcor gehȳran be þām Gode sprecende þām þe hē bodade.
text_bare: Þa gen toætyhte Cefi and cwæð, þæt he wolde Paulinus þone bisceop geornlicor gehyran be þam Gode sprecende þam þe he bodade.

text: Þā hēt sē cyning swā dōn.
text_bare: Þa het se cyning swa don.

text: Þā hē þā his word gehȳrde, þā clypode he ond þus cwæð: 'Geare ic þæt ongeat, þæt ðæt nōwiht wæs þæt wē beēodan; for þon swā micle swā ic geornlīcor on þām bīgange þæt sylfe sōð sōhte, swā ic hit lǣs mētte.
text_bare: Þa he þa his word gehyrde, þa clypode he ond þus cwæð: 'Geare ic þæt ongeat, þæt ðæt nowiht wæs þæt we beeodan; for þon swa micle swa ic geornlicor on þam bigange þæt sylfe soð sohte, swa ic hit læs mette.

text: Nū þonne ic openlīce ondette, þæt on þysse lāre þæt sylfe sōð scīneð, þæt ūs mæg þā gyfe syllan ēcre ēadignesse ond ēces līfes hǣlo.
text_bare: Nu þonne ic openlice ondette, þæt on þysse lare þæt sylfe soð scineð, þæt us mæg þa gyfe syllan ecre eadignesse ond eces lifes hælo.

text: For þon ic þonne nū lǣre, cyning, þæt þæt templ ond þā wigbedo, þā ðe wē būton wæstmum ǣnigre nytnisse hālgodon, þæt wē þā hraþe forlēosen ond fȳre forbærne.
text_bare: For þon ic þonne nu lære, cyning, þæt þæt templ ond þa wigbedo, þa ðe we buton wæstmum ænigre nytnisse halgodon, þæt we þa hraþe forleosen ond fyre forbærne.

text: Ono hwæt, hē þā sē cyning openlīce ondette þām biscope ond him eallum, þæt hē wolde fæstlīce þām deofolgildum wiðsacan ond Crīstes gelēafan onfōn.
text_bare: Ono hwæt, he þa se cyning openlice ondette þam biscope ond him eallum, þæt he wolde fæstlice þam deofolgildum wiðsacan ond Cristes geleafan onfon.

text: Mid þȳ þe hē þā sē cyning from þǣm foresprecenan biscope sōhte ond āhsode heora hālignesse, þe hēo ǣr biēodon, hwā ðā wīgbed ond þā hergas þāra dēofolgilda mid heora hegum, þe hēo ymbsette wǣron, hēo ǣrest āīdligan & tōweorpan scolde, þā ondsworede hē: 'Efne ic.
text_bare: Mid þy þe he þa se cyning from þæm foresprecenan biscope sohte ond ahsode heora halignesse, þe heo ær bieodon, hwa ða wigbed ond þa hergas þara deofolgilda mid heora hegum, þe heo ymbsette wæron, heo ærest aidligan & toweorpan scolde, þa ondsworede he: 'Efne ic.

text: Hwā mæg þā nū ēað, þā þe ic longe mid dysignesse beēode, tō bȳsene ōðerra monna gerisenlecor tōweorpan, þonne ic seolfa þurh þā snytro þe ic from þǣm sōðan Gode onfeng?' Ond hē ðā sona from him āwearp þā īdlan dysignesse, þe hē ǣr beēode, ond þone cyning bæd þæt hē him wǣpen sealde ond stōdhors, þæt hē meahte on cuman ond dēofolgyld tōweorpan.
text_bare: Hwa mæg þa nu eað, þa þe ic longe mid dysignesse beeode, to bysene oðerra monna gerisenlecor toweorpan, þonne ic seolfa þurh þa snytro þe ic from þæm soðan Gode onfeng?' Ond he ða sona from him awearp þa idlan dysignesse, þe he ær beeode, ond þone cyning bæd þæt he him wæpen sealde ond stodhors, þæt he meahte on cuman ond deofolgyld toweorpan.

text: For þon þam biscope heora hālignesse ne wæs ālȳfed, þæt hē mōste wǣpen wegan, nē elcor būton on mȳran rīdan.
text_bare: For þon þam biscope heora halignesse ne wæs alyfed, þæt he moste wæpen wegan, ne elcor buton on myran ridan.

text: Þā sealde sē cyning him sweord, þæt hē hine mid gyrde; ond nōm his spere on hond ond hlēop on þæs cyninges stēdan, ond tō þǣm dēofulgeldum fērde.
text_bare: Þa sealde se cyning him sweord, þæt he hine mid gyrde; ond nom his spere on hond ond hleop on þæs cyninges stedan, ond to þæm deofulgeldum ferde.

text: Þā ðæt folc hine þā geseah swā gescyrpedne, þā wendon hēo þæt hē teola ne wiste, ac þæt hē wedde.
text_bare: Þa ðæt folc hine þa geseah swa gescyrpedne, þa wendon heo þæt he teola ne wiste, ac þæt he wedde.

text: Sōna þæs þe hē nēalēhte tō þǣm herige, þā scēat hē mid þȳ spere þæt hit sticode fæste on þǣm herige, ond wæs swīðe gefēonde þǣre ongytenesse þæs sōðan Godes bigonges.
text_bare: Sona þæs þe he nealehte to þæm herige, þa sceat he mid þy spere þæt hit sticode fæste on þæm herige, ond wæs swiðe gefeonde þære ongytenesse þæs soðan Godes bigonges.

text: Ond hē ðā heht his gefēran tōweorpan ealne þone herig ond þā getimbro ond forbærnan.
text_bare: Ond he ða heht his geferan toweorpan ealne þone herig ond þa getimbro ond forbærnan.

text: Is sēo stōw gȳt ætēawed gū ðeara dēofulgilda, nōht feor ēast from Eoforwīcceastre begeondan Deorwentan þǣre ēa, ond gēn tō dæge is nemned Godmundingaham, þǣr sē biscop þurh þæs sōðan Godes inbryrdnesse tōwearp ond fordyde þā wīgbed, þe hē seolfa ǣr gehālgode.
text_bare: Is seo stow gyt æteawed gu ðeara deofulgilda, noht feor east from Eoforwicceastre begeondan Deorwentan þære ea, ond gen to dæge is nemned Godmundingaham, þær se biscop þurh þæs soðan Godes inbryrdnesse towearp ond fordyde þa wigbed, þe he seolfa ær gehalgode.

text: Ða onfeng Ēadwine cyning mid eallum þǣm æðelingum his þēode ond mid micle folce Crīstes gelēafan ond fulwihte bæðe þȳ endlyftan gēare his rīces.
text_bare: Ða onfeng Eadwine cyning mid eallum þæm æðelingum his þeode ond mid micle folce Cristes geleafan ond fulwihte bæðe þy endlyftan geare his rices.

text: Wæs hē gefulwad from Paulīni, þǣm biscope his lārēowe, in Eoforwīcceastre þȳ hālgestan Ēastordæge in Scē.
text_bare: Wæs he gefulwad from Paulini, þæm biscope his lareowe, in Eoforwicceastre þy halgestan Eastordæge in Sce.

text: Pētres cirican, þæs apostoles, þā hē þǣr hræde geweorce of trēo cirican getimbrode.
text_bare: Petres cirican, þæs apostoles, þa he þær hræde geweorce of treo cirican getimbrode.

text: Siðþan hē gecrīsnad wæs, sylce ēac his lārēowe ond biscope Paulīni biscopseðl forgeaf.
text_bare: Siðþan he gecrisnad wæs, sylce eac his lareowe ond biscope Paulini biscopseðl forgeaf.

text: Ond sōna þæs þe hē gefulwad wæs, hē ongon mid þæs biscopes lāre māran cirican ond hȳrran stǣnenne timbran ond wyrcan ymb þā circan ūtan þe hē ǣr worhte.
text_bare: Ond sona þæs þe he gefulwad wæs, he ongon mid þæs biscopes lare maran cirican ond hyrran stænenne timbran ond wyrcan ymb þa circan utan þe he ær worhte.

text: Ac ǣr þon hēo sēo hēannis þæs wealles gefylled wǣre ond geendad, þæt hē sē cyning mid ārlēasre cwale ofslegen wæs, ond þæt ilce geweorc his æfterfylgende Ōswalde forlēt tō geendianne.
text_bare: Ac ær þon heo seo heannis þæs wealles gefylled wære ond geendad, þæt he se cyning mid arleasre cwale ofslegen wæs, ond þæt ilce geweorc his æfterfylgende Oswalde forlet to geendianne.

text: Of þǣre tīde Paulīnus, sē biscop, syx gēr ful, þæs is ōð ende þæs cyninges rīce, þæt hē mid his fultome in þǣre mǣgðe Godes word bodade ond lǣrde; ond men gelȳfdon ond gefulwade wǣron, swā monige swā fortēode wǣron tō ēcum līfe.
text_bare: Of þære tide Paulinus, se biscop, syx ger ful, þæs is oð ende þæs cyninges rice, þæt he mid his fultome in þære mægðe Godes word bodade ond lærde; ond men gelyfdon ond gefulwade wæron, swa monige swa forteode wæron to ecum life.

text: Þisses middangeardes ende nēah is.
text_bare: Þisses middangeardes ende neah is.

text: Men þā lēofostan hwæt!
text_bare: Men þa leofostan hwæt!

text: nū ānra manna gehwylcne ic myngie ond lǣre, ge weras ge wīf, ge geonge ge ealde, ge snottre ge unwīse, ge þā welegan ge þā þearfan, þæt ānra gehwylc hine sylfne scēawige ond ondgyte, ond swā hwæt swā hē on mycclum gyltum oþþe on medmycclum gefremede, þæt hē þonne hrædlīce gecyrre tō þām sēlran ond tō þon sōðan lǣcedōme; þonne magon wē ūs God ælmihtigne mildne habban, for þon þe Drihten wile þæt ealle men sȳn hāle ond gesunde, ond tō þon sōþan andgite gecyrran, swā Dāuid cwæþ: 'Þā ēaðmōdan heortan ond þā ondrǣdendan heora Scyppend, ne forhodaþ þā nǣfre God nē ne forsyhþ; ah heora bēna hē gehȳreð, þonne hīe tō him cleopiað ond him āre biddaþ.'
text_bare: nu anra manna gehwylcne ic myngie ond lære, ge weras ge wif, ge geonge ge ealde, ge snottre ge unwise, ge þa welegan ge þa þearfan, þæt anra gehwylc hine sylfne sceawige ond ondgyte, ond swa hwæt swa he on mycclum gyltum oþþe on medmycclum gefremede, þæt he þonne hrædlice gecyrre to þam selran ond to þon soðan læcedome; þonne magon we us God ælmihtigne mildne habban, for þon þe Drihten wile þæt ealle men syn hale ond gesunde, ond to þon soþan andgite gecyrran, swa Dauid cwæþ: 'Þa eaðmodan heortan ond þa ondrædendan heora Scyppend, ne forhodaþ þa næfre God ne ne forsyhþ; ah heora bena he gehyreð, þonne hie to him cleopiað ond him are biddaþ.'

text: Magon wē þonne nū gesēon ond oncnāwan ond swīþe gearelīce ongeotan þæt þisses middangeardes ende swīþe nēah is, ond manige frēcnesse ætēowde, ond manna wōhdǣda ond wōnessa swīþe gemonigfealdode; ond wē fram dæge tō ōþrum geāxiað ungecyndelīco wītu ond ungecyndelīce dēaþas geond þēodland tō mannum cumne; ond wē oft ongytaþ þæt ārīseþ þēod wiþ þēode, ond ungelimplīco gefeoht on wōlīcum dǣdum; ond wē gehȳraþ oft secggan gelōme worldrīcra manna dēaþ þe heora līf mannum lēof wǣre, ond þūhte fæfer ond wlitig heora līf ond wynsumlīc; swā wē ēac geāxiað mislīce ādla on manegum stōwum middangeardes, ond hungras wexende; ond manig yfel wē geāxiaþ hēr on līfe gelōmlīcian ond wæstmian, ond nǣnig gōd āwunigende, ond ealle worldlīcu þing swīþe synlīcul ond cōlaþ tō swīþe sēo lufu þe wē tō ūrum Hǣlende habban secoldan, ond þā gōdan weorc wē ānforlǣtaþ þe wē for ūre sāule hǣle begān sceoldan.
text_bare: Magon we þonne nu geseon ond oncnawan ond swiþe gearelice ongeotan þæt þisses middangeardes ende swiþe neah is, ond manige frecnesse æteowde, ond manna wohdæda ond wonessa swiþe gemonigfealdode; ond we fram dæge to oþrum geaxiað ungecyndelico witu ond ungecyndelice deaþas geond þeodland to mannum cumne; ond we oft ongytaþ þæt ariseþ þeod wiþ þeode, ond ungelimplico gefeoht on wolicum dædum; ond we gehyraþ oft secggan gelome worldricra manna deaþ þe heora lif mannum leof wære, ond þuhte fæfer ond wlitig heora lif ond wynsumlic; swa we eac geaxiað mislice adla on manegum stowum middangeardes, ond hungras wexende; ond manig yfel we geaxiaþ her on life gelomlician ond wæstmian, ond nænig god awunigende, ond ealle worldlicu þing swiþe synlicul ond colaþ to swiþe seo lufu þe we to urum Hælende habban secoldan, ond þa godan weorc we anforlætaþ þe we for ure saule hæle began sceoldan.

text: Þās tācno þuslīce syndon þe ic nū hwīle big sægde be þisse worlde earfoþnessum ond frǣcnessum, swā Crīst sylfa his geongrum sægde, þæt þās þing ealle geweorþan sceoldan ǣr þisse worlde ende.
text_bare: Þas tacno þuslice syndon þe ic nu hwile big sægde be þisse worlde earfoþnessum ond fræcnessum, swa Crist sylfa his geongrum sægde, þæt þas þing ealle geweorþan sceoldan ær þisse worlde ende.

text: Uton wē nū efstan ealle mægene gōdra weorca, ond geornfulle bēon Godes miltsa, nū wē ongeotan magon þæt þis nēalǣcþ worlde forwyrde; for þon ic myngige ond manige manna gehwylcne þæt hē his āgene dǣda georne smēage, þæt hē hēr on worlde for Gode rihtlīce lifge, ond on gesyhþe þæs hēhstan Cyninges.
text_bare: Uton we nu efstan ealle mægene godra weorca, ond geornfulle beon Godes miltsa, nu we ongeotan magon þæt þis nealæcþ worlde forwyrde; for þon ic myngige ond manige manna gehwylcne þæt he his agene dæda georne smeage, þæt he her on worlde for Gode rihtlice lifge, ond on gesyhþe þæs hehstan Cyninges.

text: Sȳn wē wūmmōde þearfendum mannum, on earmum ælmesgeorne, swā ūs God sylfa bebēad þæt wē sōþe sibbe hēoldan, ond geþwǣrnesse ūs betwēonon habban.
text_bare: Syn we wummode þearfendum mannum, on earmum ælmesgeorne, swa us God sylfa bebead þæt we soþe sibbe heoldan, ond geþwærnesse us betweonon habban.

text: Ond þā men þe bearn habban, lǣran hīe þǣm rihtne þēodscipe, ond him tǣcean līfes weg ond rihtne gang tō heofonum; ond gif hīe on ǣnigum dǣle wōlīce libban heora līf, sȳn hīe þonne sōna from heora wōnessum onwende, ond fram heora unrihtum oncyrron, þæt wē þurh þæt ealle Gode līcian, swā hit eallum gelēaffullum folcum beboden standeþ, næs nā þām ānum þe Gode sylfum underþēodde syndon mid myclum hādum, biscopas ond cyningas ond mæsseprēostas ond hēahdiaconas, ac ēac sōþlīce hit is beboden subdīaconum on munecum.
text_bare: Ond þa men þe bearn habban, læran hie þæm rihtne þeodscipe, ond him tæcean lifes weg ond rihtne gang to heofonum; ond gif hie on ænigum dæle wolice libban heora lif, syn hie þonne sona from heora wonessum onwende, ond fram heora unrihtum oncyrron, þæt we þurh þæt ealle Gode lician, swa hit eallum geleaffullum folcum beboden standeþ, næs na þam anum þe Gode sylfum underþeodde syndon mid myclum hadum, biscopas ond cyningas ond mæssepreostas ond heahdiaconas, ac eac soþlice hit is beboden subdiaconum on munecum.

text: Ond is eallum mannum nēdþearf ond nytlīc þæt hīe heora fulwihþādas wel gehealdan.
text_bare: Ond is eallum mannum nedþearf ond nytlic þæt hie heora fulwihþadas wel gehealdan.

text: Ne bēo nǣnig man hēr on worldrīce on his geþōhte tō mōdig, nē on his līchoman tō strang, nē nīþa tō georn, nē bealwes tō beald, nē bregda tō full, nē inwit tō lēof, nē wrōhtas tō webgenne, nē searo tō rēnigenne.
text_bare: Ne beo nænig man her on worldrice on his geþohte to modig, ne on his lichoman to strang, ne niþa to georn, ne bealwes to beald, ne bregda to full, ne inwit to leof, ne wrohtas to webgenne, ne searo to renigenne.

text: Ne þearf þæs nān man wēnan þæt his līchama mōte oþþe mæge þā synbyrþenna on eorþscrafe gebētan; ah hē þǣr on moldan gemolsnaþ, ond þǣr wyrde bīdeþ hwonne sē ælmihtiga God wille þisse worlde ende gewyricean, ond þonne hē his byrnsweord getȳhþ ond þās world ealle þurhslyhþ, ond þā līchoman þurhscēotaþ, ond þysne middangeard tōclēofeð, ond þā dēadan ūp āstandaþ; biþ þonne sē flǣschoma āscȳred swā glæs: ne mæg ðæs unrihtes bēon āwiht bedīgled.
text_bare: Ne þearf þæs nan man wenan þæt his lichama mote oþþe mæge þa synbyrþenna on eorþscrafe gebetan; ah he þær on moldan gemolsnaþ, ond þær wyrde bideþ hwonne se ælmihtiga God wille þisse worlde ende gewyricean, ond þonne he his byrnsweord getyhþ ond þas world ealle þurhslyhþ, ond þa lichoman þurhsceotaþ, ond þysne middangeard tocleofeð, ond þa deadan up astandaþ; biþ þonne se flæschoma ascyred swa glæs: ne mæg ðæs unrihtes beon awiht bedigled.

text: For þone wē habbaþ nēdþearfe þæt wē tō lande ne fylgeon unwitweorcum, ac wē sceolan ūs geearnian þā siblecan wǣra Godes ond manna, ond þone rihtan gelēafan fæste staðelian on ūrum heortum, þæt hē ðǣr wunian mæge ond mōte, ond þǣr grōwan ond blōwan.
text_bare: For þone we habbaþ nedþearfe þæt we to lande ne fylgeon unwitweorcum, ac we sceolan us geearnian þa siblecan wæra Godes ond manna, ond þone rihtan geleafan fæste staðelian on urum heortum, þæt he ðær wunian mæge ond mote, ond þær growan ond blowan.

text: Ond wē sceolan andettan þā sōþan gelēaffulnesse on ūrne Drihten Hǣlende Crīst, ond on his ðone ācendan Suna, ond on ðone Hālgan Gāst, sē is efnēce Fæder ond Sunu.
text_bare: Ond we sceolan andettan þa soþan geleaffulnesse on urne Drihten Hælende Crist, ond on his ðone acendan Suna, ond on ðone Halgan Gast, se is efnece Fæder ond Sunu.

text: Ond wē sceolan gehyhtan on Godes þā gehālgodan cyricean, ond on ðā rihtgelēfedan.
text_bare: Ond we sceolan gehyhtan on Godes þa gehalgodan cyricean, ond on ða rihtgelefedan.

text: Ond wē sceolan gelȳfan synna forlǣtnessa, ond līchoman ǣrīstes on dōmes dæg.
text_bare: Ond we sceolan gelyfan synna forlætnessa, ond lichoman æristes on domes dæg.

text: Ond wē sceolan gelēfan on þæt ēce līf, ond þæt heofonlīce rīce þæt is gehāten eallum þe nū syndan Godes wyrhtan.
text_bare: Ond we sceolan gelefan on þæt ece lif, ond þæt heofonlice rice þæt is gehaten eallum þe nu syndan Godes wyrhtan.

text: Þis is sē rihta gelēafa þe ǣghwylcum men gehyreð þæt hē wel gehealde ond gelǣste, for ðon þe nān wyrhta ne mæg gōd weorc wyrcean for Gode būton lufan ond gelēafan.
text_bare: Þis is se rihta geleafa þe æghwylcum men gehyreð þæt he wel gehealde ond gelæste, for ðon þe nan wyrhta ne mæg god weorc wyrcean for Gode buton lufan ond geleafan.

text: Ond ūs is mycel nēdþearf þæt wē ūs sylfe geðencean ond gemunan, ond þonne geornost þonne wē gehȳron Godes bēc ūs beforan reccean ond rǣdan, ond godspell secggean, ond his wuldorþrymmas mannum cȳþan.
text_bare: Ond us is mycel nedþearf þæt we us sylfe geðencean ond gemunan, ond þonne geornost þonne we gehyron Godes bec us beforan reccean ond rædan, ond godspell secggean, ond his wuldorþrymmas mannum cyþan.

text: Uton wē þonne georne teolian þæt wē æfter þon ðē beteran sȳn ond þē sēlran for ðǣre lāre ðe wē oft gehyrdon.
text_bare: Uton we þonne georne teolian þæt we æfter þon ðe beteran syn ond þe selran for ðære lare ðe we oft gehyrdon.

text: Ēalā men ðā lēofostan, hwæt!
text_bare: Eala men ða leofostan, hwæt!

text: wē sceolan geðencean þæt wē ne lufian tō swīþe þæt þæt wē forlǣton sceolan, nē þæt huru ne forlǣtan tō swīþe þæt wē ēcelīce habban sceolan.
text_bare: we sceolan geðencean þæt we ne lufian to swiþe þæt þæt we forlæton sceolan, ne þæt huru ne forlætan to swiþe þæt we ecelice habban sceolan.

text: Gesēo wē nū for georne þæt nǣnig man on worlde tō ðæs mycelne welan nafað, nē tō ðon mōdelīco gestrēon hēr on worlde, þæt sē on medmycclum fyrste tō ende ne cume, ond þæt eall forlǣteð þæt him ǣr hēr on worlde wynsumlīc wæs, ond lēofost tō āgenne ond tō hæbbenne.
text_bare: Geseo we nu for georne þæt nænig man on worlde to ðæs mycelne welan nafað, ne to ðon modelico gestreon her on worlde, þæt se on medmycclum fyrste to ende ne cume, ond þæt eall forlæteð þæt him ær her on worlde wynsumlic wæs, ond leofost to agenne ond to hæbbenne.

text: Ond sē man nǣfre tō ðon lēof ne bið his nēhmāgum ond his worldfrēondum, nē heora nān hine tō þæs swīþe ne lufað þæt hē sona syþþan ne sȳ onscungend, seoþþan sē līchoma ond sē gāst gedǣlde bēoþ, ond þincð his nēawist lāþlīco ond unfæger.
text_bare: Ond se man næfre to ðon leof ne bið his nehmagum ond his worldfreondum, ne heora nan hine to þæs swiþe ne lufað þæt he sona syþþan ne sy onscungend, seoþþan se lichoma ond se gast gedælde beoþ, ond þincð his neawist laþlico ond unfæger.

text: Nis þæt nān wundor; hwæt biþ hit lā elles būton flǣsc, seoððan sē ēcea dǣl of biþ, þæt is sēo sāwl?
text_bare: Nis þæt nan wundor; hwæt biþ hit la elles buton flæsc, seoððan se ecea dæl of biþ, þæt is seo sawl?

text: hwæt biþ lā elles sēo lāf būton wyrma mete?
text_bare: hwæt biþ la elles seo laf buton wyrma mete?

text: Hwǣr bēoþ þonne his welan ond his wista?
text_bare: Hwær beoþ þonne his welan ond his wista?

text: hwǣr bēoþ þonne his wlencea ond his anmēdlan?
text_bare: hwær beoþ þonne his wlencea ond his anmedlan?

text: hwǣr bēoþ þonne his idlan gescyrplan?
text_bare: hwær beoþ þonne his idlan gescyrplan?

text: Hwǣr bēoþ ðonne þā glengeas ond þā mycclan gegyrelan þe hē þone līchoman ǣr mid frætwode?
text_bare: Hwær beoþ ðonne þa glengeas ond þa mycclan gegyrelan þe he þone lichoman ær mid frætwode?

text: hwǣr cumaþ þonne his willan ond his fyrenlustas ðe hē hēr on worlde beēode?
text_bare: hwær cumaþ þonne his willan ond his fyrenlustas ðe he her on worlde beeode?

text: Hwæt!
text_bare: Hwæt!

text: hē þonne sceal mid his sāule ānre Gode ælmihtigum riht āgyldan, ealles þæs þe hē hēr on worlde tō wommum gefremede.
text_bare: he þonne sceal mid his saule anre Gode ælmihtigum riht agyldan, ealles þæs þe he her on worlde to wommum gefremede.

text: Magon wē nū gehēran secg gean be sumum welegum men ond worldrīcum; āhte hē on þysse worlde mycelne welan ond swīðe mōdelīco gestrēon ond manigfealde, ond on wynsumnesse life.
text_bare: Magon we nu geheran secg gean be sumum welegum men ond worldricum; ahte he on þysse worlde mycelne welan ond swiðe modelico gestreon ond manigfealde, ond on wynsumnesse life.

text: Þā gelamp him þæt his līf wearð geendod ond fǣrlic ende on becōm þisses lǣnan līfes.
text_bare: Þa gelamp him þæt his lif wearð geendod ond færlic ende on becom þisses lænan lifes.

text: Þā wæs his nēhmāga sum ond his worldfrēonda þæt hine swȳþor lufode þonne ǣnig ōþor man; hē þā for þǣre langugnga ond for þǣre gēomrunga þæs ōþres dēaþes, leng on þām lande gewunian ne mihte, ac hē unrtmōd of his cȳþþe gewāt ond of his earde, ond on þǣm lande feala wintra wunode; ond him nǣfre sēo langung ne getēorode, ac hine wīþe gebyrde ond þēade.
text_bare: Þa wæs his nehmaga sum ond his worldfreonda þæt hine swyþor lufode þonne ænig oþor man; he þa for þære langugnga ond for þære geomrunga þæs oþres deaþes, leng on þam lande gewunian ne mihte, ac he unrtmod of his cyþþe gewat ond of his earde, ond on þæm lande feala wintra wunode; ond him næfre seo langung ne geteorode, ac hine wiþe gebyrde ond þeade.

text: Þā ongan hine eft langian on his cȳþþe; for þon þæt hē wolde gesēon eft ond scēawian þā byrgenne, hywlc sē wǣre þe hē oft ǣr mid wlite ond mid wæstmum fæsgerne m...
text_bare: Þa ongan hine eft langian on his cyþþe; for þon þæt he wolde geseon eft ond sceawian þa byrgenne, hywlc se wære þe he oft ær mid wlite ond mid wæstmum fæsgerne m...

text: geseah.
text_bare: geseah.

text: Him þā tō cleopodon þæs dēadan bān, ond þus cwǣdon: 'For hwon cōme þū hider ūs tō scēawigenne?
text_bare: Him þa to cleopodon þæs deadan ban, ond þus cwædon: 'For hwon come þu hider us to sceawigenne?

text: Nū þū miht hēr gesēon moldan dǣl ond wyrmes lāfe, þǣr þū ǣr gesāwe godweb mid golde gefāgod.
text_bare: Nu þu miht her geseon moldan dæl ond wyrmes lafe, þær þu ær gesawe godweb mid golde gefagod.

text: Scēawa þǣr nū dūst ond drȳge bān, þǣr þǣr þū ǣr gesāwe æfter flǣsclīcere gecynde fægre leomu on tō sēonne.
text_bare: Sceawa þær nu dust ond dryge ban, þær þær þu ær gesawe æfter flæsclicere gecynde fægre leomu on to seonne.

text: Ēalā þū frēond ond mīn mǣg, gemyne þis ond ongyt þē sylfne, þæt þū eart nū þæt ic wæs īo; ond þū byst æfter fæce þæt ic nū eom.
text_bare: Eala þu freond ond min mæg, gemyne þis ond ongyt þe sylfne, þæt þu eart nu þæt ic wæs io; ond þu byst æfter fæce þæt ic nu eom.

text: Gemyne þis ond oncnāw þæt mīne welan þe ic īo hæfde syndon eall gewitene ond gedrorene, ond mīne herewīc syndon gebrosnode ond gemolsnode.
text_bare: Gemyne þis ond oncnaw þæt mine welan þe ic io hæfde syndon eall gewitene ond gedrorene, ond mine herewic syndon gebrosnode ond gemolsnode.

text: Ac onwend þē tō þē sylfum, ond þīne heortan tō rǣde gecyr, ond geearna þæt þīne bēna sȳn Gode ælmihtigum andfenge.' Hē þā swā gēomor ond swā gnorngende gewāt from þǣre dūstscēawunga, ond hine þā onwende from ealre þisse worlde begangum; ond hē ongan Godes lof leornian ond þæt lǣran, ond þæt gāstlīce mægen lufian; ond þurh þæt geearnode him þā gife Hāliges Gāstes, ond ēac þæs ōþres sāule of wītum generede ond of tintregum ālēsde.
text_bare: Ac onwend þe to þe sylfum, ond þine heortan to ræde gecyr, ond geearna þæt þine bena syn Gode ælmihtigum andfenge.' He þa swa geomor ond swa gnorngende gewat from þære dustsceawunga, ond hine þa onwende from ealre þisse worlde begangum; ond he ongan Godes lof leornian ond þæt læran, ond þæt gastlice mægen lufian; ond þurh þæt geearnode him þa gife Haliges Gastes, ond eac þæs oþres saule of witum generede ond of tintregum alesde.

text: Magon wē þonne, men þā lēofstan, ūs þis tō gemyndum habban, ond þās bȳsene on ūrum heortan staþelian, þæt wē ne sceolan lufian worlde glengas tō swīþe nē þysne middangeard; for þone þe þēos world is eall forwordenlīc ond gedrōfenlīc ond gebrosnodlīc ond feallenlīc, ond þēos world is eall gewitenlīc.
text_bare: Magon we þonne, men þa leofstan, us þis to gemyndum habban, ond þas bysene on urum heortan staþelian, þæt we ne sceolan lufian worlde glengas to swiþe ne þysne middangeard; for þone þe þeos world is eall forwordenlic ond gedrofenlic ond gebrosnodlic ond feallenlic, ond þeos world is eall gewitenlic.

text: Uton wē þonne geornlīce geþencean ond oncnāwan be þuses middangeardes fruman; þā hē ǣrest gesceapen wæs, þā wæs hē ealre fægernesse fyll, ond hē wæs blōwende on him sylfum on swȳþe manigfealdre wynsumnesse.
text_bare: Uton we þonne geornlice geþencean ond oncnawan be þuses middangeardes fruman; þa he ærest gesceapen wæs, þa wæs he ealre fægernesse fyll, ond he wæs blowende on him sylfum on swyþe manigfealdre wynsumnesse.

text: Ond on þā tīd wæs mannum lēof ofer eorþan, ond halwende ond hāl syltnes wæs ofer orþan, ond sibba genihtsumnes, ond tūddres æþelnes.
text_bare: Ond on þa tid wæs mannum leof ofer eorþan, ond halwende ond hal syltnes wæs ofer orþan, ond sibba genihtsumnes, ond tuddres æþelnes.

text: Ond þēs middangeard wæs on þā tīd tō þon fæger ond tō þon wynsumlīc þæt hē tēah men tō him þurh his wlite on þurh his fægernesse ond wynsumnesse fram þon ælmihtegan Gode.
text_bare: Ond þes middangeard wæs on þa tid to þon fæger ond to þon wynsumlic þæt he teah men to him þurh his wlite on þurh his fægernesse ond wynsumnesse fram þon ælmihtegan Gode.

text: Ond þā hē þus fæger wæs ond þus wynsum, þā wisnode hē on Crīstes hāligra heortum, ond is nū on ūrum heortan blōwende swā hit gedafen is.
text_bare: Ond þa he þus fæger wæs ond þus wynsum, þa wisnode he on Cristes haligra heortum, ond is nu on urum heortan blowende swa hit gedafen is.

text: Nū is ǣghwonon hrēam on wōp; nū is hēaf ǣgwonon, ond sibbe tōlēsnes; nū is ǣghwonon yfel ond slege; ond ǣghwonon þēs middangeard flȳhþ from ūs mid mycelre biternesse, ond wē him flēondum flygeaþ, ond hine fealendne lufiaþ.
text_bare: Nu is æghwonon hream on wop; nu is heaf ægwonon, ond sibbe tolesnes; nu is æghwonon yfel ond slege; ond æghwonon þes middangeard flyhþ from us mid mycelre biternesse, ond we him fleondum flygeaþ, ond hine fealendne lufiaþ.

text: Hwæt!
text_bare: Hwæt!

text: wē on þām gecnāwan magon þæt þēos world is scyndende ond heononweard.
text_bare: we on þam gecnawan magon þæt þeos world is scyndende ond heononweard.

text: Uton wē þonne þæs geþencean, þā hwīle þe wē magon ond mōton, þæt wē ūs georne tō Gode þȳdon.
text_bare: Uton we þonne þæs geþencean, þa hwile þe we magon ond moton, þæt we us georne to Gode þydon.

text: Uton ūrum Drihtne hȳran georne, ond him þancas secggan ealra his geofena ond ealra his miltsa ond ealra his ēaðmōdnessa ond fremsumnessa þe hē wiþ ūs ǣfre gecȳþde, þǣm heofonlīcan Cininge þe leofað ond rīxaþ ond worlda world aa būton ende on ēcnesse.
text_bare: Uton urum Drihtne hyran georne, ond him þancas secggan ealra his geofena ond ealra his miltsa ond ealra his eaðmodnessa ond fremsumnessa þe he wiþ us æfre gecyþde, þæm heofonlican Cininge þe leofað ond rixaþ ond worlda world aa buton ende on ecnesse.

text: Iōhannes sē Godspellere, Crīstes dȳrling, wearð on ðysum dæge tō heofenan rīces myrhðe þurh Godes nēosunge genumen.
text_bare: Iohannes se Godspellere, Cristes dyrling, wearð on ðysum dæge to heofenan rices myrhðe þurh Godes neosunge genumen.

text: Hē wæs Crīstes mōddrian sunu, and hē hine lufode synderlīce; nā swā micclum for ðǣre mǣglīcan sibbe swā for ðǣre clǣnnysse his ansundan mægðhādes.
text_bare: He wæs Cristes moddrian sunu, and he hine lufode synderlice; na swa micclum for ðære mæglican sibbe swa for ðære clænnysse his ansundan mægðhades.

text: Hē wæs on mægðhāde Gode gecoren, and hē on ēcynesse on ungewemmendum mægðhāde þurhwunode.
text_bare: He wæs on mægðhade Gode gecoren, and he on ecynesse on ungewemmendum mægðhade þurhwunode.

text: Hit is gerǣd on gewyrdelīcum racum þæt hē wolde wīfian, and Crīst wearð tō his gyftum gelaðod.
text_bare: Hit is geræd on gewyrdelicum racum þæt he wolde wifian, and Crist wearð to his gyftum gelaðod.

text: Þā gelamp hit þæt æt ðām gyftum wīn wearð ātēorod.
text_bare: Þa gelamp hit þæt æt ðam gyftum win wearð ateorod.

text: Sē Hǣlend ðā hēt þā ðēningmen āfyllan six stǣnene fatu mid hlūttrum wætere, and hē mid his blētsunge þæt wæter tō æðelum wīne āwende.
text_bare: Se Hælend ða het þa ðeningmen afyllan six stænene fatu mid hluttrum wætere, and he mid his bletsunge þæt wæter to æðelum wine awende.

text: Þis is þæt forme tācn ðe hē on his menniscnysse openlīce geworhte.
text_bare: Þis is þæt forme tacn ðe he on his menniscnysse openlice geworhte.

text: Þā wearð Iōhannes swā onbryrd þurh þæt tācn, þæt hē ðǣr rihte his brȳde on mægðhāde forlēt, and symle syððan Drihtne folgode, and wearð ðā him inweardlīce gelufod, for ðan ðe hē hine ætbrǣd þām flǣsclīcum lustum.
text_bare: Þa wearð Iohannes swa onbryrd þurh þæt tacn, þæt he ðær rihte his bryde on mægðhade forlet, and symle syððan Drihtne folgode, and wearð ða him inweardlice gelufod, for ðan ðe he hine ætbræd þam flæsclicum lustum.

text: Witodlīce ðisum lēofan leorningcnihte befæste sē Hǣlend his mōdor, þā þā hē on rōdehengene manncynn ālȳsde, þæt his clǣne līf ðæs clǣnan mǣdenes Marīan gȳmde; and hēo ðā on hyre swyster suna þēnungum wunode.
text_bare: Witodlice ðisum leofan leorningcnihte befæste se Hælend his modor, þa þa he on rodehengene manncynn alysde, þæt his clæne lif ðæs clænan mædenes Marian gymde; and heo ða on hyre swyster suna þenungum wunode.

text: Eft on fyrste, æfter Crīstes ūpstige tō heofonum, rīcode sum wælhrēow cāsere on Rōmāna rīce, æfter Nerōne, sē wæs Domiciānus gehāten, crīstenra manna ēhtere: sē hēt āfyllan āne cȳfe mid wallendum ele, and þone mǣran godspellere þǣre on hēt bescūfan; ac hē ðurh Godes gescyldnysse ungewemmed on þām hātan bæðe ēode.
text_bare: Eft on fyrste, æfter Cristes upstige to heofonum, ricode sum wælhreow casere on Romana rice, æfter Nerone, se wæs Domicianus gehaten, cristenra manna ehtere: se het afyllan ane cyfe mid wallendum ele, and þone mæran godspellere þære on het bescufan; ac he ðurh Godes gescyldnysse ungewemmed on þam hatan bæðe eode.

text: Eft ðā ðā sē wælhrēowa ne mihte dahes ēadigan apostoles bodunge ālecgan, þā āsende hē gine on wræcsīð tō ānum īgeoðe þe is Paðmas gecīged, þæt hē ðǣr þurh hungres scearpnysse ācwǣle.
text_bare: Eft ða ða se wælhreowa ne mihte dahes eadigan apostoles bodunge alecgan, þa asende he gine on wræcsið to anum igeoðe þe is Paðmas geciged, þæt he ðær þurh hungres scearpnysse acwæle.

text: Ac sē ælmihtiga Hǣlend ne forlēt tō gȳmelēaste his gelufedan apostol, ac geswutelode him on ðām wræcsīðe þā tōweardan onwrigenysse, be ðǣre hē āwrāt ðā bōc ðe is gehāten 'Apocalipsis': and sē wælhrēowa Domiciāanus on ðǣm ylcan gēare wearð ācweald æt his witena handum; and hī ealle ānmōdlīce rǣddon þæt ealle his gesetnyssa āȳdlode wǣron.
text_bare: Ac se ælmihtiga Hælend ne forlet to gymeleaste his gelufedan apostol, ac geswutelode him on ðam wræcsiðe þa toweardan onwrigenysse, be ðære he awrat ða boc ðe is gehaten 'Apocalipsis': and se wælhreowa Domiciaanus on ðæm ylcan geare wearð acweald æt his witena handum; and hi ealle anmodlice ræddon þæt ealle his gesetnyssa aydlode wæron.

text: Þā wearð Nerua, swīðe ārfæst man, tō cāsere gecoren.
text_bare: Þa wearð Nerua, swiðe arfæst man, to casere gecoren.

text: Be his geþafunge gecyrde sē apostol ongēan mid micclum wiðmynte, sē ðe mid hospe tō wræcsīðe āsend wæs.
text_bare: Be his geþafunge gecyrde se apostol ongean mid micclum wiðmynte, se ðe mid hospe to wræcsiðe asend wæs.

text: Him urnon ongēan weras and wīf fægnigende, and cweðende, 'Geblētsod is sē ðe cōm on Godes naman.'
text_bare: Him urnon ongean weras and wif fægnigende, and cweðende, 'Gebletsod is se ðe com on Godes naman.'

text: Mid þām ðe sē apostol Iōhannes stōp intō ðǣre byrig Ephesum, þā bær man him tōgēanes ānre wydewan līc tō byrigenne, hire nama wæs Drūsiāna.
text_bare: Mid þam ðe se apostol Iohannes stop into ðære byrig Ephesum, þa bær man him togeanes anre wydewan lic to byrigenne, hire nama wæs Drusiana.

text: Hēo wæs swīðe gelȳfed and ælmesgeorn, and þā ðearfan, de hēo mid cystigum mōde eallunga āfēdde, drēorige mid wōpe ðǣm līce folgodon.
text_bare: Heo wæs swiðe gelyfed and ælmesgeorn, and þa ðearfan, de heo mid cystigum mode eallunga afedde, dreorige mid wope ðæm lice folgodon.

text: Ðā hēt sē apostol ðā bǣre settan, and cwæð, 'Mīn Drihten Hǣlend Crīst ārǣre ðē, Drūsiāna; ārīs, and gecyrr hām, and gearca ūs gereordunge on þīnum hūse.' Drūsiāna þā ārās swilce of slǣpe āwreht, and earfull be ðæs apostoles hǣse hām gewende.
text_bare: Ða het se apostol ða bære settan, and cwæð, 'Min Drihten Hælend Crist arære ðe, Drusiana; aris, and gecyrr ham, and gearca us gereordunge on þinum huse.' Drusiana þa aras swilce of slæpe awreht, and earfull be ðæs apostoles hæse ham gewende.

text: On ðām ōðrum dæge ēode sē apostol be ðǣre strǣt; þā ofseah hē hwǣre sum ūðwita lǣdde twēgen gecrōðru þe hæfdon behwyrfed eall heora yldrena gestrēon on dēorwurðum gemstānum, and woldon ðā tōcwȳsan on ealles þæs folces gesihðe, tō wǣfersȳne, swylce tō forsewennysse woruldlīcra ǣhta.
text_bare: On ðam oðrum dæge eode se apostol be ðære stræt; þa ofseah he hwære sum uðwita lædde twegen gecroðru þe hæfdon behwyrfed eall heora yldrena gestreon on deorwurðum gemstanum, and woldon ða tocwysan on ealles þæs folces gesihðe, to wæfersyne, swylce to forsewennysse woruldlicra æhta.

text: Hit wæs gewunelīc on ðām tīman þæt ðā ðe woldon woruldwīsdōm gecneordlīce leornian, þæt hī behwyrdon heora āre on gymstānum, and ðā tōbrǣconl oððe on sumum geldenum wecge, and ðone on sǣ āwurpan; þī lǣs ðe sēo smēaung þǣra ǣhta hī æt ðǣre lāre hremde.
text_bare: Hit wæs gewunelic on ðam timan þæt ða ðe woldon woruldwisdom gecneordlice leornian, þæt hi behwyrdon heora are on gymstanum, and ða tobræconl oððe on sumum geldenum wecge, and ðone on sæ awurpan; þi læs ðe seo smeaung þæra æhta hi æt ðære lare hremde.

text: Þā clypode sē apostol ðone ūðwitan Grāton him tō, and cwæð, 'Dyslīc bið þæt hwā woruldlīce spēda forhogige for manna herunge, and bēo on Godes dōme geniðerod.
text_bare: Þa clypode se apostol ðone uðwitan Graton him to, and cwæð, 'Dyslic bið þæt hwa woruldlice speda forhogige for manna herunge, and beo on Godes dome geniðerod.

text: Ȳdel bið sē lǣcedōm þe ne mæg done untruman gehǣlan; swā bið ēac ȳdel sēo lāre ðe ne gehǣlð ðǣre sāwle leahtras and unðēawas.
text_bare: Ydel bið se læcedom þe ne mæg done untruman gehælan; swa bið eac ydel seo lare ðe ne gehælð ðære sawle leahtras and unðeawas.

text: Sōðlīce mīn lārēow Crīst sumne cniht þe gewilnode þæs ēcan līfes þysum wordum lǣrde, þæt hē sceolde ealle his welan becēapian, and þæt wurð ðearfum dǣlan, gif hē wolde fulfremed bēon, and hē syððan hæfde his golðord on heofenum, and ðǣr tō ēacan þæt ēce līf.' Grāton ðā sē ūðwita him andwyrde, 'Þās gymstānas synde tōcwȳsede for ȳdelum gylpe, ac gif ðīn lārēow is soð God, gefēg ðās bricas tō ansundnysse, þæt heora wurð mæge þearfum fremian.' Iōhannes þā gegaderode ðǣra gymstāna bricas, and beseah tō geofonum, þus cweðende, 'Drihten Hǣlend, nis ðē nān ðing earfode; þū geedstaðelodest ðisne tōbrocenan middangeard on þīnum gelēaffullum þurh tācen þǣre hālgan rōde: geedstaðela nū þās dēorwurðan gymstānas ðurh ðīnra engla handa, þæt ðās nytenan menn ðīne mihta oncnāwon, and on þē gelȳfon.' Hwæt!
text_bare: Soðlice min lareow Crist sumne cniht þe gewilnode þæs ecan lifes þysum wordum lærde, þæt he sceolde ealle his welan beceapian, and þæt wurð ðearfum dælan, gif he wolde fulfremed beon, and he syððan hæfde his golðord on heofenum, and ðær to eacan þæt ece lif.' Graton ða se uðwita him andwyrde, 'Þas gymstanas synde tocwysede for ydelum gylpe, ac gif ðin lareow is soð God, gefeg ðas bricas to ansundnysse, þæt heora wurð mæge þearfum fremian.' Iohannes þa gegaderode ðæra gymstana bricas, and beseah to geofonum, þus cweðende, 'Drihten Hælend, nis ðe nan ðing earfode; þu geedstaðelodest ðisne tobrocenan middangeard on þinum geleaffullum þurh tacen þære halgan rode: geedstaðela nu þas deorwurðan gymstanas ðurh ðinra engla handa, þæt ðas nytenan menn ðine mihta oncnawon, and on þe gelyfon.' Hwæt!

text: ðā fǣrlīce wurdon ðā gymstānas swā ansunde þæt furðon nān tācen ðǣre ǣrran tōcwȳsednysse næs gesewen.
text_bare: ða færlice wurdon ða gymstanas swa ansunde þæt furðon nan tacen ðære ærran tocwysednysse næs gesewen.

text: Þā sē ūðwita Grāton samod mid þām cnihtum fēoll tō Iōhannes fōtum, gelȳfende on God.
text_bare: Þa se uðwita Graton samod mid þam cnihtum feoll to Iohannes fotum, gelyfende on God.

text: Sē apostol hine fullode mid eallum his hīrēde, and hē ongann Godes gelēafan openlīce bodian.
text_bare: Se apostol hine fullode mid eallum his hirede, and he ongann Godes geleafan openlice bodian.

text: Þā twēgen gebrōðra, Atticus and Eugenīus, sealdon heora gymstānas, and ealla heora ǣhta dǣldon wǣdlum, and filigdon þām apostole, and micel menigu gelēaffullra him ēac tō geðēodde.
text_bare: Þa twegen gebroðra, Atticus and Eugenius, sealdon heora gymstanas, and ealla heora æhta dældon wædlum, and filigdon þam apostole, and micel menigu geleaffullra him eac to geðeodde.

text: Þā becōm sē apostol æt sumum sǣle tō þǣre byrig Pergamum, þǣr ðā foresǣdan cnihtas īu ǣr eardodon, and gesāwon heora ðēowan mid godwebbe gefrætewode, and on woruldlīcum wuldre scīnende.
text_bare: Þa becom se apostol æt sumum sæle to þære byrig Pergamum, þær ða foresædan cnihtas iu ær eardodon, and gesawon heora ðeowan mid godwebbe gefrætewode, and on woruldlicum wuldre scinende.

text: Ðā wurdon hī mid dēofles flān þurhscotene, and drēorige on mōde þæt hī wǣdligende on ānum wāclīcum wǣfelse fērdon, and heora ðēowan on woruldlīcum wuldre scīnende wǣron.
text_bare: Ða wurdon hi mid deofles flan þurhscotene, and dreorige on mode þæt hi wædligende on anum waclicum wæfelse ferdon, and heora ðeowan on woruldlicum wuldre scinende wæron.

text: Þā undergeat sē apostol ðās dēoflīcan fācn, and cwæð, 'Ic gesēo þæt ēower mōd is āwend and ēower andwlita, for ðan ðe gē ēowre spēda þearfum dǣldon, and mīnes Drihtnes lāre fyligdon: gāð nū for ðī tō wuda, and hēawað incre burðene gyrda, and gebringað tō mē.' Hī dydon be his hǣse, and hē on Godes naman ðā grēnan gyrda geblētsode, and hī wurdon tō rēadum golde āwende.
text_bare: Þa undergeat se apostol ðas deoflican facn, and cwæð, 'Ic geseo þæt eower mod is awend and eower andwlita, for ðan ðe ge eowre speda þearfum dældon, and mines Drihtnes lare fyligdon: gað nu for ði to wuda, and heawað incre burðene gyrda, and gebringað to me.' Hi dydon be his hæse, and he on Godes naman ða grenan gyrda gebletsode, and hi wurdon to readum golde awende.

text: Eft cwæð sē apostol Iōhannes, 'Gāð tō ðǣre sǣ strande, and feccað mē papolstānas.' Hī dydon swā; and Iōhannes þā on Godes mæsgenðrymme hī geblētsode, and hī wurdon gehwyrfede tō dēorwurðum gymmum.
text_bare: Eft cwæð se apostol Iohannes, 'Gað to ðære sæ strande, and feccað me papolstanas.' Hi dydon swa; and Iohannes þa on Godes mæsgenðrymme hi gebletsode, and hi wurdon gehwyrfede to deorwurðum gymmum.

text: Þā cwæð sē apostol, 'Gāð tō smiððan, and fandiað þises goldes and ðissera gymstāna.' Hī ðā eōdon, and eft cōmon, þus cweðende, 'Ealle ðās goldsmiðas secgað þæt hī nǣfre ǣr swā clǣne gold nē swā rēad ne gesāwon; ēac ðās gymwyrhtan secgað þæt hī nǣfre swā dēorwurðe gymstānas ne gemētton.' Þā cwæð sē apostol him tō, 'Nimað þis gold and ðās gymstānas, and farað, and bicgað ēow landāre; for ðan þe gē forluron ðā heofonlīcan spēda.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se apostol, 'Gað to smiððan, and fandiað þises goldes and ðissera gymstana.' Hi ða eodon, and eft comon, þus cweðende, 'Ealle ðas goldsmiðas secgað þæt hi næfre ær swa clæne gold ne swa read ne gesawon; eac ðas gymwyrhtan secgað þæt hi næfre swa deorwurðe gymstanas ne gemetton.' Þa cwæð se apostol him to, 'Nimað þis gold and ðas gymstanas, and farað, and bicgað eow landare; for ðan þe ge forluron ða heofonlican speda.

text: Bicgað ēow pællene cyrtlas, þæt gē tō lȳtelre hwīle scīnon swā swā rōse, þæt gē hrædlīce forweornion.
text_bare: Bicgað eow pællene cyrtlas, þæt ge to lytelre hwile scinon swa swa rose, þæt ge hrædlice forweornion.

text: Bēoð blōwende and welige hwīlwendlīce, þæt gē ēcelīce wǣdlion.
text_bare: Beoð blowende and welige hwilwendlice, þæt ge ecelice wædlion.

text: Hwæt lā!
text_bare: Hwæt la!

text: ne mæg sē ælmihtiga Wealdend þurhtēon þæt hē dō his ðēowan rīce for worulde, genihtsume on welan, and unwiðmetenlīce scīnan?
text_bare: ne mæg se ælmihtiga Wealdend þurhteon þæt he do his ðeowan rice for worulde, genihtsume on welan, and unwiðmetenlice scinan?

text: Ac hē sette gecamp gelēaffullum sāwlum, þæt hī gelȳfon tō geāgenne þā ēcan welan, ðā ðe for his naman þā hwīlwendan spēda forhogiað.
text_bare: Ac he sette gecamp geleaffullum sawlum, þæt hi gelyfon to geagenne þa ecan welan, ða ðe for his naman þa hwilwendan speda forhogiað.

text: Gē gehǣldon untruman on þæs Hǣlendes naman, gē āflīgdon dēoflu, gē forgēadon blindum gesihðe, and gehwilce uncoðe gehǣldon: efne, nū is ðēos gifu ēow ætbrōden, and gē sind earmingas gewordene, gē ðe wǣron mǣre and strange.
text_bare: Ge gehældon untruman on þæs Hælendes naman, ge afligdon deoflu, ge forgeadon blindum gesihðe, and gehwilce uncoðe gehældon: efne, nu is ðeos gifu eow ætbroden, and ge sind earmingas gewordene, ge ðe wæron mære and strange.

text: Swā micel ege stōd dēoflum fram ēow þæt hī be ēowere hǣse þā ofsettan dēofolsēocan forlēton; nū gē ondrǣdað ēow dēoflu.
text_bare: Swa micel ege stod deoflum fram eow þæt hi be eowere hæse þa ofsettan deofolseocan forleton; nu ge ondrædað eow deoflu.

text: Þā heofonlīcan ǣhta sind ūs eallum gemǣne.
text_bare: Þa heofonlican æhta sind us eallum gemæne.

text: Nacode wē wǣron ācennede, and nacode wē gewītað.
text_bare: Nacode we wæron acennede, and nacode we gewitað.

text: Þǣre sunnan beorhtnys, and þæs mōnan lēoht and ealra tungla sind gemǣne þām rīcan and ðām hēanan.
text_bare: Þære sunnan beorhtnys, and þæs monan leoht and ealra tungla sind gemæne þam rican and ðam heanan.

text: Rēnscūras and cyrcan duru, fulluht and synna forgyfennys, hūselgang and Godes nēosung sind eallum gemǣne, earmum and ēadigum; ac sē ungesǣliga gȳtsere wile māre habban þonne him genihtsumað, þonne hē furðon onsorh ne brīcð his genihtsumnysse.
text_bare: Renscuras and cyrcan duru, fulluht and synna forgyfennys, huselgang and Godes neosung sind eallum gemæne, earmum and eadigum; ac se ungesæliga gytsere wile mare habban þonne him genihtsumað, þonne he furðon onsorh ne bricð his genihtsumnysse.

text: Sē gȳtsere hæfð ǣnne līchaman, and menigfealde scrūd; hē hæfð āne wambe, and þūsend manna bigleofan: witodlīce þæt hē for gȳtsunge uncyste nānum ōðrum syllan ne mæg, þæt hē hordað, and nāt hwām; swā swā sē wītega cwæð.
text_bare: Se gytsere hæfð ænne lichaman, and menigfealde scrud; he hæfð ane wambe, and þusend manna bigleofan: witodlice þæt he for gytsunge uncyste nanum oðrum syllan ne mæg, þæt he hordað, and nat hwam; swa swa se witega cwæð.

text: "On īdel bið ǣle man gedrēfed sē ðe horðað, and nāt hwām hē hit gegaderað." Witodlīce ne bið hē ðǣre ǣhta hlāfor, ðonne hē hī ðǣlan ne mæg; ac hē bið þǣra ǣhta ðēowa, þonne hē him eallunga þēowað; and þǣr tō ēacan him weaxað untrumnyssa on his līchaman, þæt hē ne mæg ǣtes oððe wǣtes brūcan.
text_bare: "On idel bið æle man gedrefed se ðe horðað, and nat hwam he hit gegaderað." Witodlice ne bið he ðære æhta hlafor, ðonne he hi ðælan ne mæg; ac he bið þæra æhta ðeowa, þonne he him eallunga þeowað; and þær to eacan him weaxað untrumnyssa on his lichaman, þæt he ne mæg ætes oððe wætes brucan.

text: Hē carað dæges and nihtes þæt his feoh gehealdan sȳ; hē gȳmð grǣdelīce his teolunge, his gafoles, his gebylta hē berȳpð þā wanspēdigan, hē fulgǣð his lustum and his plegan; þonne fǣrlīce gewītt hē of ðissere worulde, nacod and forscyldigod, synna āna mid him ferigende; for ðan þe hē sceal ēce wīte ðrōwian.'
text_bare: He carað dæges and nihtes þæt his feoh gehealdan sy; he gymð grædelice his teolunge, his gafoles, his gebylta he berypð þa wanspedigan, he fulgæð his lustum and his plegan; þonne færlice gewitt he of ðissere worulde, nacod and forscyldigod, synna ana mid him ferigende; for ðan þe he sceal ece wite ðrowian.'

text: Efne ðā ðā sē apostol þās lāre sprecende wæs, ðā bær sum wuduwe hire suna līc tō bebyrgenne, sē hæfde gewīfod þrītigum nihtum ǣr.
text_bare: Efne ða ða se apostol þas lare sprecende wæs, ða bær sum wuduwe hire suna lic to bebyrgenne, se hæfde gewifod þritigum nihtum ær.

text: Sēo drēorige mōdor þā samod mid þām līcmannum rārigende hī āstrehte æt þæs hālgan apostoles fōtum, biddende þæt hē hire sunu on Godes naman ārǣrde, swā swā hē dyde þā wydewan Drūsiānam.
text_bare: Seo dreorige modor þa samod mid þam licmannum rarigende hi astrehte æt þæs halgan apostoles fotum, biddende þæt he hire sunu on Godes naman arærde, swa swa he dyde þa wydewan Drusianam.

text: Iōhannes ðā ofhrēow þǣre mēder and ðǣra līcmanna drēorignysse, and āstrehte his līchaman tō eorðan on langsumum gebede, and ðā æt nēxtan ārās, and eft ūpāhafenum handum langlīce bæd.
text_bare: Iohannes ða ofhreow þære meder and ðæra licmanna dreorignysse, and astrehte his lichaman to eorðan on langsumum gebede, and ða æt nextan aras, and eft upahafenum handum langlice bæd.

text: Þā ðā hē þus þrīwa gedōn hæfde, ðā hēt hē unwindan þæs cnihtes līc, and cwæð, 'Ēalā ðū cniht, ðe þurh ðīnes flǣsces lust hrædlīce ðīne sāwle forlure; ēalā þū cniht, þū ne cūðest ðīnne Scyppend; þū ne cūðest manna Hǣlend; þū ne cūðest ðone sōðan frēond; and for ðī þū beurne on ðone wyrstan fēond.
text_bare: Þa ða he þus þriwa gedon hæfde, ða het he unwindan þæs cnihtes lic, and cwæð, 'Eala ðu cniht, ðe þurh ðines flæsces lust hrædlice ðine sawle forlure; eala þu cniht, þu ne cuðest ðinne Scyppend; þu ne cuðest manna Hælend; þu ne cuðest ðone soðan freond; and for ði þu beurne on ðone wyrstan feond.

text: Nū ic āgēat mīne tēaras, and for ðīnre nytennysse geornlīce bæd, þæt þū of dēaðe ārīse, and þisum twām gebrōðrum, Attico and Eugenīo, cȳðe hū micel wuldor hī forluron, and hwilc wīte hī geearonodon.' Mid ðām þā ārās sē cniht Stactus, and fēoll tō Iōhannes fōtum, and begann to ðrēagenne þā gebrōðu þe miswende wǣron, þus cweðende, 'Ic geseah ðā englas þe ēower gȳmdon drēorige wēpan, and ðā āwyrigedan sceoccan blissigende on ēowerum forwyrde.
text_bare: Nu ic ageat mine tearas, and for ðinre nytennysse geornlice bæd, þæt þu of deaðe arise, and þisum twam gebroðrum, Attico and Eugenio, cyðe hu micel wuldor hi forluron, and hwilc wite hi geearonodon.' Mid ðam þa aras se cniht Stactus, and feoll to Iohannes fotum, and begann to ðreagenne þa gebroðu þe miswende wæron, þus cweðende, 'Ic geseah ða englas þe eower gymdon dreorige wepan, and ða awyrigedan sceoccan blissigende on eowerum forwyrde.

text: Ēow wæs heofenan rīce gearo, and scīende gebytlu mid wistum āfyllede and mid ēcum lēohte; þā gē forluron þurh unwærscipe, and gē begēaton ēow ðēosterfulle wununga mid dracum āfyllede and mid brastligendum līgum, mid unāsecgendlīcum wītum āfyllede and mid anðrǣcum stencum; on ðām ne āblinð grānung and þoterung dægs oþþe nihtes: biddað for ðī mid inweardre heortan ðysne Godes apostol, ēowerne lārēow, þæt hē ēow fram ðām ēcum forwyrde ārǣre, swā swā hē mē fram dēaðe ārǣrde; and hē ēowre sāula, þe nū sind ādȳlegode of þǣre līflīcan bēc, gelǣde eft tō Godes gife and miltsunge.'
text_bare: Eow wæs heofenan rice gearo, and sciende gebytlu mid wistum afyllede and mid ecum leohte; þa ge forluron þurh unwærscipe, and ge begeaton eow ðeosterfulle wununga mid dracum afyllede and mid brastligendum ligum, mid unasecgendlicum witum afyllede and mid anðræcum stencum; on ðam ne ablinð granung and þoterung dægs oþþe nihtes: biddað for ði mid inweardre heortan ðysne Godes apostol, eowerne lareow, þæt he eow fram ðam ecum forwyrde arære, swa swa he me fram deaðe arærde; and he eowre saula, þe nu sind adylegode of þære liflican bec, gelæde eft to Godes gife and miltsunge.'

text: Sē cniht þā Stacteus, ðe of dēaðe ārās, samod mid þām gebrōðrum āstrehte hine tō Iōhannes fōtswaðum, and þæt folc forð mid ealle, ānmōdlīce biddende þæt hē him tō Gode geþingode.
text_bare: Se cniht þa Stacteus, ðe of deaðe aras, samod mid þam gebroðrum astrehte hine to Iohannes fotswaðum, and þæt folc forð mid ealle, anmodlice biddende þæt he him to Gode geþingode.

text: Sē apostol þā bebēad ðām twām gebrōðrum þæt hī ðrītig daga be hrēowsunge dǣdbētende Gode geofrodon, and on ðām fæce geornlīce bǣdon þæt þā gyldenan gyrda eft tō þan ǣrran gecynde āwendon, and þā gymstānas tō heora wācnysse.
text_bare: Se apostol þa bebead ðam twam gebroðrum þæt hi ðritig daga be hreowsunge dædbetende Gode geofrodon, and on ðam fæce geornlice bædon þæt þa gyldenan gyrda eft to þan ærran gecynde awendon, and þa gymstanas to heora wacnysse.

text: Æfter ðrītigra daga fæce, þā þā hī ne mihton mid heora bēnum þæt gold and þā gymstānas tō heora gecynde āwendan, ðā cōmon hī mid wōpe tō þām apostole, þus cweþende, 'Symle ðū tǣhtest mildheortnysse, and þæt man ōðrum miltsode; and gif man ōðrum miltsað, hū micele swīðor wile God miltsian and ārian mannum his handgeweorce!
text_bare: Æfter ðritigra daga fæce, þa þa hi ne mihton mid heora benum þæt gold and þa gymstanas to heora gecynde awendan, ða comon hi mid wope to þam apostole, þus cweþende, 'Symle ðu tæhtest mildheortnysse, and þæt man oðrum miltsode; and gif man oðrum miltsað, hu micele swiðor wile God miltsian and arian mannum his handgeweorce!

text: Þæt þæt wē mid gītsigendum ēagum āgylton, þæt wē nū mid wēpendum ēagum behrēowdiað.' Ðā andwyrde sē apostol, 'Berað ðā gyrda tō wuda, and þā stānas tō sǣstrange: hī synd gecyrrede tō heora gecynde'.
text_bare: Þæt þæt we mid gitsigendum eagum agylton, þæt we nu mid wependum eagum behreowdiað.' Ða andwyrde se apostol, 'Berað ða gyrda to wuda, and þa stanas to sæstrange: hi synd gecyrrede to heora gecynde'.

text: Þā ðā hī þis gedōn hæfdon, ðā underfēngon hī eft Godes gife, swā þæt hī ādrǣfdon dēoflu, and blinde and untrume gehǣldon, and feala tācna on Drihtnes naman gefremedon, swā swā hȳ ǣr dydon.
text_bare: Þa ða hi þis gedon hæfdon, ða underfengon hi eft Godes gife, swa þæt hi adræfdon deoflu, and blinde and untrume gehældon, and feala tacna on Drihtnes naman gefremedon, swa swa hy ær dydon.

text: Sē apostol þā gebīgde tō Gode ealne þone eard Asiam, sē is geteald tō healfum dǣle middaneardes; and āwrāt ðā fēorðan Crīstes bōc, sēp hrepað swȳðost ymbe Crīstes godcundnysse.
text_bare: Se apostol þa gebigde to Gode ealne þone eard Asiam, se is geteald to healfum dæle middaneardes; and awrat ða feorðan Cristes boc, sep hrepað swyðost ymbe Cristes godcundnysse.

text: Ðā ōðre ðrȳ godspellereas, Mathēus, Marcus, Lūcās, āwriton ǣror be Crīstes menniscnysse.
text_bare: Ða oðre ðry godspellereas, Matheus, Marcus, Lucas, awriton æror be Cristes menniscnysse.

text: Þā āsprungan gedwolmenn on Godes gelaðunge, and cwǣdon ðæt Crīst nǣre, ǣre hē ācenned wæs of Marīan.
text_bare: Þa asprungan gedwolmenn on Godes gelaðunge, and cwædon ðæt Crist nære, ære he acenned wæs of Marian.

text: Þā bǣdan ealle ðā lēodbisceopas ðone hālgan apostol þæt hē þā fēorðan bōc gesette, and þǣra gedwolmanns dyrstignesse āadwǣscte.
text_bare: Þa bædan ealle ða leodbisceopas ðone halgan apostol þæt he þa feorðan boc gesette, and þæra gedwolmanns dyrstignesse aadwæscte.

text: Ealle ðing sind þurh hine geworhte, and nis nān þing būton him gesceapan.' And swā forð on ealre ðǣre godspellīcan gesetnysse hē cȳdde fela be Crīstes godcundnysse, hū hē ēcelīce būtan angynne of his Fæder ācenned is, and mid him rīxað on ānnyse þæs Hālgan Gāstes, ā būtan ende.
text_bare: Ealle ðing sind þurh hine geworhte, and nis nan þing buton him gesceapan.' And swa forð on ealre ðære godspellican gesetnysse he cydde fela be Cristes godcundnysse, hu he ecelice butan angynne of his Fæder acenned is, and mid him rixað on annyse þæs Halgan Gastes, a butan ende.

text: Fēaws hē āwrāt be his menniscnysse, for ðan þe þā ðrȳ ōðre godspelleras gnihtsumlīce be þām heora bēc setton.
text_bare: Feaws he awrat be his menniscnysse, for ðan þe þa ðry oðre godspelleras gnihtsumlice be þam heora bec setton.

text: Hit gelamp æt sumum sǣle þæt þā dēofolgyldan, þe þā gȳt ungelēaffulle wǣron, gecwǣdon þæt hī woldon þone apostol tō heora hǣðenscipe genēadian.
text_bare: Hit gelamp æt sumum sæle þæt þa deofolgyldan, þe þa gyt ungeleaffulle wæron, gecwædon þæt hi woldon þone apostol to heora hæðenscipe geneadian.

text: Þā cwæð sē apostol tō ðām hǣðengyldum, 'Gāð elle endemes tō Godes cyrcan, and clypiað ealle tō ēowerum godum, þæt sēo cyrce āfealle ðurh heora mihte; ðonne būge ic tō ēowerum hǣðenscipe.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se apostol to ðam hæðengyldum, 'Gað elle endemes to Godes cyrcan, and clypiað ealle to eowerum godum, þæt seo cyrce afealle ðurh heora mihte; ðonne buge ic to eowerum hæðenscipe.

text: Gif ðonne ēower godes miht þā hālgan gyrcan tōwurpan ne mæg, ic tōwurpe ēower tempel þurh ðæs ælmihtigan Godes mihte, and ic tōcwȳse ēower dēofolgyld; and bið þonne rihtlīc geðūht þæt gē geswȳcon ēoweres gedwyldes, and gelȳfon on ðonne sōðan God, sē ðe āna is ælmihtig.' Þā hǣðengyldan ðisum cwyde geðǣrlǣhton, and Iōhannes mid geswǣsum wordum þæt folc tihte þæt hī ufor ēodon fram þām dēofles temple; and mid beorhtre stemne ætforum him ealle clypode, 'On Godes naman āhrēose þis templ mid eallum þām dēofolgyldum þe him on eardiað, þæt þēos menigu tōcnāwe þæt ðis hǣðengyld dēofles biggeng is.' Hwæt ðā fǣrlīce āhrēas þæt tempel grundlunga mid eallum his anlīcnyssum tō dūste āwende.
text_bare: Gif ðonne eower godes miht þa halgan gyrcan towurpan ne mæg, ic towurpe eower tempel þurh ðæs ælmihtigan Godes mihte, and ic tocwyse eower deofolgyld; and bið þonne rihtlic geðuht þæt ge geswycon eoweres gedwyldes, and gelyfon on ðonne soðan God, se ðe ana is ælmihtig.' Þa hæðengyldan ðisum cwyde geðærlæhton, and Iohannes mid geswæsum wordum þæt folc tihte þæt hi ufor eodon fram þam deofles temple; and mid beorhtre stemne ætforum him ealle clypode, 'On Godes naman ahreose þis templ mid eallum þam deofolgyldum þe him on eardiað, þæt þeos menigu tocnawe þæt ðis hæðengyld deofles biggeng is.' Hwæt ða færlice ahreas þæt tempel grundlunga mid eallum his anlicnyssum to duste awende.

text: On þām ylcan dæge wurdon gebīgede twelf ðūsend hǣðenra manna tō Crīstes gelēafan, and mid fulluhte gehālgode.
text_bare: On þam ylcan dæge wurdon gebigede twelf ðusend hæðenra manna to Cristes geleafan, and mid fulluhte gehalgode.

text: Þā sceorede ðā gȳt sē yldesta hǣðengylda mid mycelre þwyrnysse, and cwæð þæt hē nolde gelȳfan būton.
text_bare: Þa sceorede ða gyt se yldesta hæðengylda mid mycelre þwyrnysse, and cwæð þæt he nolde gelyfan buton.

text: Iōhannes āttor drunce, and þurh Godes mihte ðone cwealmbǣran drenc oferswīðde.
text_bare: Iohannes attor drunce, and þurh Godes mihte ðone cwealmbæran drenc oferswiðde.

text: Þā cwæð sē apostol, 'Þēah ðū mē āttor sylle, þurh Godes naman hit mē ne derað.' Ðā cwæð sē hǣðengylda Aristodēmus, 'Þū scealt ǣrest ōðerne gesēon drincan, and ðǣr rihte cwelan, þæt hūru ðīn heorte swā forhtige for ðām dēadbǣrum drence.' Iōhannes him andwyrde, 'Gif ðū on God gelȳfan wylt, ic unforhtmōd ðæs drences onfō.' Þā getengde sē Aristodēmus tō ðām hēahgerēfan, and genam on his cwearterne twēgen dēofas, and sealde him ðone unlybban ætforan eallum ðām folce, on Iōhannes gesihðe; and hī ðǣr rihte æfter ðām drence gewiton.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se apostol, 'Þeah ðu me attor sylle, þurh Godes naman hit me ne derað.' Ða cwæð se hæðengylda Aristodemus, 'Þu scealt ærest oðerne geseon drincan, and ðær rihte cwelan, þæt huru ðin heorte swa forhtige for ðam deadbærum drence.' Iohannes him andwyrde, 'Gif ðu on God gelyfan wylt, ic unforhtmod ðæs drences onfo.' Þa getengde se Aristodemus to ðam heahgerefan, and genam on his cwearterne twegen deofas, and sealde him ðone unlybban ætforan eallum ðam folce, on Iohannes gesihðe; and hi ðær rihte æfter ðam drence gewiton.

text: Syððan sē hǣðengilda ēac sealde ðone āttorbǣran drenc þām apostole, and hē mid rōdetācne his mūð and ealne his līchaman gewǣpnode, and ðone unlybban on Godes naman hālsode, and siððan mid gebildum mōde hine ealne gedranc.
text_bare: Syððan se hæðengilda eac sealde ðone attorbæran drenc þam apostole, and he mid rodetacne his muð and ealne his lichaman gewæpnode, and ðone unlybban on Godes naman halsode, and siððan mid gebildum mode hine ealne gedranc.

text: Aristodēmus ðā and þæt folc behēoldon þone apostol ðrēo tīda dæges, and gesāwon gine habban glædne andwlitan būton blācunge and forhtunge; and hī ealle clypodon, 'Ān sōð God is, sē ðe Iōhannes wurðað.' Þā cwæð sē hǣðengylda tō ðām apostole, 'Gȳt mē twēonað; ac gif ðū ðās dēadan sceaðan on ðīnes Godes naman ārǣrst, þonne bið mīn heorte geclǣnsod fram ǣlcere twȳnunge.' Ðā cwæð Iōhannes, 'Aristodēme, nim mīne tunecan, and lege bufon þǣra dēadra manna līc, and cweð, "Þæs Hǣlendes Crīstes apostol mē āsende tō ēow, þæt gē on his naman of dēaðe ārīson, and ǣlc mann oncnāwe þæt dēað and līf þēowiað nīnum Hǣlende."' Hē ðā be ðæs apostoles hǣse bær his tunecan, and ālēde uppon ðām twām dēadum; and hī ðǣr rihte ansunde ārison.
text_bare: Aristodemus ða and þæt folc beheoldon þone apostol ðreo tida dæges, and gesawon gine habban glædne andwlitan buton blacunge and forhtunge; and hi ealle clypodon, 'An soð God is, se ðe Iohannes wurðað.' Þa cwæð se hæðengylda to ðam apostole, 'Gyt me tweonað; ac gif ðu ðas deadan sceaðan on ðines Godes naman arærst, þonne bið min heorte geclænsod fram ælcere twynunge.' Ða cwæð Iohannes, 'Aristodeme, nim mine tunecan, and lege bufon þæra deadra manna lic, and cweð, "Þæs Hælendes Cristes apostol me asende to eow, þæt ge on his naman of deaðe arison, and ælc mann oncnawe þæt deað and lif þeowiað ninum Hælende."' He ða be ðæs apostoles hæse bær his tunecan, and alede uppon ðam twam deadum; and hi ðær rihte ansunde arison.

text: Þā ðā sē hǣðengilda þæt geseah, ðā āstrehte hē hine tō Iōhannes fōtum, and syððan fērde tō ðām hēahgerēfan, and him ðā wundra mid hlūddre stemne cȳdde.
text_bare: Þa ða se hæðengilda þæt geseah, ða astrehte he hine to Iohannes fotum, and syððan ferde to ðam heahgerefan, and him ða wundra mid hluddre stemne cydde.

text: Hī ðā bēgen þone apostol gesōhton, his miltsunge biddende.
text_bare: Hi ða begen þone apostol gesohton, his miltsunge biddende.

text: Þā bēad sē apostol him seofon nihta fæsten, and hī siððan gefullode; and hī æfter ðām fulluhte tōwurpon eall heora dēofolgyld, and mid heora māga fultume and mid eallum cræfte ārǣrdon Gode mǣre cyrcan on ðæs apostoles wurðmynte.
text_bare: Þa bead se apostol him seofon nihta fæsten, and hi siððan gefullode; and hi æfter ðam fulluhte towurpon eall heora deofolgyld, and mid heora maga fultume and mid eallum cræfte arærdon Gode mære cyrcan on ðæs apostoles wurðmynte.

text: Þā ðā sē apostol wæs nigon and hundnigontig gēara, þā ætēowode him Drihten Crīst mid þām ōðrum apostolum, þe hē of ðisum līf genumen hæfde, and cwæð, 'Iōhannes, cum tō mē: tīma is þæt þū mid ðīnum gebrōðrum wistfullige on mīnum gebēorscipe.' Iōhannes þā ārās, and ēode wið þæs Hǣlendes; ac hē him tō cwæð, 'Nū on sunnandæg, mīnes ǣrīstes dæge, þū cymst tō mē;' and æfter ðām worde Drihten gewende tō heofonum.
text_bare: Þa ða se apostol wæs nigon and hundnigontig geara, þa æteowode him Drihten Crist mid þam oðrum apostolum, þe he of ðisum lif genumen hæfde, and cwæð, 'Iohannes, cum to me: tima is þæt þu mid ðinum gebroðrum wistfullige on minum gebeorscipe.' Iohannes þa aras, and eode wið þæs Hælendes; ac he him to cwæð, 'Nu on sunnandæg, mines æristes dæge, þu cymst to me;' and æfter ðam worde Drihten gewende to heofonum.

text: Sē apostol micelum blissode on ðām behāte, and on þām sunnannūhtan ǣrwacol tō ðǣre cyrcan cōm, and þām folce, fram hancrēde oð undern, Godes herihta lǣrde, and him mæssan gesang, and cwæð þæt sē Hǣlende hine on ðām dæge tō hēofonum gelaðod hæfde.
text_bare: Se apostol micelum blissode on ðam behate, and on þam sunnannuhtan ærwacol to ðære cyrcan com, and þam folce, fram hancrede oð undern, Godes herihta lærde, and him mæssan gesang, and cwæð þæt se Hælende hine on ðam dæge to heofonum gelaðod hæfde.

text: Hēt ðā delfan his byrgene wið þæt wēofod, and þæt grēot ūtāwegan.
text_bare: Het ða delfan his byrgene wið þæt weofod, and þæt greot utawegan.

text: And hē ēode cucu and gesund intō his byrgene, and āstrehtum handum tō Gode clypode, 'Drihten Crīst, ic þancige ðē þæt þū mē gelaðodest tō þīnum wistum; þū wāst þæt ic mid ealre heortan þē gewilnode.
text_bare: And he eode cucu and gesund into his byrgene, and astrehtum handum to Gode clypode, 'Drihten Crist, ic þancige ðe þæt þu me gelaðodest to þinum wistum; þu wast þæt ic mid ealre heortan þe gewilnode.

text: Oft ic ðē bæd þæt ic mōste tō ðē faran, ac þū cwǣde þæt ic andbidode, þæt ic ðē māre folc gestrȳnde.
text_bare: Oft ic ðe bæd þæt ic moste to ðe faran, ac þu cwæde þæt ic andbidode, þæt ic ðe mare folc gestrynde.

text: Þū hēolde mīnne līchaman wið ǣlce besmitennysse, and þū simle mīne sāwle onlīhtest, and mē nāhwār ne forlēte.
text_bare: Þu heolde minne lichaman wið ælce besmitennysse, and þu simle mine sawle onlihtest, and me nahwar ne forlete.

text: Þū settest on mīnum mūðe þīnre sōðfæstnysse word, and ic āwrāt ðā lāre ðe ic of ðīnum mūðe gehȳrde, and ðā wundra ðe ic ðē wyrcan geseah.
text_bare: Þu settest on minum muðe þinre soðfæstnysse word, and ic awrat ða lare ðe ic of ðinum muðe gehyrde, and ða wundra ðe ic ðe wyrcan geseah.

text: Nū ic ðē betǣce, Drihten, þīne bearn, ðā ðe þīn gelaðung, mǣden and mōder, þurh wæter and þone Hālgan Gāst ðē gestrȳnde.
text_bare: Nu ic ðe betæce, Drihten, þine bearn, ða ðe þin gelaðung, mæden and moder, þurh wæter and þone Halgan Gast ðe gestrynde.

text: Onfōh mē tō mīnum gebrōðrum mid ðām ðe ðū cōme, and mē gelaðodest.
text_bare: Onfoh me to minum gebroðrum mid ðam ðe ðu come, and me gelaðodest.

text: Geopena ongēan mē līfes geat, þæt ðǣra ðēostra ealdras mē ne gemēton.
text_bare: Geopena ongean me lifes geat, þæt ðæra ðeostra ealdras me ne gemeton.

text: Þū eart Crīst, ðæs lifigendan Godes Sunu, þū þe be ðīnes Fæder hǣse middangeard gehǣldest, and ūs ðone Hālgan Gāst āsendest.
text_bare: Þu eart Crist, ðæs lifigendan Godes Sunu, þu þe be ðines Fæder hæse middangeard gehældest, and us ðone Halgan Gast asendest.

text: Þē wē heriað, and þanciað þīnra menigfealdra gōda geond ungeendode worulde.
text_bare: Þe we heriað, and þanciað þinra menigfealdra goda geond ungeendode worulde.

text: Amen.'
text_bare: Amen.'

text: Æfter ðysum gebede ætēowode heofonlīc lēoht bufon ðām apostol binnon ðǣre byrgene, āne tīd swā beorhte scīnende þæt nānes mannes gesihð þæs lēohtes lēoman scēawian ne mihte; and hē mid þām lēohte his gāst āgeaf þām Drihtne þe hine tō his rīce gelaðode.
text_bare: Æfter ðysum gebede æteowode heofonlic leoht bufon ðam apostol binnon ðære byrgene, ane tid swa beorhte scinende þæt nanes mannes gesihð þæs leohtes leoman sceawian ne mihte; and he mid þam leohte his gast ageaf þam Drihtne þe hine to his rice gelaðode.

text: Hē gewāt swā frēoh fram dēades sārnysse of ðisum andweardan līfe swā swā hē wæs ælfremed fram līchamlīcere gewemmednysse.
text_bare: He gewat swa freoh fram deades sarnysse of ðisum andweardan life swa swa he wæs ælfremed fram lichamlicere gewemmednysse.

text: Sōðlīce syððan wæs his byrgen gemēt mid mannan āfylled.
text_bare: Soðlice syððan wæs his byrgen gemet mid mannan afylled.

text: Manna wæs gehāten sē heofonlīca mete þe fēowertig gēara āfēdde Israhēla folc on wēstene.
text_bare: Manna wæs gehaten se heofonlica mete þe feowertig geara afedde Israhela folc on westene.

text: Nū wæs sē bigleofa gemētt on Iōhannes byrgene, and nān ðing elles; and sē mete is weaxende on hire oð ðisne andweardan dæg.
text_bare: Nu wæs se bigleofa gemett on Iohannes byrgene, and nan ðing elles; and se mete is weaxende on hire oð ðisne andweardan dæg.

text: Þǣr bēoð fela tācna ætēcwode, and untrume gehǣlde and fram eallum frēcednyssum ālȳsede þurh ðæs apostoles ðingunge.
text_bare: Þær beoð fela tacna ætecwode, and untrume gehælde and fram eallum frecednyssum alysede þurh ðæs apostoles ðingunge.

text: Þæs him getīðað Drihten Crīst, þām is wuldor and wurðmynt mid Fæder and Hālgum Gāste ā būton ende.
text_bare: Þæs him getiðað Drihten Crist, þam is wuldor and wurðmynt mid Fæder and Halgum Gaste a buton ende.

text: Amen.
text_bare: Amen.

text: Grēgōrius sē hālga pāpa, Engliscre ðēode apostol, on ðisum andwerdan dæge, æfter menigfealdum gedeorfum and hālgum gecnyrdnyssum, Godes rīce gesǣliglīce āstāh.
text_bare: Gregorius se halga papa, Engliscre ðeode apostol, on ðisum andwerdan dæge, æfter menigfealdum gedeorfum and halgum gecnyrdnyssum, Godes rice gesæliglice astah.

text: Hē is rihtlīce Engliscre ðēode apostol, for ðan ðe hē þurh his rǣd and sande ūs fram dēofles biggengum ætbrǣd, and tō Godes gelēafan gebīgde.
text_bare: He is rihtlice Engliscre ðeode apostol, for ðan ðe he þurh his ræd and sande us fram deofles biggengum ætbræd, and to Godes geleafan gebigde.

text: Manega hālige bēc cȳðað his drohtnunge and his hālige līf, and ēac 'Historia Anglōrum,' ðā ðe Ælfrēd cyning of Lēdene on Englisc āwende.
text_bare: Manega halige bec cyðað his drohtnunge and his halige lif, and eac 'Historia Anglorum,' ða ðe Ælfred cyning of Ledene on Englisc awende.

text: Sēo bōc sprecð genōh swutelīce be ðisum hālgan were.
text_bare: Seo boc sprecð genoh swutelice be ðisum halgan were.

text: Nū wylle wē sum ðing scortlīce ēow be him gereccan, for ðan ðe sēo foresǣde bōc nis ēow eallum cūð, þēah ðe hēo on Englisc āwend sȳ.
text_bare: Nu wylle we sum ðing scortlice eow be him gereccan, for ðan ðe seo foresæde boc nis eow eallum cuð, þeah ðe heo on Englisc awend sy.

text: Þēs ēadiga pāpa Grēgōrius wæs of æðelborenre mǣgðe and ēawfæstre ācenned; Rōmānisce witan wǣron his māgas; his fæder hātte Gordiānus, and Fēlix, sē ēawfæsta pāpa, wæs his fīfta fæder.
text_bare: Þes eadiga papa Gregorius wæs of æðelborenre mægðe and eawfæstre acenned; Romanisce witan wæron his magas; his fæder hatte Gordianus, and Felix, se eawfæsta papa, wæs his fifta fæder.

text: Hē wæs — swā swā wē cwǣdon — for worulde æðelboren, ac hē oferstāh his ædelborennysse mid hālgum ðēawum and mid gōdum weorcum geglengde.
text_bare: He wæs — swa swa we cwædon — for worulde æðelboren, ac he oferstah his ædelborennysse mid halgum ðeawum and mid godum weorcum geglengde.

text: Grēgōrius is Grēcisc nama, sē swēgfh on Lēdenum gereorde 'Vigilantius,' þæt is on Englisc 'Wacolre.' Hē wæs swīðe wacol on Godes bebodum, ðā ðā hē sylf herigendlīce leofode, and hē wacollīce ymbe manegra ðēoda þearfe hogode and him līfes weg geswutelode.
text_bare: Gregorius is Grecisc nama, se swegfh on Ledenum gereorde 'Vigilantius,' þæt is on Englisc 'Wacolre.' He wæs swiðe wacol on Godes bebodum, ða ða he sylf herigendlice leofode, and he wacollice ymbe manegra ðeoda þearfe hogode and him lifes weg geswutelode.

text: Hē wæs fram cilðāde on bōclīcum lārum getȳd, and hē on ðǣre lāre swā gesǣliglīce ðēah, þæt on ealre Rōmānabyrig næs nān his gelīca geðūht.
text_bare: He wæs fram cilðade on boclicum larum getyd, and he on ðære lare swa gesæliglice ðeah, þæt on ealre Romanabyrig næs nan his gelica geðuht.

text: Hē gecneordlǣhte æfter wīsra lārēowa gebīsnungum, and næs forgytol, ac gefæstnode his lāre on fæsþafelum gemynde.
text_bare: He gecneordlæhte æfter wisra lareowa gebisnungum, and næs forgytol, ac gefæstnode his lare on fæsþafelum gemynde.

text: Hē hlōd ðā mid þurstigum brēoste ðā flōwendan lāre, ðe hē eft æfter fyrste mid hunigswēttre þrotan þæslīce bealcette.
text_bare: He hlod ða mid þurstigum breoste ða flowendan lare, ðe he eft æfter fyrste mid hunigswettre þrotan þæslice bealcette.

text: On geonglīcum gēarum, ðā ðā his geogoð æfter gecynde woruldðing lufian sceolde, þā ongann hē hine sylfne tō Gode geþēodan, and tō ēðele þæs ūpplīcan līfes mid eallum gewilnungum orðian.
text_bare: On geonglicum gearum, ða ða his geogoð æfter gecynde woruldðing lufian sceolde, þa ongann he hine sylfne to Gode geþeodan, and to eðele þæs upplican lifes mid eallum gewilnungum orðian.

text: Witodlīce æfter his fæder forðsīðe, hē ārǣrde six munuclīf on Sicilialande, and þæt seofoðe binnon Rōmānabyrig getimbrode, on ðām hē sylf regollīce under abbodes hǣsum drohtnode.
text_bare: Witodlice æfter his fæder forðsiðe, he arærde six munuclif on Sicilialande, and þæt seofoðe binnon Romanabyrig getimbrode, on ðam he sylf regollice under abbodes hæsum drohtnode.

text: Þā seofon mynstru hē gelende mid his āgenum, and genihtsumlīce tō dæghwōmlīcum bigleofan gegōdode.
text_bare: Þa seofon mynstru he gelende mid his agenum, and genihtsumlice to dæghwomlicum bigleofan gegodode.

text: Þone oferēacan his ǣhta hē āspende on Godes þearfum, and ealle his woruldlīcan æðelborennysse tō heofonlīcum wuldre āwende.
text_bare: Þone ofereacan his æhta he aspende on Godes þearfum, and ealle his woruldlican æðelborennysse to heofonlicum wuldre awende.

text: Hē ēode ǣr his gecyrrednysse geond Rōmānaburh mid pællenum gyrlum, and scīnendum gymmum, and rēadum golde gefrætewod, ac æfter his gecyrrednysse hē ðēnode Godes ðearfum, hē sylf ðearfa, mid wācum wǣfelse befangen.
text_bare: He eode ær his gecyrrednysse geond Romanaburh mid pællenum gyrlum, and scinendum gymmum, and readum golde gefrætewod, ac æfter his gecyrrednysse he ðenode Godes ðearfum, he sylf ðearfa, mid wacum wæfelse befangen.

text: Swā fulfremedlīce hē drohtnode on anginne his gecyrrednysse, swā þæt hē mihte ðā gȳu bēon geteald on fulfremedra hālgena getele.
text_bare: Swa fulfremedlice he drohtnode on anginne his gecyrrednysse, swa þæt he mihte ða gyu beon geteald on fulfremedra halgena getele.

text: Hē lufode forhæfednysse on mettum and on drence, and wæccan on dyndrigum gebedum; þǣr tō ēacan hē ðrōwade singāllīce untrumnysse, and swā hē stīðlīcor mid andwerdum untrumnyssum ofsett wæs, swā geornfullīcor þæs ēcan līfes gewilnode.
text_bare: He lufode forhæfednysse on mettum and on drence, and wæccan on dyndrigum gebedum; þær to eacan he ðrowade singallice untrumnysse, and swa he stiðlicor mid andwerdum untrumnyssum ofsett wæs, swa geornfullicor þæs ecan lifes gewilnode.

text: Þā undergeat sē pāpa, þe on þām tīman þæt apostolīcesetl gesæt, hū sē ēadiga Grēgōrius on hālgum mægnum ðēonde wæs, and hē ðā hine of ðǣre munuclīcan drohtnunge genam and him tō gefylstan gesette, on dīaconhāade geendebyrdne.
text_bare: Þa undergeat se papa, þe on þam timan þæt apostolicesetl gesæt, hu se eadiga Gregorius on halgum mægnum ðeonde wæs, and he ða hine of ðære munuclican drohtnunge genam and him to gefylstan gesette, on diaconhaade geendebyrdne.

text: Ðā gelamp hit æt sumum sǣle, swā swā gȳt for oft deð, þæt Englisce cȳpmenn brōhton heora ware tō Rōmānabyrig, and Grēgōrius ēode be þǣre strǣt tō ðām Engliscum mannum, heora ðing scēawigende.
text_bare: Ða gelamp hit æt sumum sæle, swa swa gyt for oft deð, þæt Englisce cypmenn brohton heora ware to Romanabyrig, and Gregorius eode be þære stræt to ðam Engliscum mannum, heora ðing sceawigende.

text: Þā geseah hē betwux ðām warum cȳpecnihtas gesette, þā wǣron hwītes līchaman and fægeres andwlitan menn, and æðellīce gefexode.
text_bare: Þa geseah he betwux ðam warum cypecnihtas gesette, þa wæron hwites lichaman and fægeres andwlitan menn, and æðellice gefexode.

text: Grēgorius ðā behēold þǣra cnapena wlite, and befrān of hwilcere þēode hī gebrōhte wǣron.
text_bare: Gregorius ða beheold þæra cnapena wlite, and befran of hwilcere þeode hi gebrohte wæron.

text: Þā sǣde him man þæt hī of Englalande wǣron, and þæt ðǣre ðēode mennisc swā wlitig wǣre.
text_bare: Þa sæde him man þæt hi of Englalande wæron, and þæt ðære ðeode mennisc swa wlitig wære.

text: Eft ðā Grēgōrius befrān, hwæðer þæs landes folc crīsten wǣre ðe hǣðen.
text_bare: Eft ða Gregorius befran, hwæðer þæs landes folc cristen wære ðe hæðen.

text: Him man sǣde þæt hī hǣðen wǣron.
text_bare: Him man sæde þæt hi hæðen wæron.

text: Grēgōrius ðā of innweardre heortan langsume siccetunge tēah, and cwæð, 'Wālāwā, þæt swā fægeres hīwes menn sindon ðām sweartan dēofle underðēodde!' Eft hē āxode, hū ðǣre ðēode nama wǣre þe hī of cōmon.
text_bare: Gregorius ða of innweardre heortan langsume siccetunge teah, and cwæð, 'Walawa, þæt swa fægeres hiwes menn sindon ðam sweartan deofle underðeodde!' Eft he axode, hu ðære ðeode nama wære þe hi of comon.

text: Him wæs geandwyrd, þæt hī Angle genemnode wǣron.
text_bare: Him wæs geandwyrd, þæt hi Angle genemnode wæron.

text: Þā cwæð hē, 'Rihtlīce hī Angle gehātene, for ðan ðe hī engla wlite habbað, and swilcum gedafenað þæt hī on heofonum engla gefēran bēon.' Gȳt ðā Grēgōrius befrān, hū ðǣre scīre nama wǣre þe ðā cnapan of ālǣdde wǣron.
text_bare: Þa cwæð he, 'Rihtlice hi Angle gehatene, for ðan ðe hi engla wlite habbað, and swilcum gedafenað þæt hi on heofonum engla geferan beon.' Gyt ða Gregorius befran, hu ðære scire nama wære þe ða cnapan of alædde wæron.

text: Him man sǣde, þæt ðā scīrmen wǣron Dēre gehātene.
text_bare: Him man sæde, þæt ða scirmen wæron Dere gehatene.

text: Grēgōrius andwyrde, 'Wel hī sind Dēre gehātene, for ðan ðe hī sind fram graman generode, and tō Crīstes milðeortnysse gecȳgede.' Gȳt ðā hē befrān, 'Hū is ðǣre lēode cyninge gehāten?' Him wæs geandswarod, þæt sē cyninge Ælle gehāten wǣre.
text_bare: Gregorius andwyrde, 'Wel hi sind Dere gehatene, for ðan ðe hi sind fram graman generode, and to Cristes milðeortnysse gecygede.' Gyt ða he befran, 'Hu is ðære leode cyninge gehaten?' Him wæs geandswarod, þæt se cyninge Ælle gehaten wære.

text: Hwæt ðā Grēgōrius gamenode mid his wordum tō ðām naman, and cwæð, 'Hit gedafenað þæt Allēlūia sȳ gesungen on ðām lande tō lofe þæs ælmihtigan Scyppendes.'
text_bare: Hwæt ða Gregorius gamenode mid his wordum to ðam naman, and cwæð, 'Hit gedafenað þæt Alleluia sy gesungen on ðam lande to lofe þæs ælmihtigan Scyppendes.'

text: Grēgōrius ðā sōna ēode tō ðām pāpan þæs apostolīcan setles, and hine bæd þæt hē Angelcynne sume lārēowas āsende, ðe hī tō Crīste gebīgden, and cwæð, þæt hē sylf gearo wǣre þæt weorc tō gefremmenne mid Godes fultume, gif hit ðām pāpan swā gelīcode.
text_bare: Gregorius ða sona eode to ðam papan þæs apostolican setles, and hine bæd þæt he Angelcynne sume lareowas asende, ðe hi to Criste gebigden, and cwæð, þæt he sylf gearo wære þæt weorc to gefremmenne mid Godes fultume, gif hit ðam papan swa gelicode.

text: Þā ne mihte sē pāpa þæt geðafian, þēah ðe hē eall wolde; for ðan þe ðā Rōmāniscan ceastergewaran noldon geðafian þæt swā getogen mann and swā geðunguen lārēow þā burh eallunge forlēte, and swā fyrlen wræcsīð genāme.
text_bare: Þa ne mihte se papa þæt geðafian, þeah ðe he eall wolde; for ðan þe ða Romaniscan ceastergewaran noldon geðafian þæt swa getogen mann and swa geðunguen lareow þa burh eallunge forlete, and swa fyrlen wræcsið gename.

text: Æfter ðisum gelamp þæt micel manncwealm becōm ofer ðǣre Rōmāniscan lēode, and ǣrest ðone pāpan Pelāgium gestōd, and būton yldinge ādȳdde.
text_bare: Æfter ðisum gelamp þæt micel manncwealm becom ofer ðære Romaniscan leode, and ærest ðone papan Pelagium gestod, and buton yldinge adydde.

text: Witodlīce æfter ðæs pāpan geendunge, swā micel cwealm wearð þæs folces, þæt gehwǣr stōdon āwēste hūs geond þā burh būton būgigendum.
text_bare: Witodlice æfter ðæs papan geendunge, swa micel cwealm wearð þæs folces, þæt gehwær stodon aweste hus geond þa burh buton bugigendum.

text: Þā ne mihte swā ðēah sēo Rōmānaburh būton pāpan wunian, ac eal folc ðone ēadigan Grēgōrium tō ðǣre geðingðe ānmōdlīce gecēas, þēah ðe hē mid eallum mægne wiðerigende wǣre.
