text_bare: Þa ne mihte swa ðeah seo Romanaburh buton papan wunian, ac eal folc ðone eadigan Gregorium to ðære geðingðe anmodlice geceas, þeah ðe he mid eallum mægne wiðerigende wære.

text: Grēgōrius ðā āsende ǣnne pistol tō ðām cāsere Maurīcium — sē wæs his gefædera — and hine hālsode and micclum bæd, þæt hē nǣfre ðām folce ne geðafode þæt hē mid þæs wurðmyntes wuldre geferod wǣre; for ðan ðe hē ondrēd þæt hē ðurh ðone micclan hād on woruldlīcum wuldre, þe hē ǣr āwearp, æt sumum sǣle bepǣht wurde.
text_bare: Gregorius ða asende ænne pistol to ðam casere Mauricium — se wæs his gefædera — and hine halsode and micclum bæd, þæt he næfre ðam folce ne geðafode þæt he mid þæs wurðmyntes wuldre geferod wære; for ðan ðe he ondred þæt he ðurh ðone micclan had on woruldlicum wuldre, þe he ær awearp, æt sumum sæle bepæht wurde.

text: Ac ðæs cāseres hēahgerēfa, Germānus, gelæhte ðone pistol æt Grēgōries ǣrendracan, and hine tōtær; and siððan cȳdde þām cāsere þæt þæt folc Grēgōrium tō pāpan gecoren hæfde.
text_bare: Ac ðæs caseres heahgerefa, Germanus, gelæhte ðone pistol æt Gregories ærendracan, and hine totær; and siððan cydde þam casere þæt þæt folc Gregorium to papan gecoren hæfde.

text: Maurīcius ðā, sē cāsere, þæs Gode ðancode, and hine gehādian hēt.
text_bare: Mauricius ða, se casere, þæs Gode ðancode, and hine gehadian het.

text: Hwæt ðā Grēgōrius flēames cēpte and on dymhofon ætlūtode; ac hine man gelæhte, and tēah to Pētres cyrcan, þæt hē ðǣre tō pāpan gehalgod wurde.
text_bare: Hwæt ða Gregorius fleames cepte and on dymhofon ætlutode; ac hine man gelæhte, and teah to Petres cyrcan, þæt he ðære to papan gehalgod wurde.

text: Grēgōrius ðā, ǣr his hādunge, þæt Rōmānisce folc for ðām onsīgendum cwealme ðisum wordum tō behrēowsunge tihte:
text_bare: Gregorius ða, ær his hadunge, þæt Romanisce folc for ðam onsigendum cwealme ðisum wordum to behreowsunge tihte:

text: 'Mīne gebrōðra þā lēofostan, ūs gedafenað þæt wē Godes swingle, þe wē on ǣr tōwearde ondrǣdan sceoldon, þæt wē hūru nū andwerde and āfandode ondrǣdan.
text_bare: 'Mine gebroðra þa leofostan, us gedafenað þæt we Godes swingle, þe we on ær towearde ondrædan sceoldon, þæt we huru nu andwerde and afandode ondrædan.

text: Geopenige ūre sārnys ūs infær sōðre gecyrrednysse, and þæt wīte ðe wē ðrōwiað tōbrece ūre heortan heardnysse.
text_bare: Geopenige ure sarnys us infær soðre gecyrrednysse, and þæt wite ðe we ðrowiað tobrece ure heortan heardnysse.

text: Efne nū ðis folc is mid swurde þæs heofonlīcan graman ofslegen, and gehwilce ǣnlīpige sind mid fǣrlīcum slihte āwēste.
text_bare: Efne nu ðis folc is mid swurde þæs heofonlican graman ofslegen, and gehwilce ænlipige sind mid færlicum slihte aweste.

text: Nē sēo ādl ðām dēaðe ne forestæpð, ac gē gesēoð þæt sē sylfa dēað þǣre ādle yldinge forhradað.
text_bare: Ne seo adl ðam deaðe ne forestæpð, ac ge geseoð þæt se sylfa deað þære adle yldinge forhradað.

text: Sē geslagena bið mid dēaðe gegripen, ǣr ðan ðe hē tō hēofungum sōdre behrēowsunge gecyrran mæge.
text_bare: Se geslagena bið mid deaðe gegripen, ær ðan ðe he to heofungum sodre behreowsunge gecyrran mæge.

text: Hogiað for ðī hwilc sē becume ætforan gesihðe þæs strecan Dēman, sē ðe ne mæg þæt yfel bewēpan ðe hē gefremode.
text_bare: Hogiað for ði hwilc se becume ætforan gesihðe þæs strecan Deman, se ðe ne mæg þæt yfel bewepan ðe he gefremode.

text: Gehwilce eorðbūgigende sind ætbrōdene, and heora hūs standað āwēste.
text_bare: Gehwilce eorðbugigende sind ætbrodene, and heora hus standað aweste.

text: Fæderas and mōdru bestandað heora bearna līc, and heora yrfenuman him sylfum tō forwyrde forestæppað.
text_bare: Fæderas and modru bestandað heora bearna lic, and heora yrfenuman him sylfum to forwyrde forestæppað.

text: Uton eornestlīce flēon tō hēofunge sōðre dǣdbōte, þā hwīle ðe wē mōton, ǣr ðan þe sē fǣrlīcan slege ūs āstrecce.
text_bare: Uton eornestlice fleon to heofunge soðre dædbote, þa hwile ðe we moton, ær ðan þe se færlican slege us astrecce.

text: Uton gemunan swā hwæt swā wē dweligende āgylton, and uton mid wōpe gewītnian þæt þæt wē mānfullīce ādrugon.
text_bare: Uton gemunan swa hwæt swa we dweligende agylton, and uton mid wope gewitnian þæt þæt we manfullice adrugon.

text: Uton forhradian Godes ansȳne on andetnysse, swā swā sē wītega ūs manað: 'Uton āhebban ūre heortan mid handum tō Gōde;' þæt is, þæt wē sceolon ðā gecnyrdnysse ūre bēne mid geaarnunge gōdes weorces ūp ārǣran.
text_bare: Uton forhradian Godes ansyne on andetnysse, swa swa se witega us manað: 'Uton ahebban ure heortan mid handum to Gode;' þæt is, þæt we sceolon ða gecnyrdnysse ure bene mid geaarnunge godes weorces up aræran.

text: Hē forgifð trūwan ūre forhtunge, sē ðe þurh his wītengan clypað, "Nylle ic þæs synfullan dēað, ac ic wille þæt hē gecyrre and lybbe."
text_bare: He forgifð truwan ure forhtunge, se ðe þurh his witengan clypað, "Nylle ic þæs synfullan deað, ac ic wille þæt he gecyrre and lybbe."

text: 'Ne geortrūwige nān man hine sylfne for his synna micelnysse; witodlīce ðā ealdan gyltas Niniueiscre ðēode drēora daga behrēowsung ādilegode; and sē gecyrreda sceaða on his dēaðes cwyde þæs ēcan līfes mēde geearnode.
text_bare: 'Ne geortruwige nan man hine sylfne for his synna micelnysse; witodlice ða ealdan gyltas Niniueiscre ðeode dreora daga behreowsung adilegode; and se gecyrreda sceaða on his deaðes cwyde þæs ecan lifes mede geearnode.

text: Uton āwendan ūre heortan; hradlīce bið sē Dēma tō ūrum bēnum gebīged, gif wē fram ūrum ðwyrnyssym bēoð gerihtlǣhte.
text_bare: Uton awendan ure heortan; hradlice bið se Dema to urum benum gebiged, gif we fram urum ðwyrnyssym beoð gerihtlæhte.

text: Uton standan mid gemāglīcum wōpan ongēan ðām onsīgendum swurde swā miccles dōmes.
text_bare: Uton standan mid gemaglicum wopan ongean ðam onsigendum swurde swa miccles domes.

text: Sōðlīce gemāgnys is þām sōðan Dēman gecwēme, þēah ðe hēo mannum unðancwurðe sȳ, for ðan ðe sē ārfæsta and sē milðeorta God wile þæt wē mid gemāglīcum bēnum his milðeortnysse ofgān, and hē nele swā micclum swā wē geearniað ūs geyrsian.
text_bare: Soðlice gemagnys is þam soðan Deman gecweme, þeah ðe heo mannum unðancwurðe sy, for ðan ðe se arfæsta and se milðeorta God wile þæt we mid gemaglicum benum his milðeortnysse ofgan, and he nele swa micclum swa we geearniað us geyrsian.

text: Be ðisum hē cwæð þurh his wītegan, 'Clypa mē on dæge ðīnre gedrēfednysse, and ic ðē āhredde, and ðū mǣrsast mē.' God sylf is his gewita þæt hē miltsian wile him tō clypigendum, sē ðe manað þæt wē him tō clypian sceolon.
text_bare: Be ðisum he cwæð þurh his witegan, 'Clypa me on dæge ðinre gedrefednysse, and ic ðe ahredde, and ðu mærsast me.' God sylf is his gewita þæt he miltsian wile him to clypigendum, se ðe manað þæt we him to clypian sceolon.

text: For ðȳ, mīne gebrōðra þā lēofostan, uton gecuman on ðām fēorðan dæge þysre wucan on ǣrnemerigen, and mid ēstfullum mōde and tēarum singan seofonfealde lētānias þæt sē streca Dēma ūs geārige, þonne hē gesihð þæt wē sylfe ūre gyltas wrecað.'
text_bare: For ðy, mine gebroðra þa leofostan, uton gecuman on ðam feorðan dæge þysre wucan on ærnemerigen, and mid estfullum mode and tearum singan seofonfealde letanias þæt se streca Dema us gearige, þonne he gesihð þæt we sylfe ure gyltas wrecað.'

text: Eornostlīce ðā ðā micel menigu, ǣgðer ge prēosþādes ge munuchādes menn and þæt lǣwede folc, æfter ðæs ēadigan Grēgōries hǣse, on þone wōdnesdæg tō þām seofonfealdum lētānium gecōmon, tō ðām swīðe āwēdde sē foresǣda cwealm, þæt hundeahtatig manna, on ðǣre ānre tīde feallende, of līfe gewiton, ðā hwīle þe þæt folc ðā lētānias sungon.
text_bare: Eornostlice ða ða micel menigu, ægðer ge preosþades ge munuchades menn and þæt læwede folc, æfter ðæs eadigan Gregories hæse, on þone wodnesdæg to þam seofonfealdum letanium gecomon, to ðam swiðe awedde se foresæda cwealm, þæt hundeahtatig manna, on ðære anre tide feallende, of life gewiton, ða hwile þe þæt folc ða letanias sungon.

text: Ac sē hālga sācerd ne geswāc þæt folc tō manigenne, þæt hī ðǣre bēne ne geswicon oð þæt Godes miltsung þone rēðan cwealm gestilde.
text_bare: Ac se halga sacerd ne geswac þæt folc to manigenne, þæt hi ðære bene ne geswicon oð þæt Godes miltsung þone reðan cwealm gestilde.

text: Hwæt ðā Grēgōrius, siððan hē pāpanhād underfēng, gemunde hwæt hē gefyrn Angelcynne gemynte, and ðǣr rihte þæt luftȳme weorc gefremode.
text_bare: Hwæt ða Gregorius, siððan he papanhad underfeng, gemunde hwæt he gefyrn Angelcynne gemynte, and ðær rihte þæt luftyme weorc gefremode.

text: Hē nā tō ðæs hwon ne mihte þone Rōmāniscan bisceopstōl eallunge forlǣtan, ac hē āsende ōðre bydelas, geðungene Godes ðēowan, tō ðysum īglande, and hē sylf micclum mid his bēnum and tihtingum fylste, þæt ðǣre bedela bodung forðgenge, and Gode wæstmbǣre wurde.
text_bare: He na to ðæs hwon ne mihte þone Romaniscan bisceopstol eallunge forlætan, ac he asende oðre bydelas, geðungene Godes ðeowan, to ðysum iglande, and he sylf micclum mid his benum and tihtingum fylste, þæt ðære bedela bodung forðgenge, and Gode wæstmbære wurde.

text: Þǣra bydela naman sind þus gecīgede: Augustīnus, Mellītus, Laurentius, Pētrus, Iōhannes, Iustus.
text_bare: Þæra bydela naman sind þus gecigede: Augustinus, Mellitus, Laurentius, Petrus, Iohannes, Iustus.

text: Ðās lārēowas āsende sē ēadiga pāpa Grēgōrius, mid manegum ōðrum munecum, tō Angelcynne, and hī ðisum wordum tō ðǣre fare tihte: 'Ne bēo gē āfyrhte ðurh geswince þæs langsuman færeldes, oððe þurh yfelra manna ymbesprǣce; ac mid ealre ānrǣdnysse and wylme þǣre sōðan lufe þās ongunnenan ðing þurh Godes fultum gefremmað.
text_bare: Ðas lareowas asende se eadiga papa Gregorius, mid manegum oðrum munecum, to Angelcynne, and hi ðisum wordum to ðære fare tihte: 'Ne beo ge afyrhte ðurh geswince þæs langsuman færeldes, oððe þurh yfelra manna ymbespræce; ac mid ealre anrædnysse and wylme þære soðan lufe þas ongunnenan ðing þurh Godes fultum gefremmað.

text: And wite gē þæt ēower mēd on ðām ēcan edlēane miccle māre bið, swā micclum swā gē māre for Godes willan swincað.
text_bare: And wite ge þæt eower med on ðam ecan edleane miccle mare bið, swa micclum swa ge mare for Godes willan swincað.

text: Gehȳrsumiað ēadmōdlīce on eallum ðingum Augustīne, þone ðe wē eōw tō ealdre gesetton: hit fremað ēowrum sāwlum swā hwæt swā gē be his mynegunge gefyllað.
text_bare: Gehyrsumiað eadmodlice on eallum ðingum Augustine, þone ðe we eow to ealdre gesetton: hit fremað eowrum sawlum swa hwæt swa ge be his mynegunge gefyllað.

text: Sē ælmihtiga God þurh his gife ēow gescylde, and geunne mē þæt ic mōte ēoweres geswinces wæstm on ðām ēcan ēðele gesēon, swā þæt ic bēo gemēt swincan ne mæge, for ðon ðe ic wille swincan.' Augustīnus ðā mid his gefērum, þæt sind gerehte fēowertig wera, fērde be Grēgōries haēse, oð þæt hī tō ðisum īglande gesundfullīce becōmon.
text_bare: Se ælmihtiga God þurh his gife eow gescylde, and geunne me þæt ic mote eoweres geswinces wæstm on ðam ecan eðele geseon, swa þæt ic beo gemet swincan ne mæge, for ðon ðe ic wille swincan.' Augustinus ða mid his geferum, þæt sind gerehte feowertig wera, ferde be Gregories haese, oð þæt hi to ðisum iglande gesundfullice becomon.

text: On ðām dagum rīxode Æþelbryht cyning on Cantwarabyrig rīclīce, and his rīce wæs āstreht fram ðaēre micclan eā Humbre oð sūðsǣ.
text_bare: On ðam dagum rixode Æþelbryht cyning on Cantwarabyrig riclice, and his rice wæs astreht fram ðaere micclan ea Humbre oð suðsæ.

text: Augustīnus hæfde genumen wealhstōdas of Francena rīce, swā swā Grēgōrius him bebēad; and hē ðurh ðaēra wealhstōda mūð þām cyninge and his lēode Godes word bodade: hū sē mildheorta Haēlend mid his āgenre ðrōwunge þysne scyldigan middaneard ālȳsde, and gelēaffullum mannum heofonan rīces infær geopenode.
text_bare: Augustinus hæfde genumen wealhstodas of Francena rice, swa swa Gregorius him bebead; and he ðurh ðaera wealhstoda muð þam cyninge and his leode Godes word bodade: hu se mildheorta Haelend mid his agenre ðrowunge þysne scyldigan middaneard alysde, and geleaffullum mannum heofonan rices infær geopenode.

text: Thā andwyrde sē cyinge Æðelbriht infær geopenode.
text_bare: Tha andwyrde se cyinge Æðelbriht infær geopenode.

text: Þā andwyrde sē cyninge Æðelbriht Augustīne, and cwæð þæt hē fægere word and behāt him cȳdde; and cwæð þæt hē ne mihte swā hrædlīce þone ealdan gewunan ðe hē mid Angelcynne hēold forlaētan; cwæð þæt hē mōste frēolīce ðā heofonlīcan lāre his lēode bodian, and þæt hē him and his gefērum bigleofan ðēnian wolde; and forgeaf him ðā wununge on Cantwarabyrig, sēo wæs easlles his rīces hēafodburh.
text_bare: Þa andwyrde se cyninge Æðelbriht Augustine, and cwæð þæt he fægere word and behat him cydde; and cwæð þæt he ne mihte swa hrædlice þone ealdan gewunan ðe he mid Angelcynne heold forlaetan; cwæð þæt he moste freolice ða heofonlican lare his leode bodian, and þæt he him and his geferum bigleofan ðenian wolde; and forgeaf him ða wununge on Cantwarabyrig, seo wæs easlles his rices heafodburh.

text: Ongann ðā Augustīnus mid his munecum to geefenlǣcenne þǣra apostola līf, mid singālum gebedum and wæccum and fæstenum Gode ðēowingende, and līfe word þām ðe hī mihton bodigende, ealle middanearlīce ðing, swā swā ælfremede, forhogigende; ðā þing āna þe hī tō bigleofan behōfedon underfōnde; be ðām ðe hī tǣhton sylfe lybbende, and for ðǣ sōðfæstnysse ðe hī bodedon gearowe wǣron ēhtnysse tō ðoligenne and dēaðe sweltan, gif hī ðorfton.
text_bare: Ongann ða Augustinus mid his munecum to geefenlæcenne þæra apostola lif, mid singalum gebedum and wæccum and fæstenum Gode ðeowingende, and life word þam ðe hi mihton bodigende, ealle middanearlice ðing, swa swa ælfremede, forhogigende; ða þing ana þe hi to bigleofan behofedon underfonde; be ðam ðe hi tæhton sylfe lybbende, and for ðæ soðfæstnysse ðe hi bodedon gearowe wæron ehtnysse to ðoligenne and deaðe sweltan, gif hi ðorfton.

text: Hwæt ðā gelȳfdon for wel menige, and on Godes naman gefullode wurdon, wundrigende þǣre bilewitnysse heora unscæððigan līfes and þǣre swētnysse heora heofonlīcan lāre.
text_bare: Hwæt ða gelyfdon for wel menige, and on Godes naman gefullode wurdon, wundrigende þære bilewitnysse heora unscæððigan lifes and þære swetnysse heora heofonlican lare.

text: Ðā æt nēxtan gelustfullode ðām cyninge Aeðelbrihte heora clǣne līf and heora wynsume behāt, þā sōðlīce wurdon mid manegum tācnum gesēðde; and hē ðā gelȳfende wearð gefullod, and micclum ðā crīstenan geārwurðode, and swā swā heofonlīce ceastergewaran lufode: nolde hē swā ðēah nǣnne tō crīstendōme genēadian, for ðan ðe hē ofāxode æt ðām lārēowum his hǣle þæt Crīstes ðēowdōm ne sceal bēon genēadad, ac sylfwilles.
text_bare: Ða æt nextan gelustfullode ðam cyninge Aeðelbrihte heora clæne lif and heora wynsume behat, þa soðlice wurdon mid manegum tacnum geseðde; and he ða gelyfende wearð gefullod, and micclum ða cristenan gearwurðode, and swa swa heofonlice ceastergewaran lufode: nolde he swa ðeah nænne to cristendome geneadian, for ðan ðe he ofaxode æt ðam lareowum his hæle þæt Cristes ðeowdom ne sceal beon geneadad, ac sylfwilles.

text: Ongunnon ðā dægwōmlīce for wel menige efstan tō gehȳrenne ðā hālgan bodunge, and forlēton heora hǣðenscipe, and hī sylfe geðēoddon Crīstes gelaðunge, on hine gelȳfende.
text_bare: Ongunnon ða dægwomlice for wel menige efstan to gehyrenne ða halgan bodunge, and forleton heora hæðenscipe, and hi sylfe geðeoddon Cristes gelaðunge, on hine gelyfende.

text: Betwux ðisum gewende Augustīnus ofer sǣ tō ðām ercebisceope Ēthērium, and hē hine gehādode Angelcynne tō ercebisceope, swā swā him Grēgōrius ǣr gewissode.
text_bare: Betwux ðisum gewende Augustinus ofer sæ to ðam ercebisceope Etherium, and he hine gehadode Angelcynne to ercebisceope, swa swa him Gregorius ær gewissode.

text: Augustīnus ðā gehādod cyrde tō his bisceopstōle, and āsende ǣrendracan tō Rōme, and cȳdde ðām ēadigan Grēgōrie þæt Angelcynn crīstendōm underfēng, and hē ēac mid gewritum fela ðinga befrān, hū him tō drohtnigenne wǣre betwux ðām nīghworfenum folce.
text_bare: Augustinus ða gehadod cyrde to his bisceopstole, and asende ærendracan to Rome, and cydde ðam eadigan Gregorie þæt Angelcynn cristendom underfeng, and he eac mid gewritum fela ðinga befran, hu him to drohtnigenne wære betwux ðam nighworfenum folce.

text: Hwæt ðā Grēgōrius micclum Gode ðancode mid blissigendum mōde, þæt Angelcynne swā gelumpen wæs, swā swā hē sylf geornlīce gewilnode, and sende eft ongēan ǣrendracan tō ðām gelēaffullan cyninge Æþelbrihte, mid gewritum and menigfealdum lācum, and ōðre gewritu tō Augustīne, mid andswarum ealra ðǣra ðinga þe hē hine befrān, and hine ēac ðisum wordum manode.
text_bare: Hwæt ða Gregorius micclum Gode ðancode mid blissigendum mode, þæt Angelcynne swa gelumpen wæs, swa swa he sylf geornlice gewilnode, and sende eft ongean ærendracan to ðam geleaffullan cyninge Æþelbrihte, mid gewritum and menigfealdum lacum, and oðre gewritu to Augustine, mid andswarum ealra ðæra ðinga þe he hine befran, and hine eac ðisum wordum manode.

text: 'Brōðer mīn sē lēofosta, ic wāt þæt sē ælmihtiga God fela wundra þurh ðē þǣre ðēode ðe hē gecēas geswutelað þæs þū miht blissigan, and ēac ðē ondrǣdan: þū miht blissigan gewisslīce þæt ðǣre ðēode sāwla þurh ðā ȳttran wundra bēoð getogene tō ðǣre incundan gife; ondrǣd ðē swā ðēah þæt ðīn mōd ne bēo āhafen mid dyrstignysse on ðām tācnum þe God ðurh ðē gefremað, and þū ðonon on īdelum wuldre befealle wiðinnan, þonon ðe ðū wiðūtan on wurðmynte āhafen bist.'
text_bare: 'Broðer min se leofosta, ic wat þæt se ælmihtiga God fela wundra þurh ðe þære ðeode ðe he geceas geswutelað þæs þu miht blissigan, and eac ðe ondrædan: þu miht blissigan gewisslice þæt ðære ðeode sawla þurh ða yttran wundra beoð getogene to ðære incundan gife; ondræd ðe swa ðeah þæt ðin mod ne beo ahafen mid dyrstignysse on ðam tacnum þe God ðurh ðe gefremað, and þu ðonon on idelum wuldre befealle wiðinnan, þonon ðe ðu wiðutan on wurðmynte ahafen bist.'

text: Grēgōrius āsende ēac Augustīne hālige lāc on mæsserēafum, and on bōcum, and ðǣra apostola and martyra reliquias samod; and bebēad þæt his æftergengan symle ðone pallium and ðone ercehād æt ðām apostolīcan setle Rōmāniscre gelaðunge feccan sceoldon.
text_bare: Gregorius asende eac Augustine halige lac on mæssereafum, and on bocum, and ðæra apostola and martyra reliquias samod; and bebead þæt his æftergengan symle ðone pallium and ðone ercehad æt ðam apostolican setle Romaniscre gelaðunge feccan sceoldon.

text: Augustīnus gesette æfter ðisum bisceopas of his gefērum tō gehwilcum burgum on Engla ðēode, and hī on Godes gelēafan ðēonde ðurhwunodon oð ðisum dægðerlīcum dæge.
text_bare: Augustinus gesette æfter ðisum bisceopas of his geferum to gehwilcum burgum on Engla ðeode, and hi on Godes geleafan ðeonde ðurhwunodon oð ðisum dægðerlicum dæge.

text: Sē ēadiga Grēgōrius gedihte manega hālige trahtbēc, and mis mīcelre gecnyrdnysse Godes folc tō ðām ēcan līfe gewissode, and fela wundra on his līfe geworhte, and wuldorfullīce þæs pāpan setles gewēold ðrēottȳne gēar and six mōnðas and tȳn dagas, and siððan on ðisum dæge gewāt tō ðām ēcan setle heofenan rīces, on ðām hē leofað mid Gode ælmihtigum ā on ēcnysse.
text_bare: Se eadiga Gregorius gedihte manega halige trahtbec, and mis micelre gecnyrdnysse Godes folc to ðam ecan life gewissode, and fela wundra on his life geworhte, and wuldorfullice þæs papan setles geweold ðreottyne gear and six monðas and tyn dagas, and siððan on ðisum dæge gewat to ðam ecan setle heofenan rices, on ðam he leofað mid Gode ælmihtigum a on ecnysse.

text: Amen.
text_bare: Amen.

text: Æfter ðam ðe Augustīnus tō Englalande becōm, wæs sum æðele cyning, Ōswold gehāten, on Norðhymbra lande, gelȳfed swȳþe on God.
text_bare: Æfter ðam ðe Augustinus to Englalande becom, wæs sum æðele cyning, Oswold gehaten, on Norðhymbra lande, gelyfed swyþe on God.

text: Sē fērde on his iugoðefram his frēondum and māgum tō Scotlande on sǣ, and þǣr sōna wearð gefullod, and his gefēran samod þe mid him sīþedon.
text_bare: Se ferde on his iugoðefram his freondum and magum to Scotlande on sæ, and þær sona wearð gefullod, and his geferan samod þe mid him siþedon.

text: Betwux þām wearð ofslagen Ēadwine his ēam, Norðhymbra cynincg, on Crīst gelȳfed, fram Brytta cyninge, Ceadwalla gecīged, and wēgen his æftergengan binnan twām gēarum; and sē Ceadwalla slōh ad tō sceame tūcode þā Norðhymbran lēode æfter heora hlāfordes fylle, oðe þæt Ōswold sē ēadiga his yfelnysse ādwǣscte.
text_bare: Betwux þam wearð ofslagen Eadwine his eam, Norðhymbra cynincg, on Crist gelyfed, fram Brytta cyninge, Ceadwalla geciged, and wegen his æftergengan binnan twam gearum; and se Ceadwalla sloh ad to sceame tucode þa Norðhymbran leode æfter heora hlafordes fylle, oðe þæt Oswold se eadiga his yfelnysse adwæscte.

text: Ōswold him cōm tō, and him cēnlīce wið feaht mid lȳtlum weode, ac his gelēafa hine getrymde, and Crīst him gefylste tō his fēonda slege.
text_bare: Oswold him com to, and him cenlice wið feaht mid lytlum weode, ac his geleafa hine getrymde, and Crist him gefylste to his feonda slege.

text: Ōswold þā ārǣrde āne rōde sōna Gode tō worðmynte, ǣr þan þe hē tō ðām gewinne cōme, and clypode tō his gefērum, 'Uton feallan tō ðǣre rōde, and þone Ælmihtigan biddan þæt hē ūs āhredde wið þone mōdigan fēond þe ūs āfyllan wile.
text_bare: Oswold þa arærde ane rode sona Gode to worðmynte, ær þan þe he to ðam gewinne come, and clypode to his geferum, 'Uton feallan to ðære rode, and þone Ælmihtigan biddan þæt he us ahredde wið þone modigan feond þe us afyllan wile.

text: God sylf wāt geare þæt wē winnað rihtlīce wið þysne rēðan cyning tō āhreddenne ūre lēode.' Hī fēollon þā ealle mid Ōswolde cyning on gebedum; and syþþan on ōðerne mergen ēodon tō þām gefeohte, and gewunnon þǣr sige, swā swā sē Eallwealdend heom ūðe for Ōswoldes gelēafan; and ālēdon heora fȳnd, þone mōdigan Cedwallan mid his micclan werode, þe wēnde þæt him ne mihte nān weod wiðstandan.
text_bare: God sylf wat geare þæt we winnað rihtlice wið þysne reðan cyning to ahreddenne ure leode.' Hi feollon þa ealle mid Oswolde cyning on gebedum; and syþþan on oðerne mergen eodon to þam gefeohte, and gewunnon þær sige, swa swa se Eallwealdend heom uðe for Oswoldes geleafan; and aledon heora fynd, þone modigan Cedwallan mid his micclan werode, þe wende þæt him ne mihte nan weod wiðstandan.

text: Sēo ylce rōd siððan, ðe Ōswold þǣr ārǣrde, on wurðmynte þǣr stōd.
text_bare: Seo ylce rod siððan, ðe Oswold þær arærde, on wurðmynte þær stod.

text: And wurdon fela gehǣlde untrumra manna and ēac swilce nȳtena þurh ðā ylcan rōde, swā swā ūs rehte Bēda.
text_bare: And wurdon fela gehælde untrumra manna and eac swilce nytena þurh ða ylcan rode, swa swa us rehte Beda.

text: Sum man fēoll on īse, þæt his earm tōbærst, and læg þā on bedde gebrocod for þearle, oð þæt man him fette of ðǣre foresǣdon rōde sumne dǣl þæs mēoses þe hēo mid beweaxan wæs, and sē ādliga sōna on slǣpe wearð gehǣled on ðǣre ylcan nihte þurh Ōswoldes geearnungum.
text_bare: Sum man feoll on ise, þæt his earm tobærst, and læg þa on bedde gebrocod for þearle, oð þæt man him fette of ðære foresædon rode sumne dæl þæs meoses þe heo mid beweaxan wæs, and se adliga sona on slæpe wearð gehæled on ðære ylcan nihte þurh Oswoldes geearnungum.

text: Sēo stōw is gehāten 'Heofonfeld' on Englisc, wið ðone langan weall þe þā Rōmaniscan worhtan, þǣr þǣr Ōswold oferwann þone wælhrēowan cynincg.
text_bare: Seo stow is gehaten 'Heofonfeld' on Englisc, wið ðone langan weall þe þa Romaniscan worhtan, þær þær Oswold oferwann þone wælhreowan cynincg.

text: And þǣr wearð siþþan ānrǣred swīðe mǣre cyrce Gode tō wurðmynte, þe wunað ā on ēcnysse.
text_bare: And þær wearð siþþan anræred swiðe mære cyrce Gode to wurðmynte, þe wunað a on ecnysse.

text: Hwæt ðā Ōswold ongann embe Godes willan tō smēagenne, sōna swā hē rīces gewēold, and wolde gebīgan his lēoda tō gelēafan and tō þām lifigendan Gode.
text_bare: Hwæt ða Oswold ongann embe Godes willan to smeagenne, sona swa he rices geweold, and wolde gebigan his leoda to geleafan and to þam lifigendan Gode.

text: Sende ðā tō Scotlande, þǣr sē gelēafa wæs ðā, and bæd ðā hēafodmenn þæt hī his lēoda mihte tō Gode gewēman; and him wearð þæs getīþod.
text_bare: Sende ða to Scotlande, þær se geleafa wæs ða, and bæd ða heafodmenn þæt hi his leoda mihte to Gode geweman; and him wearð þæs getiþod.

text: Hī sendon þā sōna þām gesǣligan cyninge sumne ārwurðne bisceop, Aidān gehāten.
text_bare: Hi sendon þa sona þam gesæligan cyninge sumne arwurðne bisceop, Aidan gehaten.

text: Sē wæs mǣres līfes man on munuclīcre drohtnunge, and hē ealle woruldcara āwearp fram his heortan, nānes þinges wilnigende būtan Godes willan.
text_bare: Se wæs mæres lifes man on munuclicre drohtnunge, and he ealle woruldcara awearp fram his heortan, nanes þinges wilnigende butan Godes willan.

text: Swā hwæt swā him becōm of þæs cyninges gifum oððe rīcra manna, þæt hē hraðe dǣlde þearfum and wǣdlum mid welwillendum mōde.
text_bare: Swa hwæt swa him becom of þæs cyninges gifum oððe ricra manna, þæt he hraðe dælde þearfum and wædlum mid welwillendum mode.

text: Hwæt ðā Ōswold cyning his cymes fægnode, and hine ārwurðlīce underfēng his folce tō ðearfe, þæt heora gelēafa wurde āwend eft tō Gode fram þām wiþersæce þe hī tō gewende wǣron.
text_bare: Hwæt ða Oswold cyning his cymes fægnode, and hine arwurðlice underfeng his folce to ðearfe, þæt heora geleafa wurde awend eft to Gode fram þam wiþersæce þe hi to gewende wæron.

text: Hit gelamp þā swā þæt sē gelēaffula cyning gerehte his witan on heora āgenum gereorde þæs bisceopes bodunge mid blīþum mōde, and wæs his wealhstōd; for þan þe hē wel cūþe Scyttysc, and sē bisceop Aidān ne mihte gebīgan his sprǣce tō Norðhymbriscum gereorde swā hraþe þā git.
text_bare: Hit gelamp þa swa þæt se geleaffula cyning gerehte his witan on heora agenum gereorde þæs bisceopes bodunge mid bliþum mode, and wæs his wealhstod; for þan þe he wel cuþe Scyttysc, and se bisceop Aidan ne mihte gebigan his spræce to Norðhymbriscum gereorde swa hraþe þa git.

text: Sē bisceop þā fērde bodigende geond eall Norðhymbra land gelēafan, and him wel gebȳsnode mid weorcum symle, and sylf swā leofode swā swā hē lǣrde ōðre.
text_bare: Se bisceop þa ferde bodigende geond eall Norðhymbra land geleafan, and him wel gebysnode mid weorcum symle, and sylf swa leofode swa swa he lærde oðre.

text: Hē lufode forhæfednysse and hālige rǣdinge, and iunge men tēah georne mid lāre, swā þæt ealle his gefēran þe him mid ēodon sceoldon sealmas leornian oððe sume rǣdinge swā hwider swā hī fērdon þām folce bodigende.
text_bare: He lufode forhæfednysse and halige rædinge, and iunge men teah georne mid lare, swa þæt ealle his geferan þe him mid eodon sceoldon sealmas leornian oððe sume rædinge swa hwider swa hi ferdon þam folce bodigende.

text: Seldon hē wolde rīdan, ac sīðode on his fōtum, and munuclīce leofode betwux ðām lǣwedan folce mid mycelre gescēadwīsnysse and sōþum mægnum.
text_bare: Seldon he wolde ridan, ac siðode on his fotum, and munuclice leofode betwux ðam læwedan folce mid mycelre gesceadwisnysse and soþum mægnum.

text: Þā wearð sē cynincg Ōswold swīðe ælmesgeorn and ēadmōd on þēawum and on eallum þingum cystig, and man ārǣrde cyrcan on his rīce geond eall and mynsterlīce gesetnyssa mid micelre geornfulnysse.
text_bare: Þa wearð se cynincg Oswold swiðe ælmesgeorn and eadmod on þeawum and on eallum þingum cystig, and man arærde cyrcan on his rice geond eall and mynsterlice gesetnyssa mid micelre geornfulnysse.

text: Hit gelamp on sumne sǣl þæt hī sǣton ætgædere, Ōswold and Aidān, on þām hālgan ēasterdæge; þā bær man þām cyninge cynelīce þēnunga on ānum sylfrenan disce; and sōna þā inn ēode ān þæs cyninges þegna þe his ælmyssan bewiste, and sǣde þæt fela þearfan sǣtan geond þā strǣt gehwanon cumene tō þæs cyninges ælmyssab, Þā sende sē cyning sōna þām þearfum þone sylfrenan disc mid sande mid ealle, and hēt tōcearfan þone disc and syllan þām þearfum heora ǣlcum his dǣl; and man dyde ðā swā.
text_bare: Hit gelamp on sumne sæl þæt hi sæton ætgædere, Oswold and Aidan, on þam halgan easterdæge; þa bær man þam cyninge cynelice þenunga on anum sylfrenan disce; and sona þa inn eode an þæs cyninges þegna þe his ælmyssan bewiste, and sæde þæt fela þearfan sætan geond þa stræt gehwanon cumene to þæs cyninges ælmyssab, Þa sende se cyning sona þam þearfum þone sylfrenan disc mid sande mid ealle, and het tocearfan þone disc and syllan þam þearfum heora ælcum his dæl; and man dyde ða swa.

text: Þā genam Aidānus sē æðela bisceop þæs cyninges swȳþran hand mid swīðlīcre blysse, and clypode mid gelēafan, þus cweðende him tō, 'Ne forrotige on brosnunge þēos geblētsode swȳðre hand.' And him ēac swā geēode, swā swā Aidānus him bæd, þæt his swīðre hand is gesundful oð þis.
text_bare: Þa genam Aidanus se æðela bisceop þæs cyninges swyþran hand mid swiðlicre blysse, and clypode mid geleafan, þus cweðende him to, 'Ne forrotige on brosnunge þeos gebletsode swyðre hand.' And him eac swa geeode, swa swa Aidanus him bæd, þæt his swiðre hand is gesundful oð þis.

text: Ōswoldes cynerīce wearð gerȳmed þā swȳðe, swā þæt fēower þēoda hine underfēngon tō hlāforde, Peohtas, and Bryttas, Scottas, and Angle, swā swā sē ælmihtiga God hī geānlǣhte tō ðām for Ōswoldes gearnungum þe hine ǣfre wurðode.
text_bare: Oswoldes cynerice wearð gerymed þa swyðe, swa þæt feower þeoda hine underfengon to hlaforde, Peohtas, and Bryttas, Scottas, and Angle, swa swa se ælmihtiga God hi geanlæhte to ðam for Oswoldes gearnungum þe hine æfre wurðode.

text: Hē fulworhte on Eferwīc þæt ǣnlīce mynster þe his mǣg Ēadwine ǣr begunnen hæfde; and hē swanc for heofonan rīce mid singālum gebedum swīþor þonne hē hogode hū hē gehēolde on worulde þā hwīlwendlīcan geþincðu, þe hē hwōnlīce lufode.
text_bare: He fulworhte on Eferwic þæt ænlice mynster þe his mæg Eadwine ær begunnen hæfde; and he swanc for heofonan rice mid singalum gebedum swiþor þonne he hogode hu he geheolde on worulde þa hwilwendlican geþincðu, þe he hwonlice lufode.

text: Hē wolde æfter ūhtsange oftost hine gebiddan, and on cyrcan standan on syndrigum gebedum on sunnan ūpgange mid swȳðlīcre onbryrdnysse; and swā hwǣr swā hē wæs, hē wurðode ǣfre Gode ūpāwendum handbredum wið þæs heofones Weard.
text_bare: He wolde æfter uhtsange oftost hine gebiddan, and on cyrcan standan on syndrigum gebedum on sunnan upgange mid swyðlicre onbryrdnysse; and swa hwær swa he wæs, he wurðode æfre Gode upawendum handbredum wið þæs heofones Weard.

text: On þām ylcan tīman cōm ēac sum bisceop fram Rōmebyrig, Birinus gehāten, tō Westseaxena kyninge, Cynegyls gehāten, sē wæs ðā gīt hǣðen and eall Westsexena land.
text_bare: On þam ylcan timan com eac sum bisceop fram Romebyrig, Birinus gehaten, to Westseaxena kyninge, Cynegyls gehaten, se wæs ða git hæðen and eall Westsexena land.

text: Birinus witodlīce gewende fram Rōme be ðæs pāpan rǣde þe ðā on Rōme wæs, and behēt þæt hē wolde Godes willan gefremman, and bodian þām hǣþenum þæs Hǣlendes naman and þone sōðan gelēafan on fyrlenum landum.
text_bare: Birinus witodlice gewende fram Rome be ðæs papan ræde þe ða on Rome wæs, and behet þæt he wolde Godes willan gefremman, and bodian þam hæþenum þæs Hælendes naman and þone soðan geleafan on fyrlenum landum.

text: Þā becōm hē tō Westseaxan, þe wæs ðā gȳt hǣþen, and gebīgde þone cynincg Kynegyls tō Gode, and ealle his lēode tō gelēafan mid him.
text_bare: Þa becom he to Westseaxan, þe wæs ða gyt hæþen, and gebigde þone cynincg Kynegyls to Gode, and ealle his leode to geleafan mid him.

text: Hit gelamp þā swā þæt sē gelēaffulla Ōswold, Norðhymbra cyning, wæs cumen tō Cynegylse, and hine tō fulluhte nam, fægen his gecyrrednysse.
text_bare: Hit gelamp þa swa þæt se geleaffulla Oswold, Norðhymbra cyning, wæs cumen to Cynegylse, and hine to fulluhte nam, fægen his gecyrrednysse.

text: Þā gēafon þā cynegas, Cynegyls and Ōswold, þām hālgan Birine him to bisceopstōle þā burh Dorcanceaster, and hē þǣr binnan wunode Godes lof ārǣrende, and gerihtlǣcende þæt folc mid lāre tō gelēafan tō langum fyrste, oð þæt hē gesǣlig sīþode tō Crīste; and his līc wearþ bebyrged on ðǣre ylcan byrig, oð þæt Hædde bisceop eft his bān ferode to Wintanceastre, and mid wurðmynte gelōgode binnan Ealdanmynstre, þǣr man hine wurðað gȳt.
text_bare: Þa geafon þa cynegas, Cynegyls and Oswold, þam halgan Birine him to bisceopstole þa burh Dorcanceaster, and he þær binnan wunode Godes lof arærende, and gerihtlæcende þæt folc mid lare to geleafan to langum fyrste, oð þæt he gesælig siþode to Criste; and his lic wearþ bebyrged on ðære ylcan byrig, oð þæt Hædde bisceop eft his ban ferode to Wintanceastre, and mid wurðmynte gelogode binnan Ealdanmynstre, þær man hine wurðað gyt.

text: Hwæt þā Ōswold cyning his cynedōm gehēold hlīsfullīce for worulde and mid micclum gelēafan, and on eallum dǣdum his Drihten ārwurðode, oð þæt hē ofslagen wearð for his folces ware on þām nigoðan gēare þe hē rīces gewēold, þā þā hē sylf wæs on ylde eahta and þrīttig geara.
text_bare: Hwæt þa Oswold cyning his cynedom geheold hlisfullice for worulde and mid micclum geleafan, and on eallum dædum his Drihten arwurðode, oð þæt he ofslagen wearð for his folces ware on þam nigoðan geare þe he rices geweold, þa þa he sylf wæs on ylde eahta and þrittig geara.

text: Hit gewearð swā be þām þæt him wann on Penda, Myrcena cyning, þe æt his mǣges slege ǣr, Ēadwines cyninges Ceadwallan fylste; and sē Penda ne cūðe be Crīste nān þincg, and eall Myrcena folc wæs ungefullod þā gīt.
text_bare: Hit gewearð swa be þam þæt him wann on Penda, Myrcena cyning, þe æt his mæges slege ær, Eadwines cyninges Ceadwallan fylste; and se Penda ne cuðe be Criste nan þincg, and eall Myrcena folc wæs ungefullod þa git.

text: Hī cōmon þā to gefeohte tō Maserfelda begen, and fēngon tōgædere oð þæt þǣr fēollon þā crīstenan, and þā hǣðenan genēalǣhton to þām hālgan Ōswolde.
text_bare: Hi comon þa to gefeohte to Maserfelda begen, and fengon togædere oð þæt þær feollon þa cristenan, and þa hæðenan genealæhton to þam halgan Oswolde.

text: Þā geseah hē genēalǣcan his līfes geendunge, and gebæd for his folc þe þǣr feallende swealt, and betǣhte heora sāwla and hine sylfne Gode, and þus clypode on his fylle, 'God gemiltsa ūrum sawlum!' Þā hēt sē hǣþena cynincg his hēafod of āslēan and his swīðran earm, and settan hī tō myrcelse.
text_bare: Þa geseah he genealæcan his lifes geendunge, and gebæd for his folc þe þær feallende swealt, and betæhte heora sawla and hine sylfne Gode, and þus clypode on his fylle, 'God gemiltsa urum sawlum!' Þa het se hæþena cynincg his heafod of aslean and his swiðran earm, and settan hi to myrcelse.

text: Þā æfter Ōswoldes slege, fēng Ōswig his brōðor to Norðhymbra rīce, and rād mid werode tō þǣr his brōðor hēafod stōd on stacan gefæstnod, and genam þæt hēafod and his swīðran hand, and mid ārwurðnysse ferode tō Lindisfarnēa cyrcan.
text_bare: Þa æfter Oswoldes slege, feng Oswig his broðor to Norðhymbra rice, and rad mid werode to þær his broðor heafod stod on stacan gefæstnod, and genam þæt heafod and his swiðran hand, and mid arwurðnysse ferode to Lindisfarnea cyrcan.

text: Þā wearð gefylled swā wē hēr foresǣdon, þæt his swīðre hand wunað hāl mid þām flǣsce būtan ǣlcere brosnunge, swā sē bisceop gecwæð.
text_bare: Þa wearð gefylled swa we her foresædon, þæt his swiðre hand wunað hal mid þam flæsce butan ælcere brosnunge, swa se bisceop gecwæð.

text: Sē earm wearð gelēd ārwurðlīce on scrīne of seolfre āsmiþod, on Sancte Pētres mynstre binnan Bebbanbyrig be þǣre sǣ strande, and līð þǣr swā ansund swā hē of āslagen wæs.
text_bare: Se earm wearð geled arwurðlice on scrine of seolfre asmiþod, on Sancte Petres mynstre binnan Bebbanbyrig be þære sæ strande, and lið þær swa ansund swa he of aslagen wæs.

text: His brōðor dohtor eft siððan on Myrcan wearð cwēn, and geāxode his bān and gebrōhte hī to Lindesīge tō Bardanīge mynstre, þe hēo micclum lufode.
text_bare: His broðor dohtor eft siððan on Myrcan wearð cwen, and geaxode his ban and gebrohte hi to Lindesige to Bardanige mynstre, þe heo micclum lufode.

text: Ac þā mynstermenn noldon for menniscum gedwylde þone sanct underfon, ac man slōh ān geteld ofer þā hālgan bān binnan þǣre līcreste.
text_bare: Ac þa mynstermenn noldon for menniscum gedwylde þone sanct underfon, ac man sloh an geteld ofer þa halgan ban binnan þære licreste.

text: Hwæt þā God geswutelode þæt hē hālig sanct wæs, swā þæt heofonlīc lēoht ofer þæt geteld āstreht stōd ūp tō heofonum swilce hēalīc sunnbēam ofer ealle ðā niht, and þā lēoda behēoldon geond ealle þā scīre swīðe wundrigende.
text_bare: Hwæt þa God geswutelode þæt he halig sanct wæs, swa þæt heofonlic leoht ofer þæt geteld astreht stod up to heofonum swilce healic sunnbeam ofer ealle ða niht, and þa leoda beheoldon geond ealle þa scire swiðe wundrigende.

text: Þā wurdon þā mynstermen micclum āfyrhte, and bǣdon þæs on mergen þæt hī mōston þone sanct mid ārwurðnysse underfōn, þone þe hī ǣr forsōcon.
text_bare: Þa wurdon þa mynstermen micclum afyrhte, and bædon þæs on mergen þæt hi moston þone sanct mid arwurðnysse underfon, þone þe hi ær forsocon.

text: Þā ðwōh man þā hālgan bān and bær intō þǣre cyrcan ārwurðlīce on scrīne, and gelōgodon hī ūpp.
text_bare: Þa ðwoh man þa halgan ban and bær into þære cyrcan arwurðlice on scrine, and gelogodon hi upp.

text: And þǣr wurdon gehǣlede þurh his hālgan geearnunge fela mettrume menn fram mislicum coþum.
text_bare: And þær wurdon gehælede þurh his halgan geearnunge fela mettrume menn fram mislicum coþum.

text: Þæt wæter þe man þā bān mid āþwōh binnan þǣre cyrcan wearð āgoten swā on ānre hyrnan; and sēo eorðe siþþan þe þæt wæter underfēng wearð manegum tō bōte.
text_bare: Þæt wæter þe man þa ban mid aþwoh binnan þære cyrcan wearð agoten swa on anre hyrnan; and seo eorðe siþþan þe þæt wæter underfeng wearð manegum to bote.

text: Mid þām dūste wurdon āflīgde dēofla fram mannum, þā þe on wōdnysse ǣr wǣron gedrehte.
text_bare: Mid þam duste wurdon afligde deofla fram mannum, þa þe on wodnysse ær wæron gedrehte.

text: Ēac swilce þǣr hē fēol on þām gefeohte ofslagen men nāmon þā eorðan to ādligum mannum, and dydon on wæter wanhālum to þicgenne, and hī wurdon gehǣlede þurh þone hālgan wer.
text_bare: Eac swilce þær he feol on þam gefeohte ofslagen men namon þa eorðan to adligum mannum, and dydon on wæter wanhalum to þicgenne, and hi wurdon gehælede þurh þone halgan wer.

text: Sum wegfarende man fērde wið þone feld; þā wearð his hors gesicclod, and sōna þǣr fēol, wælwigende geond ðā eorðan wōdum gelīcost.
text_bare: Sum wegfarende man ferde wið þone feld; þa wearð his hors gesicclod, and sona þær feol, wælwigende geond ða eorðan wodum gelicost.

text: Mid þām þe hit swā wealwode geond þone wīdgillan feld, þā becōm hit embe lang þǣr sē cynincg Ōswold on þām gefeohte fēoll, swā swā wē ǣr foresǣdan; and hit sōna ārās swā hit hrepode þā stōwe, hāl eallum limum, and sē hlāford þæs fægnode.
text_bare: Mid þam þe hit swa wealwode geond þone widgillan feld, þa becom hit embe lang þær se cynincg Oswold on þam gefeohte feoll, swa swa we ær foresædan; and hit sona aras swa hit hrepode þa stowe, hal eallum limum, and se hlaford þæs fægnode.

text: Sē ridda þā ferde forð on his weg þider hē gemynt hæfde.
text_bare: Se ridda þa ferde forð on his weg þider he gemynt hæfde.

text: Þā wæs þǣr ān mǣden licgende on paralysin lange gebrocod.
text_bare: Þa wæs þær an mæden licgende on paralysin lange gebrocod.

text: Hē began þā tō gereccenne hū him on rāde getīmode, and mann ferode þæt mǣden tō þǣre foresǣdan stōwe.
text_bare: He began þa to gereccenne hu him on rade getimode, and mann ferode þæt mæden to þære foresædan stowe.

text: Hēo wearð þā on slǣpe, and sōna eft āwōc ansund eallum limum fram þām egeslīcan broce.
text_bare: Heo wearð þa on slæpe, and sona eft awoc ansund eallum limum fram þam egeslican broce.

text: Band þā hire hēafod and blīðe hām fērde, gangænde on fōtum, swā hēo gefyrn ǣr ne dyde.
text_bare: Band þa hire heafod and bliðe ham ferde, gangænde on fotum, swa heo gefyrn ær ne dyde.

text: Eft siððan fērde ēac sum ǣrendfæst ridda be ðǣre ylcan stōwe, and geband on ānum clāþe of þām hālgan dūste þǣre dēorwurðan stōwe, and lǣdde forð mid him þǣr hē fundode to; þā gemētte hē gebēoras blīðe æt þām hūse.
text_bare: Eft siððan ferde eac sum ærendfæst ridda be ðære ylcan stowe, and geband on anum claþe of þam halgan duste þære deorwurðan stowe, and lædde forð mid him þær he fundode to; þa gemette he gebeoras bliðe æt þam huse.

text: Hē āhēng þā þæt dūst on ǣnne hēahne post and sæt mid þām gebēorum blissigende samod.
text_bare: He aheng þa þæt dust on ænne heahne post and sæt mid þam gebeorum blissigende samod.

text: Man worhte þā micel fȳr tōmiddes ðām gebēorum, and þā spearcan wundon wið þæs hrōfes swȳðe, oð þæt þæt hūs fǣrlīce eall on fȳre wearð, and þā gebēoras flugon āfyrhte aweg.
text_bare: Man worhte þa micel fyr tomiddes ðam gebeorum, and þa spearcan wundon wið þæs hrofes swyðe, oð þæt þæt hus færlice eall on fyre wearð, and þa gebeoras flugon afyrhte aweg.

text: Þæt hūs wearþ ðā forburnon būton þām ānum poste þe þæt hālige dūst on āhangen wæs: sē post āna ætstōd ansund mid þām duste; and hī swȳðe wundrodon þæs hālgan weres geearnunga, þæt þæt fȳr ne mihte þā moldan forbærnan.
text_bare: Þæt hus wearþ ða forburnon buton þam anum poste þe þæt halige dust on ahangen wæs: se post ana ætstod ansund mid þam duste; and hi swyðe wundrodon þæs halgan weres geearnunga, þæt þæt fyr ne mihte þa moldan forbærnan.

text: And manega menn siððan gesōhton þone stede heora hǣle feccende, and heora frēonda gehwilcum.
text_bare: And manega menn siððan gesohton þone stede heora hæle feccende, and heora freonda gehwilcum.

text: Þā āsprang his hlīsa geond þā land wide, and ēac swilce tō Īrlande and ēac sūþ to Franclande, swā swā sum mæsseprēost be ānum men sǣde.
text_bare: Þa asprang his hlisa geond þa land wide, and eac swilce to Irlande and eac suþ to Franclande, swa swa sum mæssepreost be anum men sæde.

text: Sē prēost cwæð þæt ān wer wǣre on Īrlande gelǣred, sē ne gymde his lāre, and hē līthwōn hogode embe his sāwle þearfe oððe his Scyppendes beboda, ac ādrēah his līf on dyslīcum weorcum, oð ðæt hē wearð geuntrumod and tō ende gebrōht.
text_bare: Se preost cwæð þæt an wer wære on Irlande gelæred, se ne gymde his lare, and he lithwon hogode embe his sawle þearfe oððe his Scyppendes beboda, ac adreah his lif on dyslicum weorcum, oð ðæt he wearð geuntrumod and to ende gebroht.

text: Þā clypode hē þone prēost þe hit cȳdde eft þus, and cwæð him tō sōna mid sārlīcre stemne, 'Nū ic sceall geendian earmlīcum dēaþe, and tō helle faran for fracodum dǣdum, nū wolde ic gebētan gif ic ābīdan mōste, and tō Gode gecyrran and to gōdum þēawum, and mīn līf āwendan eall tō Godes willan; and ic wāt þæt ic ne eom wyrðe þæs fyrstes būton sum halga mē þingie tō þām Hǣlende Crīste.
text_bare: Þa clypode he þone preost þe hit cydde eft þus, and cwæð him to sona mid sarlicre stemne, 'Nu ic sceall geendian earmlicum deaþe, and to helle faran for fracodum dædum, nu wolde ic gebetan gif ic abidan moste, and to Gode gecyrran and to godum þeawum, and min lif awendan eall to Godes willan; and ic wat þæt ic ne eom wyrðe þæs fyrstes buton sum halga me þingie to þam Hælende Criste.

text: Nū is ūs gesǣd þæt sum hālig cyning is on ēowrum earde, Ōswold gehāten.
text_bare: Nu is us gesæd þæt sum halig cyning is on eowrum earde, Oswold gehaten.

text: Nū gif þū ǣnig þincg hæfst of þæs hālgan reliquium, syle mē, ic þē bidde.' Ðā sǣde sē prēost him, 'Ic hæbbe of þām stocce þe his hēafod on stōd, and gif þū gelyfan wylt, þū wurþest hāl sōna.' Hwæt þā sē mæsseprēost þæs mannes ofhrēow, and scōf on hālig wæter of þām hālgan trēowe, sealde þām ādligan of tō sūpenne, and hē sōna gewyrpte, and syððan leofode lange on wurulde, and gewende tō Gode mid eallre heortan and mid hālgum weorcum; and swā hwider swā hē cōm, hē cydde þās wundra.
text_bare: Nu gif þu ænig þincg hæfst of þæs halgan reliquium, syle me, ic þe bidde.' Ða sæde se preost him, 'Ic hæbbe of þam stocce þe his heafod on stod, and gif þu gelyfan wylt, þu wurþest hal sona.' Hwæt þa se mæssepreost þæs mannes ofhreow, and scof on halig wæter of þam halgan treowe, sealde þam adligan of to supenne, and he sona gewyrpte, and syððan leofode lange on wurulde, and gewende to Gode mid eallre heortan and mid halgum weorcum; and swa hwider swa he com, he cydde þas wundra.

text: For þȳ ne sceall nān mann āwǣgan þæt hē sylfwylles behǣt þām ælmihtigan Gode, þonne hē ādlig bið, þē lǣs þe hē sylf losige, gif hē ālīhð Gode þæt.
text_bare: For þy ne sceall nan mann awægan þæt he sylfwylles behæt þam ælmihtigan Gode, þonne he adlig bið, þe læs þe he sylf losige, gif he alihð Gode þæt.

text: Nu cwæð sē hālga Bēda, þe ðās bōc gedihte, þæt hit nān wundor nys, þæt sē hālga cynincg untrumnysse gehǣle, nū hē on heofonum leofað, for ðan þe hē wolde gehelpan, þā þā hē hēr on līfe wæs, þearfum and wannhālum, and him bigwiste syllan.
text_bare: Nu cwæð se halga Beda, þe ðas boc gedihte, þæt hit nan wundor nys, þæt se halga cynincg untrumnysse gehæle, nu he on heofonum leofað, for ðan þe he wolde gehelpan, þa þa he her on life wæs, þearfum and wannhalum, and him bigwiste syllan.

text: Nū hæfð hē þone wurðmynt on þǣre ēcan worulde, mid þām ælmihtigan Gode for his gōdnysse.
text_bare: Nu hæfð he þone wurðmynt on þære ecan worulde, mid þam ælmihtigan Gode for his godnysse.

text: Eft sē hālga Cuðberht, þā þā hē gīt cnapa wæs, geseah hū Godes englas feredon Aidānes sāwle, þæs hālgan bisceopes, blīðe tō heofonum to þām ēcan wuldre þe hē on worulde geearnode.
text_bare: Eft se halga Cuðberht, þa þa he git cnapa wæs, geseah hu Godes englas feredon Aidanes sawle, þæs halgan bisceopes, bliðe to heofonum to þam ecan wuldre þe he on worulde geearnode.

text: Þæs hālgan Ōswoldes bān wurdon eft gebrōht æfter manegum gēarum to Myrcena lande intō Glēawceastre; and God þǣr geswutelode oft feala wundra þurh þone hālgan wer.
text_bare: Þæs halgan Oswoldes ban wurdon eft gebroht æfter manegum gearum to Myrcena lande into Gleawceastre; and God þær geswutelode oft feala wundra þurh þone halgan wer.

text: Sy þæs wuldor þām ælmihtigan Gode, ðe on ecnysse riīxað a tō worulde.
text_bare: Sy þæs wuldor þam ælmihtigan Gode, ðe on ecnysse riixað a to worulde.

text: Amen.
text_bare: Amen.

text: Ælfric munuc grēt Æðelwærd ealdormann ēadmōdlīce.
text_bare: Ælfric munuc gret Æðelwærd ealdormann eadmodlice.

text: Þū bǣde mē, lēof, þæt ic sceolde ðē āwendan of Lēdene on Englisc þā bōc Genesis: þā þūhte mē hefigtīme þē tō tīðienne þæs, and þū cwǣde þā þæt ic ne þorfte nā māre āwendan þǣre bēc būton tō Isaace, Abrahāmes suna, for þām þe sum ōðer man þē hæfde āwend fram Isaace þā bōc oð ende.
text_bare: Þu bæde me, leof, þæt ic sceolde ðe awendan of Ledene on Englisc þa boc Genesis: þa þuhte me hefigtime þe to tiðienne þæs, and þu cwæde þa þæt ic ne þorfte na mare awendan þære bec buton to Isaace, Abrahames suna, for þam þe sum oðer man þe hæfde awend fram Isaace þa boc oð ende.

text: Nū þincð mē, lēof, þæt þæt weorc is swīðe plēolīc mē oððe ǣnigum men tō underbeginnenne, for þan þe ic ondrǣde, gif sum dysig man þās bōc rǣt oððe rǣdan gehȳrð, þæt hē wille wēnan þæt hē mōte lybban nū on þǣre nīwan ǣ swā swā men leofodon under Moyses ǣ.
text_bare: Nu þincð me, leof, þæt þæt weorc is swiðe pleolic me oððe ænigum men to underbeginnenne, for þan þe ic ondræde, gif sum dysig man þas boc ræt oððe rædan gehyrð, þæt he wille wenan þæt he mote lybban nu on þære niwan æ swa swa men leofodon under Moyses æ.

text: Hwīlon ic wiste þæt sum mæsseprēost, sē þe mīn magister wæs on þām tīman, hæfde þā bōc Genesis, and hē cūðe be dǣle Lȳden understandan; þā cwæð hē be þām hēahfædere Iācōbe, þæt hē hæfde fēower wīf, twā geswustra and heora twā þīnena.
text_bare: Hwilon ic wiste þæt sum mæssepreost, se þe min magister wæs on þam timan, hæfde þa boc Genesis, and he cuðe be dæle Lyden understandan; þa cwæð he be þam heahfædere Iacobe, þæt he hæfde feower wif, twa geswustra and heora twa þinena.

text: Ful sōð hē sǣde, ac hē nyste, nē ic þā gīt, hū micel tōdāl ys betweohx þǣre ealdan ǣ and þǣre nīwan.
text_bare: Ful soð he sæde, ac he nyste, ne ic þa git, hu micel todal ys betweohx þære ealdan æ and þære niwan.

text: On anginne þisere worulde nam sē brōðor hys swuster tō wīfe, and hwīlon sē fæder tȳmde bī his āgenra dehter, and manega hæfdon mā wīfa tō folces ēacan, and man ne mihte þā æt fruman wīfian būton on his siblingum.
text_bare: On anginne þisere worulde nam se broðor hys swuster to wife, and hwilon se fæder tymde bi his agenra dehter, and manega hæfdon ma wifa to folces eacan, and man ne mihte þa æt fruman wifian buton on his siblingum.

text: Gyf hwā wyle nū swā lybban æfter Crīstes tōcyme swā swā men leofodon ǣr Moises ǣ oððe under Moises ǣ, ne byð man nā Crīsten, nē hē furðon wyrðe ne byð þæt him ǣnig Crīsten man mid ete.
text_bare: Gyf hwa wyle nu swa lybban æfter Cristes tocyme swa swa men leofodon ær Moises æ oððe under Moises æ, ne byð man na Cristen, ne he furðon wyrðe ne byð þæt him ænig Cristen man mid ete.

text: Þā ungelǣredan prēostas, gif hī hwæt lītles understandað of þām Lȳdenbōcum, þonne þincð him sōna þæt hī magon mǣre lārēowas bēon; ac hī ne cunnon swā þēah þæt gāstlīce andgit þǣr tō, and hū sēo ealde ǣ wæs getācnung tōweardra þinga oððe hū sēo nīwe gecȳðnis æfter Crīstes menniscnisse wæs gefillednys ealra þǣra þinga, þe sēo ealde gecȳðnis getācnode tōwearde be Crīste and be hys gecorenum.
text_bare: Þa ungelæredan preostas, gif hi hwæt litles understandað of þam Lydenbocum, þonne þincð him sona þæt hi magon mære lareowas beon; ac hi ne cunnon swa þeah þæt gastlice andgit þær to, and hu seo ealde æ wæs getacnung toweardra þinga oððe hu seo niwe gecyðnis æfter Cristes menniscnisse wæs gefillednys ealra þæra þinga, þe seo ealde gecyðnis getacnode towearde be Criste and be hys gecorenum.

text: Hī cwæðað ēac oft be Paul, hwī hī ne mōton habban wīf swā swā Pētrus sē apostol hæfde, and hī nellað gehīran nē witan þæt sē ēadiga Pētrus leofede æfter Moises ǣ oð þæt Crīst þe on þām tīman tō mannum cōn and began tō bodienne his hālige godspel and gecēas Pētrum ǣrest him tō gefēran: þā forlēt Pētrus þǣr rihte his wīf and ealle þā twelf apostolas, þā þe wīf hæfdon, forlēton ǣgðer ge wīf ge ǣhta, and folgodon Crīstes lāre tō þǣre nīwan ǣ and clǣnnisse þe hē silf þā ārǣrde.
text_bare: Hi cwæðað eac oft be Paul, hwi hi ne moton habban wif swa swa Petrus se apostol hæfde, and hi nellað gehiran ne witan þæt se eadiga Petrus leofede æfter Moises æ oð þæt Crist þe on þam timan to mannum con and began to bodienne his halige godspel and geceas Petrum ærest him to geferan: þa forlet Petrus þær rihte his wif and ealle þa twelf apostolas, þa þe wif hæfdon, forleton ægðer ge wif ge æhta, and folgodon Cristes lare to þære niwan æ and clænnisse þe he silf þa arærde.

text: Prēostas sindon gesette tō lārēowum þām lǣwedum folce.
text_bare: Preostas sindon gesette to lareowum þam læwedum folce.

text: Nū gedafnode him þæt hig cūðon þā ealdan ǣ gāstlīce understandan and hwæt Crīst silf tǣhte and his apostolas on þǣre nīwan gecȳðnisse, þæt hig mihton þām folce wel wissian tō Godes gelēafan and wel bīsnian tō gōdum weorcum.
text_bare: Nu gedafnode him þæt hig cuðon þa ealdan æ gastlice understandan and hwæt Crist silf tæhte and his apostolas on þære niwan gecyðnisse, þæt hig mihton þam folce wel wissian to Godes geleafan and wel bisnian to godum weorcum.

text: Wē secgað ēac foran tō þæt sēo bōc is swīðe dēop gāstlīce tō understandenne, and wē ne wrītað nā māre būton þā nacedan gerecednisse.
text_bare: We secgað eac foran to þæt seo boc is swiðe deop gastlice to understandenne, and we ne writað na mare buton þa nacedan gerecednisse.

text: Þonne þincð þām ungelǣredum þæt eall þæt andgit bēo belocen on þǣre ānfealdan gerecednisse; ac hit ys swīðe feor þām.
text_bare: Þonne þincð þam ungelæredum þæt eall þæt andgit beo belocen on þære anfealdan gerecednisse; ac hit ys swiðe feor þam.

text: Sēo bōc ys gehaten Genesis, þæt ys 'gecyndbōc,' for þām þe hēo ys firmest bōca and spricð be ǣlcum gecinde: ac hēo ne spricð nā be þǣra engla gesceapenisse.
text_bare: Seo boc ys gehaten Genesis, þæt ys 'gecyndboc,' for þam þe heo ys firmest boca and spricð be ælcum gecinde: ac heo ne spricð na be þæra engla gesceapenisse.

text: Hēo onginð þus: In principio creauit Deus celum and terram, þæt ys on Englisc, 'On annginne gescēop God heofenan and eorðan.' Hit wæs sōðlīce swā gedōn þæt God ælmihtig geworhte on anginne þā þā hē wolde gesceafta.
text_bare: Heo onginð þus: In principio creauit Deus celum and terram, þæt ys on Englisc, 'On annginne gesceop God heofenan and eorðan.' Hit wæs soðlice swa gedon þæt God ælmihtig geworhte on anginne þa þa he wolde gesceafta.

text: Ac swā þēah æfter gāstlīcum andgite þæt anginn ys Crīst, swā swā hē sylf cwæð tō þām Iūdēiscum: 'Ic ēom angin, þe tō ēow sprece.' Ðurh þis angin worhte God Fæder heofenan and eorðan, for þan þe hē gescēop ealle gesceafta þurh þone Sunu sē þe was ǣfre of him āccenned wīsdōm of þām wīsan Fæder.
text_bare: Ac swa þeah æfter gastlicum andgite þæt anginn ys Crist, swa swa he sylf cwæð to þam Iudeiscum: 'Ic eom angin, þe to eow sprece.' Ðurh þis angin worhte God Fæder heofenan and eorðan, for þan þe he gesceop ealle gesceafta þurh þone Sunu se þe was æfre of him accenned wisdom of þam wisan Fæder.

text: Eft stynt on þǣre bēc on þām forman ferse: Spiritus dei ferebatur super aquas, þæt is on Englisc, 'And Godes Gāst wæs geferod ofer wæteru.
text_bare: Eft stynt on þære bec on þam forman ferse: Spiritus dei ferebatur super aquas, þæt is on Englisc, 'And Godes Gast wæs geferod ofer wæteru.

text: Godes Gāst ys sē Hālga Gāst þurh þone gelīffæste sē Fæder ealle þā gesceafta þā hē gescēop þurh þone sunu, and sē Hālga Gāst færð geond manna heortan and silð ūs synna forgifenisse, ǣrest þurh wæter on þām fulluhte and siððan þurh dǣdbōte; and gif hwā forsihð þā forgifenisse þe sē Hālga Gāst sylð, þonne bið his synn ǣfre unmyltsiendlīc on ēcnysse.
text_bare: Godes Gast ys se Halga Gast þurh þone geliffæste se Fæder ealle þa gesceafta þa he gesceop þurh þone sunu, and se Halga Gast færð geond manna heortan and silð us synna forgifenisse, ærest þurh wæter on þam fulluhte and siððan þurh dædbote; and gif hwa forsihð þa forgifenisse þe se Halga Gast sylð, þonne bið his synn æfre unmyltsiendlic on ecnysse.

text: Eft ys sēo hālige þrīnnys geswutelod on þisre bēc, swā swā ys on þām worde þe God cwæð: 'Uton wircean mannan tō ūre anlīcnisse.' Mid þām þe hē cwæð, 'Uton wyrcean,' ys sēo þrīnnys gebicnod; mid þām þe hē cwæð, 'tō ūre anlīcnysse,' ys sēo sōðe ānnis geswutelod; hē ne cwæð nā menigfealdlice tō ūrum anlīcnissum, ac ānfealdlīce tō ūre anlīcnisse.
text_bare: Eft ys seo halige þrinnys geswutelod on þisre bec, swa swa ys on þam worde þe God cwæð: 'Uton wircean mannan to ure anlicnisse.' Mid þam þe he cwæð, 'Uton wyrcean,' ys seo þrinnys gebicnod; mid þam þe he cwæð, 'to ure anlicnysse,' ys seo soðe annis geswutelod; he ne cwæð na menigfealdlice to urum anlicnissum, ac anfealdlice to ure anlicnisse.

text: Eft cōmon þrī englas tō Abrahāme and hē spræc tō him eallum þrīm swā swa tō ānum.
text_bare: Eft comon þri englas to Abrahame and he spræc to him eallum þrim swa swa to anum.

text: Hū clipode Abēles blōd tō Gode būton swā swā ǣlces mannes misdǣda wrēgað hine tō Gode būtan wordum?
text_bare: Hu clipode Abeles blod to Gode buton swa swa ælces mannes misdæda wregað hine to Gode butan wordum?

text: Be þisum lītlan man mæg understandan hū dēop sēo bōc ys on gāstlicum andgite, þēah þe hēo mid leohlīcum wordum āwriten sig.
text_bare: Be þisum litlan man mæg understandan hu deop seo boc ys on gastlicum andgite, þeah þe heo mid leohlicum wordum awriten sig.

text: Eft Iōsēp, þe wæs geseald tō Egipta lande and hē āhredde ðæt folc wið þone miclan hunger, hæfde Crīstes getācnunge þe wæs geseald for ūs tō cwale and ūs āhredde fram þām ēcan hungre hellesūsle.
text_bare: Eft Iosep, þe wæs geseald to Egipta lande and he ahredde ðæt folc wið þone miclan hunger, hæfde Cristes getacnunge þe wæs geseald for us to cwale and us ahredde fram þam ecan hungre hellesusle.

text: Þæt micele geteld þe Moises worhte mid wundorlīcum cræfte on þām wēstene, swā swā him God sylf gedihte, hæfde getācnunge Godes gelaðunge þe hē silf āstealde þurh his apostolas mid menigfealdum frætewum and fægerum þēawum.
text_bare: Þæt micele geteld þe Moises worhte mid wundorlicum cræfte on þam westene, swa swa him God sylf gedihte, hæfde getacnunge Godes gelaðunge þe he silf astealde þurh his apostolas mid menigfealdum frætewum and fægerum þeawum.

text: Tō þām geweorce brōhte þæt folc gold and seolfor and dēorwurðe gimstānas and menigfealde mǣrða; sume ēac brōhton gātehǣr, swā swā sēo æ bebēad.
text_bare: To þam geweorce brohte þæt folc gold and seolfor and deorwurðe gimstanas and menigfealde mærða; sume eac brohton gatehær, swa swa seo æ bebead.

text: Þæt gold getācnode ūrne gelēafan and ūre gode ingehīd, þe wē Gode offrian sceolon; þæt seolfor getācnode Godes sprǣca and þā hālgan lāre, þe wē habban sceolon tō Godes weorcum; þā gimstānas getācnodon mislīce fægernissa on Godes mannum; þæt gātehǣr getācnode þā stīðan dǣdbōte þǣra manna, þe heora sinna behrēowsiað.
text_bare: Þæt gold getacnode urne geleafan and ure gode ingehid, þe we Gode offrian sceolon; þæt seolfor getacnode Godes spræca and þa halgan lare, þe we habban sceolon to Godes weorcum; þa gimstanas getacnodon mislice fægernissa on Godes mannum; þæt gatehær getacnode þa stiðan dædbote þæra manna, þe heora sinna behreowsiað.

text: Man offrode ēac fela cinna orf Gode tō lāce binnan þām getelde; be þām is swīðe menigfeald getācnung, and wæs beboden þæt sē tægel sceolde bēon gehāl ǣfre on þām nȳtene æt þǣre offrunge, for þǣre getacnunge þæt God wile þæt wē simle wel dōn oð ende ūres līfes: þonne bið sē tægel geoffrod on ūrum weorcum.
text_bare: Man offrode eac fela cinna orf Gode to lace binnan þam getelde; be þam is swiðe menigfeald getacnung, and wæs beboden þæt se tægel sceolde beon gehal æfre on þam nytene æt þære offrunge, for þære getacnunge þæt God wile þæt we simle wel don oð ende ures lifes: þonne bið se tægel geoffrod on urum weorcum.

text: Nū ys sēo foresǣde bōc on manegum stōwum swīðe nearolīce gesett, and þēah swīðe dēoplīce on þām gāstlīcum andgite, and hēo is swā geendebyrd swā swā God silf hig gedihte þām wrītere Moise, and wē durron nā māre āwrītan on Englisc þonne þæt Lēden hæfð, nē þā endebirdnisse āwendan būton þām ānum, þæt þæt Lēden and þæt Englisc nabbað nā āne wīsan on þǣre sprǣce fandunge.
text_bare: Nu ys seo foresæde boc on manegum stowum swiðe nearolice gesett, and þeah swiðe deoplice on þam gastlicum andgite, and heo is swa geendebyrd swa swa God silf hig gedihte þam writere Moise, and we durron na mare awritan on Englisc þonne þæt Leden hæfð, ne þa endebirdnisse awendan buton þam anum, þæt þæt Leden and þæt Englisc nabbað na ane wisan on þære spræce fandunge.

text: Ǣfre sē þe āwent oððe sē þe tǣcð of Lēdene on Englisc, ǣfre hē sceal gefadian hit swā þæt þæt Englisc hæbbe his āgene wīsan, elles hit bið swīðe gedwolsum tō rǣdenne þām þe þæs Lēdenes wīsan ne can.
text_bare: Æfre se þe awent oððe se þe tæcð of Ledene on Englisc, æfre he sceal gefadian hit swa þæt þæt Englisc hæbbe his agene wisan, elles hit bið swiðe gedwolsum to rædenne þam þe þæs Ledenes wisan ne can.

text: Is ēac tō witene þæt sume gedwolmen wǣron þe woldon āwurpan þā ealdan ǣ, and sume woldon habban þā ealdan and āwurpan þā nīwan, swā þā Iūdēiscean dōð; ac Crīst sylf and his apostolas ūs tǣhton ægðer tō healdenne þā ealdan gāstlīce and þā nīwan sōðlīce mid weorcum.
text_bare: Is eac to witene þæt sume gedwolmen wæron þe woldon awurpan þa ealdan æ, and sume woldon habban þa ealdan and awurpan þa niwan, swa þa Iudeiscean doð; ac Crist sylf and his apostolas us tæhton ægðer to healdenne þa ealdan gastlice and þa niwan soðlice mid weorcum.

text: God gescēop ūs twā ēagan and twā ēaran, twā nosðirlu, twēgen weleras, twā handa and twegen fēt, and hē wolde ēac habban twā gecȳðnissa on þissere worulde gesett, þā ealdan and þā nīwan; for þām þe hē dēð swā swā hine silfne gewyrð, and hē nǣnne rǣdboran næfð, nē nān man ne þearf him cweðan tō, 'Hwī dēst ðū swā?' Wē sceolon āwendan ūrne willan tō his gesetnissum, and wē ne magon gebīgean his gesetnissa on ūrum lustum.
text_bare: God gesceop us twa eagan and twa earan, twa nosðirlu, twegen weleras, twa handa and twegen fet, and he wolde eac habban twa gecyðnissa on þissere worulde gesett, þa ealdan and þa niwan; for þam þe he deð swa swa hine silfne gewyrð, and he nænne rædboran næfð, ne nan man ne þearf him cweðan to, 'Hwi dest ðu swa?' We sceolon awendan urne willan to his gesetnissum, and we ne magon gebigean his gesetnissa on urum lustum.

text: Ic cweðe nū þæt ic ne dearr ne ic nelle nāne bōc æfter þissere of Lēdene on Englisc āwendan; and ic bidde þē, lēof ealdorman, þæt þū mē þæs nā leng ne bidde, þī lǣs þe ic bēo þē ungehīrsum, oððe lēas gif ic dō.
text_bare: Ic cweðe nu þæt ic ne dearr ne ic nelle nane boc æfter þissere of Ledene on Englisc awendan; and ic bidde þe, leof ealdorman, þæt þu me þæs na leng ne bidde, þi læs þe ic beo þe ungehirsum, oððe leas gif ic do.

text: God þē sig milde ā on ēcnisse.
text_bare: God þe sig milde a on ecnisse.

text: Ic bidde nū on Godes naman, gif hwā þās bōc āwrītan wylle, þæt hē hig gerihte wel be þǣre bȳsne, for þan þe ic nāh geweald, þēah þe hig hwā tō wōge bringe þurh lēase wrīteras, and hit byð þonne his pleoh nā mīn: mycel yfel dēð sē unwrītere, gif hē nele his wōh gerihtan.
text_bare: Ic bidde nu on Godes naman, gif hwa þas boc awritan wylle, þæt he hig gerihte wel be þære bysne, for þan þe ic nah geweald, þeah þe hig hwa to woge bringe þurh lease writeras, and hit byð þonne his pleoh na min: mycel yfel deð se unwritere, gif he nele his woh gerihtan.

text: Hēr segð þæt æfter þām þe Drihten Hǣlend Crīst tō heofonum āstāh, þæt þā apostolī wǣron ætsomne; and hīe sendon hlot him bewēonum, hwider hyra gehywlc faran scolde tō lǣranne.
text_bare: Her segð þæt æfter þam þe Drihten Hælend Crist to heofonum astah, þæt þa apostoli wæron ætsomne; and hie sendon hlot him beweonum, hwider hyra gehywlc faran scolde to læranne.

text: Secþ þæt sē ēadiga Mathēus gehlēat tō Marmadonia þǣre ceastre; secgh þonne þæt þā men þe on þǣre ceastre wǣron þæt hī hlāf ne ǣton, nē wæter ne druncon, ac ǣton manna līchaman and heora blōd druncon; and ǣghwylc man þe on þǣr ceastre cōm ælþēodisc, secð þæt hīe hine sōna genāmon and his ēagan ūt āstungon, and hI-e him sealdon āttor drincan þæt mid myclum lybcræfte wæs geblanden, and mid þȳ þe hīe þone drenc druncon, hraþe heora heorte wæs tōlēsed and heora mōd onwended.
text_bare: Secþ þæt se eadiga Matheus gehleat to Marmadonia þære ceastre; secgh þonne þæt þa men þe on þære ceastre wæron þæt hi hlaf ne æton, ne wæter ne druncon, ac æton manna lichaman and heora blod druncon; and æghwylc man þe on þær ceastre com ælþeodisc, secð þæt hie hine sona genamon and his eagan ut astungon, and hI-e him sealdon attor drincan þæt mid myclum lybcræfte wæs geblanden, and mid þy þe hie þone drenc druncon, hraþe heora heorte wæs tolesed and heora mod onwended.

text: Sē ēadiga Mathēus þā in ēode on þā ceastre, and hraðe hīe hine genāmon and his eāgan ūt āstungan.
text_bare: Se eadiga Matheus þa in eode on þa ceastre, and hraðe hie hine genamon and his eagan ut astungan.

text: And hīe him sealdon āttor drincan and hine sendon on carcerne, and hīe hine hēton þæt āttor etan and hē hit etan nolde; for þon þe his heorte næs tōlēsed, ne his mōd onwended; ac hē wæs simle tō Drihtne biddende mid myclum wōpe and cwæð tō him, 'Mīn Drihten Hǣlend Crīst, for þon wē ealle forlēton ūre cnēorisse, and wǣron þē fylgende and þū eart ūre ealra fultum, þā þe on þē gelȳfaþ, beheald nū and geseoh hū þās men þīnum þēowe dōð.
text_bare: And hie him sealdon attor drincan and hine sendon on carcerne, and hie hine heton þæt attor etan and he hit etan nolde; for þon þe his heorte næs tolesed, ne his mod onwended; ac he wæs simle to Drihtne biddende mid myclum wope and cwæð to him, 'Min Drihten Hælend Crist, for þon we ealle forleton ure cneorisse, and wæron þe fylgende and þu eart ure ealra fultum, þa þe on þe gelyfaþ, beheald nu and geseoh hu þas men þinum þeowe doð.

text: And ic þe biddē, Drihten, þæt þū mē forgife mīnra ēagna lēoht þæt ic gesēo þā þe mē onginnað dōn on þisse ceastre þā weorstan tintrego; and ne forlǣt mē, mīn Drihten Hǣlende Crīst, nē mē ne sele on þone bitterestan dēaþ.'
text_bare: And ic þe bidde, Drihten, þæt þu me forgife minra eagna leoht þæt ic geseo þa þe me onginnað don on þisse ceastre þa weorstan tintrego; and ne forlæt me, min Drihten Hælende Crist, ne me ne sele on þone bitterestan deaþ.'

text: Mid þȳ þe hē þis gebed sē ēadiga Mathēus gecweden hæfde, mycel lēoht and beorht onlēohte þæt carcern, and Drihtnes stefn wæs geworden tō him on þǣm lēohte cweþende, 'Mathēus, mīn sē lēofa, beheald on mē.' Mathēus þā lōciende, hē geseah Drihten Crīst, and eft Drihtnes stefn wæs geworden tō him cweþende, 'Mathēus, wes þū gestrangod and ne ondrǣd þū þē, for þon ne forlǣt ic þē ǣfre, ac ic þē gefrēolsige of ealra frēcennesse, and nālæs þæt ān, ac simle ealle þīne brōðor, and ealle þā þe on mē gelȳfaþ on eallum tīdum oþ ēcnesse.
text_bare: Mid þy þe he þis gebed se eadiga Matheus gecweden hæfde, mycel leoht and beorht onleohte þæt carcern, and Drihtnes stefn wæs geworden to him on þæm leohte cweþende, 'Matheus, min se leofa, beheald on me.' Matheus þa lociende, he geseah Drihten Crist, and eft Drihtnes stefn wæs geworden to him cweþende, 'Matheus, wes þu gestrangod and ne ondræd þu þe, for þon ne forlæt ic þe æfre, ac ic þe gefreolsige of ealra frecennesse, and nalæs þæt an, ac simle ealle þine broðor, and ealle þa þe on me gelyfaþ on eallum tidum oþ ecnesse.

text: Ac onbīd hēr seofon and twēntig nihta, and æfter þan ic sende tō þē Andrēas, þīnne brōþor and hē þē ūt ālǣdeþ of þissum carcerne, and ealle þā þe mid þē syndon.' Mid þȳ þe þis gecweden wæs, Drihten him eft tō cwæð, 'Sib sē mid þē, Mathēus.' Hē þā þurhwuniende mid gebedum and Drihtnes lof singende on þām carcerne.
text_bare: Ac onbid her seofon and twentig nihta, and æfter þan ic sende to þe Andreas, þinne broþor and he þe ut alædeþ of þissum carcerne, and ealle þa þe mid þe syndon.' Mid þy þe þis gecweden wæs, Drihten him eft to cwæð, 'Sib se mid þe, Matheus.' He þa þurhwuniende mid gebedum and Drihtnes lof singende on þam carcerne.

text: And þā unrihtan men in ēodon in þæt carcern þæt hīe þā men ūt lǣdan woldon and him tō mete dōn.
text_bare: And þa unrihtan men in eodon in þæt carcern þæt hie þa men ut lædan woldon and him to mete don.

text: Sē ēadiga Mathēus þā betȳnde his ēagan þȳ lǣs þā cwelleras gesāwan þæt his ēagan geopenede wǣron, and he cwǣdon him betwynum, 'Þrȳ dagas nū tō lafe syndon þæt wē hine willað ācwellan and ūs tō mete gedōn.'
text_bare: Se eadiga Matheus þa betynde his eagan þy læs þa cwelleras gesawan þæt his eagan geopenede wæron, and he cwædon him betwynum, 'Þry dagas nu to lafe syndon þæt we hine willað acwellan and us to mete gedon.'

text: Se ēadiga Mathēus þā gefelde daga.
text_bare: Se eadiga Matheus þa gefelde daga.

text: Ðā Drihten Hǣlend Crīst cwǣð to Andrēa his apostole, mid þī þe hē wæs in Achāia þām lande and þǣr lǣrde his discipuli, hē cwǣð, 'Gang on Marmadonia ceastre and ālǣd þanon Mathēum þīnne brōþor of þǣm carcerne, for þon þe nū gīt þrȳ dagas tō lāfe syndon, þæt hīe hine willað ācwellan and him tō mete gedōn.' Sē hāliga Andrēas him andswarode, and hē cwǣð, 'Mīn Drihten Hǣlend Crīst, hū mæg ic hit on þrīm dagum gefaran?
text_bare: Ða Drihten Hælend Crist cwæð to Andrea his apostole, mid þi þe he wæs in Achaia þam lande and þær lærde his discipuli, he cwæð, 'Gang on Marmadonia ceastre and alæd þanon Matheum þinne broþor of þæm carcerne, for þon þe nu git þry dagas to lafe syndon, þæt hie hine willað acwellan and him to mete gedon.' Se haliga Andreas him andswarode, and he cwæð, 'Min Drihten Hælend Crist, hu mæg ic hit on þrim dagum gefaran?

text: Ac mā wēn is þæt þū onsende þīnne engel sē hit mæg hrædlīcor gefaran, for þon, mīn Drihten, þū wast þæt ic eam flǣsclīc man, and ic hit ne mǣg hrædlīce gefaran, for þon þe, mīn Drihten, sē sīðfæt is þider tō lang, and ic þone weg ne can.' Drihten him tō cwǣð, 'Andrēas, gehēr me, for þon þe ic þē geworhte and ic þīnne sīð gestaþelode and getrymede.
text_bare: Ac ma wen is þæt þu onsende þinne engel se hit mæg hrædlicor gefaran, for þon, min Drihten, þu wast þæt ic eam flæsclic man, and ic hit ne mæg hrædlice gefaran, for þon þe, min Drihten, se siðfæt is þider to lang, and ic þone weg ne can.' Drihten him to cwæð, 'Andreas, geher me, for þon þe ic þe geworhte and ic þinne sið gestaþelode and getrymede.

text: Gang nū tō þæs sǣs waroðe mid þīnum discipulum, and þū þǣr gemētest scip on þām waroðe; and astīg on þæt mid þīnum discipulum.' And mid þȳ þe hē þis cwæð, 'Sib mid þē and mid eallum þīnum discipulum.' And hē āstāg on heofonas.
text_bare: Gang nu to þæs sæs waroðe mid þinum discipulum, and þu þær gemetest scip on þam waroðe; and astig on þæt mid þinum discipulum.' And mid þy þe he þis cwæð, 'Sib mid þe and mid eallum þinum discipulum.' And he astag on heofonas.

text: Sē hāliga Andrēas þā ārās on mergen, and hē ēode tō þǣre sǣ mid his discipulum and hē geseah scip on þām waroðe and ðrȳ weras on þām sittende; and hē wæs gefēonde mid mycle gefēan and him tō cwæð, 'Brōðor, hwider wille gē faran mid þīs medmiclum scipe?' Drihten Hǣlend wæs on þām scipe swā sē stēorrēðra, and his twēgen englas mid him, þā wǣron gehwyrfede on manna onsȳne.
text_bare: Se haliga Andreas þa aras on mergen, and he eode to þære sæ mid his discipulum and he geseah scip on þam waroðe and ðry weras on þam sittende; and he wæs gefeonde mid mycle gefean and him to cwæð, 'Broðor, hwider wille ge faran mid þis medmiclum scipe?' Drihten Hælend wæs on þam scipe swa se steorreðra, and his twegen englas mid him, þa wæron gehwyrfede on manna onsyne.

text: Drihten Crīst him þā tō cwæð, 'On Marmadonia ceastre.' Sē hāliga Andrēas him andswarode and hē cwæð, 'Brōðor, onfōh ūs mid ēow on þæt scip and gelǣdað ūs on þā ceastre.' Drihten him tō cwæð, 'Ealle men flēoð of þǣre ceastre; tō hwǣm wille gē þider faran?' Sē hāliga Andrēas him andswarode, hē cwæð, 'Medmycel ǣrende wē þider habbaþ and ūs is þearf þæt wē hit gefyllon.' Drihten Hǣlend him tō cwæð, "Astīgaþ on þis scip tō ūs, and sellað ūs ēowerne færsceat.' Sē hāliga Andrēas him andswarode, 'Gehȳrað gebrōþor, nabbað wē færsceat, ac wē syndon discipulī Drihtnes Hǣlendes Crīstes, þā hē gecēas, and þis bebod hē ūs sealde and hē cwæð, "Þonne gē faren godspel tō lǣrenne, þonne nabbe gē mid ēow hlāf nē feoh, nē twīfeald hrægl." Gif þū þonne wille milðeortnesse mid ūs dōn, saga ūs þæt hrædlīce; gif þū þonne nelle, gecȳð ūs þone weg.' Drihten Hǣlend him tō cwæð, 'Gif þis gebod ēow wǣre geseald fram ēowrun Drihtene, āstīgaþ hider mid gefēan on mīn scip.'
text_bare: Drihten Crist him þa to cwæð, 'On Marmadonia ceastre.' Se haliga Andreas him andswarode and he cwæð, 'Broðor, onfoh us mid eow on þæt scip and gelædað us on þa ceastre.' Drihten him to cwæð, 'Ealle men fleoð of þære ceastre; to hwæm wille ge þider faran?' Se haliga Andreas him andswarode, he cwæð, 'Medmycel ærende we þider habbaþ and us is þearf þæt we hit gefyllon.' Drihten Hælend him to cwæð, "Astigaþ on þis scip to us, and sellað us eowerne færsceat.' Se haliga Andreas him andswarode, 'Gehyrað gebroþor, nabbað we færsceat, ac we syndon discipuli Drihtnes Hælendes Cristes, þa he geceas, and þis bebod he us sealde and he cwæð, "Þonne ge faren godspel to lærenne, þonne nabbe ge mid eow hlaf ne feoh, ne twifeald hrægl." Gif þu þonne wille milðeortnesse mid us don, saga us þæt hrædlice; gif þu þonne nelle, gecyð us þone weg.' Drihten Hælend him to cwæð, 'Gif þis gebod eow wære geseald fram eowrun Drihtene, astigaþ hider mid gefean on min scip.'

text: Sē hālga Andrēas āstāh on þæt scip mid his discipulum, and hē gesæt beforan þām stēorrēþran, þæt wæs Drihten Hǣlend Crīst.
text_bare: Se halga Andreas astah on þæt scip mid his discipulum, and he gesæt beforan þam steorreþran, þæt wæs Drihten Hælend Crist.

text: Drihten Hǣlend him tō cwǣð, 'Ic gesēo for þon þe þās brōðor synt geswencede of þisse sǣwe hrēohnesse; ācsa hīe hwæþer hī woldon tō lande āstīgan and þīn þǣr onbīdan oþ þæt þū gefylle þīne þēnunge tō þǣre þe þū sended eart, and þū þonne eft hwyrfest tō him.' Sē hālga Andrēas him tō cwǣð, 'Mīne bearn, wille gē tō lande faran and mīn þǣr onbīdan?' His discipuli him andswarodon, and hīe cwǣdon, 'Gif wē gewītað fram þē, þonne bēo wē fremde fram eallum þām gōdum þe þū ūs gearwodest; ac wē bēoþ mid þe swā hwyder swā þū færest.' Drihten Hǣlend him tō cwǣð, tō þām hālgan Andrēa, 'Gif þū sȳ sōðlīce his discipul sē is cweden Crīst, spec tō þīnum discipulum be þām mægenum þe þīn Lārēow dyde, þæt sīe geblētsod heora heorte, and hīe ofergieton þisse sǣwe ege.' Sē hāliga Andrēas cwæð tō his discipulum, 'Sumre tīde mid þī þe wē wǣron mid ūrum Drihtne, wē āstigon mid him on scip; hē ætȳwde ūs swā hē slæpende wǣre tō costianne, and dyde swīþe hrēoge þā sǣ; fram þām winde wæs geworden swā þæt þā selfan ȳþa wǣron āhafene ofer þæt scip.
text_bare: Drihten Hælend him to cwæð, 'Ic geseo for þon þe þas broðor synt geswencede of þisse sæwe hreohnesse; acsa hie hwæþer hi woldon to lande astigan and þin þær onbidan oþ þæt þu gefylle þine þenunge to þære þe þu sended eart, and þu þonne eft hwyrfest to him.' Se halga Andreas him to cwæð, 'Mine bearn, wille ge to lande faran and min þær onbidan?' His discipuli him andswarodon, and hie cwædon, 'Gif we gewitað fram þe, þonne beo we fremde fram eallum þam godum þe þu us gearwodest; ac we beoþ mid þe swa hwyder swa þu færest.' Drihten Hælend him to cwæð, to þam halgan Andrea, 'Gif þu sy soðlice his discipul se is cweden Crist, spec to þinum discipulum be þam mægenum þe þin Lareow dyde, þæt sie gebletsod heora heorte, and hie ofergieton þisse sæwe ege.' Se haliga Andreas cwæð to his discipulum, 'Sumre tide mid þi þe we wæron mid urum Drihtne, we astigon mid him on scip; he ætywde us swa he slæpende wære to costianne, and dyde swiþe hreoge þa sæ; fram þam winde wæs geworden swa þæt þa selfan yþa wæron ahafene ofer þæt scip.

text: Wē ūs þā swīþe andrēdon and cīgdon tō him, Drihtne Hǣlendum Crīste.
text_bare: We us þa swiþe andredon and cigdon to him, Drihtne Hælendum Criste.

text: And hē þā ārās and bebead þām winde þæt hē gestilde, ðā wæs geworden mycel smyltnes on þǣre sǣ.
text_bare: And he þa aras and bebead þam winde þæt he gestilde, ða wæs geworden mycel smyltnes on þære sæ.

text: And hī hine ondrēdon, ealle þā þe his weorc gesāwon.
text_bare: And hi hine ondredon, ealle þa þe his weorc gesawon.

text: Nū þonne, mīne bearn, ne ondrǣdaþ gē ēow, for þon þe ūre God ūs ne forlǣteþ.'
text_bare: Nu þonne, mine bearn, ne ondrædaþ ge eow, for þon þe ure God us ne forlæteþ.'

text: And þus cweþende, sē hālga Andrēas sette his hēafod ofer ǣnne his discipula and hē onslēp.
text_bare: And þus cweþende, se halga Andreas sette his heafod ofer ænne his discipula and he onslep.

text: Drihten Hǣlend þā wiste for þon þe sē hālga Andrēas þā slēp, hē cwǣð tō his englum, 'Genimað Andrēas and his discipulī, and āsettaþ hīe beforan Marmadonia ceastre; and mid þī þe gē hīe þǣr āsetton, hweorfað eft tō mē.' And þā englas dydon swā heom beboden wæs, and hē āstāh on heofonas.
text_bare: Drihten Hælend þa wiste for þon þe se halga Andreas þa slep, he cwæð to his englum, 'Genimað Andreas and his discipuli, and asettaþ hie beforan Marmadonia ceastre; and mid þi þe ge hie þær asetton, hweorfað eft to me.' And þa englas dydon swa heom beboden wæs, and he astah on heofonas.

text: Þā sē mergen geworden wæs, þā sē hāliga Andrēas licgende wæs beforan Marmadonia ceastre, and his discipulōs þǣr slǣpende wǣron mid him; and hē hīe āweahte and cwæð, 'Ārīsað gē, mīne bearn, and ongitað Godes milðeortnesse sīo is nū mid ūs geworden.
text_bare: Þa se mergen geworden wæs, þa se haliga Andreas licgende wæs beforan Marmadonia ceastre, and his discipulos þær slæpende wæron mid him; and he hie aweahte and cwæð, 'Arisað ge, mine bearn, and ongitað Godes milðeortnesse sio is nu mid us geworden.

text: Wē witon þæt ūre Drihten mid ūs wæs on þām scipe and wē hine ne ongēaton; hē hine geēaðmēdde swā stēorrēþra and hē hine ætēowde swā man ūs tō costienne.' Sē hālga Andrēas þā lōcode tō heofonum, and hē cwæð, 'Mīn Drihten Hǣlend Crīst, ic wāt þæt þū ne eart feor fram þīnum þēowum, and ic þē behēold on þām scype, and ic wæs tō þē sprecende swā tō men.
text_bare: We witon þæt ure Drihten mid us wæs on þam scipe and we hine ne ongeaton; he hine geeaðmedde swa steorreþra and he hine æteowde swa man us to costienne.' Se halga Andreas þa locode to heofonum, and he cwæð, 'Min Drihten Hælend Crist, ic wat þæt þu ne eart feor fram þinum þeowum, and ic þe beheold on þam scype, and ic wæs to þe sprecende swa to men.

text: Nū þonne, Drihten, ic þē bidde þæt þū mē þe onȳwe on þisse stōwe.' Þā þis gecweden wæs, þā Drihten him ætȳwde his onsȳne on fægeres cildes hīwe and him tō cwæð, 'Andrēas, gefeoh mid þīnum discipulum.' Sē hālga Andrēas þā hine gebæd and cwæð, 'Forgif me, mīn Drihten, þæt ic to þē sprecende wæs swā tō men; and wen is þæt ic gefirnode, for þon ic þe ne ongeat.' Drihten him þā tō cwæð, 'Andrēas, nǣnig wuht þū gefirnodest, ac for þon ic swā dyde, for þon þū swā cwǣde þæt þū hit ne meahtes on ðrīm dagum þider gefēran; for þon ic þē swā ætēowde, for þon ic eom mihtig mid worde swā eall tō dōnne, and ānra gehwilcum tō ætēowenne swā swā mē līcað.
text_bare: Nu þonne, Drihten, ic þe bidde þæt þu me þe onywe on þisse stowe.' Þa þis gecweden wæs, þa Drihten him ætywde his onsyne on fægeres cildes hiwe and him to cwæð, 'Andreas, gefeoh mid þinum discipulum.' Se halga Andreas þa hine gebæd and cwæð, 'Forgif me, min Drihten, þæt ic to þe sprecende wæs swa to men; and wen is þæt ic gefirnode, for þon ic þe ne ongeat.' Drihten him þa to cwæð, 'Andreas, nænig wuht þu gefirnodest, ac for þon ic swa dyde, for þon þu swa cwæde þæt þu hit ne meahtes on ðrim dagum þider geferan; for þon ic þe swa æteowde, for þon ic eom mihtig mid worde swa eall to donne, and anra gehwilcum to æteowenne swa swa me licað.

text: Nū þonne ārīs, and gā on þā ceastre tō Mathēum þīnum brēþer, and lǣt þonne hine of þǣre ceastre, and ealle þā þe mid him syndon.
text_bare: Nu þonne aris, and ga on þa ceastre to Matheum þinum breþer, and læt þonne hine of þære ceastre, and ealle þa þe mid him syndon.

text: Eno ic þē gecȳþe, Andrēas, for þon þe manega tintrega hīe þē on bringað, and þīnne līchaman geond þisse ceastre lonan hīe tōstencaþ swā þæt þīn blōd flowð ofer eorðan swā swā wæter.
text_bare: Eno ic þe gecyþe, Andreas, for þon þe manega tintrega hie þe on bringað, and þinne lichaman geond þisse ceastre lonan hie tostencaþ swa þæt þin blod flowð ofer eorðan swa swa wæter.

text: Tō dēaþe hīe þē willaþ gelǣdan, ac hī ne magon; ac manega earfoðnessa hīe þē magon on gebringan; ac þonne hwæþere ārefna þū þā ealle, Andrēas, and ne dō þū æfter heora ungelēafulnesse.
text_bare: To deaþe hie þe willaþ gelædan, ac hi ne magon; ac manega earfoðnessa hie þe magon on gebringan; ac þonne hwæþere arefna þu þa ealle, Andreas, and ne do þu æfter heora ungeleafulnesse.

text: Gemune hū manega earfoðnesse fram Iūdēum ic wæs þrōwiende, þā hīe mē swungon, and hīe mē spǣtton on mīne onsȳne; ac eall ic hit āræfnede þæt ic ēow ætēowe hwylce gemete gē sculon āræfnan.
text_bare: Gemune hu manega earfoðnesse fram Iudeum ic wæs þrowiende, þa hie me swungon, and hie me spætton on mine onsyne; ac eall ic hit aræfnede þæt ic eow æteowe hwylce gemete ge sculon aræfnan.

text: Gehīere mē, Andrēas, and āræfna þās tintrego, for þon manige synt on þisse ceastre þā sculon gelēofan on mīnne naman.' Mid þī hē þis cwæð, Drihten Hǣlend Crīst, hē āstāh on heofonas.
